jobs.title: Senior Palantir Foundry Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Pivot Point Solutions** ========================= Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based technology consulting firm that specializes in delivering IT solutions and support for the construction and utility industries. We partner with organizations across the state to provide reliable technology services that improve operational efficiency, enhance project delivery, and support critical business systems. Our team understands the unique technology challenges facing construction and utility organizations, from field operations and infrastructure projects to enterprise applications and cybersecurity. By combining industry expertise with responsive service, we help clients modernize their technology environments, streamline workflows, and maintain secure, reliable IT systems that support long\-term growth. **Job Overview** ---------------- **Title:** Senior Palantir Foundry Data Engineer **Sector:** Information Technology / Data Engineering **Seniority:** Senior Level **Location:** Oakland, CA **Job Type:** Hybrid – 1 Day Onsite per Week **Contract Length:** 24 Months \+ **Compensation:** $53\-$80/hr **Role Overview** ----------------- Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced Senior Palantir Foundry Data Engineer to design, develop and support enterprise data pipelines, data products and operational solutions using Palantir Foundry. This position requires extensive hands\-on experience with PySpark, Python, SQL, Foundry Ontology, TypeScript and enterprise data integrations. The ideal candidate has experience developing production\-grade data engineering solutions in large enterprise environments, including real\-time data processing, data modeling and pipeline optimization. This individual will collaborate with architects, product owners, business stakeholders and engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable data solutions that support operational and business decision\-making. **Your Day\-to\-Day Activities** -------------------------------- * Design, develop and maintain enterprise data pipelines using Palantir Foundry, PySpark, Python and SQL. * Build and enhance Foundry Ontology models, including object types, properties, relationships and actions. * Develop real\-time and near\-real\-time data pipelines using Spark Streaming and event\-driven jobs.title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer, Data & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About the role** Keebler Health builds AI\-driven risk adjustment and hospitalization\-prevention products for healthcare organizations. Over the next few quarters we’re tripling the volume of clinical data we manage, and the systems that got us here won’t get us there. We’re looking for a hands\-on senior engineer to own the scaling of our data and AI infrastructure: storage, retrieval, model throughput, and the compute and network underneath it. This isn’t a greenfield role. You’ll work on real systems under real load in a HIPAA\-regulated AWS environment, alongside a small, senior team. This is a US\-based remote position. We have a strong preference for candidates based in North Carolina or New York, where our team hubs are. **What you’ll build** We’re tripling the clinical data we manage over the next few quarters. You’ll work on the data and AI platform that makes that growth routine rather than heroic, working in a HIPAA\-regulated AWS environment alongside a small, senior team. * **A retrieval layer that scales with the data.** Our embedding store is 8TB today and heading toward \~25TB. You’ll decide how semantic search is built for that scale: index strategy, quantization, partitioning, tiering, or a different storage engine entirely. You’ll set the latency and recall targets and the cost model behind them. * **A model gateway for every LLM workload.** Today, high\-volume workloads can run into provider rate limits. You’ll design the shared layer that all model traffic goes through: queueing and backpressure, batching, caching, prioritization, and routing across providers and models. The goal is that product teams never think about quotas. * **Network and cluster foundations that scale with us.** You’ll evolve the AWS networking and compute foundations behind our data and AI workloads, partnering with our DevOps engineer to anticipate capacity limits and address bottlenecks before they affect delivery. That could mean improving network addressing, cluster capacity, or resource utilization. * **A data architecture that separates workloads by design.** Bulk ingestion, transactional traffic, and analytics currently share Aurora. You’ll define how each should be served, whether through staging pipelines, replicas, CDC into a warehouse or lakehouse, or something else, so that ingestion volume can grow without touching application performance. * **A self\-hosted inference platform**. We already serve OCR models on vLLM and are expanding into open\-weight LLMs. You’ll build the platform around them: benchmarking and model selection, GPU capacity planning, autoscaling, throughput tuning, and a clear framework for which workloads belong on self\-hosted models versus commercial APIs. **Experience that’s relevant** You don’t need to have solved these exact problems before. We care about adjacent experience and sound judgment about tradeoffs. Strong candidates will have several of the following: * **Large\-scale search or retrieval systems.** This could be vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch k\-NN, Pinecone, Turbopuffer, Milvus), but classic search infrastructure (Elasticsearch/Lucene), recommender candidate retrieval, or any work tuning latency on large indexes is directly applicable. You should understand the tradeoffs between ANN index types, memory footprint, recall, and cost. * **High\-throughput systems built on quota\-limited dependencies.** Work in payments, ad\-tech, data integrations, or anywhere you’ve had to push large volumes through third\-party APIs with hard limits. You know how to use token buckets, priority queues, idempotent retries, and graceful degradation. * **Postgres at scale.** Deep experience with query planning, partitioning, bulk ingestion (COPY, staging tables, batching), connection management, and replica strategy. Aurora\-specific experience is a plus. Experience separating OLTP from analytical workloads (CDC into a warehouse or lakehouse, for example) is especially valuable. * **AWS networking and Kubernetes.** You’re comfortable with VPC design, subnet planning, and EKS networking (VPC CNI behavior, prefix delegation, secondary CIDRs, IPv6\), or you have the equivalent depth on another major cloud. * **Capacity planning and cost modeling.** You can project how a system behaves at 3x, identify which components scale nonlinearly, and make a cost\-aware case for when to optimize and when to re\-architect. * **Observability.** You instrument before you optimize, and you’re comfortable with metrics, tracing, and profiling across application and database layers. * **Production model inference.** Experience serving models on GPUs in production, whether that’s LLMs on vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or TensorRT\-LLM, or earlier\-generation serving on Triton or TorchServe. You should understand the levers that matter for throughput and cost, including continuous batching, KV cache memory, quantization (AWQ, GPTQ, FP8\), tensor parallelism, and GPU instance selection. Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes (node pools, the NVIDIA device plugin, Karpenter or a similar autoscaler) is especially relevant. **Nice to have** * Experience in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, or similar), including working under BAAs and data\-residency constraints * Familiarity with LLM application infrastructure: embedding pipelines, multi\-provider routing, Bedrock or OpenAI, batch inference APIs * Startup experience, where you were the person who both made the architectural decision and shipped it * Python and/or TypeScript fluency, plus infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CDK, Pulumi) **What success looks like in the first six months** Semantic search latency is well within product requirements at current volume, with a credible path to 3x. Model throughput is no longer a recurring incident category. Nightly loads complete without database alarms. The team has a capacity plan it trusts. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, equity options, and benefits package. * A fast\-paced, innovative environment. * Professional growth and development opportunities. * A collaborative and supportive team culture. * The chance to make a meaningful impact on the healthcare industry. Compensation Range: $190K \- $260K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agents
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Software Engineer, Agents **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Head of Engineering **About Plug** Plug is an automotive fintech startup that’s building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Sellers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing and battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Every vehicle Plug acquires is sold through a competitive wholesale auction, where franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated over $150M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. Join us as we build the AI\-native transaction rails behind the used EV market’s exponential growth. Learn more at plugmotors.com. **Why Plug** * You’ll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You’ll be part of an AI\-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You’ll ship constantly, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes. **The Opportunity** Plug runs on a lot of manual work: reading titles and inspection reports, chasing paperwork with dealers, checking vehicle details, answering sellers, and moving each car from offer to sale. Much of that work can be done by agents. We already run LLM features in production, and our engineers own the core platform: the marketplace, pricing, and the systems that tie them together. We’re looking for someone to join our team and help turn real operational problems into agents that work reliably, working closely with senior engineers as you grow into greater ownership over time. **What You’ll Do** * Build and ship agents and multi\-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling, with support from senior engineers on scope and architecture. * Use LangChain and LangGraph to build agents, and LangSmith or Langfuse to trace, debug, and evaluate them. * Write evals, build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and make regressions visible. * Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them. * Help monitor agents in production: cost, latency, error rates, and human\-review rates. Learn to identify and fix what breaks, and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time. * Ship full\-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them. * Contribute to the reusable tools, examples, and short write\-ups that help the team build agents faster, growing into helping others adopt these patterns as you build experience. **What You’ll Bring** * 3\+ years of full\-time industry software engineering, with experience shipping features to production and supporting them after launch. * Solid TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed. * Some hands\-on experience with LLM features in production (tool use, retrieval, structured output) or strong interest and aptitude for learning this quickly. * Familiarity with an agent framework and observability stack (LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or Langfuse) is a plus; we’re also open to candidates who’ve worked with other tools and can show us what you built. * Comfortable using agentic coding tools day to day, and curious about building your own tooling around them (skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals) as you grow. * Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan. * A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up. * You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, and sharing credit. * A proactive mindset in an ambiguous, fast\-moving startup. You’re eager to find valuable workflows to automate and ship against them with support from the team. * BS in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience with document\-heavy workflows such as titles, registrations, inspections, lending, or insurance. * Experience with vehicle, marketplace, or auction products. * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop review tools, or with fine\-tuning and prompt optimization for production LLM features. **Compensation and Benefits** Annual salary: $145,000 to $175,000 Salary ranges come from independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes. **Benefits \& Perks** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is an in\-person role based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time. **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Plug will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Sr Lead Network Engineer-Metro Network Dallas, TX & Denver, CO
jobs.description: **About Forged Fiber** At Forged Fiber, our mission is bold but simple: deliver fast, reliable, future\-proof connectivity that builds the foundation for everything online. As we execute, we believe the right way to do something is the only way. This foundation guides how the company builds, operates, and maintains a state\-of\-the\-art open\-access fiber network platform that empowers millions. Forged Fiber is about more than building a network. It is about people. Every role matters. Every contribution counts. Together, employees create impact through teamwork, trust, and a shared commitment to excellence. **Work Location: Dallas, TX or Denver, CO\-Hybrid** **The Role** ============ The Senior Lead Network Engineer is a highly experienced technical leader within the Architecture, Engineering, and Technology Support (AET) organization, responsible for the design, engineering, operational support, optimization, and long\-term evolution of the Metro and Transport IP network infrastructure. This role serves as a senior subject matter expert for carrier\-grade Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies, advanced routing architectures, Metro Ethernet services, transport networks, and multi\-vendor platforms supporting critical telecommunications services. The Senior Lead Network Engineer provides strategic technical leadership across Architecture, Engineering, Operations, Planning, and vendor organizations to ensure highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient network solutions. This role requires extensive experience supporting large\-scale Metro Ethernet and IP/MPLS environments, deep expertise in routing protocols and traffic engineering, and advanced knowledge of carrier\-class platforms from Cisco, Juniper, and Ciena. **The Main Responsibilities** ============================= **Network Design and Architecture** ----------------------------------- * Lead collaboration with Network Architecture teams to define, validate, and evolve Metro Ethernet, IP/MPLS, and transport network architectures. * Develop and maintain engineering standards governing Layer 2 and Layer 3 network design, resiliency, scalability, redundancy, and operational supportability. * Drive architecture reviews and network modernization initiatives. **Advanced Routing and MPLS Engineering** ----------------------------------------- * Serve as the primary technical authority for BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, MPLS, LDP, RSVP\-TE, Segment Routing, and route policy engineering. * Design, implement, and support large\-scale IPv4 and IPv6 routing architectures. * Lead resolution of complex routing convergence and protocol interoperability issues. **Metro Ethernet Engineering and Support** ------------------------------------------ * Serve as the senior technical authority for Metro Ethernet service delivery and operational support. * Support E\-Line, E\-LAN, EVPL, EPL and carrier Ethernet services. * Troubleshoot complex customer\-impacting Metro Ethernet issues across multiple domains. **Technology Evaluation and Validation** ---------------------------------------- * Lead lab validation and certification of hardware, software, routing features and transport services. * Evaluate Cisco, Juniper and Ciena technologies for deployment. **Collaboration and Coordination** ---------------------------------- * Provide technical leadership across Architecture, Engineering, Operations, NOC and Planning teams. * Mentor engineers and drive engineering best practices. **Tier 4 Operational Support** ------------------------------ * Serve as the highest level escalation point for outages and service disruptions. * Lead root cause analysis and preventative action planning. * Project Leadership * Lead modernization, migration and infrastructure expansion programs. **What We Look for in a Candidate** =================================== **Core Competencies** --------------------- * Expert knowledge of Layer 2/3 carrier networking. * Advanced expertise with BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, MPLS, Segment Routing and EVPN. * Deep understanding of Metro Ethernet operations and support. * Hands\-on knowledge of Cisco, Juniper and Ciena platforms. * Strong leadership and mentoring skills. **Education** ============= * Bachelor degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology or related discipline preferred. * CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, JNCIE or equivalent certifications highly desirable. **Experience** ============== **Required Experience:** ------------------------ * 7\+ years of service provider or telecommunications network engineering experience. * Extensive experience designing, implementing and supporting Metro Ethernet and IP/MPLS networks. * Direct experience supporting carrier\-grade Metro Ethernet services in a Tier 3 or Tier 4 engineering role. * Advanced experience with BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS and MPLS technologies. * Hands\-on experience with Cisco, Juniper and Ciena platforms. * Experience leading major network upgrades, migrations and modernization initiatives. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Segment Routing and EVPN architectures. * Python, Ansible and network automation platforms. * Telemetry, assurance and packet\-optical transport experience. * CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise or JNCIE\-SP certifications. **Compensation \& Benefits** This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary by location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience, and other relevant factors. Starting pay within this range is based on job\-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, certifications, and work location. Additional growth opportunities exist beyond the starting range through progression and performance. Forged Fiber also offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your physical, mental, emotional, and financial well\-being. **What to Expect Next** **Background Screening** If you are selected for a position, there will be a background screen, which may include checks for criminal records and/or motor vehicle reports and/or drug screening, depending on the position requirements. We do not tolerate unlawful discrimination in any employment decisions, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, promotion, benefits, discipline, termination, job assignments or training. In addition, Forged Fiber will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, and is a fair change employer and does not initiate a background check until after an offer is made. © 2026 Forged Fiber 37 Services, LLC

jobs.title: Sr Systems Engineer, Information Technology
jobs.description: **Location:** Allston, MA and Woburn, MA **About Terrestrial Bio, Inc.** Terrestrial is transforming the delivery of next\-generation therapies, starting with GLP\-1\. Terrestrial’s proprietary Tacterra microarray patch (MAP) and applicator platform consists of a patch resembling an adhesive bandage, which is applied with a preloaded applicator and removed after a few minutes. Once applied, each patch delivers bioactive tips into the skin, which dissolve quickly into the body, rapidly releasing their therapeutic payload. Designed for self\-administration, the temperature\-stable Tacterra platform enables precise, controlled delivery of a wide range of therapeutics without medical sharps or refrigeration. Terrestrial has generated strong clinical and in\-vivo proof of concept across multiple molecules. For more information, visit www.terrestrialbio.com. **Why this role** Terrestrial is growing quickly, and the technology behind our science needs to scale with it. As Senior Systems Engineer, Cloud \& Identity, you’ll be the senior hands\-on technical owner of our Microsoft 365, Entra ID, public cloud (Azure, AWS or Google Cloud), endpoint, SaaS and infrastructure environment, reporting to the Senior Director, Information Technology. Your signature project is an identity architecture in which HR data automatically drives account creation, access and offboarding across our business and scientific applications. On a lean team, you’ll own work from design and build through documentation and support, and the results will be felt by every scientist, engineer and leader at Terrestrial. **What you’ll do** * Run and continuously improve Microsoft 365, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Intune: users, groups, admin roles, licensing and access policies. * Design, build and operate cloud infrastructure in Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, including subscriptions, accounts and projects, virtual networking, compute, storage, IAM, monitoring, and security and cost governance, using infrastructure as code where it fits. * Own identity and access management: SSO, MFA, Conditional Access and role\-based access across Microsoft 365 and our cloud platforms, with integrations built on SAML 2\.0, SCIM 2\.0, OpenID Connect and OAuth 2\.0\. * Build automated joiner, mover and leaver processes that connect our HR system to Entra ID, Microsoft 365 and downstream applications. * Administer and integrate our SaaS portfolio (DocuSign, Adobe, Zoom, HR platforms, ELN/LIMS, lab and quality systems), and evaluate new applications for security, supportability and identity integration. * Automate routine administration with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions, with monitoring, error handling and source control built in. * Manage Windows and macOS endpoints as well as office and lab networking, wireless, firewalls and VPN. * Serve as the senior escalation point for complex issues while supporting executives, scientists, lab personnel and administrative teams directly. This is a hands\-on role: you might build an Entra/SCIM integration one day and troubleshoot a laptop the next. * Partner with the Senior Director on cybersecurity, audits and compliance, and with Quality on infrastructure and identity controls for GxP and other regulated systems. * Keep diagrams, runbooks, SOPs and configuration records current so our IT processes scale. * Provide technical direction to consultants, vendors and MSP resources, and help shape the IT team as it grows. **How you’ll impact** In your first 12–18 months, success looks like: * Operational ownership of core Microsoft 365, Entra, endpoint, SaaS and infrastructure services, with fewer routine escalations reaching the Senior Director. * A secure, well\-governed public cloud foundation with consistent identity, networking, logging and cost controls. * Onboarding, role changes and offboarding that are standardized and automated end to end. * An identity architecture moving toward HRIS Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft 365, business and scientific applications, with SSO and automated provisioning across far more of our application portfolio. * Stronger security across identity, endpoints, infrastructure and applications, and better endpoint deployment, inventory and lifecycle management. * Documentation and operational standards that let IT scale with Terrestrial’s clinical, scientific, manufacturing and organizational growth. You’ll bring deep, practical expertise in Microsoft cloud identity and automation to a company where getting access and systems right directly supports research and regulated work. **Who you are** ***Required*** * BS degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience and 7\+ years of progressively responsible experience in systems engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems administration or enterprise IT. * Strong hands\-on Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration, including Enterprise Applications, authentication, SSO and access management. * Hands\-on experience engineering and operating cloud infrastructure in at least one major platform (Azure, AWS or Google Cloud), including virtual networking, compute, storage, IAM and security configuration. * Practical experience implementing and troubleshooting SAML\-based SSO, with working knowledge of OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect. * Strong PowerShell skills and experience with Microsoft Graph, REST APIs or similar integration technologies. * Microsoft Intune or comparable modern endpoint management, strong Windows administration and practical macOS support. * Solid networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, wireless, VPN and firewalls. * A track record of independently owning projects and operational issues from identification through resolution, including root\-cause analysis and clear written documentation. ***Preferred*** * Familiarity with, or previous experience working in, a GxP\-validated environment, such as supporting validated systems under change control, contributing to computer system validation (CSV/CSA) documentation, and applying data integrity and 21 CFR Part 11 principles. * SCIM\-based provisioning and HRIS\-to\-identity integration with ADP Workforce Now, BambooHR, Workday or a comparable platform. * Entra Lifecycle Workflows, Identity Governance, access reviews, entitlement management or Privileged Identity Management. * Infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep/ARM, CloudFormation or similar, plus Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions and Git\-based source control. * Experience across more than one cloud platform, including federating AWS or Google Cloud access with Entra ID (e.g., AWS IAM Identity Center, Google Cloud Workforce Identity Federation) and organization\-level governance (Azure management groups and Policy, AWS Organizations, Google Cloud organization policies). * Apple Business Manager or enterprise macOS management. * Experience supporting Benchling or comparable scientific SaaS, and laboratory, manufacturing or quality environments. * Biotech, pharmaceutical, medical device or other regulated\-industry IT experience. * Microsoft certifications such as Identity and Access Administrator, Endpoint Administrator or Azure Administrator, AWS Solutions Architect or SysOps Administrator, or Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer (valued, but not a substitute for hands\-on expertise). **Compensation:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $140,000 \- $160,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including experience, qualifications, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity and company benefits. **Onsite expectations:** The majority of our roles at Terrestrial are either onsite or hybrid, which allows us to meet both business and team needs. This is an onsite role, and candidates applying must be willing to be onsite 5 days per week. **Location:** Allston MA and Woburn MA At Terrestrial, we’re bringing together exceptional talent to drive our product development forward. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a dynamic work environment. We aim to recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Staff Compiler Engineer, CPU & ML Accelerators
jobs.description: Ricursive Intelligence is a frontier AI lab building self\-improving systems, starting with chip design. We are reinventing chip development and closing the loop between AI and the hardware that fuels it, recursively accelerating the path to artificial superintelligence. Backed by $335M from Sequoia, Lightspeed, DST, and NVIDIA Ventures, we are a growing, fast\-paced team where every hire shapes the work. The company has unmatched talent density, including IMO, IPhO, and IOAA gold medalists, pioneers who made prior breakthroughs in chip design: AlphaChip (Nature 2021\), ePlace (DAC Best Paper Nominee 2014\), RL\-CCD (DAC Best Paper 2023\), INSTA (DAC Best Paper 2025\), and C3PO (ASP\-DAC Best Paper 2026\), chip leads for Apple Silicon (multiple generations of iPhone and iPad) and Google (TPU, OpenTitan), and top researchers and engineers from Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Stanford, and MIT. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Every chip Ricursive designs is only as good as the software that targets it. The compiler is where architecture meets workload: it turns new vector units, matrix engines, and custom instructions into real speedups on real programs and ML models. We need a toolchain that keeps pace with an AI\-driven hardware design loop, one that can test proposed architecture features against real code within days and feed what it learns back into the chip. You will own the compiler toolchain for our CPU and accelerator cores end to end: backend code generation, support for new instructions, lowering ML models to hardware, and performance. As a Staff engineer you will set technical direction, make the key architectural calls, and raise the engineering bar for the team. This is a small and early team, so the methodology and infrastructure are still being defined. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Own the design and implementation of the compiler backend for our CPU and accelerator cores, including instruction selection, scheduling, register allocation, and target\-specific optimization. * Add support for standard and custom instruction set extensions (vector, matrix, bit\-manipulation, and domain\-specific) across the compiler, assembler, linker, intrinsics, and binutils. * Build the path from ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX) through MLIR to our hardware, covering dialects, tiling, data layout, vectorization, and kernel generation. * Lead hardware/software co\-design: evaluate proposed ISA and microarchitecture features by compiling real workloads against simulators and performance models, and report quantitative results to the architecture team. * Own performance and correctness infrastructure: benchmark suites, differential testing, fuzzing, and CI against simulators, FPGA, and silicon. * Apply ML to the compiler itself through learned cost models, autotuning, and ML\-guided optimization heuristics. * Set the technical roadmap for the compiler effort, mentor engineers, and upstream work to the open\-source projects we build on. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * 8\+ years of compiler development, including substantial hands\-on backend and code generation work for a CPU or accelerator target. * Expert C\+\+ and deep knowledge of LLVM (or GCC) internals. * A track record of shipping a production compiler toolchain for real hardware: new target bring\-up, support for new ISA extensions, or optimization work in a shipped compiler. * Experience leading multi\-quarter technical efforts across several engineers or teams. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * MS or PhD with a focus on compilers, programming languages, or computer architecture. * Experience with vector/SIMD ISAs, ML accelerators (TPUs, tensor cores, NPUs), or DSPs, and with open\-standard ISA ecosystems. * Hands\-on experience with MLIR, XLA, TVM, Triton, IREE, or torch.compile, and with kernel performance tuning. * Experience applying ML to compilers (e.g. MLGO, learned cost models, autotuning) or building ML systems. * Publications at PLDI, CGO, CC, ASPLOS, MICRO, ISCA, or MLSys. * Upstream contributions to, or code ownership in, LLVM, MLIR, GCC, or binutils. * Experience with architecture simulators (e.g. gem5\) and performance modeling. **Location** ------------ Palo Alto **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Engineering

jobs.title: Staff Platform & Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Project Healthy Minds** Project Healthy Minds is a mental health nonprofit that runs like a tech startup. We are pioneering a first\-of\-its\-kind model: applying technology to address one of the biggest social issues of our time: the growing mental health crisis. We believe in a simple but profound idea: that it should be as easy to find mental health services as it is to book a flight or a restaurant reservation. That's why we're building the world’s first digital marketplace for finding mental health services that are right for you. To do that, we work with some of the most inspiring and influential leaders in America \- business titans, tech entrepreneurs, clinicians and scientists, musicians, artists, athletes, media stars, policymakers, and more \- because we believe that the world's most complex challenges require interdisciplinary teams and solutions. We are backed by a powerhouse of industry\-leading Board of Directors and Advisory Council Members who are passionate, hands\-on, and dive into the important work with us. Learn more at projecthealthyminds.com and @projecthealthyminds on social. **About The Role** WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Project Healthy Minds (PHM) is a small nonprofit team building the front door on the internet for finding mental health care. People share sensitive information about their mental health when they use our screeners and search, and protecting it is part of the product. As our first full\-time platform and security engineer, you’ll keep our Google Cloud platform reliable and secure. You’ll also serve as PHM’s designated Security Officer, owning the program that governs how we protect that data. You’ll split your time between hands\-on platform work and running the security program, and the balance will shift with what PHM needs. WHAT YOU'LL DO **Platform** * Own the reliability, performance, and cost of production on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, BigQuery) and Cloudflare * Manage infrastructure in Terraform and keep our GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines secure and fast * Build the monitoring, alerting, and logging that catch problems before users do, and lead the response when something breaks * Design and maintain least\-privilege access for a distributed team, and run the quarterly access review * Plan for growth: traffic spikes from media coverage, partner integrations, and new features that handle health data * Review application changes that touch sensitive data, authentication, or access control * Co\-design the architecture of new systems and features with product and engineering **Security program** * Serve as PHM’s Security Officer: own our written information security program, built on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0, along with its policies and annual review * Maintain the risk register and report on security posture to our Risk Committee * Review risk assessments before adding them to our stack * Run our annual third\-party penetration test and track findings to closure * Lead security incident response with legal counsel, and run the annual disaster\-recovery drill * Set the guardrails for how the team uses AI tools, and deliver security and privacy training to staff and contractors WHAT YOU'LL BRING * 8\+ years in platform, infrastructure, site reliability, or security engineering, with hands\-on production work in the last two years * Experience at a health tech company that handled sensitive health data (required) * Ownership of a security or compliance program under SOC 2, HIPAA, HITRUST, or NIST CSF. You built the controls, kept the evidence, and answered the auditors’ or partners’ questions. * Deep production experience in at least one major cloud, and working familiarity with Google Cloud * Infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred) and CI/CD * Incident response experience, including at least one incident where you led the response * Sound risk judgment: you can tell a launch\-blocking issue from one that belongs in the risk register, and you can explain the difference to non\-engineers * A preference for hands\-on work over managing people * Able to work from our New York City office 5 days a week * Belief in our mission: connecting Americans to mental health services that actually work for them NICE TO HAVE * Deep Google Cloud security experience * Experience securing applications that use large language models * You were the first security hire at a startup WHY THIS IS A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY * Strong backing. Our Board, Clinical Advisory Committee, and partners come from business, academia, medicine, and media, and they’re closely involved in the work. * A big goal with the funding to pursue it. We have a multi\-year record of year\-over\-year growth, paid for by philanthropy and earned revenue. * Real authority. As Security Officer you can approve security policy, require fixes, and pause a launch that puts people’s data at risk. On security, you report to our Risk Committee directly. * A modern platform. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Foot
jobs.description: **About 1X** ============ We’re building humanoid robots that work in home \- doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it’s not. To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing \- at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here. We’ve been at this since 2014 and we’re at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us. NEO is our flagship \- a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it \- we’re shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you. If you’ve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world \- this is that moment. We’re scaling, we’re hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time \- safely creating abundance for all. **About the Team** ================== The Robot Interconnect and Tendon Systems team develops the soft goods, harnessing, tendon routing, and compliant mechanical systems that enable reliable motion, durability, and integration across humanoid robotic platforms. A key focus area for the team is the development of foot systems that must withstand demanding real\-world loading, wear, environmental exposure, and continuous robotic operation while remaining lightweight, durable, and manufacturable at scale. You’ll work closely with mechanical, industrial design, manufacturing, and integration teams to rapidly prototype, test, and refine assemblies that are critical to robot mobility, reliability, and long\-term performance. **Your Charter** ================ Develop and validate the foot systems that connect the robot to the world. You will design, prototype, integrate, and test foot soft goods assemblies, tendon interfaces, harnessing systems, and compliant mechanical structures that enable robust operation in real\-world environments. Your work will focus on balancing durability, performance, manufacturability, and rapid iteration while helping drive these systems from early prototypes to production\-ready designs. As a Mechanical Engineer on the Foot Systems team, your work will directly impact robot mobility, reliability, serviceability, and overall product performance. **Key Outcomes** ================ * Design and release foot assemblies, harnesses, tendon routing systems, and compliant structures that meet durability, integration, and manufacturability requirements * Execute structured testing and validation efforts that identify wear patterns, failure modes, and reliability risks, resulting in measurable design improvements * Develop and maintain high\-quality CAD models, engineering drawings, BOMs, and documentation that support both prototype and production builds * Partner effectively with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and cross\-functional engineering groups to improve assembly quality, repeatability, and production readiness * Support rapid hardware iteration cycles while maintaining a high standard of engineering rigor and execution quality **Key Competencies** ==================== * Strong hands\-on engineering capability with experience building, testing, and iterating physical hardware systems * Solid understanding of soft goods construction methods, textiles, harness systems, sewn assemblies, wearable products, or tendon\-driven mechanisms * Strong mechanical intuition and ability to quickly diagnose integration, wear, durability, and reliability issues * Ability to thrive in fast\-moving environments with evolving technical requirements and aggressive development timelines * Strong communication and collaboration skills across design, manufacturing, supplier, and engineering teams **Minimum Requirements** ======================== * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field * 3\+ years of experience in mechanical engineering, soft goods product development, robotics, wearable products, or consumer hardware * Proficiency with CAD tools and standard engineering documentation workflows * Hands\-on experience designing, prototyping, and validating mechanical components * Experience working closely with fabrication, assembly, prototyping, or manufacturing processes **Preferred Skills** ==================== * Experience with soft goods or textile\-based assemblies * Experience with harness systems, sewn assemblies, rope\- or cable\-driven systems, tendon routing systems, or compliant mechanisms * Experience working directly with suppliers or contract manufacturers on soft goods development * Experience designing fixtures, jigs, or test systems used for product validation * Exposure to robotics, footwear, wearable technology, medical devices, or other high\-reliability consumer products * Familiarity with rapid prototyping methods and iterative hardware development workflows **What does a successful 1X Team Member look like?** ==================================================== Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back \- because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect. Successful engineers on this team combine strong technical fundamentals with a highly practical mindset. They enjoy building and testing hardware, move quickly from ideas to prototypes, and use data from real\-world testing to drive decisions. They are comfortable working across disciplines and understand that great robotic systems emerge from thousands of small details executed well. **Compensation Range** ====================== $150,000 \- $200,000 \+ Equity **Benefits** ============ * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave * 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%) * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options * Commuter benefits (transit and parking) * Short\-term and long\-term disability, and life insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support * Onsite snacks and catered lunches **Equal Opportunity Employer** ============================== 1X is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, military or veteran status, justice system impact, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, AI/ML
jobs.description: ### **Why This Role Exists** We operate a multi\-tenant automotive SaaS platform serving thousands of dealer groups across the United States, running on a native AWS backend: Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions. That platform works. Now we are making it think: production agentic AI systems built code\-first and deployed on AWS Bedrock AgentCore, connected to real systems, making decisions and executing workflows against real dealer data and real money. This is a hands\-on builder role. Expect the large majority of your time in code. But we are not hiring a pair of hands. Every agent you ship makes decisions that touch dealer revenue, so we need an engineer who understands the business problem before writing the technical solution: someone who asks what a workflow is worth, weighs build cost against dealer impact, and knows when the right answer is a simpler tool, or no agent at all. ### **Scope \& Scale** * 5,000\+ destination dealer tenants, each with isolated databases and per\-tenant configuration. * Agent workflows that touch production transaction data: real dealer money, not a sandbox. * Tens of thousands of API requests across REST, SOAP, and event\-driven integration surfaces that your agents' tools will call into. * A growing portfolio of production agents, each with its own cost, latency, and evaluation budget. ### **What You'll Own** * **Production agents on AgentCore.** Agent logic, tool orchestration, and multi\-agent workflows built in Strands or LangGraph and deployed on AgentCore Runtime with Memory, Identity, and Gateway. * **Tool interfaces.** Framework\-agnostic Python tools, MCP servers, and AgentCore Gateway targets that let agents safely call production APIs. * **Evaluation harnesses.** Offline and online eval pipelines and LLM\-as\-judge CI/CD gates that catch regressions before dealers do. * **Guardrails and safe failure.** Approval gates and rollback paths that determine whether an agent fails safe or fails loud. * **Cost and latency management.** Per\-agent cost tracking and multi\-model routing so each workflow earns more than it costs. * **Production observability.** AgentCore session tracing, OpenTelemetry, and CloudWatch dashboards for every agent you ship. You work within the platform's established architectural patterns, and produce deliverables using agentic frameworks, AWS serverless core, MCP and tool design, and observability without someone looking over your shoulder. Prompt engineering and tool\-use design are core engineering disciplines here, not an afterthought. ### **First 90 Days / First Year** **First 90 Days:** Ramp on the platform architecture, existing agents, and integration surfaces, and on the dealer workflows behind them, so you know what the agents are for, not just how they run. Ship your first tool integration (MCP server or Gateway target) to production in month one. By month three, own end\-to\-end agent workflows from design through production on AgentCore: Strands agent logic, tool interfaces, evaluation harness with CI gates, and guardrails. **First Year:** Running autonomously from month four: shipping new agents and tools with minimal oversight, with observability and cost tracking in place for everything you own. A portfolio of production agents in your name, each with an eval harness, guardrails, and a cost and latency budget it stays inside. At least one case where you argued for the simpler tool, or no agent at all, and were right. ### **Hands\-On Expectations** The large majority of your time is in code: agents, tools, evals, and the observability around them. The rest is design within the platform's established patterns and working with the Tech Leads whose domains your agents touch. You measure your week in shipped code. ### **Tech \& Tools** * **AI and agents:** Strands Agents SDK on AWS Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Observability); MCP servers; Bedrock Guardrails; Anthropic models (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus). * **AWS:** Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions, ECS Fargate, Aurora, API Gateway, CDK. * **Languages:** Python primary, Java (Spring Boot) secondary. * **Observability:** AgentCore session tracing, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch. ### **How You'll Use AI** This is not a "we are AI\-curious" company. We use Claude every day, and we expect you to as well. Concrete examples for this role: * Build the production agents themselves: Anthropic models on Bedrock AgentCore, orchestrated in Strands, calling production APIs through MCP servers and Gateway targets. * Write eval fixtures and LLM\-as\-judge CI gates so every agent is tested against what good looks like before a dealer sees it. * Use Claude as your pair for agent code, tool schemas, and prompt iteration, with the agentic development harness as your default workflow. * Instrument every agent for cost and latency and use multi\-model routing so the workflow earns more than it costs. * Decide, with evidence, when an agent is the wrong answer and a deterministic tool is the right one. **You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the engineer who builds the agents that do real work for real dealers.** ### **Role Specifics** * **Department:** Engineering * **Reports To:** Head of Data Platform * **Location:** Denver, CO, hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including hands\-on production experience building LLM agents in a code\-first framework. Strands Agents and LangGraph are equally acceptable, as are Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and comparable frameworks. If you have built and operated real agents in any of them, you will pick up Strands quickly. * Business\-conscious judgment: you start from the problem and its value, not the technology, and you have walked away from a clever solution because a simpler one served the customer better. * Strong Python; ability to read and contribute to Java (Spring Boot) services. * Hands\-on experience with AWS serverless (Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, Step Functions). * Experience with prompt engineering, tool/function\-calling design, and evaluating LLM output quality in production. * An appetite for a heads\-down building role: you measure your week in shipped code. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Direct experience with Strands Agents and/or AgentCore Runtime (or migrating agent workloads from Lambda/Fargate to a managed agent runtime); LLM\-as\-judge, agent\-to\-agent orchestration, and agent governance. * Direct production experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. * Comfort owning production observability (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch) for the systems you build. ### **Nice to Have** * Automotive, fintech, or multi\-tenant marketplace platform experience. * Familiarity with Bedrock Guardrails, LLM\-as\-judge evaluation, model cost/latency optimization, and multi\-agent orchestration patterns. * Experience with data pipelines (Glue/Athena) or ETL/data lake tooling. **Benefits** We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. At A2Z Sync, we're deeply committed to our employees' well\-being, starting with comprehensive benefits designed to help you care for yourself and your family. **Here's what we offer:** * **Base Salary:** $160,000 – $180,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus an equity grant. * **Employer\-Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance:** Comprehensive coverage for you and your family starting on day one. * **Flexible Work:** Denver hybrid (2 days/week in office) or fully remote anywhere in the US. * **401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match:** Build your future with our competitive matching program. * **Generous Paid Time Off (PTO):** Unlimited PTO and 10 paid holidays. * **Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Coverage:** Fully employer\-paid. * **Life and AD\&D Insurance:** Employer\-paid coverage for peace of mind. * **Free Mental Health Support:** Access to confidential therapy sessions through BetterHelp. * **Pet Insurance Options:** Affordable plans for your furry family members. * **Identity Theft Protection:** Voluntary services to safeguard your personal information. * **Other Cool Stuff:** On\-site gym in Denver, great co\-workers, and a stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages to keep you fueled.

Team member will work together with our materials analysis group to perform comprehensive failure analysis investigation to support AISIN's North American manufacturing processes. These analysis requests may come from any source (suppliers, AISIN manufacturing plants, customers, etc.) and must be accompanied by a professional analysis report. **Position Responsibilities** The incumbent is expected to perform the following functions that the company has determined are essential to this position: * Reference drawing and engineering standards to create and execute inspection plans for new model launch quality confirmation. This includes dimensional analysis and functional testing on completed assemblies (product audit). This regularly includes on\-vehicle evaluation in a lab and on a test track with the assistance of product design engineering. * Perform dimensional measurement and analyze resulting data to support failure analysis investigations on submitted samples and sub\-assemblies in a timely fashion. + Provide detailed analysis and conclusions documented in a standard AISIN format report. + Analysis includes determining proper investigation sequence, performing hands\-on sample preparation, teardown, and testing as required. + Equipment includes Optical 3D and scanning point contact CMMs, measurement microscopes, surface and contour tracer, various hand gauges, and other test equipment. * Perform internal calibration and arrange external calibration of all QA Center test equipment. Maintain records to meet IATF16949 requirements. * Audit AISIN North American manufacturing facilities' Measurement Management Systems * Assist in sourcing equipment and support material as necessary for effective and efficient operation of the NA QA Center dimensional laboratory. * Provide measurement skills training, development, and guidance to engineers from AISIN North American manufacturing facilities. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (DevOps)
jobs.description: AndHealth is on a mission to radically improve access and outcomes for the most challenging chronic health conditions, with the goal of making world\-class specialty care accessible and affordable to all. We partner with health systems, community health centers, and independent practices to remove barriers to care to ensure all people have access to the care they deserve. ### **The Opportunity** Our platform runs on Google Cloud and Firebase, so you won’t spend your days patching servers or nursing infrastructure. Instead, you’ll build the systems that let a small, fast\-moving engineering team ship safely: infrastructure as code, trustworthy pipelines, and automation that handles the routine work before anyone has to touch it. As our DevOps Engineer, you’ll own the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and security automation our engineers rely on every day. You’ll bring existing infrastructure under code, make our CI/CD pipelines faster and more trustworthy, and build automation, including AI\-assisted systems, that triages and resolves routine security and operational work. The goal is to make it easier for people to build, test, and ship software. You’ll work in person alongside the engineering team, and much of what you build will be for them. This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You’ll share production health and on\-call responsibility with the team, and you’ll have room to shape how we operate as we grow. This is an on\-site role in Columbus, Ohio, and is not remote or hybrid. **What You’ll Do in the Role** * **Keep production dependable.** Share on\-call and incident response with the team, improve monitoring and alerting so problems are easy to diagnose, and lead or join root cause analysis after incidents. Write and test runbooks and recovery procedures before they’re needed. * **Bring all infrastructure under one source of truth.** Move the parts of our environment built by hand in the cloud console into Terraform, and keep access, service accounts, secrets, and certificates in order so nothing depends on someone’s memory. * **Help engineers ship quickly and with confidence.** Own our GitHub Actions workflows and deployments across development, staging, and production. Build faster feedback loops, stronger validation, and rollbacks that work. As AI\-assisted development changes how we build software, help rethink the path from code change to trusted release. * **Remove friction from developers’ day.** Find where engineers get slowed down and build the internal tools and patterns that clear those obstacles. You’ll work inside the engineering process, not as a separate ops queue. * **Automate security and compliance work.** Partner with our security team to triage findings as they appear, gather context, and propose fixes for human approval. Apply the same approach to SOC 2 and HIPAA evidence gathering and control documentation. * **Eliminate repetitive chores.** Automate recurring operational and engineering work, including building and deploying AI agents where they help, with clear checks and human oversight. When a new platform need comes up, evaluate the options and recommend one. * **Own the engineering side of Zoom.** Zoom supports our meetings, phone system, patient visits, transcription, and Contact Center. You’ll handle integrations, API automation, reporting, and analytics. Day\-to\-day telecom administration is handled separately. ### **Education \& Licensure Requirements** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Other Skills or Qualifications** * **Software and DevOps depth.** About 6 to 10 years of experience, with a software development foundation and hands\-on DevOps, platform, or SRE work. You’ve operated production systems, not only designed them. * **Cloud and infrastructure\-as\-code experience.** Strong experience with a major cloud provider (Google Cloud is a plus) and Terraform or comparable tools * **CI/CD experience.** You’ve built and maintained delivery pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar) and can explain the tradeoffs behind testing, promotion, deployment, and rollback. * **A history of building internal tools.** You’ve built and maintained tools that other engineers or teams actually use. * **An AI\-forward approach.** You’ve built or deployed AI agents or AI\-assisted automation, and you understand where they help, where they don’t, and what the risks are. You’re eager to use these capabilities, not waiting to see if they pan out. * **Security awareness.** You understand IAM, secrets, vulnerability management, and the practical controls needed in a regulated environment. * **Operational judgment.** You can investigate an unfamiliar failure, communicate clearly during an incident, and follow through afterward. You’re willing to take part in on\-call. * **Independence.** You don’t need much oversight, and you’re ready to grow toward staff\-level scope. * **Cross\-functional range.** You work well with engineers, security, compliance, IT, and vendors. **Nice to have:** * Firebase, Node.js/TypeScript, Docker or container orchestration * SOC 2 or HIPAA experience, healthcare technology * Developer\-experience work * Zoom APIs, telephony, or contact\-center platforms * A home lab or side projects. Many people who thrive in roles like this build and experiment outside of work, but it’s never required. ### **Here’s what we’d like to offer you** * Equal investment and support for our people and patients. * A fun and ambitious start\-up environment with a culture that takes on important things, takes risks, and learns quickly. * The ability to demonstrate creativity, innovation, and conscientiousness, and find joy in working together. * A team of highly skilled, incredibly kind, and welcoming employees, every one of whom has something unique to offer. * We know that the overall success of our business is a collaborative effort, and we strive to provide ongoing opportunities for our employees to learn and grow, both personally and professionally. * Full\-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits package which includes Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance, Paid time off, Short\- and Long\-Term Disability, and more. We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior MBE Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** The Senior MBE (Molecular Beam Epitaxy) Engineer is responsible for the operation, optimization, maintenance, and technical leadership of the MBE systems used to manufacture InP\-based laser epitaxial structures. The senior engineer plays a key role in ensuring repeatable production growth, minimizing equipment downtime, enhancing material quality, improving production yield, and supporting continuous process improvement. In addition to hands\-on production line responsibilities, this position serves as a senior technical resource for the other MBE engineers, providing guidance on wafer growth, equipment troubleshooting, process optimization, and risk management. The senior engineer should demonstrate the capability to independently identify failure modes or quality/reliability improvement areas in the MBE production line without detailed instructions from management. They will also be required to lead equipment maintenance and respond to emergency outages. **Responsibilities** * Wafer Growth * Independently operate MBE growth and characterization of InP\-based materials. * Take MBE system ownership and be responsible for production and equipment service. * Collect and input production and growth data into the database. * Measure epitaxial wafers by using structural, optical, and electrical characterization tools. * Reporting * Monitor and maintain SPC charts for the MBE production line. * Track device and equipment performance, and conduct failure analysis. * Write characterization results into reports to monitor yield and performance. * Evaluate device performance trends and make recommendations on process changes. * Maintenance * Evaluate equipment and recommend upgrade/replacement parts as needed. * Maintain equipment, including preventative and corrective maintenance, and devise methods to resolve equipment issues to minimize downtime. * Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of MBE equipment failures. * Calibrate inspection and MBE equipment, and qualify new equipment. * Log maintenance items and predict the future needs to avoid downtime. * Coordinate with equipment manufacturers to resolve critical issues and source parts. * Process Improvement * Lead continuous efforts to improve process control to enhance wafer quality and yield. * Develop and revise training materials and standard operating procedures (SOPs). * Collaborate with other process teams and quality teams to identify root causes of yield loss and implement corrective actions. * Technical Leadership * Serve as a source of professional and technical knowledge of MBE equipment. * Utilize professional experience to mentor engineers on growth techniques. * Respond to equipment failures by leading emergency service and repairs. * Communicate production line activities with management. **Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Material Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline is required; PhD is preferred. * Minimum 5\-years of experience in experiment design, process development, or epitaxial manufacturing in a semiconductor laboratory is required. * Direct experience in semiconductor characterization techniques, such as photoluminescence, x\-ray diffraction, optical microscopy, ECV, etc., is required. * Knowledge of compound semiconductor device theory is desired. * Experience with DOE, SPC, root cause analysis and yield improvement. * Direct experience operating MBE or MOCVD epitaxy growth systems is required. * Demonstrated experience diagnosing complex epitaxial process and equipment issues. * Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical improvement projects. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** * Will be required to work in a cleanroom environment. * Must be comfortable working while gowned in cleanroom garments. * Should be willing to work flexible hours upon the demands of the production line on request. * While performing the duties of this job, the associate may need the ability to lift and carry loads up to 20 pounds, stand and/or walk for 10\+ hrs. daily and climb stairs. * Will work in areas with noise, vibration, dust, and odors. * Will work in areas with laboratory hazards. Includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, or exposure to toxic or caustic chemicals. * Will work in a manufacturing environment, and be required to wear personal protective equipment. **Location** This position will be on\-site based in Sugar Land, Texas. **WHY AOI** In addition to competitive salary, AOI offers: * Flexible and competitive health (medical, dental, vision) plans offer the employee with the right options to meet individual and family needs * Employer matching on 401(k) deferrals * Generous PTO policy, with unused PTO payout at end of the year * Relocation package available within US * Immigration sponsorships (Must be currently authorized to work in the US) We do not accept unsolicited proposals from third\-party recruiters or agencies. Contacting hiring managers directly may result in disqualification of submissions. \#HP!

jobs.title: Senior Customer Engineer, AI-Factory
jobs.description: **About the Company** Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada's solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12\), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI \- rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud. Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. **About the Role** The AI Factory Customer Engineer plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between customer modular AI\-ready data center requirements and Armada's Product and Engineering teams. This role requires deep technical credibility, hands\-on infrastructure experience, and strong interpersonal skills to translate complex AI infrastructure and data center architectures into clear, practical solutions for customers looking to deploy sovereign AI infrastructure at speed. This role goes beyond traditional pre\-sales. The Customer Engineer acts as the technical interface between high\-profile customers and Armada Engineering, ensuring customer requirements, constraints, and feedback are accurately represented and incorporated into solution design and future platform evolution. Armada's AI Factory serves a broad and growing set of customers across enterprise, industrial, and infrastructure\-heavy verticals. Additionally, renewable energy operators who own or control significant land, power, and stranded energy assets are increasingly positioned to host or operate AI compute infrastructure at scale. The ideal candidate brings an engineering and customer\-first mindset, strong data center and AI\-ready infrastructure expertise, particularly around AI, HPC, liquid\-cooling, modular data center solutions, Nvidia reference architectures, along with the energy, curiosity, and positivity required to operate in a fast\-moving, hyper\-growth environment. This role is instrumental in driving adoption, trust, and long\-term success for Armada's AI Factory modular solutions. **Location** United States (Remote) **What You'll Do — Key Responsibilities** technical inputs. * Provide expert technical guidance to Armada's AI Factory customers, including Modular Data Center (MDC)solutions, high\-density and liquid\-cooled designs, and GPU\-based reference architectures created with partners such as NVIDIA. * Understand customer workloads and objectives deeply and advise on solution details including rack\-level design, systems architectures, cooling and power draw advisory, and deployment strategy tradeoffs. * Lead technical demonstrations and workshops, tailoring content to customer constraints and operational realities. * Cultivate trusted\-advisor relationships with customer engineering, infrastructure, IT, OT, and security stakeholders and teams * Engage with solution partners and supply chain, including MEP, OEM, xPU vendors, in service to end\-to\-end customer solutions * Enable field and sales teams by simplifying complex technical concepts into clear, customer\-relevant narratives * Support RFI/P and ongoing customer\-facing technical documentation required to support lighthouse customer requirements * Bring a high\-ownership, self\-starting mindset with the energy and curiosity to fill gaps, solve problems, and drive outcomes end\-to\-end. **AI Datacenter Co\-Lo \& Neocloud Engagement** * Engage AI\-focused datacenter co\-location operators and Neocloud providers as a critical customer segment, positioning Armada's AI Factory as a solution for rapid capacity expansion, modular overflow deployments, and high\-density liquid\-cooled compute environments. * Develop sufficient familiarity with co\-lo and Neocloud operational models — GPU cluster economics, high\-density power and cooling requirements, multi\-tenant compute, and deployment velocity expectation ustomer engagements, technical scoping, and solution design across all target verticals. * Stay current on industry trends related to AI infrastructure, energy sector AI adoption, data center design, liquid cooling, and modular systems — and share insights internally to shape future product strategy. * Attend industry events and conferences, representing Armada with customers, partners, and industry insiders * Bring positive energy, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset to every engagement — this role values technical excellence and having fun while building something meaningful. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on engineering experience). Advanced engineering degrees are a plus. * 10\-15\+ years of relevant experience in data center engineering, infrastructure engineering, pre\-sales, sales engineering, or solution architecture roles. * Strong understanding of compute, networking, and storage fundamentals, including AI and GPU\-based systems * Hands\-on experience with mechanical, electrical, thermal, advanced cooling and networking components of data center solutionsFamiliarity with modular data centers (MDCs) landscape * Engineering mindset with curiosity about what lives inside the rack, including openness to evolving beyond current AI and HPE reference designs (e.g., B300 / GB300\) as architectures evolve. * Familiarity with foundational cloud platforms, containerization, virtualization, and modern enterprise infrastructure. * Ability to navigate and build credibility with technical infrastructure buying personas at all levels * Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort operating in complex, live customer environments. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both highly technical engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * Willingness to travel as required. **Compensation \& Benefits** For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the **On\-Target Earnings (OTE)** for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed below, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits *(details available upon request)*. \#LI\-DA1 \#LI\-REMOTE **You're a Great Fit if You're** * A go\-getter with a growth mindset. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company * A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda * Highly organized and results\-driven.
