jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: ATPCO is the world's primary source for air fare content, holding over 200 million fares across 160 countries. Every day, the travel industry relies on ATPCO's technology and data solutions to help millions of travelers reach their destinations efficiently. Join us and contribute to the development of innovative applications that power global travel. ATPCO is everywhere people buy flights. We’re not just shaping the future of air travel– we’re redefining how and where great work happens. At ATPCO, we believe in flexibility, trust, and a culture where your wellbeing comes first **Why Join Us?** ✅ Remote\-First Culture – Flexibility to work from home in your country of hire ✅ Inclusive, Collaborative Culture– Be seen, heard, and valued ✅ “Leave Your Way” PTO– Take the time you need, when you need it ✅ 401(k) with Generous Employer Match– Invest in your future ✅ Comprehensive Benefits– Medical, dental, vision, \& mental health ✅ Global Tuition and Gym Reimbursement– Learn and be well on us ✅ Standby Flight Program– Explore the world **Our Culture:** We’ve built a remote\-first culture rooted in trust, transparency, and belonging. With open\-door leadership, weekly 1:1s, and real\-time recognition, we keep our people connected and valued—no matter where they work. Our cultural pillars of Collaboration, Empowerment, Innovation, Learning, Transparency, and Trust guide how we show up for one another and grow together. **Job Description:** Looking to redefine how the airline industry prices and sells products at a global scale? This is not just another engineering role—this is your opportunity to architect and build a next\-generation pricing engine that will power airline retailing across the globe. At ATPCO, you’ll join a newly formed Pricing Platform Team (est. 2024\) with a bold mission: to create a highly scalable, cost\-efficient, and intelligent pricing platform capable of managing 200M\+ fares across 160\+ countries. This platform will shape how airlines distribute and optimize their products in real time. As a Principal Software Engineer, you won’t just contribute—you’ll lead from the front, solving some of the hardest technical challenges in distributed systems, performance engineering, and large\-scale data processing. Want to redefine how the airline industry prices and sells products at global scale? This role is your chance to shape and extend the pricing engine that powers airline retailing around the world. You’ll join ATPCO’s Pricing Platform Team, formed in 2024 to own a highly scalable, cost\-efficient, and intelligent pricing platform that manages 200M\+ fares across 160\+ countries. The engine is built and running; the mission now is to evolve it to support new use cases and shape how airlines distribute and optimize their products in real time. As a Principal Software Engineer, you’ll lead from the front. You’ll set technical direction on some of the hardest problems in distributed systems, performance engineering, and large\-scale data processing, and you’ll spend most of your time building. **What You’ll Do** * Extend and evolve our high\-performance, fault\-tolerant pricing engine to support new use cases * Shape the platform’s architecture and drive key technical decisions with the team * Solve complex challenges in distributed systems, scalability, and reliability * Work across the stack, from low\-level system interactions to distributed algorithms and APIs * Optimize for extreme performance. At 200M\+ fares, shaving milliseconds off latency and fractions of a cent off cost adds up fast. Techniques in play include: * Zero\-copy data paths * Lock\-free data structures * Sophisticated fault tolerance and replication strategies * Get deep in the existing engine’s codebase and design, so enhancements build on what’s already there * Partner with engineers, product, and stakeholders to shape the future of airline retailing technology **What We’re Looking For** * **Systems programming expertise:** expert\-level C and Rust. Go or Python are a plus. * **A love of the hard stuff:** complex algorithms, data structures, and systems design, for their own sake and not just as a means to ship a feature. * **Linux depth:** a deep understanding of Linux systems, performance, and resource management. * **Distributed systems at scale:** proven experience building and operating fault\-tolerant distributed systems in production. * **A scientific approach:** you work through complex, ambiguous problems with data, measurement, and evidence. * **Ownership:** you take ownership of the product’s success, not just your assigned tickets, and you identify and solve problems proactively. * **Self\-directed learning:** you dig into a large, unfamiliar codebase yourself and come with specific, well\-researched questions. The team invests heavily in helping people who do. * **Strong technical discussion:** this team enjoys rigorous debate. You argue from data, defend good ideas, and change your mind when shown better ones. * **Clear communication:** excellent written communication and collaboration skills in a distributed, async\-friendly team. * **Thoughtful AI use:** you use AI\-assisted development tools to increase productivity without lowering the quality bar. **Bonus Points** * Experience in airline pricing, distribution, or ATPCO data * Background building high\-throughput, low\-latency data platforms **The Impact You’ll Have** Your work will directly influence how airlines worldwide price, distribute, and optimize their offerings, unlocking new capabilities in airline retailing and shaping the future of the industry. **Compensation:** **Salary Range**: $170,000 \- $195,000 The disclosed salary range applies uniformly across all U.S. locations and is not modified based on geographic differentials. At ATPCO, we are deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our supportive policies promote work\-life balance through flexible work arrangements, and we cultivate a workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and a true sense of belonging. We consider qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, protected military/veteran status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, or any other legally protected factor. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide. The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third\-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission\-critical servers must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small\-to\-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities. The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment\-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand\-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- External Job Description AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help. Amazon Web Services (AWS) Hardware Engineering team creates compute and storage server designs for Amazon's web services. Our engineers work with leading edge technologies, solve challenging problems, influence the industry's roadmaps, and develop new and unique solutions that are ahead of the pack. We work in an environment that fosters innovation and creativity. We encourage and invest in new directions and new ideas that will serve our customers better. We sometimes fail, but we learn from such failures and we improve. It is because of the team and our constant focus on the customers, that we are able to develop creative and new designs that set the standards on performance, quality, cost, and operational excellence. We are looking for a Sr System Development Engineer, Mfg Bring Up and Test to drive manufacturing test excellence across our global server and rack production network. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end manufacturing test strategy for new product introductions — from early design engagement through production ramp and yield optimization. As a technical leader, you will solve complex test architecture challenges at the intersection of hardware design, firmware, and manufacturing operations, ensuring that every server and rack we produce meets the highest quality bar before reaching our data centers. Key job responsibilities The Sr System Development Engineer, Mfg Bring Up and Test owns the end\-to\-end manufacturing test strategy and execution for server and rack systems across all contract manufacturer sites, from early product design through volume production. Key responsibilities include: * Drive testability requirements and lead design\-for\-test (DFT) reviews from the earliest design stages to optimize hardware for efficient manufacturing validation, debug, and serviceability. * Develop and standardize comprehensive test strategies spanning board\-, server\-, and rack\-level validation across all critical subsystems (compute, memory, networking, power, and storage), enforcing consistency across all production sites globally. * Architect and deploy the complete manufacturing test infrastructure and automated test flows at factory sites — including network configurations, boot environments, test fixtures, and provisioning systems — to ensure production readiness ahead of volume ramp. * Drive test automation and telemetry to reduce manual intervention, accelerate feedback loops, and achieve significant test\-time reductions through risk\-based testing and optimized sequencing. * Apply a rigorous change management process — validating in lab environments, qualifying at factory sites, and deploying in a controlled, traceable manner to prevent regressions. * Lead manufacturing test failure triage and yield improvement during New Product Introduction (NPI), applying structured root cause analysis and corrective actions to achieve first\-pass yield targets. * Establish data\-driven boundaries between manufacturing and post\-deployment validation to balance cost, cycle time, and defect escape risk. * Drive capacity analysis across test positions, yield projections, and equipment utilization during production ramp to ensure throughput aligns with production targets. * Serve as the key technical liaison between internal engineering teams and external manufacturing partners, aligning on build schedules, design changes, and production readiness. A day in the life As a Sr System Development Engineer, Mfg Bring Up and Test, no two days are the same. On any given day, you might be leading a design\-for\-test (DFT) review with hardware engineers to ensure testability is built into products from the earliest design stage, or architecting test strategies that span board\-, server\-, and rack\-level validation across compute, memory, GPU, networking, power, and storage subsystems. You'll develop and deploy automated test flows and infrastructure at contract manufacturer sites — optimizing test sequencing and building telemetry to accelerate feedback loops. During production, you'll lead structured root cause analysis and drive yield improvements through data\-driven corrective actions. You'll collaborate across cross\-functional teams and global manufacturing partners to ensure every platform is production\-ready ahead of volume ramp. About the team The team consists of Hardware Design Engineers, System Design Engineers, Software Develop perience with server\- or rack\-level hardware testing and validation in a data center, Original Design Manufacturer (ODM), or contract manufacturer environment. * Experience designing or architecting test systems, test infrastructure, or manufacturing validation frameworks. * Experience deploying and operating in Linux/Unix environments. * Experience leading cross\-functional technical initiatives with external manufacturing partners. * Experience with test coverage analysis, yield improvement, and root cause investigation methodologies. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience with system\-level burn\-in testing, subsystem validation (CPU/memory/PCIe/power), or hardware validation at scale. * Experience with rack\-level integration testing and connectivity validation. * Knowledge of board\-level testing (ICT, BFT, functional test) and server\-level validation flows. * Experience with test automation frameworks and automated test deployment pipelines for manufacturing test. * Experience with fault injection testing and test coverage effectiveness analysis. * Experience with BOM validation, firmware programming, or hardware telemetry configuration. * Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), PFMEA, and first\-pass yield improvement methodologies. * Experience with test fixture design, validation, and correlation studies. * Familiarity with ARM\-based and x86 server platforms. * Experience with test change management processes and controlled deployment across multiple production sites. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise. Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer\-facing experiences—while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services. We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision\-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow. Global Commercial Services (GCS) serves millions of business customers around the world, from mom\-and\-pop shops to Fortune 500 companies. We back businesses so they can do more business, with a mission to be the undisputed leader in financial and membership services — responsibly driving double\-digit revenue growth. We do that by offering a diverse range of payment and cashflow tools, from a wide range of traditional card products, to working capital and supply chain financing, to new digital solutions that make it easy for our customers to manage a full range of their financial and payment needs. **The Role** As a Staff AI Engineer on the Commercial Cross Platform Delivery Team you will operate as a senior individual contributor within Amex Technology, helping define how AI systems are designed, built, and operated across the company. You will work at the intersection of AI system architecture and hands\-on execution: designing core frameworks, writing production code, reviewing critical designs, and guiding teams through complex technical decisions. This role does not include people management; your impact comes from technical leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to turn ambiguity into reliable, scalable agentic systems. You will work closely with Product and UX partners to shape a shared vision for AI experiences. While product teams own prioritization, Staff engineers are expected to actively influence*what* gets built and*how* agentic systems come together across teams. We are primarily looking for senior individual contributors; however, as the team grows, you will take on increasing responsibility for technical leadership and people development within the agentic AI space. Mentoring, developing and managing direct reports may be in scope for some of our opportunities. **What We’re Looking For** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including deep, hands\-on experience delivering agentic AI or LLM\-powered systems to production. * Proven ownership of complex, cross\-cutting agentic systems spanning multiple teams or products. * Strong engineering fundamentals across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure * Deep experience across the agentic AI stack, including planning, tool use, memory, and evaluation. * Fluency with AI\-assisted and agentic development workflows. * Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces and translating them into shipped, reliable autonomous systems * Ability to influence technical direction and align teams without formal authority. * Experience in workflow engines, async processing, queues, and streaming systems. * **Preferred Qualifications** * + Experience building agentic systems in fintech or other regulated industries. * + Experience as a founding engineer or early technical leader in AI\-driven products. * + In depth knowledge and understanding of tokenization, virtual payments, commercial technology landscape, expense management and reconciliation capabilities. * + Demonstrated success delivering technically complex autonomous systems that customers actively rely on. * + Meaningful contributions to open\-source AI or agentic frameworks. * + Familiarity with fine\-tuning, model optimization and inference pipelines is a plus Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **About Analog Devices** Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X . **About the Role** As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be a founding engineer on an API\-First platform for managing ADI's product specifications, building a single trusted source for product specification data. This role sits at the intersections of software, hardware, design, and marketing. The data you will model describes integrated circuits, including parametric and non\-parametric data. You will need to understand what that data means to the engineers who write it and the customers who design with it. Working closely with the hiring manager, you will deepen your knowledge of the product specification domain, help shape the architecture, and build and ship usable software in early, incremental releases. You will also own the migration of existing specification data into the new platform, making sure it arrives complete, accurate, and traceable. This is a hands\-on, high\-visibility role working with cross\-functional teams across the business. As the platform and team expand, this role will grow into the platform's technical lead. As a core technical member of this system\-driven software product development team, you will collaborate with experienced colleagues representing a well\-rounded team, e.g., product management, project management, software engineering, software QA, business analysis, user experience, etc. Our goal is to set new standards of software product development excellence together. **Key Responsibilities** **Build the platform** * Design, build, test, and deploy the services and APIs of an API\-first specification platform, from data model through to downstream consumers. * Implement a structured data model for product specifications, aligned with industry standards and supporting traceability from requirements to specification to verification. * Build stable, versioned, well\-documented APIs that let teams across ADI read and use specification content. * Integrate with existing systems and tooling, such as Jama requirements management, document control, and data sheet generation. * Work directly with design, applications, and test engineers to understand how specifications are defined, measured, and guaranteed, and reflect that faithfully in the data model, including parameters, conditions, units, MIN/TYP/MAX limits, and test coverage. **Own the data migration** * Own the migration of large volumes of specification data from existing systems into the new platform, including source analysis, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover planning. * Reconcile specification content during migration: identify values that are missing, inconsistent, or stated without their conditions, and work with engineering owners to resolve them. * Keep the migration transparent: define measurable completeness and accuracy criteria, report progress and data quality to stakeholders, and ensure every migrated record can be traced back to its source. **Deliver production\-quality software** * Take end\-to\-end ownership of what you build, from design through production operation, including fixing what breaks. * Deliver reliable, secure, observable, and maintainable software in incremental releases, starting with an early usable release and evolving it toward a production platform. * Apply and help establish industry\-standard product development practices: backlog management, design and code reviews, automated testing, jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer - Barracuda
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **ABOUT THE TEAM** As a **Product Quality Engineer at Anduril in Santa Ana, CA**, you will work inside \& outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality missile programs. This role focuses on collaborating and driving early engagement with our design teams and partner to meet our quality requirements the first time and to evaluate the product health \& performance. The right person for this role has knowledge of missile product performance, sub\-system performance criteria, metrology, and continuous improvement. An ideal candidate for this role has experiences in missile manufacturing, product development, test/system performance criteria, metrology, and quality planning. If you are someone who loves to build world\-class quality processes and missile products, work hands\-on with engineering, and be accountable for results of a small team, then this role is for you. Per Anduril's expansion plans, we anticipate this job will be based out of Long Beach, CA beginning late 2027\. #### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Drive product development and production for missile programs using processes such as drawing and work instruction reviews, quality planning, inspection, acceptance test performance management, end\-of\-line metrics, verification, validation, and qualification of processes and parts, sub\-assemblies, and the vehicle, itself. * Drive clarity \& resolution for production ambiguities associated with product maturity, process stability, and field performance. * Champion the transition from new product introduction (NPI) to a sustainable \& predictable, high rate manufacturing process, supply chain, and deployment support. * Own the elimination of product risk to improve reliability across the product lifecycle. * Ensure the execution of product and process requirements. Define and improve such requirements. * Lead Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA), Material Review Board (MRB) activities, and inspection process performance. Review the effectiveness of actions and share lessons learned across the product team. * Lead product health data analysis and improvement activities. Establish metrics for measuring quality and the factors that predict quality performance. * Support the continuous improvement of the Quality Management System. Define and improve required documentation and activities. * Develop an overall quality plan (similar to APQP) for various missile projects. Leverage resources and direct reports to delivery quality through the development cycle. Design, development, and leverage elements of the Anduril QMS to build confidence and containment for missile customers quality expectations. Set expectations for qualification of internal and external manufacturing processes including measurement methods, PPAP/FAI, inspection methods \& test protocol \& acceptance test plans for missile programs. Lead the transition from engineering qualification to manufacturing variance testing for product quality coverage. * Lead product health data analysis and improvement activities for the missile projects. * Matrix lead supplier quality engineers who are supporting the design and development activities with the suppliers for Missile programs. #### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or similar technical field * Experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Quality on previous Missiles or high velocity vehicle systems. * Working knowledge of design review and quality management of missile systems, PCBA, harnessing, avionics, systems integration, composites/control surfaces, propulsion systems, and lethality systems. * Experience driving product quality and performance requirements to test and measurement system development and optimization. Knowledgeable of missile storage and maintenance processes. * Experience partnering with Reliability Engineering, chief engineers, architects, manufacturing engineering, and customer facing team members to deliver to customer requirements. * Working knowledge of product development methodologies such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) elements such as Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), and Geometric Dimensi  4\+ years of experience with developing quality systems for low volume, high complex manufacturing environments and suppliers. Working knowledge of AS9100/ AS6500 / ISO 9001\-based Quality Management System requirements. * Experience with IPC standards and general workmanship standards. * Experience with government contracts and MIL standard requirements commonly applied to quality requirements for aerial vehicles. Experience with Teamcenter, SolidWorks/NX, Jira, Foundry, and manufacturing execution The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Commercial
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As an Applied AI Engineer on the Commercial team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the companies that run the real economy, across software, financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and professional services, as they go from using Claude to building on it. Commercial is one of Anthropic's largest and fastest\-moving books of business, covering thousands of mid\-market and small companies. Some of these companies put Claude inside the product they sell, and others put agents to work inside their own engineering, operations, finance, and support teams, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with customer engineering teams to take their hardest agent builds from idea to production on the Claude API, the Agent SDK, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Code, and Claude for Enterprise. Many of these teams are lean, with years of existing systems and no dedicated AI function, and you will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to run it inside a business that already has customers depending on it. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll go deep where hands\-on engineering changes the outcome, then turn what you learn into something the rest of the book can use. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the reference implementations, tooling, and technical resources that enable Commercial customers to succeed with Claude. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as a deep technical advisor to high\-potential Commercial customers, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they run their own business, bringing them use cases worth building and pushing the boundaries of what agents can do in engineering, operations, finance, customer support, and more * Work hands\-on with customer engineering teams through build sprints, pair programming, and architecture reviews that move agents from idea to production, and understand their stack, data, and workflows end to end so that your guidance fits the systems, security requirements, and team they have today * Ship working code. Develop prototypes, near\-production examples, and technical documentation, including evaluation suites that become the customer's acceptance criteria, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable customers to build, operate, and scale with Claude * Create reference implementations, blueprints, and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example multi\-agent systems on the Agent SDK or Claude Managed Agents, MCP servers for common business systems, or Claude Code running across the software development lifecycle * Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects and Account Executives to decide where engineering depth changes the outcome, and to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements * Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about running agents inside established companies such as legacy systems, messy data, permissions and security review, cost and latency at scale, and model migrations, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team * Build the demos, agents, and internal tooling that scale the Commercial Applied AI team itself, and pair with architects on their hardest technical problems * Create technical content for customer and partner engineering audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code * Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and customer events * Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Deep software engineering experience, gained by designing, building, and operating production systems, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how established companies get work done * 4\+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, forward deployed engineer, ML engineer, product engineer, or technical founder, with production experience building LLM\-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, MCP, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, and the ability to work in  degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We're building a massive, real\-time conversational experience from the ground up, one that will reach users at Apple scale. It sits at the intersection of Generative AI, Information Retrieval, and Knowledge Graphs. We're looking for a senior machine learning engineer to own the conversational intelligence layer: the agent's reasoning and tool\-calling, the low\-latency LLM inference behind it, and the knowledge services that keep every response accurate and grounded. You'll design multi\-turn conversational experiences, build agent logic that plans and calls tools, and develop query understanding models that turn natural language into structured intent. You'll also make large and small models fast and cost\-efficient enough to serve in real time. Just as importantly, you'll help make sure every response is accurate and grounded. You'll build and scale knowledge graph services that resolve, enrich, and expand user requests with low latency and also connect the system to real\-time data sources so its answers stay current. Finally, you'll build the evaluation that keeps all of it honest: automated and LLM\-as\-judge evaluation for multi\-turn conversations, built into the development workflow so regressions are caught before they reach users. jobs.title: Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering
jobs.description: **Aspire Public Schools NorCal — Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Engineering** **Job Description****About Aspire NorCal** Founded in 1998, Aspire Public Schools has served scholars and communities across California for nearly three decades. With Aspire Los Angeles transitioning into an independent organization, the Bay Area and Central Valley regions are coming together to form Aspire NorCal, operating 22 schools serving approximately 10,000 scholars across Northern California (Oakland, Richmond, East Palo Alto, Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, and Ceres). This evolution comes at an important moment for Aspire. Changes in California’s funding, policy, enrollment, and operating environment have created an opportunity to rethink how the organization supports its schools and scholars in its next chapter. The formation of Aspire NorCal creates an opportunity to strengthen support for schools across teams previously organized by geography, improve the consistency and effectiveness of school support, and create clear accountability systems for organizational and scholar outcomes. The new model will require the organization to balance greater coherence across Aspire NorCal with responsiveness to the different communities and contexts of its schools. Aspire NorCal enters this transition with a long\-standing mission focused on post\-secondary success and a deep commitment to educational equity, along with decades of institutional knowledge across its schools and teams. Preserving those strengths while building Aspire NorCal as a unified region will be central to the work ahead. **About the AI, Data \& Systems Enablement team** The Data \& Systems team exists to give principals, teachers, and teammates their time back. We are responsible for Aspire NorCal's data and the key software systems that cross departments, and we measure ourselves by the experience of the people we serve: a principal gets a trusted answer in minutes if not seconds, a new hire is entered once, and no one navigates five systems to do one job. We use AI to get there, and we set the policy and training that keep it useful and appropriately safe. The team is made up of an Enablement team that builds the shared foundation, plus pods that each serve a customer group: School Operations \& Principals, Academics \& Teachers, and People \& Resources. Our working principles: go deep with users, one shared foundation, self\-serve first, learning is the job, and nobody works alone. **About the role** Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Engineering leads the engineering that makes Aspire NorCal's data trustworthy. As the team's technical lead, you are the dedicated owner of the data warehouse, semantic layer, integrations, data governance, and the AI platform. You set and uphold the engineering practices every pod builds on: code control, review, testing, and standard toolkits. You own the integration strategy, set the integration priorities, and write the migration plan, then move the 40\+ legacy integrations onto a governed, version\-controlled platform, and you mentor pod members in AI\-supported data modeling and semantic layer management through pairing and review. This role works closely with the Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Enablement, a peer who also reports to the CTO, and with the Senior Analyst for AI, Data \& Systems (Enablement). It has no direct reports, but mentors pod members. This posting is for one opening. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the data warehouse (in partnership with our vendor, KAE) and ensure it remains useful and relevant to achieve the team’s broader goals. Retire legacy data warehouse. * Own Lightdash administration and the semantic layer, which holds the shared definitions and documentation that let teammates and AI find and trust the data. * Own data governance: the data access rules for Lightdash and the warehouse, data classification, and data quality, so that AI answers come only from governed sources, under the asker’s own access rights. * Own the AI platform: approved AI tools, data rules, and technical guardrails, and the technical review of each AI use case. The Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Enablement drafts the AI policy and runs the use\-case pipeline with you. * Create and execute an appropriate strategy for maintaining systems integrations, set integration priorities, write the migration plan, and migrate/retire existing integrations. * In the first six months, serve as technical lead for the implementation of the new HRIS. * Set engineering practices: code control, code review, and standard toolkits, and socialize them throughout the team. * Mentor pod members in AI\-supported data modeling and semantic layer management, through pairing and review. **Qualifications** **Mindsets (required)** * **Intellectual humility:** curious enough to ask the question that shows what you don't know, and secure enough to laugh at yourself. * **Interest in AI that serves Aspire's mission:** has used AI tools on real work, can describe what worked and what did not, and wants to help colleagues use AI to give time back to teachers, principals, and teammates. * **Teaches, coaches, and keeps learning:** leaves people more capable than you found them, and learns from colleagues, customers, and mistakes. * **Service\-minded:** treats principals, teachers, and teammates as customers, with a track record of empathy for the people you serve and curiosity about how schools really work. **Experience (required)** * 15\+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering. * 5\+ years as part of a high performing, mature development team leveraging modern software practices. * Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), dbt, and data pipelines. * Has created AI workflows and automations that colleagues actually used. * Has written or enforced data governance and access controls. * Has migrated legacy data jobs or integrations onto a governed, version\-controlled platform without losing what users relied on. * Track record of teaching and developing others effectively and treating knowledge\-sharing as part of the job. * Communicates clearly with non\-technical users. * Understands student or employee data privacy obligations (FERPA, California privacy law) and handles sensitive data carefully. **Bonus points for** * K\-12 data experience. * Experience with a semantic layer, Lightdash, or similar AI\-enabled data tool. * A teaching, coaching, or mentoring background. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- The salary range for this role is $168,050 to $215,728 annually in accordance with our salary schedule policy, commensurate with experience. This full\-time, exempt position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Eligible for Aspire health benefits * Retirement through CalSTRS or CalPERS, depending on the role's credential requirements, with a 403(b) option * Paid time off and additional teammate benefits to be determined in accordance with updated employee value proposition to be shared prior to offer. Aspire NorCal is conducting a comprehensive study of our employee value proposition, which could lead to material changes in July 2027\. **Location and work arrangement** --------------------------------- * Preference is given to candidates who reside in a county where Aspire NorCal schools are located (San Mateo, Alameda, Contra Costa, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, or Sacramento) or in an adjacent county. Periodic travel is required across schools, from East Palo Alto to the East Bay and from Sacramento to Modesto. This is a remote or hybrid role; the arrangement will be determined by the Chief Technology Officer. Employment with Aspire is at\-will. **Application Deadline:** December 4, 2026 **Equal opportunity** Aspire Public Schools is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Aspire Public Schools provides reasonable accommodations during the application and interview process. #### **Disclaimer** *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

change control and CAPA systems; DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ; FAT/SAT/UAT; positive and negative testing; traceability; audit trails; access management; backup/restore; archival; electronic signatures; data\-flow cybersecurity, integration, automation projects, and cross\-functional technical leadership. **Core Competencies** * Purpose\-driven CSV and Data Integrity leadership * Sound judgment, critical jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Engineering
jobs.description: At Auction.com, we’re transforming real estate. As the nation’s leading online platform for buying and selling residential bank\-owned and foreclosure properties, we connect buyers, sellers, and investors with innovative technology. With over $70 billion in assets, our success is driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact. We go beyond the bid—empowering our people to thrive and shape the future of the industry About the Role We operate one of the largest digital marketplaces in residential real estate, where buyers, sellers, servicers, and agents transact on real property with real money at stake. Every listing that moves through our platform touches valuation, bidding, contracts, payments, and a broad ecosystem of external systems. Our technology platform continues to evolve to meet the needs of a dynamic market. We're seeking an Sr. Engineering Manager, Full Stack Engineering to lead and develop engineering talent while driving the architecture, delivery, and ongoing evolution of our core technology platform. This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role responsible for managing and developing a team of software engineers, establishing technical direction, and ensuring the delivery of scalable, secure, high\-quality software. You'll partner closely with Product, UX, Data, and business leaders to translate strategic priorities into technical solutions and deliver meaningful business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings deep full stack engineering experience, proven people management capabilities, and the ability to balance technical leadership with team development and execution. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - Data Capture, Data Capture Team
jobs.description: At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It's why we work with some of the world's leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us. ABOUT THIS ROLE As a Software Dev Engineer II, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Bring challenging ideas, and we’ll support you with the tools and systems you need to succeed. You’ll work closely with your teammates, review their work, and help them grow. Together, you’ll build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice. ABOUT THE TEAM The Data Capture team builds Audible’s data collection and distribution platform. We capture how customers use our apps and website, and deliver that data in near real time to analytics, marketing and personalization systems across Audible and Amazon. Our systems handle high\-volume event streams using AWS technologies such as Kinesis, EventBridge, Lambda, DynamoDB and S3\. ABOUT YOU You have a background in building large\-scale data collection systems, and you’re excited to make near real\-time data useful across the business. You enjoy owning your services end to end, from design through operations, and you care about getting the details right. We look for people who show initiative, set their standards high and see every failure as an opportunity to learn. You’re looking for an environment where you can thrive. With opportunities to challenge yourself and a talented team by your side, you’ll find what you’re looking for at Audible. As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will... * Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable event\-driven systems that collect near real\-time data across Audible’s apps and services, with a focus on data quality, primarily using Java and AWS * Create integrations to distribute data to Audible and Amazon services as well as third\-party marketing and analytics platforms * Own the operational health of your services, including monitoring, alarming and on\-call support * Work alongside an agile engineering team, writing scalable and maintainable code and influencing team decisions * Independently clarify technical requirements, assess development estimates, and employ diverse design approaches. * Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members * Collaborate with stakeholders to envision, design, develop, test, and launch customer\-centric software solutions * Foster continuous improvement in software quality, customer experience, and product maintainability * Use AI\-powered developer tools across the software lifecycle, from design and coding to testing and operations ABOUT AUDIBLE Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners' imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers' daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home. jobs.title: Staff ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About Axiado Corporation** Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast\-growing, well\-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real\-time platform management, and AI\-driven optimization. Our TCU\-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware\-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start\-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.**Job Description** ------------------- **About the role** We're looking for an ML engineer who works across the full stack from model to silicon — comfortable optimizing training and inference performance on GPU/AI\-accelerator infrastructure, building or tuning models, and adapting model and inference\-engine design to the constraints of the underlying chip and its NPU. You'll move fluidly between algorithm work, systems\-level software, and infrastructure work, closing the loop end\-to\-end rather than owning just one layer of the stack. This is a rare chance to work the full cycle of AI silicon, from model down to chip — something most ML engineers at large companies never get access to. **What you'll do** * Optimize training and inference performance across GPU and AI\-accelerator infrastructure, including MLOps pipelines * Design, train, and evaluate ML models (deep learning, LLM, CV, or recommendation systems) and take them into production * Harden and extend NPU cores (e.g. building on an open RVV/tensor core like CoralNPU) into production silicon * Build or optimize inference engines and serving runtimes against real hardware constraints — latency, memory, and power * Work below the application layer where needed — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, or RTOS (e.g. Zephyr) — so AI features run reliably on real systems * Build automated test/verification harnesses that close the loop for AI\-assisted RTL/DV, hardware bring\-up, or manufacturing test * Apply ML to security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security work * Collaborate closely with RTL/hardware, firmware, and QA teams to ship AI features end\-to\-end, from training through deployment and monitoring **Qualifications** ------------------ **What we're looking for** * 5–7\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML experience; Master's required, PhD preferred * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure and performance — GPU clusters, distributed training, inference\-serving optimization, MLOps pipelines * Model / algorithm development experience — designing, training, and evaluating ML models * Experience taking models into production — feature engineering, data pipelines, deployment * AI chip / hardware\-aware ML experience — optimizing inference engines for a specific chip, or adapting model architecture/quantization to chip constraints * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least 2 of the following 5 specialty areas — we don't expect all five: * + **NPU / AI\-accelerator —** hardening or extending an NPU core into production silicon, mapping models onto MAC/tensor\-engine constraints, or NPU\-aware RTL/DV work + **Systems / Sys\-level software —** BMC firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS (e.g. Zephyr), or other low\-level system software + **Inference engine / runtime —** built or materially optimized an inference engine or serving runtime against real hardware constraints + **Test / verification harness —** built an automated harness that closes a loop, e.g. an agent\-driven RTL/DV test runner or a hardware bring\-up / MFG test harness + **Cyber security —** AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security **Additional Information** -------------------------- Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real\-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer I, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. **Your Impact** --------------- Dedrone by Axon protects airspace from drone threats. Each deployment combines our software, our own and partner sensors, and a networking stack that connects the site to DedroneC2 in the cloud. As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you are part of the team that owns the technical outcome at our most critical customer sites. This is a software and systems role. You work mostly through remote access to customer sites, and our installation teams and partners do the physical work. You take each problem from live triage to a fix in the field, then make sure the long\-term fix lands in the product. You have the authority to raise defects and to join design reviews with our product teams, based on what you see first\-hand. One question guides the work: how do we leave the product better than we found it, so nobody has to work this issue again? **What You'll Do** ------------------ Location: Hybrid. Up to 20% travel required, to customer sites, demonstrations, and exercises. Must be within commutable distance to one of our Hub locations listed below: Sterling VA) Reports to: Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering * Own complex site issues end to end: lead the incident, get the site working, and write the review afterwards. * Resolve live site problems that Support escalates, diagnosing failures across software, sensors, and networks with customers and installers. * Write the fixes, integrations, and automation that get a site working, and set the quality bar for field fixes through code reviews. * Leave no one\-off behind: move each site\-specific fix into the product or retire it, and follow the root cause with our product teams until the fix ships. * Set the standards for the runbooks, checklists, acceptance tests, and monitoring that make deployments repeatable. * Mentor engineers on the team, and coach Support and installers on what you learn. * Take part in the engineering on\-call rota. * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools across your work, and help the team use them well. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 6\+ years of experience in software engineering, site reliability, or systems integration * Production ownership: you have been on call, led incidents, and debugged live systems from logs and metrics * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python or Java, with a record of shipping code to production * Clear communication with customers, installers, and engineers during live incidents * Experience mentoring engineers and conducting technical interviews * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted engineering tools and workflows * Deep experience in one of these: + Software: you have designed and owned production services, and you can find and fix a defect in a large codebase that you did not write. + Systems: you have deployed and troubleshot Linux systems and IP networks at production or customer sites, including integration with third\-party equipment. **Work Location** This role is based out of our Sterling Office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in\-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in\-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success. #### **Benefits that Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary paid time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, Vision plans * Fitness Programs * Emotional \& Mental Wellness support * Learning \& Development programs * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) * And yes, we have snacks in our offices *Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.* Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.* *We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.* Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers. If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not **@axon.com**, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

This is an opportunity to contribute to technology initiatives in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth. **Job Title: Test Data Engineer** **Location: Remote** **Position Type: Full\-time, Direct W2 \- \[Not open to C2C or 1099]** **Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually** **Experience Required: 5\+ years** Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H\-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H\-1B visa petitions for this position. Job Summary Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Test Data Engineer to design and maintain reliable test\-data solutions for application, integration, and analytics testing. The role will build repeatable data provisioning and refresh processes, create representative synthetic datasets, support data masking and quality checks, and help engineering teams obtain accurate test data across development and test environments. Key Responsibilities * Design and implement reusable test\-data provisioning, generation, refresh, and cleanup processes. * Build scripts and utilities to create representative datasets for functional, integration, and performance testing. * Work with relational and non\-relational databases to profile, transform, validate, and manage test data. * Implement masking, tokenization, and synthetic\-data techniques in accordance with approved privacy controls. * Collaborate with QA, developers, data teams, and environment owners to resolve data dependencies and improve test readiness. Required Qualifications * Experience Required: typically 5\+ years in data engineering, database development, or test\-data management; align with the approved requisition. * Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. * Programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or a comparable language for data automation. * Experience with data profiling, transformation, validation, referential integrity, and dataset management. * Understanding of test\-data lifecycle practices, data masking, synthetic data, and controlled access procedures. * Ability to automate repeatable data workflows and integrate them with testing or CI/CD processes. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and cross\-team communication skills. * Experience working in iterative software delivery teams, participating in planning, defect triage, and release validation as appropriate to the assignment. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with cloud data platforms, data warehouses, or distributed data processing tools. * Familiarity with test\-data management platforms and automated data\-generation utilities. * Knowledge of privacy\-by\-design principles and regulated data\-handling requirements. * Relevant database, data engineering, or cloud certifications. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com. Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Products
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast\-to\-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring. *Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.* *Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.* **Job Description:** ==================== **What we're building** ======================= We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start. Baker Tilly is the sixth\-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll own an agent or product area from discovery to production. You'll work with practitioners to turn how experts do their jobs into software they trust, and help other engineers move faster. **What you'll work with** ========================= * Years of client engagement history, tax returns, and financial records, at the scale of a major firm. * Tax, audit, and advisory practitioners who help define what good looks like and review what the agents produce. * Real users inside the firm who give direct feedback on what you build. * We work in partnership with frontier labs. * A mix of building and buying. You'll help decide which is which, and everything we ship meets the same standards for security, tracing, and testing. * Our stack: Python, TypeScript and React, Databricks, graph and vector databases, MCP, OpenTelemetry, and Braintrust, on Azure. **What you'll do** ================== * Own an agent or product area from the first conversation with practitioners through production and beyond, turning expert judgment into clear requirements and a way to measure success. * Build across the stack: frontend, backend, APIs, data, and the agent layer (retrieval, tools through MCP, orchestration). * Build the testing loop: tracing, expert\-labeled ground truth, and release gates scored against what our experts say is right. * Build access control and human approval into the design from the start. * Decide what to build and what to buy, and bring in outside tools and agents to our standards. * Use AI coding tools extensively, and help us ship through a code factory more and more: agents do more of the building while engineers direct the work, review it, and own quality. * Run your own projects: break down vague problems, manage dependencies, and own what happens in production. * Review code, pair with people, and help other engineers get better. **Who you are** =============== * You're a hands\-on technologist who has built things people actually use, ideally end to end, from the first conversation with users through production and after. * You're naturally curious, a strong problem solver, and a clear communicator. * You can take an objective, form an opinion, and move things forward on your own, even when the path is unclear. **What you bring** ================== * 8 years of experience shipping and running production software, with ownership across frontend and backend preferred. We look at the scope you've owned. * You use AI coding tools extensively, and you have opinions about what works. * React and TypeScript, plus a backend language like Python, Node, Go, or Java. * You've built LLM features in production (retrieval, tool use, structured output, evals), or you pick up new technology fast. * You've led a project through to a reliable production release. * Good judgment on APIs, data design, cloud services, authentication, testing, deployment, and observability. * You see "is this allowed?" as a design input that shapes the solution. * You've worked directly with customers or domain experts, and you can explain a tradeoff clearly. * You make the people around you better through code review and coaching. * Bachelor's Degree Required **Nice to have** ================ * React, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Azure, Databricks, containers, or event\-driven systems. * Graph or vector databases, MCP, or LLM evaluation and tracing. * Enterprise integrations, data with strict access rules, or regulated and professional\-services settings. **In a year** ============= * A messy problem has become an agent practitioners trust, and you can measure it. * Your systems run reliably and are easy to change. * Other engineers work faster because of your reviews and practices. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.* *The national pay rate range is $225,000 – $280,000* *In California: pay rate range is $225,000 – $280,000* \#LI\-AC1
