jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW:** Balchem is committed to making the world a healthier place by delivering trusted, innovative, and science\-based solutions for the health and nutritional needs of the world. Balchem employs approximately 1,400 employees worldwide who provide the service, quality, and technology that enables our customers to win with their customers. We have built a reputation for delivering results to all of our stakeholders. Founded in 1967, Balchem, a Maryland corporation, became a publicly\-traded company in 1970 and is listed on Nasdaq under the symbol “BCPC.” Our corporate headquarters is located in Montvale, New Jersey, and we have a broad network of sales offices, manufacturing sites, and R\&D centers, primarily located in the U.S. and Europe. The Company consists of three business segments: Human Nutrition and Health, Animal Nutrition and Health, and Specialty Products. **POSITION SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer will design, build, and deploy AI agents and AI\-enabled automations for Balchem's supporting functions (Finance, Operations, HR, Legal, etc.) and Business Segments. This is a hands\-on technical role focused on applying commercially available AI platforms and large language models to real business processes, not on building or training foundation models. Success in this role requires strong software development and integration skills, practical experience with generative AI and agent tooling, and the business acumen to turn a process problem into a working, reliable solution. The AI Engineer will collaborate with functional teams to understand how work gets done today, then build agents that connect to Balchem's systems and data and deliver measurable productivity gains. While working closely with specific business segments and functions to ensure each solution fits its context, the AI Engineer builds with an enterprise\-wide perspective, favoring reusable components, common standards, and secure, supportable designs that can scale across Balchem. The AI Engineer will work within Balchem's AI Governance Process, helping to execute the Corporate AI Strategy by delivering prioritized use cases and ensuring every solution meets the organization's AI guardrails for security, privacy, and responsible use. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** **AI Agent Design \& Development** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents, copilots, and assistants using existing AI platforms, large language models, and agent frameworks to automate and improve business processes across Balchem's functions and business segments. **Systems Integration \& Automation** * Integrate AI agents with Balchem's enterprise applications and data sources (ERP, CRM, collaboration, and data platforms) using APIs, connectors, and workflow tools. * Build AI\-driven automations that reduce manual steps, shorten cycle times, and improve the accuracy of routine work. **Solution Delivery \& Lifecycle Management** * Own the full delivery lifecycle for AI solutions, from requirements and prototyping through testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support. * Translate business requirements into technical designs and help prioritize the delivery backlog based on potential benefit and business objectives. * Ensure solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact. **Use Case Discovery \& Prototyping** * Work with business stakeholders to identify and assess high\-value use cases for AI agents and automation across the organization. * Build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept to validate feasibility and value before committing to full development. **Prompt Engineering \& Knowledge Grounding** * Apply prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and tool calling to ground agents in Balchem's data and knowledge, improving the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of their output. **User Enablement \& Adoption** * Support the rollout of new AI solutions with clear documentation, demonstrations, and hands\-on guidance for end users. * Partner with functional teams to gather feedback, resolve issues, and refine solutions so they are adopted and continue to deliver value. **Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI** * Build solutions that protect company data by applying appropriate access controls, data handling practices, and testing for accuracy and misuse. * Ensure all solutions comply with Balchem's AI Policy and IT security standards. **Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement** * Monitor the usage, quality, and cost of deployed agents, track KPIs, and continuously tune solutions to improve their performance and impact. **Collaboration \& Technology Awareness** * Work closely with IT, cybersecurity, and business teams, and stay current on emerging AI tools and practices to recommend those that fit Balchem's needs. **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in software development, automation, or systems integration, including at least a year of hands\-on work building generative AI solutions. * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM\-powered applications into production using existing platforms and APIs (for example, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, or comparable agent frameworks). * Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent orchestration, and solution evaluation. Experience training or building foundation models is not required. * Proficiency in Python or a similar language, REST APIs, and low\-code automation tools, with experience integrating solutions into enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, and Microsoft 365\. * Understanding of data security, privacy, and responsible AI practices, with a commitment to continuous learning as AI technologies and best practices evolve. * Strong communication, collaboration skills and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and work effectively with business stakeholders. The expected salary range for this position is $150,000 \- $180,000 a year Balchem is committed to a workplace culture that values and promotes diversity, inclusion, equal employment opportunities, and a work environment free of harassment and hostility.

jobs.description: **Title:** Sr SCADA Operations Engineer **Location:** Remote **Job Type:** Full\-time **Reports To:** Operations Engineering Manager **About Us** We are BayWa r.e. Americas Projects \& Services, a leading developer of utility\-scale renewable energy. We are also an in\-house and third\-party operations and services provider, offering 24/7/365 monitoring from our headquarters in Carlsbad, CA. Our team consists of 300 highly motivated experts across the United States and Mexico. Since first entering the North American market in 2014, we have brought over 2 GW online. Our development pipeline is currently 15GW in North America alone and continues to grow at an impressive pace. Our mission is to deliver reliable and affordable energy across the Americas. We value long\-term partnerships and actively collaborate with local communities and organizations to fund workforce development, support disaster relief efforts, and incorporate sustainability and biodiversity into our projects. BayWa r.e. Americas Projects \& Services is a subsidiary of BayWa r.e., a major player in renewable energy. BayWa r.e. has a global team of 5,400 members, operations in 34 countries, a development pipeline exceeding 30 GW, and over 10 GW in assets under management. Our shareholders are BayWa AG, a $28\.5 billion international group known for its diversified operations in agriculture, energy, and construction; and Energy Infrastructure Partners, a renowned leader in energy infrastructure investment managing over $7\.5 billion from global investors. **Purpose:** The Senior SCADA Engineer is responsible for the implementation, integration, maintenance, and technical support of Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Power Plant Controller (PPC) systems to ensure the safe, reliable, secure, and efficient operation of renewable energy facilities across the BayWa r.e. Operation Services fleet. This position provides critical real\-time technical support for SCADA systems and plant communication infrastructure, ensuring continuous monitoring, operational visibility, and remote control capabilities for the Remote Operations Control Center (ROCC). The role also supports the integration and commissioning of new renewable energy facilities, administration and continuous improvement of the centralized control center SCADA platform, and technical assistance and training for field personnel. Through close collaboration with control center operators, field technicians, engineering teams, customers, and external stakeholders, the SCADA Engineer ensures SCADA systems remain reliable, secure, and aligned with operational requirements while supporting the continued growth of the Services organization. **Position Responsibilities:** · **Real\-Time SCADA \& Operations Technical Support** o Provide real\-time technical support for both SCADA systems and operational / electrical systems, and associated control infrastructure across the renewable energy fleet. o Participate in a 24/7 engineering on\-call rotation, providing after\-hours technical support, incident response, and escalation assistance to maintain critical SCADA functionality and minimize operational disruptions. o Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve SCADA\-related issues, including communication failures, data acquisition problems, control command failures, alarm abnormalities, and system outages. o Support Remote Operations Control Center (ROCC) operators in identifying and resolving technical issues that impact plant monitoring, dispatch, and remote control capabilities. o Monitor SCADA system performance, communication health, and operational reliability to proactively identify and address potential issues. o Coordinate with field personnel, equipment manufacturers, and third\-party service providers to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical problems. o Develop and deliver technical training to improve field technicians' understanding of SCADA systems, communication protocols, and troubleshooting procedures. o Develop troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and standardized procedures to support consistent and efficient field operations. · **New Facility SCADA Integration and Commissioning** o Support the onboarding and integration of new renewable energy facilities into the centralized control center SCADA platform. o Configure and integrate plant SCADA interfaces, communication protocols, data points, alarms, and remote control functionality. o Establish and validate communication pathways between renewable energy facilities and centralized monitoring and control systems. o Develop, review, and validate SCADA point mappings, data acquisition configurations, and control interfaces. o Perform functional testing and commissioning activities to verify data accuracy, communication reliability, alarm functionality, and remote control capabilities. o Coordinate with project managers, commissioning teams, equipment vendors, and customers to ensure successful SCADA integra orking knowledge of PLC programming, industrial control logic, scripting, function blocks, and PID control loops. * **Customer Requirements and Solution Development:** Experience gathering technical requirements, incorporating operator and customer feedback, and implementing SCADA enhancements that meet operational and business needs. * **SCADA Commissioning and Validation:** Experience performing SCADA integration, functional testing, point\-to\-point verification, control validation, and commissioning activities. * **SCADA Troubleshooting and Operational Support:** Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve SCADA communication failures, data acquisition issues, control command failures, and other problems affecting operational systems. * **Technical Documentation:** Experience developing and maintaining SCADA point lists, communication diagrams, system configurations, testing procedures, and technical troubleshooting documentation. **Preferred Experience:** · **SCADA Platforms:** Direct experience with N3uron or comparable industrial SCADA and data integration platforms, such as Ignition and Kepware. · **Renewable Energy Equipment:** jobs.title: Senior Mobile App Engineer (React Native)
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. As a Senior Mobile App Engineer, you'll help power Beacon's mission by building cross\-platform apps that interface with our EEG headbands and other wearables to capture high\-fidelity data and enable seamless experiences for patients and clinicians. This isn't just another app. You'll be crafting tools that help unlock insights into neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders, with the potential to improve lives at scale. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs located in Boston and New York. For this position we will consider candidates based anywhere in the US Eastern time zone. ### **What success looks like:** As part of our small, mission\-driven Mobile Apps Team, you will: * Develop our React Native mobile applications and our native iOS and Android BLE device SDKs. * Design and implement UX workflows for clinical trial participants and at\-home diagnostic patients. * Own the user experience, app performance, reliability, and observability of the apps and features you develop, leveraging feedback from real users in a diverse set of use cases and environments. * Partner with our Devices team, other Platform teams, and product designers to develop user\-centric mobile app capabilities that are deeply integrated with the rest of Beacon's product ecosystem. * Help shape the roadmap and technical direction of our mobile platform. In your first 3–6 months, you might: * Build a new in\-app feature to validate EEG signal quality before data capture. * Improve BLE pairing and reconnection reliability across both iOS and Android. * Streamline onboarding for new patients and trial participants to help make our devices easier to use than ever. * Deploy new features to help our Clinical Operations team track compliance. ### **What you will bring:** You'll be a great fit if you have: * 5\+ years of experience in mobile development (native iOS/Android and/or React Native). * Experience working with BLE, sensor integration, or health data streams. * A product mindset — you care deeply about UX, edge cases, and performance. * Familiarity with our tech stack (TypeScript, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Expo, GitHub) * Strong communication skills and comfort working in a collaborative, async environment Bonus points if you've: * Worked with medical devices, EEG, or wearables. * Integrated BLE peripheral devices into iOS and/or Android applications. * Written native code extensively for either iOS or Android, in addition to React Native. * Worked on apps for clinical trials, patients, or in some other regulated environment. * Contributed to open source mobile or BLE projects. The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $170,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits. At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and \- most of all \- a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: SR Data Engineer

Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts. As a Software Engineer on the Self\-host Orchestration team at Bitwarden, you will directly contribute to projects that our customers use to deploy Bitwarden into their infrastructure. You'll be a part of the team that builds and maintains the packaging, testing, and deployment for our self\-host product, including our Helm chart project. This role also offers the opportunity to interact directly with our open source community through pull request and triaging community issues. This is an all remote team and we are looking for a US based engineer. Engineering and Customer Success teams to understand client needs and implement technical solutions to address them * Build and maintain tools that deploy \& test our self\-host stacks on diverse infrastructure setups * Participate in hands\-on development of Bitwarden products * Use, maintain, and augment or AI skills and infrastructure as part of our AI\-driven product delivery lifecycle. * Experience with Argo CD, Fluxcd, or alternative GitOps delivery tools * Proficiency with at least one cloud platform, Azure preferred * Proficiency with Git and dependency management * Experience jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Software Engineering – Aladdin - Director
jobs.description: Locations: **Atlanta, Georgia** **Job description** ------------------- **About this role** **Your team** Aladdin is a unified investment operating system used across BlackRock and by technology clients around the world. Aladdin Platform Engineering builds and runs the shared technology foundation on which Aladdin applications depend, giving the team impact across the platform. As part of this organization, you will lead a small, focused team of experienced engineers who turn non\-functional requirements (NFRs) into practical standards that can be tested and enforced automatically, and who apply AI engineering to assist platform engineers, including developing platform services and managing observability. You will work closely with platform teams that own the underlying technologies and with application teams across Aladdin that act on the findings. **Your role and impact** We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with solid application development and application architecture experience, who can define best practices and has a track record of driving technology transformation on a modern stack. The ability to learn quickly and understand the current Aladdin architecture is key. In this role, you will own the technology strategy for NFR standards and their enforcement, and for AI engineering initiatives that assist the platform team, helping Aladdin move from reacting to incidents to preventing them and helping platform engineers work more effectively. You will define a shared standard for what “production\-ready” means, informed by incident history, and establish automated checks on code changes. You will also develop platform services and AI\-enabled tooling, and manage observability across the platform. Applications will receive clear assessments and actionable remediation guidance, while leadership will gain visibility into the health of the portfolio. You will report to the head of the Aladdin Platform organization and be accountable for improving platform\-wide outcomes rather than for a single product. **Your responsibilities** In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: * Own NFR standards and their enforcement across the Aladdin platform, turning incident learnings into standards that are checked automatically. * Lead a small engineering team and build and run the NFR toolkit that assesses applications against those standards, and the AI\-enabled tooling that supports platform engineers. * Deliver a quality gate in the build and release pipeline that runs NFR checks on every pull request. * Deliver a quality passport and fitness dashboard that shows application scores over time and provides a clear list of required fixes. * Negotiate and agree specifications with platform owners, beginning with in\-memory data store and relational database platforms and extending coverage to additional platforms. * Drive remediation across application teams you do not manage and give leadership clear visibility into portfolio health. * Define and promote application development and architecture best practices across Aladdin, based on a quick and thorough understanding of the current architecture. * Lead AI engineering efforts that assist platform engineers, such as AI\-assisted development, operations and troubleshooting workflows. * Develop platform services that platform and application teams can reuse. * Manage observability for the platform, including monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting, to improve detection and resolution of incidents. * Own a multi\-quarter roadmap, including cost visibility by platform and application, and report progress against platform\-wide incident reduction. **Your experience** * At least 17 years of experience in large\-scale system design, development and deployment across software engineering, platform engineering, site reliability or production engineering, including experience managing engineers and owning technology strategy and multi\-quarter roadmaps. * Strong programming skills in Java, C\+\+, Golang, Python or similar, with solid application development experience in a Linux environment. * Experience deploying distributed systems, including distributed data stores, event streaming platforms and container orchestration, with cloud deployment and infrastructure\-as\-code technology. * Solid application architecture experience, with the ability to establish and communicate best practices and to quickly learn and understand an existing, complex architecture. * Experience with AI engineering, such as applying AI and large language model technologies to assist engineers, and with developing platform services and managing observability (monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting). * E  a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. **Our hybrid work model** BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. **Guidance on AI use for candidates** At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. **About BlackRock** At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window). BlackRock is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees, and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. **View the** **EEOC’s Know Your Rights poster and its supplement** **(opens in new window)** **and the** **pay transparency statement** **(opens in new window)****.** BlackRock is committed to full inclusion of all qualified individuals and to providing reasonable accommodations or job modifications for individuals with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation/adjustments are needed throughout the employment process, please email Disability.Assistance@blackrock.com (opens in new window). All requests are treated in line with our **privacy policy** (opens in new window). jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About BlinkRx:** BlinkRx is rebuilding how Americans access life\-changing medicines. Today, only one in five prescriptions for new branded therapies are ever filled. The problem isn't the medicine. It's insurance barriers, affordability challenges, fragmented pharmacy experiences, and inadequate support that keep patients from starting and staying on treatment. Our mission is to change that. We built RxOS, the first AI\-powered prescription operating system. RxOS connects the largest network of doctors, patients, pharmacies, payers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, intelligently orchestrating every step to guarantee a seamless prescription journey for every script. Our teams solve complex, high\-stakes problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare operations, logistics, payments, and regulation. The impact is transformative: BlinkRx more than doubles the rate at which patients take their medications and lowers their out\-of\-pocket expenses by hundreds of dollars every month. BlinkRx created and leads a rapidly growing $80\+ billion category, with exceptional momentum: * **Built for scale:** Over the past decade, we have invested nearly $1 billion in building the technology and operational platform required to serve patients at scale. * **Proven growth and economics:** We have grown 100% annually for the past five years, are profitable, and support more than 60 pharmaceutical brands. * **Trusted with category\-defining programs:** Our technology powers a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer's direct\-to\-patient platform for its GLP\-1 portfolio, providing the infrastructure to expand patient access as demand for these therapies grows. We are a dynamic team of technologists and industry experts seeking to build a generational company that delivers a genuine step change in American health. **Staff Site Reliability Engineer** ----------------------------------- ### **Responsibilities** * **Define and drive observability strategy** for IT system and process health, performance, and reliability, including alerting quality, dashboards, and service health indicators. * Design and implement **software\-driven solutions within the IT domain**, automating manual processes and eliminating operational complexity and toil. * Act as a **technical leader and force multiplier**, helping set priorities and influencing decision\-making across the entire IT team \- support, systems and networks. * Take ownership of **large, ambiguous initiatives**, driving them from concept to delivery while aligning stakeholders across IT, engineering and partner teams. * Proactively identify systemic risks and reliability gaps in both tools and processes, **recommending and leading platform upgrades** and architectural improvements before they become incidents. * Provide **technical mentorship**, architecture guidance, and high\-quality design and code reviews for engineers across IT teams. * Lead by example in **documentation and knowledge sharing**, ensuring systems and processes are well\-understood and not dependent on individual ownership. * Participate in and help mature **incident response**, escalation practices, and post\-incident learning across the organization. ### **Desired Experience** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering roles, with demonstrated impact at scale. #### **Reliability \& Troubleshooting** * Expert\-level, methodical troubleshooting across the **entire stack**, from application to kernel to network. * Strong command\-line proficiency and deep expertise in **Linux systems and operating system fundamentals**. * Advanced understanding of networking concepts including **load balancing, proxies, DNS, TCP/IP, NAT, and service\-to\-service communication**. #### **Software \& Automation** * Experience working across multiple languages (e.g., **Python, Go, Bash**, and familiarity troubleshooting application stacks such as React or similar). Strong proficiency in at least one. * Strong track record of **automating repetitive and complex operational work** to reduce toil and increase reliability. * Ability to design and build internal tools (Python or Go) that **standardize and scale IT practices**. * Comfortable operating in an **agile environment**, with disciplined testing and quality practices. #### **Cloud \& Platform Engineering** * Experience with cloud platforms (**AWS preferred**, GCP/Azure acceptable), particularly managed services and production\-grade architectures. * Expertise in **Kubernetes and container orchestration** (EKS, Helm), including lifecycle management and operational best practices. * Proven experience designing and implementing **observability systems**, including metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting. * Deep understanding of container technologies, security scanning, secrets management, dynamic configuration, and **microservices architectures**. * Familiarity with service meshes and advanced traffic management concepts. #### **Infrastructure as Code** * Experience designing and maintaining **company\-wide IaC codebases** using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Ansible. * Ability to think holistically about infrastructure design, cost, reliability, security, and long\-term maintainability. **Why Join Us:** It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Node/TS/Meteor)
jobs.description: TypeScript \| Node.js / Meteor \| MongoDB Build great software. Make a difference in education. **About Boom Learning** Boom Learning is an innovative EdTech company and the creator of Boom Cards, a best\-in\-breed interactive learning platform used by teachers and students around the world. Educators often describe the Boom Cards content creation platform as magical. We were the first to bring together self\-grading, student\-paced, teacher\-created digital learning content in a platform that makes teaching more effective and learning more engaging. Our marketplace features educational content created by teachers, for teachers. Teachers love the flexibility and immediate feedback. Kids love playing while they learn. Parents love seeing the impact on their children’s education. Today, Boom Cards are used in classrooms across the world, including some of the largest U.S. school districts. We’re an established, independent company with a successful product, a loyal customer base, and a small, experienced team that cares deeply about what we build. **The Opportunity** We’re looking for an exceptional senior software engineer who combines strong engineering fundamentals with curiosity, sound judgment, and ambition to build great software. We value engineers who use modern tools—including AI—to amplify their expertise, not substitute for it. Our engineering team is small, which means your contributions will have a direct and meaningful impact. You’ll work across a sophisticated production platform, help shape technical decisions, and have the autonomy to solve problems without layers of bureaucracy. We are currently hiring in FL, GA, IL, IN, OH, UT, WA, WI, and WY. Compensation: $130,000–$200,000, dependent on skills and location. **Our Technology** Our platform is built primarily on: * TypeScript * Node.js / Meteor 3\.x — Our application framework and server\-side environment. * MongoDB Atlas — Our primary database. * Blaze — Our reactive frontend framework. * AWS * Cypress and Vitest — Automated testing. * Git, Bitbucket, Jira, Asana — Source control and collaboration. Meteor experience is welcome but not required. Strong Node.js, TypeScript, database, and full\-stack engineering skills are far more important. A minimum of 3 years of professional coding experience is required. **What You’ll Do** You’ll be a hands\-on contributor working across our full\-stack application. Your responsibilities will include: * Designing, building, and maintaining features used by educators and students. * Improving the performance, scalability, security, and reliability of our platform. * Working with complex MongoDB data models and queries. * Modernizing and refactoring existing systems. * Strengthening automated testing and development infrastructure. * Investigating and resolving challenging production issues. * Using modern development tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality. * Participating in architectural decisions and helping establish engineering best practices. **What We’re Looking For** **Experienced Software Engineer** You have substantial experience building and maintaining production software, particularly with TypeScript, Node.js, and modern web applications. You understand asynchronous programming, API design, databases, application architecture, and the practical realities of operating production systems. **AI\-Proficient Developer** You use AI\-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, and you know how to evaluate, correct, and verify their output. **Strong Engineering Judgment** You understand that working code isn’t necessarily good code. You care about correctness, security, maintainability, and performance. You know when to move quickly and when a problem deserves deeper analysis. **Independent Problem Solver** You’re comfortable taking ownership of complex problems, working with incomplete specifications, and collaborating directly with other engineers and our customer\-facing teams. You enjoy the autonomy and responsibility that comes with working on a small team. **Why Join Boom Learning?** Meaningful impact. Your work helps teachers teach and students learn. Our product is used in real classrooms every day. Real ownership. We’re a small engineering team. Your ideas and contributions won’t disappear into a large organizational hierarchy. Room to innovate. We encourage thoughtful experimentation with modern tools and better ways to build software. Interesting engineering challenges. We operate a mature, feature\-rich platform with real\-world complexity, significant scale, and opportunities for modernization and innovation. Established business. We’re an independent company with an established product, brand, and customer base—not an early\-stage startup searching for product\-market fit. Experienced colleagues. You’ll work with people who understand the product, care about engineering quality, and appreciate thoughtful technical decisions. **Interested?** We’d love to hear about a substantial engineering problem you’ve solved and the judgment you brought to it. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Shield
jobs.description: **WHAT IS BOX?** Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including AstraZeneca, JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU** Box Shield is an add\-on security control that helps you protect the flow of information and reduce content\-centric risks with precision — without slowing down work. It allows classification\-based security controls to automatically prevent data loss, and AI\-powered, context\-aware alerts to detect potential data theft and malicious content. Box Shield enables secure hybrid work from anywhere, anytime, and any device with native tools that help secure content at scale. The Shield team is looking for ML engineers with a passion for building out enterprise security features that are able to handle complex use\-cases in a robust and easy\-to\-use way. Shield's mission is to protect the flow of an enterprise's information while delivering frictionless user experience so that Box is the tool of choice for secure Cloud Content Management. Shield helps customers keep their content secure by detecting malicious software in their content, potentially compromised accounts, and anomalous behavior so that Administrators have the right information to act before a problem occurs. As an engineer on our team, you will join a diverse, fast\-paced, mainly backend/core team that works together to build new capabilities that help Box's customers protect their Box content. Security being a horizontal product, you will work across teams to design and implement capabilities that power high\-demand use\-cases in a future\-proof way. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Build Threat Detection Models: Design, train, and deploy ML models for ransomware detection, suspicious session identification, and user behavior analytics, anomaly detection * Scale Data Pipelines: Own end\-to\-end ML pipelines that process high\-volume security event streams using Apache Spark, GCP Dataflow, GCP Dataproc, BigQuery and Vertex AI * Feature Engineering: Create and maintain feature stores that power real\-time and batch anomaly detection systems * Production ML Systems: Deploy, monitor, and iterate on ML models in production, serving enterprise customers at scale * Cross\-functional Collaboration: Partner with Platform, Application Engineering, and Product teams to translate security requirements into ML solutions * Participate in our on\-call rotation, available at all times while on\-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise. **WHO YOU ARE** We are an AI\-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. * 5\+ years of experience in applied machine learning * Lead design and implementation efforts in building, deploying and supporting scalable ML systems * Experience with GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow) or equivalent (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML) * Strong communication skills with ability to explain complex ML concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Ownership mindset with focus on delivering high\-quality work both technically \& collaboratively **MUST\-HAVE EXPERIENCE** * Bachelors or above degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * Strong command of machine learning fundamentals, including model training and evaluation (model weights, loss functions, precision, recall, F1, calibration), feature engineering, embeddings, and real\-world data issues such as class imbalance, label noise, and model drift. Candidates whose AI experience consists primarily of using generative AI tools, agents, or APIs will not meet this bar. * Deep understanding of MLOps, monitoring and updating ML models service real traffic. * Clear, inclusive communicator who values collaboration, mentorship, and continuous improvement. **Nice To Have Experience** * Experience in security/threat or fraud detection and with sequential data and behavioral modeling (e.g., anomaly detection, time\-series forecasting, LSTM, Transformers, or similar). * Experience with streaming/real\-time ML systems * Experience with FedRAMP/compliance\-constrained environments * Familiarity with Java stack for service integrations * Publications or contributions in ML security **Tech Stack You'll Work With** * Languages: Python, Go, Java * ML/Data: Apache Spark, Vertex AI, BigQuery, TensorFlow/PyTorch * Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes * Domains: User Behavior Analytics, Time\-Series Anomaly Detection, AI Security, Content classification, Ransomware Detection Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply! **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. This role will drive the implementation, integration, and continuous improvement of observability capabilities that provide actionable visibility across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and critical business services. The Staff Observability \& Reliability Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise monitoring, telemetry, event management, service health, and automation capabilities that enable proactive operations, improve platform stability, and accelerate incident detection and response. This role combines deep technical expertise in observability and reliability engineering with hands\-on experience developing automation, integrations, workflows, and operational solutions at enterprise scale. Working closely with application, infrastructure, cloud, platform, and operations teams, the Staff Observability \& Reliability Engineer will establish modern observability practices, improve service visibility, reduce operational complexity, strengthen operational intelligence, and advance Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) capabilities across the organization. This role will influence how engineering teams consume telemetry, measure service performance, manage operational risk, and improve overall system reliability. In addition to core observability responsibilities, the Staff Observability \& Reliability Engineer will leverage AI\-assisted engineering capabilities to accelerate development, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and operational analysis. This position offers the opportunity to influence enterprise observability strategy, deliver scalable automation solutions, and improve the reliability and resiliency of technology platforms that The incumbent supports EDD’s infrastructure security engineering and operations activities, including the hardware, software, and security components necessary to protect EDD’s enterprise environment and confidential and sensitive information. Working under the direction of an Information Technology Manager I (ITM I), the incumbent performs a variety of high\-level technical assignments that require innovative problem\-solving, sound technical judgment, and the ability to work across multiple technologies and platforms. Supporting security architecture and engineering activities for complex infrastructure and technology projects. Assisting with the development and implementation of security strategies, standards, and technical solutions. Participating in security oversight activities for ongoing projects to ensure infrastructure and solutions align with EDD security requirements. Troubleshooting complex infrastructure security issues and developing effective technical solutions. Collaborating with infrastructure, networking, application, cloud, and cybersecurity teams to integrate security into enterprise solutions. Mentoring, training, and providing technical support to Infrastructure Security Operations Group (ISOG) staff to promote adherence to EDD security standards, processes, and methodologies. Supporting project teams to ensure infrastructure security deliverables are completed accurately and within established timelines. Evaluating emerging technologies and assisting with the adoption of modern security capabilities that support EDD’s evolving infrastructure and security requirements. jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Data Science Engineer
jobs.description: **Firm Overview:** Cambridge Associates (“CA”) is a leading global investment firm. CA’s goal is to help endowments \& foundations, pension plans, and ultra\-high net worth private clients implement and manage custom investment portfolios that generate outperformance so that they can maximize their impact on the world. Cambridge Associates delivers a range of services, including outsourced CIO, non\-discretionary portfolio management, and investment consulting. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, CA has offices in key markets in North America, the United Kingdom, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. Our worldwide teams ensure our clients benefit from decades of global presence, local expertise, and relationships with the top global investment managers across the world. For more information, please visit www.cambridgeassociates.com . **Job Description Summary:** The Senior Applied AI and Data Science Engineer develops and delivers analytical and AI\-enabled solutions for investment and firm workflows within Investment Science. The role combines hands\-on technical work with leadership of agreed projects and workstreams, mentoring of junior colleagues, and collaboration across investment, business, and technology teams. Working within priorities and scope established with IS leadership, the role applies technical judgment to project delivery, quality, and improvement. **Job Description:** Responsibilities: Translate business needs into technical approaches * Work with IS leadership and investment and business stakeholders to assess potential applications, recommend practical approaches, and help define project scope and success measures within agreed priorities. * Apply statistical and machine\-learning methods to moderate\-to\-complex investment and business problems. Explain findings, assumptions, limitations, and recommendations clearly, seeking guidance on issues beyond the agreed scope or approach. Deliver agreed projects and workstreams * Lead technical delivery of agreed projects or workstreams, including LLM\-based research tools, retrieval\-augmented generation, and workflow automation. Collaborate with technology colleagues on integration and technical design within established architecture and standards. * Keep IS leadership informed of progress and escalate material scope, dependency, delivery, or resource issues. Evaluate quality and improve solutions * Evaluate models and applications against agreed criteria, monitor performance and user feedback, implement improvements, and recommend next steps. * Apply and encourage sound engineering practices through code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Prototype approaches that address agreed business needs. * Work with technology, information security, and compliance colleagues to apply established data\-access, confidentiality, validation, and human\-oversight requirements. Flag risks and seek guidance or approvals where needed. Mentor colleagues and share technical expertise * Serve as a technical resource for junior data scientists and engineers, providing guidance, reviewing work, and offering timely, actionable feedback. * Support colleagues’ analytical judgment, engineering skills, and stakeholder communication through project\-based coaching and development opportunities agreed with IS leadership. Share knowledge and development observations with the team and IS leadership. * Collaborate across teams and support adoption * Work with investment, research, technology, and other partner teams to clarify requirements and communicate project progress, technical options, trade\-offs, and risks. * Participate in project discussions with senior stakeholders, explaining technical findings and recommendations within the role’s area of expertise. Support user training and adoption. Refer competing requests and commitments beyond agreed project scope to IS leadership. * Skills and Experience: Essential * Advanced hands\-on Python expertise and experience with R for statistical modeling, data analysis, and maintainable analytical code. * Strong statistical and machine\-learning knowledge, including model selection, validation, and communication of results and limitations. * Experience building reliable data pipelines and integrating APIs and databases for analytical and AI applications. * Experience deploying and operating cloud\-based data or AI solutions, including CI/CD and application monitoring. * Experience developing LLM applications, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agent workflows using appropriate AI frameworks. * Experience coordinating project or workstream delivery, reviewing colleagues’ work, and mentoring junior staff. * Ability to apply technical judgment to moderate\-to\-complex problems, recommend improvements, and recognize when escalation is needed. * Clear communication and effective collaboration with technical, nontechnical, and senior stakeholders. Desirable * Experience applying financial modeling and investment data to investment\-management workflows. * Experience supporting adoption of analytical or AI tools and working within data or model governance requirements. Azure experience. * Other Qualifications: Educational/Professional Background * Required: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Required: Experience developing and delivering data science or AI/ML solutions, coordinating projects or workstreams, collaborating across teams, and guiding junior colleagues. * Preferred: Experience in investment management or financial services. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: 8116 \- Midtown Office \- 2220 W. Broad Street, Richmond, Virginia, 23220 CarMax, the way your career should be! **About this job** At CarMax, we are industry disruptors. At the heart of our innovation is new digital products. The CarMax Conversational AI team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer as we continue to push the boundaries of conversational AI in Retail settings – specifically through webchat on CarMax.com. Working on many different aspects of the customer experience, our Engineers research and discover new opportunities and shape products to fulfill them. From inception to completion, you will develop tools and technology, learning quickly from our spirit of experimentation. You will have a direct impact on improving the performance of our business and ensuring customers can buy the vehicles they want in a way that is right for them! **What you will do – Essential Responsibilities** * Working collaboratively and creatively as part of a close\-knit product team, you will be part of the development process from end to end: consulting users, carrying out experiments, tackling complex business problems and implementing new products. * Collaborate with other Engineers on the design, product management, and systems architecture to develop experimental solutions and bring great ideas to life * Share ideas internally and evolve them according to feedback and critique within an agile environment * Continually evolve the platform and its operations using solid engineering and agile practices. * Stay on top of industry trends and best practices to continuously improve what we do and ensure our customer experience is the best it can be **Qualifications and Requirements** Basic Qualifications * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related Technology field or equivalent experience * Strong attention to detail, problem investigation and diagnostic skills * Strong teamwork skills, ability to learn quickly, excellent written and spoken communication required. Preferably in Azure using .NET. * Extensive knowledge and experience with Object Oriented Design and Principles. Hands\-on experience with Microsoft.NET (\#C) and .NET Core * Knowledge and experience with Cloud services, CI/CD pipelines, and coding best practices * Experienced in troubleshooting and monitoring production integrations. * Hands on UX/UI programming experience with Angular/React and HTML/CSS. Work Authorization: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Sponsorship will **not** be considered for this specific role. **About CarMax** CarMax disrupted the auto industry by delivering the honest, transparent and high\-integrity experience customers want and deserve. This innovative thinking around the way cars are bought and sold has helped us become the nation’s largest retailer of used cars, with over 200 locations nationwide. Our amazing team of more than 25,000 associates work together to deliver iconic customer experiences. We are recognized for our commitment to training and diversity and are one of the FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For®. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: CarMax is committed to bringing together people from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe, welcoming, and inclusive work environment. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Voices
jobs.description: **About Cartesia** ================== Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do. We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large\-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design\-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences. We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90\+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI. **About the Role** ------------------ Cartesia builds real\-time multimodal intelligence: fast, state\-of\-the\-art voice models and the products that make them useful. We started as a research lab, pioneered the state space model architecture, and now we're bringing that research to customers through intuitive tools for creating, testing, and shipping with voice. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Voices team. Every conversation powered by Cartesia starts with a voice. The Voices team builds how customers find, clone, and design voices that sound right for their product, in any language. The work reaches across the company. You’ll work closely with: * **Research**: Turn new model capabilities into product features, such as turning voices multilingual and steering voices to match the ideal profile. * **Platform and infra**: Serve every voice reliably at the scale of our API traffic. * **On\-prem**: Build adaptable interfaces and systems so that voices are available and compatible in a variety of settings and hardware. * **Customer\-facing teams**: Help every customer get a great voice on their own. **Your Impact** --------------- * Build polished product experiences for finding, cloning, and designing voices, from the first listen to a voice running in production. * Design the APIs developers build on, so every capability is as easy to use in code as it is in the product. * Turn early research into features customers use every day, like voice cloning, localization, and voice design. * Build the backend systems that train, store, and serve custom voices at scale, in the cloud and on\-prem. * Raise the quality bar for every voice we launch, with internal tools, automated evaluations, and analytics that show how voices sound and perform. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 3\+ years of experience building and operating customer\-facing software in production, ideally at a high\-growth startup, including owning systems that serve high traffic reliably. We care more about what you’ve shipped and kept running at scale than strict years of experience. * Strong product instincts: you think in customer outcomes, usability, quality, and developer experience, and you have opinions on what to build and why. * Full\-stack range and the ability to own a product surface across frontend, backend, APIs, data, and operational concerns. * Fluent use of coding agents and a habit of keeping pace with the frontier. * Clear communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, strong cross\-functional partnership, and a sharp presence in product and design reviews. **Nice\-To\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience building developer tools, creative tools, playgrounds, or API\-adjacent products. * Experience building AI\-powered products and translating model capabilities, limitations, and quality tradeoffs into understandable user experiences. * Strong frontend craft with React and TypeScript, including polished, highly interactive workflows. * Experience with audio, media, real\-time systems, product analytics, experimentation, or evaluation infrastructure. * Working familiarity with deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting services on Kubernetes, especially in multi\-cluster setups *Note: Cartesia participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I\-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.* **More Details** ================ **In\-office policy:** We’re an in\-person team based out of offices in San Francisco, London and Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day. **Visa sponsorship:** We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case\-by\-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call. **We ship fast.** All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way. **We support each other.** We have an open \& inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed. **Our Benefits (US Employees Only)** ==================================== **Compensation** Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package. **Health Insurance** Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family. **Parental Leave** 9 weeks paternity \& 12 weeks maternity leave **401(k)** **Commuter Allowance** A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office. **Flexible PTO** Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries. **Meals \& Snacks** Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily. **Your own personal Yoshi** **Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity** --------------------------------------- *Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.* Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI: Security Engineering
jobs.description: **About Cencora** ----------------- Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today! **Job Details** =============== **About the Role** Cencora is increasingly leveraging artificial intelligence to transform business operations, accelerate decision making, improve customer experiences, and drive innovation. As AI capabilities become embedded within enterprise workflows, the security challenge extends beyond protecting information. Security must protect the models, data, prompts, agents, actions, decisions, integrations, development pipelines, and operational platforms that enable AI. The Principal, AI Security serves as the senior\-most technical authority responsible for defining and advancing the enterprise AI security strategy. This role focuses on solving the most complex engineering and architecture problems associated with AI adoption. The position is intentionally an individual contributor role rather than a people\-management position. You will influence through technical depth, architecture, innovation, and thought leadership. **What You Will Own** * AI Security Architecture and reference standards * Agentic AI and autonomous action security * AI Data Protection and privacy\-by\-design controls * Secure AI Development Lifecycle (AI SDLC) * MLOps and AI platform security * Model and AI supply chain security * AI runtime protection, monitoring, and detection engineering * AI red teaming, assurance, and adversarial testing * Enterprise AI security tooling and strategy * Technical mentoring and organizational guidance **Core Responsibilities** Lead architecture reviews for Generative AI, copilots, machine learning platforms, autonomous agents, and AI\-enabled business applications. Design security controls to ensure AI systems operate safely, transparently, and within defined trust boundaries. Develop standards governing model deployment, prompt security, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, training data protection, model access controls, and agent authorization. Establish safeguards preventing data leakage, prompt injection, model abuse, unauthorized actions, and sensitive information exposure. Partner with Security Operations, Engineering, Cloud, Identity, Data Protection, Legal, Privacy, and Enterprise Architecture teams to operationalize AI security controls at enterprise scale. Evaluate and implement AI security technologies, including monitoring, attack detection, model validation, policy enforcement, and agent oversight capabilities. Perform threat modeling and adversarial security assessments focused on emerging attack vectors including prompt injection, indirect prompt attacks, model poisoning, model theft, jailbreak techniques, and agent privilege escalation. Establish assurance programs that continuously validate the effectiveness of AI security controls throughout development, deployment, and production operations. **Required Qualifications** * 12\+ years of cybersecurity, application security, cloud security, platform security, or related engineering experience. * Demonstrated expertise in multiple security domains including AI Security, Data Protection, Cloud Security, Application Security, Identity and Access Management, Security Engineering, and Security Operations. * Experience securing enterprise AI platforms, machine learning environments, Generative AI services, or AI\-powered business workflows. * Deep understanding of AI attack surfaces and adversarial techniques. * Strong background in cloud\-native architectures, APIs, automation, and security engineering. * Ability to influence executives and engineering leaders through technical expertise and written communication. **Preferred Qualifications** * CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, SC\-100, SC\-200, SC\-400 or equivalent certifications. * Experience with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, ISO 42001, and related AI governance frameworks. * Healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry experience. * Experience with AI agents, copilots, model serving platforms, and modern AI orchestration frameworks.. **What Cencora offers** ======================= We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit https://www.virtualfairhub.com/cencora Full time**Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ Cencora is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or membership in any other class protected by federal, state or local law. The company’s continued success depends on the full and effective utilization of qualified individuals. Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non\-discriminatory. Cencora is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the employment process which are consistent with legal requirements. If you wish to request an accommodation while seeking employment, please call 888\.692\.2272 or email hrsc@cencora.com. We will make accommodation determinations on a request\-by\-request basis. Messages and emails regarding anything other than accommodations requests will not be returned **Affiliated Companies** ======================== Affiliated Companies: AmerisourceBergen Services Corporation

jobs.title: AI Lead Engineer
jobs.description: Citian is a fast growing, venture backed SaaS technology company based in Washington, DC. Our software solutions revolutionize how our transportation and infrastructure systems – roads, rail, transit, bicycle, pedestrian – operate. Our tech solutions: * **Reduce traffic fatalities** * **Enhance pedestrian accessibility** * **Empower system operators to save time \& money** You'll work with some of the brightest minds in the software and transportation industries. Our engineers and data scientists apply the latest in emerging tech, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning to build smarter, more advanced tools for our diverse client base. We work with clients across the United States, with global ambitions in the years ahead. **Who You Are:** As an AI Lead Engineer on Citian's Data Success team, you ensure our digital products meet the engineering\-level accuracy required by state and local government clients. Every agency's network has both common and unique features of geometry, structure, labeling, and management practices. You use AI, customized reasoning and logic, and mathematical models to convert these assets into clean, standardized data that powers our CRASH and ADAPT products. You plan and optimize the full lifecycle of digitalizing different assets to meet accuracy requirements. You build and run data cleaning, ingestion, and extraction pipelines; apply LLMs, computer vision, mathematical models, and reasoning where they accelerate the work; and design, improve, and execute evaluation plans that prove the output is correct. You work directly with agency GIS, IT, and engineering staff, and you can explain data issues clearly to both traffic engineers and software engineers. You are resourceful with mathematics and AI technologies, have strong engineering judgment, care about getting the details right, and want your work to have a direct impact on transforming transportation infrastructure. **Expected Duties:** * Own data accuracy for the digitalization of new and existing state and local government clients, from the initial data request through production\-ready data in Citian's products. * Work directly with agency GIS, IT, and engineering staff to understand their management needs and existing data sources, obtain access, and resolve gaps or inconsistencies. * Build, optimize, improve, and maintain pipelines that collect spatial and temporal data (such as 3D\-registered spherical images) and integrate data from other sensors and client systems, including databases, APIs, Esri/ArcGIS services, open data portals, and file transfers. * Own the accuracy of extracting roadway and infrastructure assets from point clouds, imagery, measurements, and other geospatial sources. * Apply AI\-assisted development, mathematical modeling, logical reasoning, and coding to map each agency's infrastructure data onto Citian's standard data model. * Build automated and rigorous QA/QC checks that validate digitalized results against ground truth, and design methods to collect or estimate ground truth. * Evaluate third\-party AI tools, APIs, and mathematical models for extraction work, and weigh build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs with Engineering. * Document data sources, mappings, and processes for each client so onboarding is repeatable and scalable. * Partner with Customer Success, Account Management, and Product to set data timelines, communicate data issues, and feed client needs back into the product roadmap. **Required Skills \& Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, GIS, or a related field. * 3\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related role. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and advanced mathematical models to real\-world data, ideally in a product environment. * Proficiency in Python and SQL for building data pipelines and transforming data. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs, mathematical models, and reasoning to digitalize physical environments at high accuracy. * Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and related data tools. * Experience building engineering\-based and computer\-based data validation and quality checks. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work directly with external clients and explain technical issues to non\-technical audiences. Salary Range: $150,000 \- 250,000 **Your Citian Advantage:** * Competitive salary and benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance and generous PTO. * 401(k) company match and monthly commuter transportation benefit * On\-site gym and free snacks in the office * High\-growth potential and opportunities for advancement within a fast growing, venture\-backed SaaS startup! Let's build smarter cities together! Learn more about Citian here: www.citian.co \*\* Citian is an organization committed to diversity and inclusion to drive our business results and create a better future every day for our diverse employees, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Provide engineering/technical assistance for various departments within the City of Erie (i.e., Engineering, Streets, Parks, Etc.). **SECONDARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 1\. File, index, and keep all construction project records (i.e., design plans, submittals, record drawings, operation \& maintenance manuals, etc.). Receive and coordinate inspector field drawings/notes with the Authority’s engineer, maintenance, and operations staff. Coordinate all as\-built record drawing files. 2\. The ability to perform surveying, construction inspection, special drawings and sketches, and photography. 3\. Perform other similar and related duties as required. **QUALIFICATIONS** 1\. Bachelor of Science Degree in Civil / Environmental Engineering or closely related discipline and possession of a valid and current certificate of registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) for the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. 2\. This position requires significant experience in utility or public works. Demonstrated skills in engineering, construction management, fiscal management, communications, and the establishment of working relationships are required. Must possess leadership qualities. A strong background in AutoCAD, Data Communications Equipment/Software (proficiency in Telog Instruments Enterprise Software), SCADA\-PLC instrumentation logic, and programming is necessary. Possessing expertise in Microsoft Office Applications, with emphasis on Excel, as well as Adobe Acrobat Pro. 4\. Ability to create plan design drawings, specifications, and contract documents; computer literate; basic drafting skills; excellent math skills (calculations, algebra, geometry); ability to operate basic Civil Engineering equipment. 5\. Possesses good interpersonal and communication skills (written and oral); ability to interact professionally with staff, consultants, contractors, professional boards, and the public and remain calm under stress; proven problem solver and team builder; self\-directed; good research and follow\-through with the ability to institute change. 6\. Possession of a Valid PA Driver’s License. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** This position primarily requires sedentary office work, mostly sitting while doing computer\-related tasks; however, must be able to move intermittently throughout the workday. Regularly, must be able to work outdoors and outside the office setting, which requires sitting, standing, kneeling, bending, stooping, climbing \& the ability to handle some small tools/equipment and lift up to 75 pounds. Ability to work in and around construction sites, process/equipment facilities, mechanical\-electrical equipment \& confined spaces and to drive a vehicle to construction/metering sites. **ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS** This position works mainly indoors in a well\-lit, ventilated office area. It may be subject to regular interruptions and involves direct interaction with other office and maintenance staff. Regularly, work outside the office setting will be required. When outside of the office setting, the employee must be able to work in extreme weather conditions and be exposed to oil, electricity, trenches, fumes and chemicals, excessive noise, street traffic, confined spaces, and fall hazard areas.
