jobs.title: AI Lifecycle Engineer
jobs.description: Remote, Miami, United States ### **About the Role** You'll be the engineer responsible for what AI\-MSL delivers into a customer's production system. AI\-MSL, CloudGeometry's AI Managed Software Lifecycle platform, takes a change request written in plain language and carries it through requirements, specs, code, tests, and documentation, delivered as a branch that's ready for production. AI agents do the work, and a senior engineer oversees every step. That's you. You won't write every line yourself. You'll guide agent work on real customer codebases, decide whether the results are correct, and own what happens once they reach production. On a typical day you might turn a vague request into a clear spec, review a 400\-line change you didn't write, spot an issue that looks fine in review but would fail under load, and then add a check so it doesn't happen again. You'll work across several customer systems with unfamiliar code, past decisions you weren't part of, and business rules nobody wrote down. Getting up to speed quickly in new code is a big part of the job. The title is still new in our industry, but the work is clear: someone has to be responsible for AI\-built software that real businesses rely on. ### **What You'll Do** * Turn requests into clear specs. Work out what a customer or product owner is really asking for and write a spec the agents can follow. Most bad output starts with an unclear spec. * Guide agent work and review it. Run changes through each step, step in when something goes off track, and decide at each checkpoint whether the work moves forward or goes back. You approve what ships. * Review a lot of code you didn't write. Read changes, specs, and test results closely enough to catch what looks right but isn't, like a missed edge case, a test that passes for the wrong reason, or a change that works on its own but breaks this codebase. * Learn new systems quickly. Understand each customer's codebase, including its conventions, usage patterns, and unwritten rules, and keep AppGraph (our live model of the system) accurate as things change. * Turn mistakes into safeguards. When something slips through, add a rule, test, or check so the system catches it next time. * Own production results. Handle deployment, monitoring, incident response, and the cost and speed of agent runs. Once you approve a change, it's yours. * Share feedback with the platform team. You'll see where AI\-MSL falls short before anyone else. Report it clearly and help shape what gets built next. * Work directly with customers. Explain decisions and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical people, and push back when a request needs to change before it can run. * Join a daily standup with the team in Europe and South America (between 07:00 and 11:00 MT) and stay reachable on Slack during your working hours. ### **Must\-Haves** * 5\+ years building and running production software, including fixing things when they break * Strong backend fundamentals. Our stack is TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, but fluency in any typed language matters more than knowing ours already * Strong code review skills. You can read unfamiliar code and find what's wrong with it, and this is the most important skill for the role * 1\+ years of daily hands\-on use of an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code, with clear opinions on where it struggles and how you work around it * Good testing instincts. You know the difference between a test that passes and a test that proves something * Experience working in codebases you didn't write, ideally several, and a reliable way of getting up to speed * Experience debugging in production with logs and traces, and handling live incidents * Some cloud experience, ideally AWS * Knowing when to stop and ask. We value people who raise questions early over people who guess * Strong written and spoken English, and comfort working asynchronously across time zones ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Built something with agents beyond a simple chat tool, such as a skill, hook, harness, or agent that runs on its own * Testing frameworks or automated checks for generated code * Legacy modernization or large refactoring projects * Consulting, agency, or managed services experience, switching between customers in the same week * On\-call or site reliability experience * TypeScript, Next.js, and React, for work on the review interface * Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and event\-driven architecture * Writing or open\-source contributions about AI\-assisted development * Spanish, or experience working with teams in Latin America ### **Why CloudGeometry** CloudGeometry is a Silicon Valley engineering company. We're an Anthropic Claude Partner, an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner, and a CNCF Kubernetes Certified Service Provider, and we help companies move from scattered AI chat tools to a reliable, well\-governed way of building software. Most engineers using AI today do it on their own, inside processes that weren't built for it. Here you'll work in one that was, on real production systems, with the tools and authority to do it well. * Competitive pay and benefits * Access to Claude Code and the latest AI models * Training budget for courses and certifications * Fully remote, with flexible hours outside one daily standup (07:00 to 11:00 MT) * Experience across many codebases and architectures, which helps your career grow faster Submit Resume Send us an application to jobs@cloudgeometry.com, and we’ll contact you in shortly.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Solution Owner)
jobs.description: CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high\-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data\-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants. We are honored to be recognized as a three\-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in the U.S. We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work inside our clients' businesses and build the AI\-powered applications they need. You'll sit with the people who do the work, understand how the process runs today, and build a working version quickly with AI coding tools. Our teams are small and move fast, so you'll own your application from the first conversation to the last user. Much of our current work is with large, fast\-growing industrial and manufacturing clients whose teams still rely on spreadsheets, email approvals, and disconnected systems. We've been building custom internal tools that replace those, working alongside the platforms the client already uses, such as ERP, CRM, and data and BI systems. The majority of our team are based local to Southern California (LA/OC), and we have some others based across the USA. Occasional travel to client sites is expected. ### **What You'll Do** * You'll work with business users and stakeholders to understand how work really gets done, decide what's worth building, and agree a first release. * You'll build a working prototype yourself using AI coding tools and use it to get early feedback and sign\-off. * You'll take the application to production: connecting it to the client's data and systems, defining the logic and data it needs, testing it, and bringing in our architects and engineers for the parts that need deeper expertise. * You'll make sure people use it, through training, feedback and fixes after launch. * You'll also present progress and results to senior stakeholders, and travel to client sites now and then for workshops and rollouts. ### **What You'll Bring** * Real experience building and shipping applications with AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Emergent), and the judgment to review and fix what they produce * Working knowledge of how applications are built and deployed: front\-end frameworks such as React, Python, SQL, APIs, authentication, and testing * Experience taking something from prototype to production in an enterprise environment, including security, integration, and client sign\-off * Strong product instincts: discovery with business users, scoping a first release, and prioritizing * Clear, concise communication with executives and business teams * 8\+ years of experience across consulting, product, solution architecture and/or engineering, ideally with time at a small or mid\-size consulting firm * Bachelor's degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Business) or equivalent demonstrable experience * A plus: experience with ERP, manufacturing, supply chain or enterprise data (for example Oracle) You don't need to train models or do machine learning research. The work is building and deploying applications. $140,000 \- $180,000 a year The posted compensation range reflects the anticipated compensation for this opportunity. Depending on the role, client requirements, and business needs, compensation may be structured as a salaried position with bonus eligibility or as an hourly contract engagement (including 1099 independent contractor arrangements). Final compensation and engagement type will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, market conditions, and the nature of the role. Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership. With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live. At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path \- you’ll create one. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: Silver Spring, MD \| Full\-time Competitive Power Ventures, Inc. (“CPV”), with headquarters in Silver Spring, MD, and offices in Braintree, MA and Sugar Land, TX, is uniquely positioned to leverage global technology and financial partnerships to help modernize America’s power generation. We are driven to improve our energy infrastructure by developing and operating power generation facilities using cutting edge, domestically available natural gas, and renewable power technology. CPV is owned by OPC Energy, the first privately held electric company in Israel. OPC Energy became a public company in August 2017 and is traded on the Tel\-Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE: OPCE). CPV is seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to join our Information Technology Department in our Silver Spring, MD office. The AI Solutions Engineer helps CPV design, build, test, and improve practical AI solutions using ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Databricks. Working with business teams, and vendors, this role turns real work problems into useful prototypes and production\-ready capabilities, with appropriate security, data governance, human review, and measurable outcomes. This is a hands\-on, mid\-level role for someone with 3–5 years of relevant experience who can contribute directly to solution development and explain new AI capabilities in clear, usable terms. The person will continually track changes in AI tools and practices, assess what matters to CPV, and help colleagues learn through demonstrations, guidance, and training. **Key Responsibilities**: **Build and improve AI solutions** * Partner with business users to understand processes, pain points, and success measures, then help shape practical AI use cases. * Develop and configure solutions using ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Databricks capabilities, including assistants, agents, workflow support, data analysis, and document\-based experiences. * Create prototypes and proofs of concept; gather user feedback; refine, test, document, and support solutions as they move toward broader use. * Connect AI solutions to approved enterprise data and services using available connectors, APIs, and Databricks data products, working with data and security teams as needed. * Apply sound practices for prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, access control, privacy, and human review. * Monitor solution quality and user feedback; help troubleshoot issues and recommend improvements to reliability, usability, and cost. **Enable responsible adoption** * Work with business stakeholders to identify where AI can help and where a simpler non\-AI approach is more appropriate. * Follow CPV security, privacy, records, data governance, and responsible AI requirements; raise risks and involve the right reviewers early. * Prepare clear solution documentation, user instructions, support notes, and reusable examples so successful work can be maintained and extended. * Collaborate with IT, data engineering, cybersecurity, business teams, and implementation partners to deliver solutions that fit CPV’s environment. **Keep CPV current and build capability** * Keep abreast of product releases, new features, and broader trends across ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Databricks, and the AI field. * Test relevant capabilities in a controlled way and summarize their potential value, limitations, costs, and readiness for CPV. * Share timely updates and practical recommendations with business and technology teams. * Deliver demonstrations, office hours, short training sessions, and learning materials that help employees use approved AI tools effectively and responsibly. * Capture lessons learned and contribute reusable patterns, standards, and examples for CPV’s AI community. **Requirements**: * 3–5 years of professional experience in software development, data and analytics, business systems, automation, AI solution development, or a closely related field. * Hands\-on experience building or configuring solutions with one or more of ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or Databricks; ability and interest to develop across all three. * Experience translating user needs into working technical solutions, prototypes, or process improvements. * Working knowledge of APIs, data concepts, access controls, and software or analytics delivery practices. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to nontechnical audiences and lead practical training. * Curiosity and disciplined learning habits; ability to assess new features and distinguish useful capabilities from hype. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience with Python, SQL, notebooks, workflow automation, or low\-code application development is preferred. * Familiarity with Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI, MLflow, Vector Search, or model serving is preferred. * Experience with Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Azure, or enterprise knowledge sources is preferred. * Familiarity with generative AI concepts such as prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, agents, and model evaluation are preferred. * Experience supporting adoption through user enablement, change management, documentation, or training is preferred. * Must pass a pre\-employment background and financial credit check **Compensation**: The base annual salary range for this position is $165,000 – $195,000 in the Company’s good faith estimate. The actual base salary for this position will be contingent upon individual experience, role responsibilities, and office location. In addition to base salary, this position allows additional compensation and benefits, including: * an annual discretionary bonus up to 20%, fully contingent based on individual and company performance, * paid time off (PTO) of 120 hours per year, hours earned monthly, and up to 13 company paid holidays, and * group benefits: 100% company paid medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with a 100% company match up to 6%, life insurance, short\-and\-long term disability, parental leave and flexible spending accounts. The base annual salary range may be modified in the future. Competitive Power Ventures, Inc. reserves the right to change or terminate any or all benefit plans and/or plan design at its discretion. jobs.title: Databricks Architect
jobs.description: Confiz is seeking a Databricks Architect to lead the data\-layer design and delivery for enterprise AI use cases, serving as the technical authority on the Databricks platform. This role owns the end\-to\-end architecture of the data foundation that powers AI/BI solutions from data discovery and readiness through governed, secure delivery, ensuring every solution aligns with enterprise standards. The Architect explicitly owns security design for the platform, including the Unity Catalog governance model, fine\-grained access controls, and PII handling for natural\-language query experiences. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Use Case Data\-Layer Design \& Delivery** * Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of the data layer supporting prioritized AI use cases, from source ingestion through curated, consumption\-ready data products. * Translate AI/BI use case requirements into concrete data models, pipelines, and platform patterns on Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion architecture, streaming and batch ingestion). * Define and enforce data quality, lineage, and observability standards so downstream AI models and natural\-language query experiences operate on trusted data. * Establish reusable reference architectures and design patterns that accelerate delivery across successive use cases. **Data Discovery \& Readiness** * Co\-facilitate live data discovery sessions with the Lead AI/BI Engineer, working directly with business stakeholders and data owners to identify, profile, and validate candidate data sources. * Assess data readiness for each use case — completeness, quality, granularity, latency, and access — and produce clear readiness findings with remediation plans. * Drive resolution of data readiness issues, coordinating with source\-system owners, data engineering teams, and governance stakeholders to close gaps on schedule. * Maintain a data discovery playbook and artifacts (source inventories, profiling results, gap logs) that make each engagement faster than the last. **Databricks Platform Architecture** * Architect the Databricks platform solution — workspace topology, compute strategy, storage layout, networking, and CI/CD — aligned to enterprise standards. * Define environment strategy (dev/test/prod), promotion paths, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices for repeatable, auditable deployments. * Advise on cost optimization, performance tuning, and capacity planning across clusters, SQL warehouses, and serverless compute. * Stay current on the Databricks roadmap (Unity Catalog, Genie/AI\-BI, Delta Sharing, serverless) and guide adoption decisions. **Security Design (Explicit Ownership)** * Own the platform security design end to end, including identity integration, workspace access, secrets management, and network isolation. * Design and implement the Unity Catalog governance model: catalog/schema structure, ownership model, access policies, tagging, and lineage. * Define and implement row\-level and column\-level security, dynamic data masking, and attribute\-based access controls to enforce least\-privilege data access. * Own PII handling for natural\-language query experiences — classification, masking/tokenization strategies, and guardrails that prevent sensitive data exposure through conversational and generative interfaces. * Partner with enterprise security, privacy, and compliance teams to ensure designs satisfy regulatory and audit requirements, and document controls for review. **Collaboration \& Leadership** * Serve as the primary data\-architecture counterpart to the Lead AI/BI Engineer, aligning the data layer with semantic models and AI/BI experiences. * Provide technical direction and design review for data engineers delivering pipelines and data products. jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer (Palantir Foundry & Databricks)
jobs.description: Construction Partners Inc., a publicly traded highway infrastructure company, is currently seeking a Data Platform Engineer to join the team in Dothan, AL. Remote work will be considered for the right candidate. **Who You Are** A skilled data and application engineer who will serve as a core member of CPI’s data platform team. This position is responsible for consolidating data from CPI’s operational and financial systems into a centralized lakehouse and for developing operational applications on Palantir Foundry that support plant, field, equipment, and financial decision\-making across the organization. The role spans the full lifecycle of that work: integrating source systems, modeling and governing data, and delivering production applications, including solutions that replace or extend third\-party software and provide real\-time visibility into plants, jobs, trucking, and equipment. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with sound software development practices and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. This engineer will work alongside CPI’s existing Foundry team and external consulting partners and will serve as the internal owner of the platform’s design and institutional knowledge. Prior Foundry experience is preferred. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that bring data from ERP and accounting, estimating, field production, plant operations, equipment, and telematics systems into Databricks, connecting through relational databases, REST APIs, and SFTP or flat\-file feeds. * Develop batch and incremental pipelines in Python, PySpark, and SQL using a layered lakehouse approach that cleans, standardizes, and combines data into documented, reusable datasets. * Help define a common data model across operating companies, including how jobs, equipment, plants, employees, vendors, and customers are keyed and matched when each company and system names them differently. * Build reconciliation checks so that platform figures tie out to the ERP and other systems of record. * Handle the realities of source data, including schema changes, late or duplicate records, inconsistent keys, and API limits or failures. * Support data onboarding for newly acquired companies: profile their source systems, map them to the common model, and bring them onto the platform using a repeatable approach. * Connect Foundry to the Databricks lakehouse and other sources, and configure authentication, permissions, and sync schedules. * Design and extend Ontology object types, links, properties, and actions that reflect how the business operates, reusing the existing model rather than duplicating it. * Build operational applications and automated workflows using Workshop, Pipeline Builder, Code Repositories, and TypeScript or Python functions, moving to OSDK and custom front\-end development where low\-code tools reach their limits. * Contribute to geospatial and time\-series capabilities such as geofencing, cycle\-time analytics, and equipment utilization. * Develop AIP and LLM\-assisted workflows that apply AI to operational problems, in line with CPI’s AI and data governance policies. * Take ownership of existing Foundry solutions, document how they work, and mature them into maintainable, supported products. * Monitor pipeline and sync health, set up alerting, and troubleshoot failed feeds, pipeline issues, and application defects. * Apply least\-privilege access controls, markings, and data lineage, coordinating access design with IT Security. * Follow and help strengthen the team’s practices for version control, code review, testing, documentation, and releases. * Partner with external consultants as a hands\-on contributor and ensure what they deliver is understood, documented, and supportable internally. * Work directly with business leaders and end users to map workflows, identify pain points, and turn ambiguous needs into technical designs and delivery plans. * Lead rollout and adoption with business owners and use feedback and operational results to keep improving the platform. **Minimum Requirements** * 2\-4 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or data integration, building and supporting systems used in production. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, or Palantir Foundry, and meaningful exposure to at least one other enterprise grade platform. * Strong SQL, including complex joins and window functions, and the ability to work quickly in unfamiliar schemas on platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. * Strong Python for data work, including Pandas or PySpark, API integration, and automation scripting. * Experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, rate limits, and error handling, and working with JSON, CSV, and file\-based feeds. * Solid understanding of data modeling, including relational and dimensional design, keys, and how data flows and transforms across systems. * Software engineering fundamentals, including Git, testing, code review, and maintainable, documented code. * Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar platforms quickly and apply them in production. * Ability to work directly with business users and leaders, explain tradeoffs in plain terms, and take ownership from discovery through everyday use. **Preferred Experience** * Palantir Foundry, including pipelines, Ontology, Workshop, and OSDK, or Foundry certifications. Databricks certifications, or experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows. * TypeScript, along with React or another front\-end framework. * Palantir AIP or other LLM\-backed workflows. * Geospatial or telematics data, such as GPS, geofences, and engine hours. * ERP and accounting data, especially construction ERPs, job costing, equipment, and materials data. * Integrating data across mergers and acquisitions or multi\-entity organizations. * Azure cloud services. * Experience in construction, heavy civil, materials, or other field\-operations industries. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience). At Construction Partners, we don’t just build roads – we build leaders. We provide opportunities for our employees to grow and develop meaningful careers at all levels. In addition, we offer a wide variety of benefits to support our employees’ well\-being, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage * 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching * Paid vacation and holidays * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (Construction Partners, Inc.: ROAD) * Employee Assistance Program * Professional Development Opportunities Construction Partners, Inc. is dedicated to the achievement of equality of opportunity for all its employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, age, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected group status under federal, state or local law. Construction Partners, Inc. is an E\-Verify Participant. CPI complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (AIOps)
jobs.description: Join a team where innovation meets mission. Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. With more than 1,700\+ team members, 1,500\+ AI \& data experts, and 100\+ prime contracts, we deliver at scale and with purpose. We've been recognized as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post for six consecutive years and named to the Inc. 5000 list of Fastest\-Growing Private Companies in 13 of the past 14 years. Credence is a welcoming environment for those looking to grow and make a meaningful impact. We encourage employees to push boundaries and help solve critical, world\-changing federal challenges. Credence is seeking a **Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (AIOps)** to support secure AWS hosting environments for Department of War customers and to lead engineering of our AIOps / Operations Platform. This is a senior, hands\-on role that combines three things: solutioning customer requirements into working AWS designs, strong DevOps execution across IaC, CI/CD, and containers in a large multi\-account GovCloud environment, and building the observability and AI\-assisted triage capabilities that shorten time to detect and resolve. The ideal candidate leads technical conversations with customers and security teams, sets the patterns other engineers follow, and is a technical escalation point for the hosting team. ### **Responsibilities** Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * **Technical solutioning** * + Lead solutioning discussions with customer stakeholders, application teams, and cybersecurity; turn ambiguous requirements into a clear architecture, implementation plan, and level of effort. + Produce technical designs and reference patterns that other engineers build from; present recommendations, tradeoffs, and risks to technical and nontechnical audiences and drive decisions to closure. + Review designs and merge requests from other engineers; mentor mid\-level and junior staff. * **DevOps and platform engineering** * + Design, deploy, and operate secure AWS hosting solutions for dev, test, and production environments across a multi\-account GovCloud landing zone. + Build and maintain reusable Terraform and CloudFormation modules with remote state, versioning, and policy guardrails. + Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines covering build, test, security scanning, deployment, and release, including pipeline templates teams reuse. + Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot containerized workloads on Docker, Amazon ECS/Fargate, and Amazon EKS/Kubernetes. + Write Python, Shell, and PowerShell automation; turn recurring operational issues into automation, platform capabilities, or standard deployment patterns. + Troubleshoot complex issues across infrastructure, OS, networking, IAM, databases, pipelines, and containers; act as a senior technical escalation point. + Work with cybersecurity and compliance to keep infrastructure and automation aligned with customer, federal, and organizational requirements. * **AIOps / Operations Platform** * + Build and operate the observability data pipeline: CloudWatch, OS\-, and infrastructure\-level telemetry and logs collected into a centralized analytics store. + Build the event correlation and AI\-assisted triage layer on top of it, including anomaly detection, alert deduplication and enrichment, and root cause analysis workflows, integrating generative AI services such as Amazon Bedrock with appropriate guardrails. + Own alarm and monitoring automation so new resources are covered automatically; define and report MTTD, MTTR, alert volume, and coverage. + Contribute to FinOps capabilities built on platform data: tagging standards, cost allocation, and chargeback reporting. * **Operations** * + Create and maintain runbooks, deployment procedures, and operational documentation. + Participate in a rotating on\-call schedule, typically approximately one week every four months. **Requirements** Required Qualifications * + Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust. + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. + CompTIA Security\+ certification, or the ability to obtain it within the first 60 days. + AWS Associate\-level or higher certification, or the ability to obtain one within the first 90 days. + At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure automation, including at least 3 years in a senior or lead capacity. + Demonstrated ability to lead technical solutioning: gather requirements from customers and stakeholders, propose an architecture, explain tradeoffs, and carry the design through implementation. + Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and troubleshooting production AWS environments across multiple accounts, including EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, security groups, RDS, EFS, Lambda, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and Systems Manager. + Hands\-on experience with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation, including reusable modules, remote state, and multi\-account patterns. + Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline, including security scanning and release automation. + Production experience with Docker and at least one container platform, Amazon ECS/Fargate or Amazon EKS/Kubernetes. + Strong Python skills for automation, data processing, and integration work; Shell or PowerShell. + Hands\-on experience building monitoring and observability solutions: metrics and log collection, alerting, dashboards, and alert tuning using CloudWatch plus at least one of Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry/ADOT. + Experience ingesting, transforming, and querying metrics and logs in an analytics store such as Amazon Redshift, Athena, or OpenSearch. + Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers. + Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical designs and processes. Preferred Qualifications * + Experience building or operating an AIOps, SRE, or observability platform, including event correlation, anomaly detection, or automated root cause analysis. + Experience integrating generative AI services such as Amazon Bedrock or LLM APIs into operational workflows, automation, or engineering platforms. + Experience supporting DoD environments at IL4/IL5 in AWS GovCloud, including DISA SCCA architectures, STIG compliance, and NIST 800\-53 controls. + Track record of AI innovation: prototyping and shipping AI\-driven capabilities (agents, LLM\-based triage or remediation, AI\-assisted engineering workflows) that changed how a team operates, not just proofs of concept. + Experience with both Amazon ECS/Fargate and Amazon EKS/Kubernetes, including Helm, ingress, autoscaling, and container registries. + Experience with FinOps practices: tagging standards, cost allocation and chargeback, and rightsizing. + Experience administering Linux and Windows servers, Active Directory, and configuration management tooling such as Systems Manager, Ansible, or AWX. + AWS Professional\-level or Specialty certification (DevOps Engineer, Solutions Architect Professional, or Security). + Experience authoring technical content for proposals, customer briefings, or executive reviews. Compensation * The anticipated salary range for this position is $150,000–$190,000, depending on experience, technical depth, certifications, and overall qualifications. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Training \& Development * Wellness Resources

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Search Core
jobs.description: Join the company that's building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world's biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what's next. We're one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we're remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. **Why You'll Love This Role** Cribl Search powers high\-speed investigations for security and IT teams at some of the world's largest enterprises. Whether data lives in Lakehouse Engines or is spread across Federated sources, Search unifies ingest, storage, and analysis into a single experience — no tool\-hopping, no complex orchestration. Teams collect once, search anywhere, and investigate with no blind spots. Now add agentic AI to the picture. AI\-driven workloads are exploding, autonomous agents are firing queries alongside human analysts, and the volume and complexity of concurrent searches is growing fast. The query engine at the heart of Cribl Search needs to be faster, more concurrent, and more resilient than ever — and that's where you come in. Cribl is looking for a backend\-focused Staff Software Engineer to join a remote\-first, diverse, inclusive, cross\-functional team of software developers focused on making search stupid fast. You will play a central role in evolving the query engine at the heart of Cribl Search – breaking through concurrency ceilings, optimizing query dispatching and execution, and tuning performance for workloads ranging from interactive analyst investigations to AI agents firing thousands of concurrent queries. This is an ideal role for anyone who is passionate about making Search blazing fast at a massive scale. On top of it all, you will have fun! Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone. **As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will …** * Contribute to technical direction, bringing strong, loosely held, opinions to shape how Cribl Search evolves as a platform for multiple products * Own high\-impact changes to large\-scale systems, increasing performance and concurrency for both human and AI\-driven agentic workloads * Build and support a strong foundation for Cribl Search as a whole, collaborating across various teams and divisions * Champion improvements to performance, reliability, and operability * Drive clarity across multiple stakeholders and ambiguous requirements, communicating tradeoffs and risks of competing priorities * Partner with leadership to translate organizational needs from across the business into actionable plans on our roadmap * Lead projects end\-to\-end – from ideation, scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support * Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing * Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with an eye toward observability and resilience * Share on\-call responsibilities as part of a team that embraces service ownership * Help define and refine the software development practices that make our team effective – everybody's feedback helps shape our process * We are a remote\-first company and work happens across many time\-zones – this position will require stand\-by, on\-call, or off\-hours duties **If You've Got \- We Want It** * Strong experience designing and operating multiple\-petabyte\-scale data systems, including object and distributed storage * Experience building search, query, and/or analytic systems working with structured and unstructured data * Deep understanding of how search tools work – indexing, inverted indices, query parsing, and execution (think Lucene/Solr, Elasticsearch) * Experience working on high\-performance, data\-intensive applications where concurrency, throughput, and latency matter * Familiarity with compilers, ASTs, and query language internals * Polyglot engineer – C\+\+ experience is highly desirable * Ability to problem\-solve from first principles and maintain focus on overarching objectives * Demonstrated ability to lead projects through ambiguity, driving technical decisions across team boundaries * Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment where priorities shift quickly * Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written – able to explain complex technical topics to stakeholders in remote, distributed environments * Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team * Experience with C\+\+, Typescript/JavaScript, NodeJS, and SQL \#LI\-JB1 \#LI\-Remote **Bring Your Whole Self** Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We're building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you'll ever meet at cribl.io/about\-us.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: CrowdVolt is on a mission to make going out effortless, starting with a fully automated ticket marketplace for raves and electronic music. We launched out of Y Combinator in 2024 and have since raised a $2\.5M seed round from Goodwater, Brickyard, Pioneer Fund and other top\-tier investors, along with angels including co\-founders of YouTube and Kickstarter. We're growing fast and staying small and elite. We're bringing on a Design Engineer to own how CrowdVolt looks, moves and feels. You'll work directly with our CTO, engineers and designers, and you'll ship your own designs to production. ### **What you'll do** * Design and build responsive, high\-performance interfaces, sweating the typography, motion, empty states and pixel\-level detail. * Own and evolve our design system across components, tokens and interaction patterns, keeping Figma and code in lockstep. * Own and ship features across our entire product, from idea and prototype through deployment. * Drive product and design decisions through direct user feedback and data analysis. ### **Our ideal candidate** * Intensely curious about design, software engineering, technology and learning generally. * Obsessed with craft and taste, and fanatical about polish, down to the pixel. * Has a portfolio (or projects) that shows both design sensibility and shipped frontend work, or experience owning large sections of a codebase. * Fluent in React, TypeScript, Tailwind and modern CSS, with a strong feel for motion and animation (Framer Motion, GSAP or similar) and Figma. * Biased toward action and rapid iteration; can go from a sketch to a working, interactive prototype in hours. * Uses, or can quickly adapt to, an AI\-native workflow: comfortable delegating work to models, writing code with AI and building agents, and always looking for ways to automate repetitive work. ### **Our values** * **Anything is possible.** People have solved much harder problems than ours. Stop making excuses and find a way to make it work. * **Not a playground.** We have a lot of fun, but we're dead serious about what we do and obsessed with winning. * **Overcommunicate.** Be direct. We all have positive intentions and want the best for each other. * **Ruthless prioritization.** Focus on what matters most, build incrementally and ship as fast as possible. * **AI\-focused.** Use AI every day to move faster, work smarter and do more with less. * **Fan first.** Fans are our number one stakeholder. We always go out of our way to give them the best experience possible. ### **What we offer** * **Salary.** $120,000 to $200,000 a year. * **Meaningful equity.** You own part of what you build. * **Comprehensive benefits.** Health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family. * **Unlimited PTO.** Recharge when you need to. * **Lots of food.** Costco deliveries and home\-cooked food. * **Paid dinner in the office.** If you're working late, it's on us. * **Off\-sites.** Dinners and trips away together. We're a scrappy startup, and we work incredibly hard. If you want to make a real impact, grow fast and help make going out effortless, we'd love to hear from you. Compensation Range: $120K \- $200K

jobs.description: **Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About This Role** ------------------- We’re looking for a Forward\-Deployed Engineer to solve technical problems for our customers and build the software they need to succeed with depthfirst. You’ll work directly with enterprise engineering and security teams to understand their needs and own delivery from initial discovery through production. Your work will span building customer\-facing features, developing integrations, and helping customers deploy and operate depthfirst in their environments. Depending on the problem, you might extend a product capability, build an API integration, debug an application issue, or work through a complex deployment constraint. You’ll implement solutions yourself and turn recurring customer needs into lasting improvements across our product and platform. We welcome engineers with different strengths. You might be a backend or full\-stack engineer who wants to work more closely with customers, or an infrastructure engineer with deep experience in cloud systems, Kubernetes, and networking. You don’t need to arrive with expertise in every area. We’re looking for engineers who take ownership, learn unfamiliar systems, and ship solutions. **You’re excited about this role because you will…** ---------------------------------------------------- * Build and ship customer\-facing features, APIs, and integrations that solve real customer problems. * Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, identify technical blockers, and define practical solutions. * Own delivery from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration. * Help customers integrate, deploy, and operate depthfirst within their existing systems and technical constraints. * Investigate problems across application code, integrations, and infrastructure, and implement fixes. * Turn solutions developed for individual customers into reusable product capabilities, tooling, and automation. * Communicate technical tradeoffs and progress clearly, keeping customer and internal teams aligned. **Qualifications** ------------------ * A strong engineering background in **at least one** of the following: + **Backend or full\-stack software engineering:** experience designing, building, and shipping production applications, services, APIs, or integrations. + **Infrastructure or platform engineering:** deep hands\-on experience deploying and debugging production systems across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and networking, with experience developing software and tooling. * Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or Java, and experience writing, testing, and maintaining production code. * Ability to take an ambiguous problem, identify a useful solution, and carry it through to production. * Strong debugging skills and a willingness to work across unfamiliar systems. * Strong communication skills and an interest in working directly with customers. Prior customer\-facing experience is helpful but not required. * Ownership, practical judgment, and the ability to move quickly while building reliable software. **Bonus Points For** -------------------- * Experience delivering customer\-facing features or owning technical engagements with enterprise customers. * Experience integrating software with enterprise APIs, authentication systems, and developer workflows. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, or enterprise deployment requirements. * Experience with AI platforms, developer tools, or security products. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive salary with meaningful equity. * Health, vision, and dental insurance. * Office lunch and dinner when working from our San Francisco office. * Direct impact on customer success and product direction. * The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and security. \- depthfirst is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. To all recruitment agencies: depthfirst does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to depthfirst employees. depthfirst is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

jobs.title: Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior
jobs.description: **At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross\-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.** **Join our Qrew!** EQT runs AI agents in production on Microsoft Foundry, working inside Salesforce and the enterprise systems our people use every day. Demand is compounding as domain experts across the business bring new agent ideas forward, and the platform underneath has to scale with it. We need an Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior to own that platform: secure, observable, affordable, and easy to build on. **The Role:** You own the foundation every agent runs on. Our AI Engineers build agents and the tools they use; you build and operate the layer beneath them: the Azure environment, the AI gateway, the tool registry, and the observability, evaluation, and guardrail systems that keep the fleet healthy. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role. You write the infrastructure as code, own the AI platform in production, and partner with Infrastructure to align to standards and deploy. You won't spend most of your time building agents, but you'll understand them well enough to make the platform fast and safe to build on. **Who Thrives Here:** * **You treat the platform as a product.** Your customers are engineers and business builders, and the best paved road is the one they choose to take. * **You automate the toil.** If you did it twice by hand, it's in code the third time. * **You think in least privilege.** Identity, secrets, and network boundaries are design inputs, not cleanup. * **You know what it costs.** You can say where the tokens and dollars go, and you tune before anyone asks. * **You're excited about where AI is going.** You want to build the platform that lets an organization run many agents well, not just one. **The Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior responsibilities include but are not limited to:** * Own our Azure infrastructure as code: author, review, and deploy modular templates across dev and production. * Operate Microsoft Foundry environments, model deployments, and our private Azure subscription as production infrastructure, including onboarding, upgrading, and retiring models. * Own the AI gateway on Azure API Management: routing and transformation policies, per\-consumer keys, rate limits, and onboarding new models and consumers. * Run the centralized tool registry: identity and authentication patterns, versioning, and reuse standards, so a tool built once serves every agent. * Build fleet\-wide observability: logging, compliance log collection, monitoring, alerting, and usage telemetry attributed by agent and user. * Build and operate the evaluation infrastructure that gates releases and continuously scores agents in production. * Own identity and access: Entra ID group\-based, least\-privilege RBAC, managed identities, just\-in\-time elevation, and drift detection against the code. * Own cost and performance: budgets and alerts, tagging, recurring cost reviews, and latency and token tuning across the fleet. * Set the guardrails and paved roads (spend limits, standard build patterns, templates) that let builders move fast without breaking things, and bring manually deployed services under code. * Own platform production support, partnering closely with Cyber, Infrastructure, Network, Salesforce, and data teams, and keep runbooks and documentation current. **Required Experience and Skills:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (computer science, engineering, information systems, or similar), or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 6\+ years in cloud platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or site reliability engineering, including 3\+ years running production workloads on Microsoft Azure. * Production infrastructure as code on Azure with Bicep, ARM, or Terraform: modular templates, parameterization, and multi\-scope deployments. * Azure identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, and least\-privilege design. * Azure networking and security fundamentals: VNets, private endpoints, TLS, and locking down public endpoints. * CI/CD and software fundamentals: git, code review, deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps), and scripting in Bash, PowerShell, or Python. * Observability on Azure: Log Analytics, Application Insights, and writing KQL. * Working knowledge of how LLM applications and agents work (model endpoints, tool calling, tokens, evaluation), enough to design a platform for them. * Clear communicator who documents well and can explain infrastructure tradeoffs to engineers and business leaders. **Preferred Experience and Skills:** * Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) or Azure OpenAI in production: model deployments, agents, evaluations, and the control plane. * Azure API Management policy authoring, including request and response transformation between model APIs. * Azure Container Apps and Container Registry, including hosting Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar services. * Agent evaluation and monitoring tooling, and responsible AI guardrails such as PII handling, content filtering, and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Governance at scale with Azure Policy, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and FinOps practices. * Integrating Azure services with Salesforce or Databricks Remote work is being considered for this role excluding the following states: California, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, and Tennessee unless willing to relocate. Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Disabilities/Veterans.

jobs.title: Snowflake Data Engineer
jobs.description: Seeking a Data Engineer to build and operate Snowflake and Informatica data pipelines for its Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS), also known as COdata. The system links education and workforce records from multiple agencies to support reporting on program participation, completion, equitable access, and wage outcomes. Key responsibilities * Build and maintain data pipelines. Design, test, and deploy automated Informatica workflows and Snowflake SQL transformations that map partner agency data to the SLDS common data model. * Onboard agency data. Lead ingestion of annual postsecondary course data from the Colorado Department of Higher Education. Additional feeds may include postsecondary demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability data, as well as PSAT/SAT assessment results. * Link and reconcile records. Apply identity\-matching rules to connect incoming records to existing student and workforce profiles. Investigate match exceptions and resolve cross\-agency discrepancies. * Own production feed operations. Monitor scheduled jobs, troubleshoot failures, reload late or corrected files, reconcile row counts, and rebuild downstream tables and views. * Automate data quality and privacy controls. Validate file structure, completeness, duplicates, referential integrity, and business rules. Detect layout changes, maintain audit trails, and apply de\-identification and cell suppression rules where required. * Maintain the analytics layer. Build and tune Snowflake tables, views, and metrics. Support Tableau dashboard refreshes and prepare de\-identified outcome files for participating higher education institutions. * Test, release, and document changes. Use Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans to manage releases across development, test, UAT, and production. Maintain source\-to\-target mappings, data lineage, runbooks, test evidence, and release logs. Required qualifications Minimum requirement Snowflake ETL/ELT 5\+ years building, orchestrating, and optimizing complex data pipelines and transformations directly in Snowflake Informatica CDGC 1\+ year of hands\-on experience with Informatica Cloud Data Governance and Catalog for metadata management, data profiling, cataloging, and automated data quality validation Terraform 1\+ year provisioning, configuring, and maintaining cloud resources using infrastructure as code Azure DevOps Demonstrated experience building automated CI/CD pipelines for builds, tests, and deployments Git Expert proficiency with branching, pull requests, automated merge checks, and code reviews Preferred qualifications * Experience with public\-sector education or workforce data, especially statewide longitudinal data systems. * Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, and deterministic or probabilistic identity matching across data sources. * Familiarity with FERPA, COPPA, state student and workforce data privacy requirements, and cell suppression standards. * Experience writing and executing structured test cases in Azure Test Plans. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non\-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi\-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision\-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors. **We are experiencing sky\-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025**. Requirements: * Degree in Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4\+ years combining software development with BIM, CAD, or digital delivery work, ideally on infrastructure or civil projects. * Strong coding skills in Python, plus experience with C\#/.NET or TypeScript. * Hands\-on experience automating BIM workflows using tools such as Dynamo, pyRevit, the Civil 3D or Revit APIs, or Autodesk Platform Services. * Practical experience building with large language models: prompt and workflow design, tool or function calling, retrieval over documents, and evaluating model output. * A working understanding of civil design deliverables: alignments and profiles, corridors, grading, drainage and utility networks, sheet production, and model coordination. * Comfort working directly with end users: you listen first, explain clearly to non\-technical audiences, and build trust by shipping. * Ownership and a bias for action. You are happy working in ambiguity, scoping your own work, and seeing it through to adoption. **Nice to Have** * Experience building agent integrations, for example using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool frameworks. * Familiarity with openBIM and infrastructure data standards such as IFC 4\.3, LandXML, and ISO 19650\. * Experience with Bentley OpenRoads, OpenFlows, or iTwin; Navisworks; or GIS platforms such as ArcGIS. * Experience with document AI on drawings, specifications, and reports, including PDF and OCR pipelines. * Background as a practicing civil engineer or BIM coordinator before moving into software. * Experience delivering training or leading change\-management programs in an engineering organization. Job description: Exodigo engineers the underground without digging. Our platform combines multi\-sensor fusion and AI to produce complete, accurate 3D maps of buried utilities, foundations, and geotechnical conditions, which utilities, transportation agencies, and engineering firms use to plan, design, and build with confidence. Behind every map is a team of civil engineers, BIM modelers, and mapping specialists who turn raw subsurface data into engineering\-grade deliverables. We are looking for an AI BIM Engineer to help that team move faster, stay consistent, and scale with our growth. You will work alongside our Mapping, Delivery, and Engineering Services teams, learn how a project moves from field scan through interpretation to Civil 3D and OpenRoads models and client\-ready utility maps, and find where AI can take on the repetitive work so our engineers can focus on engineering judgment. This is a hands\-on, builder role. You will scope the problem, build the solution, ship it into live projects, and stay with it until it becomes part of how the team works. You will be the bridge between engineers who know the underground deeply and the AI agents that can amplify them: you can discuss utility quality levels, model QA/QC, and client CAD standards in the morning, and write a new integration for an AI agent in the afternoon. What you learn on our projects will shape the AI capabilities we give every team. **What You'll Do** Embed with engineering teams * Work side by side with highway, structures, water, and site development teams to understand their design processes, tools, standards, and pain points. * Lead discovery sessions with engineers and project leads, and translate what you hear into clearly scoped, prioritized opportunities for AI and automation. * Own delivery end to end: from first conversation and rapid prototype through to a stable tool in daily production use. * Coach engineers on using AI effectively and safely in their work, through hands\-on sessions, office hours, and one\-on\-one support. Turn expertise into repeatable workflows * Partner with senior engineers to capture their know\-how (checking procedures, design criteria, QA/QC steps, naming and modeling standards) as reusable AI workflows, prompts, and playbooks. * Design workflows that are repeatable and reviewable: clear inputs, clear outputs, and an engineer in the loop wherever professional judgment or sign\-off is required. * Build evaluation sets from real project data so we can measure whether a workflow is accurate and reliable before it scales. * Document what you build and help teams own and extend their workflows themselves. Extend what our AI agents can do * Design and build integrations that let AI agents read, query, and act on civil engineering data: BIM models, alignments, surfaces, pipe networks, drawings, specifications, and project records. * Develop tools and connectors on top of platforms such as Autodesk Civil 3D, Revit, and Autodesk Platform Services / ACC, Bentley OpenRoads and iTwin, and open formats such as IFC and LandXML. * Build automations with Dynamo, pyRevit, Python, and C\#/.NET where a deterministic script is the right answer and expose them as capabilities an AI agent can call. * Make sound trade\-offs between speed, scope, and quality, and keep everything you ship secure, version\-controlled, and maintainable. Close the loop * Spot patterns across teams and turn one\-off solutions into shared, reusable capabilities. * Feed field insights back to our digital, IT, and data teams to shape platform priorities and roadmap. * Contribute to our AI governance, data\-handling, and BIM standards so adoption stays responsible as it grows. Learn more: **What Success Looks Like** In your first year, you will have: * Embedded with several project teams and built a clear map of where AI can save the most time and reduce the most risk. * Shipped AI workflows that engineers use every week, with measurable time savings and quality improvements. * Added new civil\-specific capabilities to our AI agents, so they can work directly with the models and data our teams produce. * Built a library of documented, evaluated workflows that other teams can pick up and adapt. * Become the go\-to person engineers call when they think, "There has to be a better way to do this." **Why Join Us** * Real impact: your work goes straight into the maps that help infrastructure owners avoid utility strikes, delays, and safety risks on major projects. * An AI\-native company: AI already sits at the core of how we read the subsurface. You will extend it to how we engineer and deliver. * A rare mix of disciplines: geophysics, civil engineering, BIM, and modern AI in one role, with a global team spanning the US, Israel, and beyond. * Room to shape, from the ground up, how a fast\-growing company scales its engineering delivery with AI. * Close collaboration with field, mapping, and engineering experts who care about getting the underground right. Our mission is to power the next era of underground exploration – saving time, money, lives, and the planet. We are focused, intentional, confident, and hard working. We solve big problems, but we are approachable, open\-minded, and love hard questions. You can learn more about us on our website or check out this short video. Apply on our careers page, via Linkedin or send your resume to cara.partovich@exodigo.ai

preferred **Pay, Benefits, and Support** ============================== Pay Range: $129,300\.00 \- $172,300\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan. Here, you’ll be part of a culture built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement — so you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and help move our customers, communities, and company forward. **About First American** ======================== First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF) is a premier provider of title, settlement, and risk solutions for real estate transactions. Backed by financial strength and stability built over more than 135 years, the company is leading the digital transformation of the industry through continued investment in proprietary technologies, unmatched data assets, and scalable solutions designed for what’s next. First American’s commitment to putting its people first has resulted in numerous accolades, including being named one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine for more than ten consecutive years. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **TITLE:** Senior Software Engineer **REPORTING TO**: CTO **LOCATION**: Marina del Rey, CA – OR – Williamsburg, NY (onsite M \- F) **Who Is Flip?** Flip builds AI voice agents that handle millions of real customer conversations for some of the biggest brands, healthcare providers, and transportation companies in the world. When you call a company and the AI actually solves your problem — tracks the order, processes the return, refills the prescription — that's us. We're a low\-ego team. We don't need the limelight or the stardom — we care about solving really hard problems, fast. And here's the part worth stopping on: outside the frontier labs, almost nobody is running AI in production at this scale. We are — millions and millions of live phone calls, at a ratio of roughly one engineer for every million calls. We deploy to production three times a day. Very few teams our size serve this volume, and the reason is simple: we hold a very high bar for development. **How we think** ---------------- **From day one, we've operated on first principles, and the first principle is the customer.** If you have strong conviction that something delivers real business value for your customer, it shouldn't die in red tape or committee. You ship it — fast and often — because the customer is what actually matters. That's why there's a direct line from your keyboard to production here. We didn't remove the committee to move fast for its own sake; we removed it because conviction plus customer obsession doesn't need a permission slip. **We reward big swings.** Our founders are very forward about this: you'll test in production, and you'll always be encouraged to take a swing — whether it lands or not. Missing on a big swing is fine. Not swinging is what gets called out. Agentic development has changed the way we work — we're not shy about that. What it hasn't changed is the necessity of experience, especially at the production level. You can ship faster than ever now; that doesn't negate experience. Speed without judgment is how you break things millions of people depend on. That's why we hire senior engineers: builders whose experience makes the new speed safe. **Our view is simple: let builders build.** We care a lot less about stack experience or corporate pedigree than most companies — and a lot more about whether you've looked past the noise and want to build product you're genuinely proud of. Tools change monthly now. The instinct to build doesn't. We keep the team lean on purpose — a high bar, real support, real resources — because that's where builders truly express themselves. The most common thing we hear from engineers after joining Flip is some version of *"I could never have done this at my last company"*. Deep industry expertise matched with ruthless execution creates wonderful work. That's the whole formula. **What you'll build** --------------------- We're serving an orchestrated system of agents answering millions of contacts daily and now also expanding into other modalities like chat. Pulling that off requires elite engineering paired with incredible DevOps — voice is unforgiving: it's real\-time, there are no retries or page refreshes, and the customer is literally on the line. The work breaks into three lanes: * **Vertical engineering** — building the agents themselves: complex multi\-step customer workflows and deep integrations into the contact center and the industries we serve — order systems, healthcare workflows, logistics. This is where "mostly works" isn't shippable. * **Platform engineering** — the orchestration layer every agent runs on: routing, state, tool use, and the primitives that let vertical teams ship fast without reinventing the engine. * **Inference \& DevOps** — we host our own models; low\-latency serving at production scale is a core competency here, not a vendor line item. Plus the telephony, observability, and deployment infrastructure that keeps millions of live calls healthy. And the range here is real. Our engineers do everything from sitting face\-to\-face with customers to going deep on complex backend systems — you really get to pick where you fit. We don't slot you into one of these on day one. There's probably a place for you — we'll find it together, and it'll probably change as we grow. **What we look for** -------------------- This is a senior role, and the bar is the same one we hold for staff: we are always raising the bar on each other. Builders love to build — and how they build varies. Some want the flexibility of working alone and joining forces when it counts; some do their best work in a small pod. We don't prescribe it. You'll own real systems from day one, work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our staff engineers, and have a clear path to staff as your scope grows. * **Real production experience.** You've built and owned systems where failure had consequences. You have 6\+ years of professional engineering experience building and running production systems. Beyond the years, we look at what you've shipped and what you learned shipping it. * **Judgment that survives contact with production.** Agentic development is how we work — but what we're actually hiring is your experience: knowing what to ship, what to slow down on, and what never to ship at all. * **Low ego, high execution.** You own outcomes, not tickets. You'd rather ship the thing than present the plan for the thing. * **A bias for big swings.** You'd rather take a shot and miss than play it safe — and you learn fast from both. * **Customer obsession.** You want to be close to the problem — sometimes literally in the room — and you measure yourself by what the customer got. **More About Us** * We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada. * We've raised \+$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A \- backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders \& executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive and Simon Data. * Our tech stack includes Python, MongoDB, AWS, Twilio, Datadog, Snowflake, and Omni. * Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year. * In the office 5 days/week, we collaborate in real time on the desk. Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.

have agents flag low confidence or missing data and hand off to a person. **Data \& Vector Infrastructure** * Manage relational and caching stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis) alongside vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) for semantic search and agent memory. * Build RAG pipelines (chunking, embeddings, ranking, filtering) over plant and platform knowledge, connected to manufacturing ontologies and knowledge graphs. **Evaluation, Token Economics \& Observability** * Test agents against shared evaluation sets before each release, add cases from plant experts, and turn confirmed fixes into better agent behavior. * Track prompt performance, manage token budgets, and optim  retrieval\-augmented generation, tool use, and agent frameworks. * Evaluating model or system output; testing, CI/CD, and code review. **Even better, you may have...** * Agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Google ADK) and protocols (MCP, A2A); multi\-agent systems. * Vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search; knowledge graphs or ontologies. * LLM observability and cost management (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Logfire, token budgets). * Real\-time features (websockets, push notifications, event streams), gRPC, API gateways, and publishing SDKs; business teams, mentor engineers on secure practices, and support audit and compliance objectives with accurate technical evidence. **What** **We’re** **Looking For*** 6\+ years of experience in prepare evidence for audits and address findings. * Run vulnerability and patch management across hosts, containers and third\-party services. #### **Database operations (MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB)** * Maintain a large Percona MySQL 8\.0 fleet: replication health, failover, backups and restores, schema migrations, performance tuning. * Maintain PostgreSQL clusters: replication, vacuum and bloat control, upgrades, connection pooling. * Maintain MongoDB replica sets and sharded clusters: replication, backups, index and storage engine tuning, version upgrades. * Keep database monitoring (PMM, VictoriaMetrics, Slack alerting) accurate and actionable; lead incident response and write blameless postmortems. * Document runbooks and automate anything done twice. ### **Required qualifications** * 5\+ years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering running production systems at scale. * 3\+ years operating Kubernetes in production, including cluster upgrades, networking (CNI, ingress) and persistent storage; experience on bare metal or self\-managed clusters, not only managed cloud offerings. * Strong Linux systems administration (RHEL/CentOS/Rocky or Debian/Ubuntu): kernel, networking, systemd, performance troubleshooting. * Hands\-on MySQL operations: replication topologies, backup/restore (XtraBackup or equivalent), failover, query and InnoDB tuning.
