jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: ace has partnered with a prestigious, leading global hedge fund to appoint a Senior QA Automation Engineer to its Legal \& Compliance technology organization in New York. This is a hands\-on engineering role, not a test management one. You will design, build and run AI\-enabled automated test capability for the systems the firm relies on to meet its regulatory obligations. You will also establish how AI\-enabled compliance systems themselves are tested and evidenced. In\-scope systems include trade and communications surveillance, transaction and regulatory reporting, control room and information barriers, and adjacent compliance platforms. The role is deliberately not tied to one function. You will be deployed wherever the need is greatest: hardening a surveillance model release one quarter, assuring a reporting change against a regulatory deadline the next. You will be expected to get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar domains, work out what “correct” means from requirements and regulation, and turn that into rigorous, automated, auditable test coverage. You will work with a high degree of autonomy in a demanding, fast\-moving environment, where the expectation is delivery rather than management overhead. **Please note that this role requires presence in the client’s New York office five days per week. This is non\-negotiable.** **Responsibilities** ***Test engineering across compliance systems*** * Design and build automated test suites, covering unit, integration, regression, end\-to\-end and data validation, for compliance applications and data pipelines across multiple functions. * Engineer test frameworks and harnesses in Python for service, API and data\-layer testing, and in TypeScript/JavaScript where front\-end or UI testing is needed. * Validate high\-volume trade, order, position and transaction data at field level and record level. This includes reconciliation between source systems, enrichment layers and regulatory outputs. * Build synthetic and scenario\-based test data that exercises edge cases, such as complex instruments, lifecycle events, amendments, cancellations and late or out\-of\-sequence data, without exposing production data inappropriately. * Test surveillance logic and alert generation. Confirm that rule and model changes behave as intended and that their downstream impact on alert volumes and coverage is understood before release. ***AI\-enabled testing and AI assurance*** * Use large language models (Gemini on Google Cloud preferred) to interpret requirements, distinguish well\-formed from poorly formed requirements, identify coverage gaps, and generate candidate test scripts, test data and expected results, with a human in the loop and full traceability. * Design and orchestrate agent\-based test execution, including how individual agents are scoped, coordinated across a single test scenario, and constrained by entitlements so that no agent can reach or surface data outside its permitted scope. * Define and implement assurance approaches for LLM\-enabled compliance capabilities, such as communications surveillance, alert triage, document classification and extraction. This covers evaluation datasets, accuracy and tolerance thresholds, regression checks when a model or prompt changes, and tracking of drift and consistency. * Produce evidence of AI system behavior that will stand up to compliance oversight, internal audit and regulatory scrutiny, including versioning of models, prompts and evaluation results. ***Platform engineering*** * Contribute to the firm’s in\-house automated testing platform and extend it, driving its adoption across the applications in scope. * Integrate test execution with source control, pull\-request workflows, requirements management and CI/CD, so that coverage is derived systematically rather than assembled manually. * Own the infrastructure and environments for test tooling through a code\-first, infrastructure\-as\-code approach. ***Lineage, governance and assurance*** * Deliver end\-to\-end lineage from requirement and rule change through test script, execution, results and UAT evidence, with full versioning and auditability. * Produce test evidence that stands up to internal audit, compliance oversight and regulatory scrutiny. * Implement entitlements and access controls within test tooling so that no test process can reach or surface data outside its permitted scope. ***Ways of working*** * Move between compliance functions as priorities shift, building working knowledge of each domain’s data, rules and regulatory drivers. * Work directly with engineers, business analysts and compliance subject\-matter experts to turn requirements, including ambiguous ones, into precise acceptance criteria. * Raise automation standards across the teams you work with through code review, pairing and reusable components. **Requirements** ***Essential*** * Strong, current, hands\-on software engineering experience with a specialism in test automation, at the level of a software engineer who specializes in quality rather than a tester who scripts. * Advanced Python, covering test frameworks (e.g. pytest), service and API testing, and data manipulation at scale. * Strong SQL and experience validating large, complex datasets, including reconciliation between systems. * Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern UI test tooling (e.g. Playwright, Cypress). * Hands\-on experience applying large language models to real engineering problems in production, rather than proofs of concept, with a clear view on controls, traceability and data access. * CI/CD and infrastructure as code. GCP and Terraform are strongly preferred; containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is an advantage. * Disciplined engineering practice: Git, branching strategies, pull\-request workflows, code review and repeatable release processes. * Experience testing systems in a regulated financial services environment, ideally capital markets. * A track record of taking automation into genuine production adoption and owning it thereafter. * The ability to learn a new domain quickly and work independently at pace, making day\-to\-day implementation decisions without direction. ***Advantageous*** * Experience building with Gemini on Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI), or comparable enterprise LLM platforms. * Experience evaluating or testing ML/LLM\-based systems, for example building evaluation sets, measuring precision and recall, testing for robustness, and handling outputs that vary between runs. * Exposure to one or more compliance technology domains: trade or communications surveillance; transaction and regulatory reporting (e.g. CAT, CFTC Part 43/45, SEC Regulation SBSR, EMIR, MiFIR); control room and information barriers; books and records. * Understanding of trade and order lifecycle data across asset classes. * Familiarity with model risk management expectations (e.g. SR 11\-7\) as they apply to AI in regulated environments. * Experience with event\-driven or streaming architectures (e.g. Kafka). **Benefits** Contract Length: 6 months, 3 months rolling Day rate: $1,000\-1,500/d, depending on experience

jobs.title: AI Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Introduction** Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client\-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. **Overview** The Senior AI Engineering Developer owns the technical delivery of enterprise AI solutions at AJ Gallagher. Reporting to the Director of AI, you will lead the design, build, and deployment of production AI systems \- RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and Copilot integrations \- on our Azure and .NET/Python stack. You will set engineering standards for a growing AI team, mentor developers, and partner directly with business units to turn ambiguous problems into shipped, governed, production\-grade AI products in a regulated insurance environment. **How you'll make an impact** * **Translate Business Problems into Technical Solutions:** Work side\-by\-side with business leaders and subject\-matter experts to unpack ambiguous, unstructured challenges and shape them into well\-scoped, buildable AI solutions with a clear delivery path. * **Own AI Solution Architecture:** Design and defend end\-to\-end architectures for GenAI and agentic systems on Microsoft Foundry \- spanning Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Foundry Tools, and Copilot Studio \- that meet enterprise security, scalability, and data\-residency requirements. * **Lead Hands\-On Delivery:** Write and review production code (C\#/.NET and Python) for RAG pipelines, AI agent orchestration, and API integrations; remain a strong individual contributor while leading the team. * **Set Engineering Standards:** Establish patterns for agentic development, evaluation, testing, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), and observability so AI solutions are repeatable and maintainable \- not one\-off prototypes. * **Mentor and Grow Engineers:** Coach AI developers through design reviews, pairing, and career development; raise the technical bar across the team. * **Ship to Enterprise Surfaces:** Deliver AI capabilities into internal applications, Microsoft Teams, and M365 Copilot, integrating through Foundry agents, Service Bus, Azure Functions, and other cloud\-native services. * **Build Governance In:** Implement responsible\-AI controls \- Entra ID/RBAC, IaC Policy, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, audit logging \- aligned to Gallagher compliance expectations from day one, not as an afterthought. * **Drive Evaluation and Reliability:** Define measurable quality bars (groundedness, accuracy, latency, cost) and build the evaluation harnesses to enforce them before and after release. * **Communicate Up and Across:** Translate technical trade\-offs into clear recommendations for the Director of AI and business stakeholders; manage delivery risks and dependencies proactively. **About You** **Required** ============ * **Experience:** 7 or more years in software engineering, including experience in building LLM/GenAI systems in production and 2\+ years leading engineers or owning technical direction. * **Azure Depth:** Hands\-on production experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure compute (Functions, Container Apps, or App Service). * **Languages:** Strong .NET/C\# plus working proficiency in Python; able to review and contribute in both. * **GenAI Engineering:** Proven delivery of RAG architectures, agent orchestration (Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or LangChain), and prompt/evaluation pipelines. * **API and Integration Skills:** Designing secure REST APIs and event\-driven integrations (Azure API Management, Service Bus) within an enterprise identity model (Entra ID, RBAC). * **Delivery Discipline:** Agile experience with Azure DevOps (or equivalent) \- backlogs, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management. * **Leadership:** Track record of mentoring engineers, running design reviews, and owning technical decisions across multiple concurrent initiatives. **Preferred Differentiators** ============================= * **Regulated Industry Experience:** Prior AI/ML delivery in insurance, financial services, or healthcare, with familiarity with model risk management or responsible AI guidance. * **Familiarity with AI\-enabled and spec\-driven development:** Using AI\-assisted tooling and agent workflows across the SDLC to quickly deliver production\-grade systems. * **Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code:** Building applications tightly aligned to Terraform\-deployed, optimized infrastructure. * **Evaluation and MLOps Maturity:** Built LLMOps tooling \- automated evals, red\-teaming, drift/cost monitoring \- at enterprise scale. * **Architecture Credentials:** Azure certifications (AZ\-305, AI\-103\) or equivalent demonstrated architecture ownership. **Professional Qualities** ========================== * **Bias for Shipped Outcomes:** Measures success by working software in users' hands, not demos or decks; cuts scope intelligently to ship. * **Calm Technical Authority:** Makes and defends decisions under ambiguity, and changes course quickly when evidence demands it. * **Force Multiplier:** Gets more from the team than from their own keyboard \- through mentoring, standards, and unblocking others. * **Governance as a Feature:** Treats compliance, security, and auditability as design inputs that build trust, not friction to route around. * **Clear Communicator:** Explains complex systems simply to executives and precisely to engineers; writes things down. * **Pragmatic Curiosity:** Tracks the fast\-moving AI landscape but adopts new tools only when they solve a real AJ Gallagher problem. **Compensation and benefits** At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being * Career development opportunities and ongoing learning * A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership * The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact **At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

jobs.description: **Job Description** The Product Program Cost Optimization (PPCO) team at General Motors is seeking a highly motivated individual for the role of Cost Engineer – Data Analytics. This individual will be technically skilled in data analytics, data engineering, machine learning, and AI implementation, with the ability to lead initiatives that enable product and program level cost optimization through robust data engineering, exploratory data analysis (EDA), advanced predictive modeling, and rapid prototype application development. This role sits within the PPCO Systems and Data Analytics teams and focuses on building and maintaining the data and foundations for advanced analytics solutions and applied AI that power cost analytics initiatives across GM Finance. You will work with data from across the GM ecosystem, identifying interconnections between multiple enterprise applications from different functional areas (e.g., engineering, purchasing, finance, program management) and designing scalable data structures, pipelines, and intelligent models that turn disparate and unstructured data into trusted, analysis\-ready, and actionable assets. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals (ETL/ELT, database and table management, EDA) with hands\-on depth in machine learning and applied AI — including classical predictive modeling, modern ML techniques, and increasingly, generative AI / LLM\-based approaches — and can rapidly translate ideas into working prototype applications that stakeholders can interact with. You will use current data to understand behaviors and to predict product attributes such as manufacturing parameters, product cost, program development cost creep, and economic factors based on parameters and features extracted from existing data, and you will build quick, functional prototype tools that put these insights directly into the hands of business users. jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer

This is a builder role. Success requires equal comfort with executive discovery, architecture whiteboarding, writing and debugging code, integrating enterprise systems and data, evaluating agent behavior, and resolving blockers with Product and Engineering. The FDE maintains end\-to\-end accountability from discovery through production and converts lessons from each engagement into reusable assets that accelerate the next customer. Work alongside customer engineers and architects, transfer knowledge, and leave customer teams more capable of operating and extending the solution after the engagement. * Create the field\-to\-product feedback loop. Translate repeatable customer needs, deployment friction, and edge cases into actionable product feedback, feature requests, technical patterns, and reference implementations. * Build once, scale everywhere. Package proven agents, integrations, prompts, evaluation methods, deployment patterns, and implementation playbooks into reusable assets that accelerate future customer engagements. * Operate with ownership and urgency. Maintain accountability through resolution, manage ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and drive multiple stakeholders toward measurable outcomes. Required Qualifications * 8\+ years of relevant technical experience in software engineering, AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical delivery, solution architecture, or a comparable hands\-on role; equivalent practical experience will be considered. * Demonstrated production ownership. Experience taking at least one meaningful software, AI, data, or integration solution from concept or prototype into a production environment and supporting it through real\-world use. * Enterprise integration expertise. Experience designing or building with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication/authorization, structured and unstructured data, and modern cloud or SaaS architectures. * Applied AI and LLM knowledge. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: The Code and Review organization owns GitHub's core code collaboration experience, from navigating code and creating pull requests through reviewing changes and merging them safely at scale. We build the user experiences, platform systems, and AI\-powered capabilities behind diffs, comments, reviews, mergeability, merge queue, and Copilot code review. We're looking for a product\-focused Senior Software Engineer with strong React and TypeScript skills. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack role with substantial frontend development. You'll partner closely with product and design to shape workflows, refine interactions, and build accessible, responsive experiences for developers. You'll own features across the stack, including the backend APIs and application logic that support the interface. We value engineers who care about usability, make thoughtful technical tradeoffs, and use customer feedback to improve what they ship. Responsibilities: * Design, build, test, and ship customer\-facing features across React and TypeScript interfaces, backend APIs, and data models. * Partner closely with product and design to understand developer needs, prototype interactions, and break larger ideas into useful, shippable improvements. * Provide technical leadership, mentorship, pairing opportunities, and code reviews to encourage the growth of others. * Own and advocate for the health and quality of the systems that the team builds, including participating in on\-call and first responder rotations * Write architecture briefs and proposals, carry out code experiments, and build prototypes to evaluate technical tradeoffs and improve the developer experience. * Design and implement APIs to facilitate seamless integration between software components. * Build accessible, responsive interfaces with attention to interaction details, loading and error states, and frontend performance. * Become intimately familiar with the systems you build and take pride in writing maintainable code. * Own feature quality through automated testing, safe rollouts, and production monitoring. Use customer feedback and telemetry to assess and improve features after launch. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications:*** 6\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python * + OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python * + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python * + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python * + OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field * + OR equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Strong experience shipping and maintaining production React and TypeScript applications, including component design, state management, data fetching, and frontend testing. * Experience working closely with designers to refine interactions and deliver accessible, polished user experiences. * Experience building backend APIs, application logic, and relational data models. Ruby on Rails experience is a plus. * Experience independently delivering substantial product features, making practical scope decisions, and iterating based on customer feedback. * Experience debugging and improving application performance across the frontend and backend. Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $127,800\.00 \- USD $339,000\.00 /Yr. These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role. This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. GitHub Leadership Principles: **GitHub values** * Customer\-obsessed * Ship to learn * Growth mindset * Own the outcome * Better together * Diverse and inclusive **Manager fundamentals** * Model * Coach * Care **Leadership principles** * Create clarity * Generate energy * Deliver success Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub. Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms. Join us, and let’s change the world, together. EEO Statement: GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

jobs.title: The Core Engineering, Associate, Software Engineering, SLC
jobs.description: The Core Engineering The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000\+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units: * Metrics \& Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions * The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics * Financials \& Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions * Non\-Financial Risk \& Controls: responsible for non\-financial risk and control processes * Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement * Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data communication skills, including experience presenting to both technical and business audiences in a global environment * An entrepreneurial approach and passion for problem\-solving and product architecture, Spring, and messaging queues (e.g., Kafka, SQS) * Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration * Experience with AWS cloud services * Familiarity with financial markets, financial assets, and liquidity management is a plus We Offer Best\-In\-Class Benefits Healthcare \& Medical Insurance We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance. Holiday \& Vacation Policies We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year. Financial Wellness \& Retirement We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities. Health Services We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices. jobs.description: About GoodLeap: GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best\-in\-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy\-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI\-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018\. GoodLeap is also proud to support our award\-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life\-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1\.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.### **Position Summary** GoodLeap's AI Transformation team partners with business units across the company to enable safe and effective AI adoption through tools, guidance, training, and custom solutions. As a Software Engineer on the team, you will build the AI solutions GoodLeap runs on: AI agents, Claude plugins and skills, evaluation frameworks, and integrations with enterprise systems such as Microsoft 365, Databricks, Okta, and Salesforce. This role is primarily focused on AI solutions work, with crossover into our Salesforce (SFDC) team — you should expect to periodically pick up Salesforce platform work (integrations, automation, AI features inside SFDC) as business priorities require. ### **Essential Job Duties \& Responsibilities** * Build \& Ship AI Solutions – Design, build, and maintain AI agents, Claude plugins/skills, evaluation harnesses, and integrations with enterprise systems (Microsoft 365/Graph, Databricks, Okta, SharePoint). Own solutions end\-to\-end from prototype through production support. * Business Unit Partnership – Work directly with business units in consult and co\-develop engagements: gather requirements, prototype quickly, train users, and hand off or maintain solutions. * Salesforce (SFDC) Crossover – Support the Salesforce team as needed: platform integrations, workflow automation, and AI capabilities within the SFDC ecosystem. * Quality \& Operations – Write tests and evals, participate in code review, document solutions, and support the tools the team owns. ### **Required Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python * Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or AI\-assisted development tooling (e.g., Claude, MCP, agentic workflows) * Strong API integration skills; comfort working across third\-party enterprise systems * Cloud experience (AWS or equivalent) * Exposure to the Salesforce ecosystem (Apex, Flows, SOQL, platform APIs) a plus — willingness to work in it required * Strong communication skills; able to work directly with non\-technical business partners * Bias to action; comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration Base pay range (CA, WA, NJ, MA, DC, NYC) per year: $116,700 \- $145,100 Base pay range (all other US locations) per year: $106,100 \- $131,900 **Please note:** **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** **Additional Information Regarding Job Duties and Job Descriptions:** Job duties include additional responsibilities as assigned by one's supervisor or other managers related to the position/department. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Quantum Control, Quantum AI
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience designing embedded software, firmware, or device drivers. * Experience developing kernel drivers for hardware devices (e.g., NICs, PCIe devices, or hardware accelerators). * Experience reading and interpreting hardware schematics, datasheets, and register maps. * Experience with C, Linux kernel internals (memory management, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization primitives), DMA engines, and cache coherency. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with embedded real\-time CPUs, real\-time Linux patches (PREEMPT\_RT), or bare\-metal development. * Experience with PCIe device drivers, enumeration, and bus controllers. * Experience with Yocto or Buildroot for creating custom Linux distributions. * Experience with hardware description languages (Verilog or VHDL) and FPGA constraints. * Experience with userspace I/O frameworks (e.g., DPDK, SPDK, or VFIO) for high\-performance applications. * Experience writing Linux subsystem drivers (e.g., V4L2, ALSA, or IIO). **About the job** ----------------- As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will develop low\-level software for electronics that control and readout our future quantum computers. You will collaborate with electrical engineers and FPGA/ASIC designers to bring custom hardware to life, ensuring drivers exploit full performance capabilities for scaled quantum processors. In this role, you will develop firmware and drivers delivered with Quantum's control and readout electronics. You will contribute to hardware\-software co\-verification, collaborating with architects and digital designers to understand functional requirements, design verification plans, and drive their execution. Additionally, you will participate in system architecture discussions and contribute to software system requirements. Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large\-scale computer capable of complex, error\-corrected computations. jobs.title: Senior Microsoft Security Entra Engineer- Remote (Anywhere in the U.S.)
jobs.description: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three\-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation's top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best\-fit solutions that mitigate risk. **General Description:** GuidePoint Security is seeking a Senior Microsoft Security (Entra) Engineer to join our Microsoft Cloud Security Team. This role is a deep identity specialization, you'll bring strong, hands\-on Microsoft Entra ID expertise across our client engagements, ranging from small businesses to large enterprises. You'll design, implement, and troubleshoot complex Entra environments, including how Entra integrates with other identity providers and with on\-premises Active Directory in hybrid scenarios. You'll partner with principal consultants, owning the identity workstream on an engagement, across varied industries and environments. You'll own your technical delivery independently (80% utilization target), managing your time and communication within assigned engagements, and contribute to internal practice and knowledge\-sharing efforts between projects. **About the Microsoft Cloud Security Practice:** Our Microsoft Cloud Security Practice is the central source of expertise for everything in the Microsoft security ecosystem. We serve both clients and internal teams with strategy, implementation, and ongoing optimization across the full stack: identity and access with Microsoft Entra ID, threat protection with Microsoft Defender XDR and Defender for Cloud, security operations with Microsoft Sentinel, data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview, endpoint management with Intune, and AI\-assisted defense with Security Copilot. For clients, we offer security assessments, Zero Trust roadmaps, solution deployment, migration and consolidation, and managed services that improve their security posture and get the most from their Microsoft licensing. For internal teams, we act as a trusted advisory and enablement hub, providing architecture guidance, pre\-sales and technical support, reusable frameworks, and training to help colleagues deliver secure, consistent, high\-quality outcomes. Our work combines deep technical certifications, close alignment with Microsoft, and hands\-on field experience to help organizations reduce risk, simplify operations, and adopt the cloud with confidence. **Roles and Responsibilities:** * Entra ID Architecture: Design and implement end\-to\-end Entra ID environments, including tenant architecture, dynamic groups, administrative units, and identity lifecycle management at scale. * Access Control \& Governance: Design and implement Conditional Access (including advanced scenarios like Global Secure Access, token protection, and authentication strengths), MFA/passwordless, PIM, RBAC, access reviews, and entitlement management. * Hybrid Identity: Own hybrid identity design and troubleshooting, including Entra Connect / Cloud Sync, Entra Connect Health, password Hash Sync vs. pass\-through auth vs. federation (ADFS), and Entra Domain Services. * Identity Federation \& Integration: Design and support identity federation and integration between Entra ID and other identity providers (Okta, Ping Identity, ADFS, third\-party SAML/OIDC IdPs), including migration scenarios moving customers onto Entra. * Application Integration: Integrate applications via SSO (SAML/OIDC), enterprise app registrations, SCIM provisioning, and application proxy/Global Secure Access for on\-prem app publishing. Advanced understanding of SAML and OIDC tokens, custom claims, and troubleshooting SAML and OIDC\-based authentication. * External Identities: Design and implement Entra External ID (B2B/B2C) for partner and customer\-facing identity scenarios. * Workload Identities: Design and implement identity solutions for Workload Identities such as Managed Identities and Workload Identity Federation. * Risk \& Investigation: Investigate and remediate identity risks using Entra ID Protection, sign\-in and audit logs, and Entra recommendations; drive hybrid identity hygiene (stale object cleanup, privileged account reduction, tiered admin models). * Adjacent Microsoft Security: Maintain deep knowledge of how Entra ID intersects with Azure, Microsoft Purview, Intune, and Defender XDR, and support those workstreams as engagements require. * Other duties as assigned. * Adhere to GuidePoint Security Core Values. **Required Experience and Education:** * 7\+ years of hands\-on, production experience OR Bachelor's Degree and 3\+ years of hands\-on, production experience specifically in Microsoft Entra ID, in addition to broader IT administration, identity management, or security operations experience. * Deep working knowledge of Conditional Access, MFA/pass  entitlement management. * Strong hands\-on experience with hybrid identity: Entra Connect/Cloud Sync, on\-premises Active Directory, and the tradeoffs between password hash sync, pass\-through authentication, and federation. * Knowledge of core authentication and provisioning protocols: SAML, OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, Kerberos, LDAP, and SCIM. * Experience integrating or migrating identity with other IdPs (Okta, Ping, ADFS, or similar) alongside or into Entra ID. * Comfortable troubleshooting complex, real\-world identity issues independently, including sign\-in failures, sync errors, and token/claims issues. * Basic to intermediate PowerShell scripting for automation and reporting (e.g., Microsoft Graph PowerShell). * Experience embracing emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes. * Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication; this role frequently leads to client\-facing identity conversations. **Preferred Experience and Education:** * Entra External ID (B2B/B2C) design and implementation. * Advanced on\-premises AD work: multi\-domain/forest design, migrations, tiered administration, legacy auth cleanup. * Microsoft Purview (sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, or eDiscovery), Intune, or Defender XDR experience. * Microsoft Sentinel or broader SIEM/SOAR experience. * Relevant certifications such as SC\-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), SC\-500, MS\-102 * Azure infrastructure and security (Azure Policy, network security, landing zones, RBAC). **Travel Requirements:** * Typical travel is limited to company events and should be less than 5%. **Physical Requirements:** * Sedentary work. * Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day. * Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day. **We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.** **Why GuidePoint?** GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately\-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers. You will write code every day, set the technical direction for your team, and put working agents in people's hands. You lead by building, not by managing tickets or running status meetings. Success is measured by what is live and in use, not by plans and presentations. **What you'll do:** * Lead from the keyboard\- Work on a project team with two other engineers, write production code every day, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself. * Ship workflows that get used\- Lead your team in turning real engineering and operations workflows into production agents on our platform, from first conversation to daily use. * Own requirements and roadmap\- Work with business stakeholders and the people who do the work to define requirements, cut scope and keep a roadmap focused on what delivers the most value. * Set and review architecture\- Define the architecture for your team's agents, review designs and code, and hold a high bar for reliability, security and maintainability. * Connect agents to the business\- Use secure tool and data connectors (including MCP servers) to give agents governed access to Halliburton data and engineering applications. * Prove it works\- Use the platform's evaluation and tracing to show each agent is reliable, then track adoption and time saved in production. * Keep agents on track\- Build optimization routines and monitoring that catch drift, regressions and failures early, so agents keep operating as designed long after launch. * Raise the team's speed\- Make AI\-first development the norm on your team, using coding agents, shared templates and code reviews to help every engineer ship faster. * Own what you ship\- Fix what breaks and keep improving your team's agents based on real use. * Add to the platform\- When you hit a gap, contribute the template, connector or evaluation that closes it, so the next workflow ships faster. **Who you are:** * AI\-first by default\- You reach for an agent before you open a ticket. Your own workflow is already heavily automated, and you can show us how. * A builder with high agency\- You don't wait for a perfect spec. You get the smallest useful version live fast, then harden and expand it. * A leader who builds\- You earn trust through your code and decisions, not status meetings. * Allergic to repeated work\- When you see the same task done twice, you build a tool so nobody has to do it a third time. * Comfortable in the mess\- Legacy systems, messy data and shifting requirements don't slow you down. * Results over demos\- A demo is not the finish line. You measure success by evaluation results, adoption and demonstrated time savings for the business. * Fluent in business and code\- You turn business needs into a roadmap, then build it with your team. **What you'll need:** * Must have 6\+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated work. * Degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * Experience leading the technical work of a small engineering team (setting architecture, reviewing code and mentoring) while remaining a hands\-on contributor. * Track record of working directly with business stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into clear requirements and a delivery roadmap. * Strong Python, and comfort working across the stack (APIs, services, simple internal user interfaces). * Shipped LLM\-powered agents to real users, ideally multi\-agent systems rather than single prompt chains: tool calling, RAG, structured outputs, and prompt and context engineering. * Hands\-on experience with agent frameworks and protocols (for example LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Model Context Protocol) — and the judgment to know when not to use one. * Experience testing non\-deterministic systems: building eval sets, automated scoring and regression checks. * Solid engineering fundamentals: Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers and cloud deployment. * Hands\-on Azure experience, such as Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Kubernetes Service or Container Apps, and Entra ID. **Nice to have:** * Databricks\- Mosaic AI Agent Framework / Agent Bricks, MLflow tracing and evaluation, Unity Catalog, Model Serving, Vector Search. * Developer tooling\- You have contributed to SDKs, internal platforms or shared libraries that other engineers use. * Total ownership\- You treat what you build as your own. You take it from idea to production and stay accountable for the outcome, not just your piece of it. * Open source\- Contributions to AI or developer tooling projects. * Energy or industrial exposure\- Helpful, not required. We will teach you the domain; we can't teach you to build. **What success looks like:** * First 30 days\- You know the platform and your team, and have agreed on the team's first workflow, its success measure and an initial roadmap with business stakeholders. * First 90 days\- Your team's first workflow is shipped and in regular use by the people it was built for, with a measured result such as hours saved. You wrote a meaningful share of the code. * First 6 months\- Your team has several workflows live and in daily use, stakeholders trust the roadmap, and the architecture and review standards you set help the team ship faster. **World Class Benefits:** At Halliburton, we're committed to providing you and your family with a comprehensive and affordable benefits package \- which means we offer support for your physical, emotional, financial and parental needs, both now and in the future. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.** **Location** Houston, Onsite **Job Details** **Requisition Number:** 213139 **Experience Level:** **Job Family:** Engineering/Science/Technology **Product Service Line:** Global R\&D **Full Time / Part Time:** Full\-time **Compensation Information** Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. *Please Note: This posting is intended to collect candidate information for Halliburton’s talent pool, and is not considered an application. jobs.description: Company Summary: Hampton Lumber is a thriving family\-owned company aspiring to be North America's preferred source for responsibly\-sourced wood solutions. Headquartered in Portland, Oregon, we operate ten sawmills across Oregon, Washington, South Carolina, and British Columbia. We also manage timberland and operate a wholesale and import/export division. Our mission is to grow, manufacture, and market renewable wood products and deliver innovative solutions for a more sustainable built environment. At Hampton Lumber, we accomplish this through our own operations as well as those of our affiliates—Trapa Forest Products, Idaho Timber, and RedBuilt. Our motto, "Find a better way every day," encapsulates our commitment to innovation and improvement across all operations. We are guided by our core values: * **Safety** – Prioritize safety across all operations. * **Integrity \& Authenticity** – Operate honestly and ethically while preserving our distinctive family\-owned brand. * **Responsible Stewardship** – Endeavor to balance and maintain economic, social, and environmental values in everything we do. * **Tenacity** – Embrace challenges with grit, determination, and a can\-do spirit. * **Continuous Improvement** – Strive to enhance our processes, products, and people. * **Customer Satisfaction** – Be nimble, responsive, and solutions\-oriented. * **Community Engagement** – Be a responsive, supportive, and respected member of the community. With over 80 years in the sawmill business, we are proud to have cultivated the knowledge and experience needed to grow and prosper, even in challenging times. We always look to the future and invest in our people, new technologies, and continuous improvement processes and techniques. Overview: Hampton Lumber is a family\-owned company that has been manufacturing lumber since 1942, and we are investing in the future. Our new, state\-of\-the\-art sawmill near Fairfax, South Carolina is now starting up, and nearly every piece of equipment in it is connected, from scanners and optimizers to cameras, kilns, and the business systems that run the operation. As our IT Infrastructure Engineer, you will be Hampton IT’s onsite technology partner at the mill and a full member of our corporate Infrastructure team. You will work with modern technology, have real ownership from day one, and see the direct impact of your work on a brand\-new operation. Hampton IT is an exciting place to be right now. Technology is moving faster than ever, and we are leaning in, putting data, automation, and AI to work wherever they create real value for the business. We are helping a company with more than 80 years of history run like a modern one, and unlike most IT jobs, you can walk out onto the mill floor and watch your work run. If you are naturally curious and love figuring out how things work, there is no better place to do it. We are looking for a strong IT generalist with a solid networking foundation. You will have an experienced IT team behind you, so you do not need to know everything. Empathy, clear communication, and the ability to explain the why behind IT standards matter as much as technical skill. Be Part of the Infrastructure Team* Share ownership of enterprise platforms (identity, Microsoft 365, endpoint, server, backup, and network) and take on assigned enterprise projects. * Document the site so the broader team can support it, and keep corporate IT informed about what is happening on site. Benefits Highlights: * Substantial company\-paid assistance for Medical and Dental insurance premiums; mental health coverage; cost effective co\-pays and deductibles * 401(k) with 5% annual company contribution and generous company matching contributions vested over three years * Paid time off, including nine paid holidays * Participation in the employee bonus program * Employee wellness program that includes free counseling sessions, financial and legal guidance, and more * Opportunities for paid training to support career advancement and personal development Responsibilities: **Own IT at the Mill*** Own the health and reliability of the site’s IT infrastructure: switching, wireless, firewalls, internet connectivity, onsite servers and edge compute, and network rooms. * Monitor, patch, and maintain site systems to Hampton standards, and keep site documentation current. * Handle hands\-on work such as cabling, rack installs, and device replacements for the broader Infrastructure team. **Support the Production Network*** Provide hands\-on build and support for the mill’s production (OT) network, working with the Electrical \& Controls Engineering team and the onsite PLC Superintendent. * Help support connected equipment such as optimizers, scanners, HMIs, and cameras, and the links between production and business networks. * Help maintain IT/OT segmentation and secure vendor remote access, and coordinate with equipment vendors and integrators. **Partner with the Mill and Represent IT*** Build tru isibility, and efficiency, and help turn them into supported solutions. **Own the Outcome for Every Site Issue*** Be the first call for anything technical at the mill. You won’t personally fix every printer, but you will make sure it gets fixed, staying engaged until the user is taken care of. * Keep site leadership and affected users informed during outages and production\-impacting incidents. * Experience with Fortinet, Cisco, or Meraki; OSPF and multicast; Microsoft Intune; and PowerShell. * Certifications such as CompTIA Network\+, CCNA, or Microsoft certifications. **What Success Looks Like*** Mill leadership and frontline teams see you as a trusted member of the mill team. * Site stakeholders bring IT in early on projects, equipment changes, and planned downtime. * The mill understands the reasons behind IT standards, and approved solutions replace workarounds. * Every site issue has an owner, and people feel taken care of regardless of who resolves it. * The mill can point to technology improvements that made a measurable difference, such as fewer delays, better visibility, or less manual effort Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, military, and industry experience. * 5\+ years in systems administration, network administration, or a similar IT generalist role * Strong networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs and trunking, routing, DHCP, DNS, wireless, and firewalls. * Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting managed switches, firewalls, and fiber connectivity. * Hands\-on experience with Windows Server and Windows clients, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365\. * Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical topics to non\-technical audiences. * Comfort working independently and taking initiative, and willingness to learn industrial networks alongside controls engineers and electricians. * Ability to work safely on an industrial plant floor with required PPE, participate in on\-call, and travel; valid driver’s license. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or other operations\-focused environments, or as the primary IT resource at a remote site. * Experience supporting industrial (OT) networks and systems alongside controls engineers and PLC technicians; familiarity with Rockwell FactoryTalk systems and EtherNet/IP. * Understanding of IT/OT security concepts such as the Purdue model, ISA/IEC 62443, industrial DMZs, and secure vendor remote access. * This is a hybrid role. Working onsite at the mill 2–3 days per week is required, with the remaining days worked remotely More About Us: The timber and wood products industry is a vital part of many communities, and we’re excited to bring new opportunities to Allendale County, South Carolina. We are committed to supporting the local workforce, investing in training and development, and being active members of the communities where we operate. Many of our employees have built long, rewarding careers with us, and we look forward to welcoming new team members to our family. jobs.title: Senior Ai Engineer
jobs.description: Senior AI Software Engineer About Us Health Data Analytics Institute (HDAI) is a commercial\-stage HealthTech company. Our Intelligent Health Management System, HealthVision™, is a first\-in\-class enterprise solution leveraging real\-time predictive analytics and generative AI to deliver improved outcomes, efficiencies, and economics for health systems and value\-based care organizations. HDAI is located in Dedham, MA near the Dedham Corporate Center Commuter Rail station on the Franklin/Foxboro line (25 minutes from Back Bay and South Station, Boston) and I\-95/128\. Summary We are hiring a Senior AI Software Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Data Science and production software by owning our full AI/ML backend. This includes a high\-throughput predictive inference engine (scoring 580\+ patient risk models in real time) and generative LLM pipelines on Amazon Bedrock (powering clinical summaries and diagnostic discovery). You will work across the entire backend stack as priorities shift, developing deep domain expertise while ensuring complete system coverage. We expect you to use AI tools daily to multiply your output. Responsibilities * **Inference engine.** Own the system that scores patients against hundreds of predictive models in production. Understand the scaling concerns (580\+ models, memory pressure, compute efficiency) and drive architectural improvements. * **ML productization.** Work with Data Science to take model artifacts (coefficient files, scoring logic built in R) and ensure they run correctly in the production Python inference pipeline. Understand the underlying model logic and statistical outputs well enough to validate data and parity between the R development environment and production output. Build tooling that automates validation and reduces the manual reimplementation cycle. * **LLM applications.** Build and maintain production LLM integrations on Amazon Bedrock (Claude) for AI summaries, PDD, and conversational interfaces. Manage prompt lifecycle: design, versioning, testing, and evaluation. Handle the specific challenges of LLM applications in production: token management, output validation, evidence citation, structured output parsing, and graceful degradation. * **Production AI engineering.** Build and maintain production Python services on AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3\). Work across the existing stack including FastAPI and legacy services during migration to serverless. * **Evaluation and quality.** Build testing and evaluation frameworks for both model inference and LLM outputs. Define what “correct” means for AI\-generated clinical content in collaboration with Clinical and Data Science teams. Write tests for critical paths. Monitor production output quality and catch regressions. * **Cross\-functional collaboration.** Partner with Data Science on model release planning, validation, and new prompt development. Work with Platform Engineering on deployment infrastructure. Collaborate across the full Product Engineering team on features that span frontend and backend. Qualifications **Required:** * 7\+ years of experience as a software engineer, ML engineer, or AI engineer building production systems. * Strong Python proficiency for production service development. * Experience building and operating services on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, S3\) or equivalent cloud platforms. * Experience in at least one of these areas, with willingness to grow into the other: ***ML engineering:*** taking model artifacts from data science and deploying them to production. You understand model scoring, feature engineering, and what it takes to validate that a production implementation matches the original model. ***LLM engineering:*** building production LLM applications (not just prototypes). You have worked with model APIs (Bedrock, OpenAI, or similar), designed prompt architectures, and handled the failure modes of generative AI in production. * AI\-native engineering practice. You use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow. * Comfort with ambiguity. Requirements evolve as we scale to new health system partners; you make sound decisions with incomplete information. * Clear written and verbal communication. **Preferred:** * Experience across both ML engineering and LLM engineering (see above). * Experience with Amazon Bedrock or similar managed LLM services. * Experience with R or familiarity reading R code (our data science team works in R). * Experience with model serving at scale (hundreds of models, multi\-tenant environments). * Healthcare or regulated industry experience. * Experience building evaluation/testing frameworks for AI system outputs. * Experience with FastAPI, event\-driven architectures (SQS, SNS), or serverless patterns. * Familiarity with Terraform and infrastructure\-as\-code. Equal Opportunity HDAI is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Pay: $160,367\.00 \- $185,457\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dedham, MA 02026

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Primary Work Address: 19700 Helix Drive, Ashburn, VA, 20147 The Howard Hughes Medical Institute’s Janelia Research Campus is a pioneering research center in Ashburn, Virginia, where scientists pursue fundamental questions in the life sciences. Our integrated teams of biologists, computational scientists, and tool\-builders innovate research practices and technologies to solve biology’s deepest mysteries. HHMI launched Janelia in 2006, establishing an intellectually enriching environment for scientists to do creative, collaborative, hands\-on work. We share our methods, results, and tools with the scientific community. **About the project** AI@HHMI is HHMI’s $500 million, 10\-year investment in AI\-driven science, embedding AI systems throughout every stage of research in labs across HHMI. HHMI is also partnering with frontier AI labs on scientific applications of AI (learn more). At the heart of AI@HHMI is the Foundational Microscopy Image Analysis (MIA) project. Our goal is to build one of the world’s most comprehensive multimodal 3D/4D microscopy datasets, and use it to power a vision foundation model that accelerates discovery across the life sciences. Our current focus is reconstructing connectomes at scale from expansion microscopy (ExM) data generated by High\-Throughput Connectomics, a sister AI@HHMI project. **About the role** You will develop and deploy production\-ready pipelines for segmenting and proofreading connectomes from expansion microscopy imaging across fly, zebrafish, and *Danionella*. You will scale reconstruction from individual datasets to hundreds or thousands of connectomes, working with large\-scale volumetric data on a compute cluster with around 800 GPUs. This role combines deep understanding of the underlying models with hands\-on engineering and careful attention to reconstruction quality. You will work closely with microscopists, cell biologists, neuroscientists, and computer scientists so that models hold up on large, real\-world data. Your home is Scientific Computing, a department of about 35 AI, data, and software engineers, where you will report to department leadership. Your day\-to\-day work is directed by the AI Scientist who leads the MIA AI@HHMI project, a team of seven scientists and engineers. This is primarily an individual\-contributor role, with potential opportunities to mentor junior engineers. **What you will actually do** * **Reconstruct connectomes at scale** using our pre\-trained segmentation models. * **Train and fine\-tune models** as new ground\-truth data becomes available. * **Evaluate rigorously.** Design and run rigorous model evaluations to measure and improve reconstruction quality. * **Optimize inference pipelines.** Increase reconstruction throughput on GPU clusters. * **Build proofreading workflows.** Build and support proofreading workflows (for example, integration with CAVE). * **Coordinate annotation.** Coordinate manual annotation and proofreading efforts to improve training and evaluation data. * **Release your work.** Release pipelines, models, and reconstructions to the broader scientific community, with a focus on reproducibility and downstream usability. * **Collaborate across disciplines.** Advise stakeholders on data strategy and best practices, and potentially mentor junior engineers. **What success looks like in your first year** * You’ve taken ownership of the production reconstruction pipeline and run it end\-to\-end on new ExM datasets. * You’ve measurably improved throughput or reconstruction accuracy against an agreed benchmark. * You’ve delivered high\-quality connectome segmentations that need minimal manual proofreading. **What we are looking for** * **Production over prototype.** You have trained and evaluated deep learning models (Transformers, U\-Nets) for three or more years, ideally on 3D image data. You have also deployed them, with workflow orchestration and high\-throughput processing on GPU clusters, using tools such as Kubernetes, Nextflow, or LSF. * **First\-principles thinking.** When a result moves, you can explain why. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake & Informatica
jobs.description: Job Description The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line\-of\-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists. In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS / COdata) an OIT Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor. The OIT Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge\-transfer progression (shadowing, co\-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer.**Scope of Responsibilities** * Data Ingestion \& Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model. * Transformation \& Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect. * Record Linkage \& Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross\-agency reconciliations. * Production Pipeline Operations \& Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects. * Data Quality \& Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de\-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout\-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes). * Performance Optimization \& Platform Stewardship: Optimize query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance for cost and latency; identify and tune heavily used models and performance hot spots in Snowflake. * Quality Assurance, Code Review \& Promotion: Adhere to the unified release process across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans; author and execute test cases, conduct peer code reviews, and maintain release change logs. **Activities Performed****A. Ingestion \& Pipeline Development (OIT\-Led Feeds)****CDHE Courses Data Ingestion:** * Ingest and validate annual postsecondary course\-level data files from CDHE per data sharing agreements. * Build ETL mapping processes from CDHE course files into the SLDS common data model based on design specifications provided by 3rd party implementation partner. * Pair with 3 party implementation team during ETL construction, validation, and promotion. **Postsecondary SES \& Disability Data Ingestion (Conditional):** * Ingest and validate demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability classification codes from postsecondary sources. * Apply mandated privacy protections, cell suppression rules, and permissible\-use governance requirements. **PSAT/SAT Assessment Data Ingestion (Conditional):** * Ingest, validate, and map section/composite assessment scores and grade levels from the College Board or CDE. * Execute identity matching to connect assessment records to existing longitudinal student profiles. **B. Knowledge Transfer \& Operational Transition (Jan–April 2027\)****Shadowing \& Co\-running (Jan–Feb 2027\):** * Shadow 3rd party implementation partner engineers on day\-to\-day operations of existing data feeds (e.g., NSC, K\-3, CDEC, and Phase 1 feeds). * Co\-run live feed cycles, handle data loading, execute record matching, and troubleshoot exceptions alongside 3rd party implementation partner. **Readiness Gate Execution (Target: March 2027\):** * Run two consecutive feed cycles completely unaided to achieve formal operational hand\-over sign\-off. **Full Production Operations (March 2027 Onward):** * Execute recurring feed schedules, rebuild downstream objects, reconcile row counts against source files, and triage failed jobs. * Address ad\-hoc data inquiries and export requests from OIT leadership and partner agencies. **C. Data Stabilization \& Analytics Layer Upkeep** * Stabilization Backlog Support: Resolve identified data reliability defects, run variations, and de\-duplication issues transitioned from the Phase 1 stabilization backlog. * Analytics Layer Hardening \& Maintenance (April 2027 Onward): * Apply object mode longitudinal reporting use cases . * De\-Identified Data Extraction Scripts: Data extraction scripts that generate de\-identified, suppressed outcome files for participating IHEs per specification. **Documentation \& Engineering Specifications** * ETL Pipeline Design Documents: Technical architecture and transformation specifications detailing source\-to\-target logic, schemas, and dependencies. * Mapping \& Transformation Specifications: Contribution to enterprise data mapping documents aligning source fields to the SLDS common data model. * Lineage Documentation \& Dependency Maps: As\-built data lineage records and dependency diagrams detailing object\-level upstream and downstream flows. * Operational Runbooks \& Incident Procedures: Standard operating procedures for running feed cycles, handling late or malformed files, performing failover, and reconciling row counts. **Governance, Testing \& Operational Reporting** * Azure Test Plans \& Execution Records: Fully documented test plans, test suites, manual test run results, and defect logs for all pipeline modifications prior to production promotion . * Release Change Logs: Detailed audit entries for all OIT\-led production releases, detailing changes, rationales, linked Azure DevOps work items, test results, and deployment timestamps]. * Feed Operation Run Logs \& Match Summaries: Run completion records, reconciliation totals, exception logs, and data\-quality summaries produced for agency loads. **Required Qualifications \& Technical Experience** * Snowflake ETL/ELT: Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience building, orchestrating, and optimizing complex ETL/ELT data pipelines and transformation logic natively within the Snowflake platform. * Informatica CDGC: Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience working with Informatica Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC) for metadata management, data profiling, cataloging, and automated data quality validation. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing Terraform to provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure and resources. * CI/CD \& DevOps: Demonstrated proficiency implementing automated build, test, and release deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps. * Version Control: Expert proficiency with Git / version control workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, automated merge checks, code reviews). * Location Constraint: Must currently reside within the State of Colorado jobs.title: Sr. AI Software Engineer (Remote)
