You are a consultant at the edge of our internal teams, helping to identify AI opportunities, define requirements, build prototypes, and ship governed, measurable AI agents into production. The primary duties include finding and scoping AI\-suited business problems; building and shipping production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms; baselining processes and measuring and reporting ROI before and after deployment; applying AI governance and compliance controls to every build; and converting repeat work into reusable patterns while raising AI fluency across the business teams this role supports. You bring information back to the CoE and deliver value to our business partners. If you love finding new challenges, showing people new was to solve problems, and to build and tinker while delivering critical business value continuously, this role is a perfect fit. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Embed within business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering to identify work that is repetitive, automatable, or bottlenecked. * Translate and communicate a business need into a written solution statement, success criteria, data requirements, and a documented recommendation on whether AI is the appropriate solution. * Build working prototypes to validate feasibility before committing to a full build. * Scope each opportunity appropriately, determining whether the right solution is a single\-purpose agent, an automated workflow, a multi\-tier agent system, or an existing approved vendor capability. * Build production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms, including assistant and agent frameworks, low\-code workflow automation, document intelligence, conversational and agent\-assist capabilities, and natural language analytics. * Design multi\-tier agent systems where an orchestration layer routes to specialized agents with scoped tools, defined boundaries, and a clean handoff to a human. * Integrate with business systems through approved connectors and MCP servers and support the approval process for new connectors when a use case requires one. * Hand off completed builds with documentation, a runbook, a named owner, and a business user able to operate the solution independently. * Baseline process performance prior to each build, capturing cycle time, volume, error and rework rates, handle time, and cost per unit as applicable. * Instrument deployed agents so that value is measured continuously rather than asserted once at launch. * Report outcomes honestly, including builds that did not deliver value and the resulting lessons learned. * Apply an ISO/IEC 42001 governance mindset to every build, including defined purpose, risk classification, data handling, human oversight, and evidence that controls operated as intended. * Define and implement governance, security, and compliance telemetry for each agent, covering tool calls, scope adherence, escalation and override rates, data access, output quality, and cost. * Build monitoring and alerting so drift, boundary violations, and unexpected spend are surfaced to an owner. * Operate within the AI Governance Committee process and the AI Acceptable Use Policy. * Report business team needs, governance friction points, recurring patterns, and tooling gaps back to the AI Center of Excellence. * Convert repeat builds into reusable patterns, templates, and starter kits for use by other consultants and delivery teams. * Run enablement sessions and working labs to raise AI fluency within the business teams this role supports. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science * AI Continuous learning certifications are a plus * 3\-6 six years of software engineering experience shipping and supporting production systems. * 2 \+years of hands\-on experience building AI solutions across assistants, agents, workflow automation, retrieval, and document processing. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership, taking a business idea from initial concept through requirements, prototype, and production use. * Ability to define and measure business value, including constructing a baseline, defending a measurement method, and communicating cost and benefit independently. * Working knowledge of at least one AI governance or management framework, such as ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF, and the ability to convert it into implemented controls. * Experience instrumenting telemetry as part of the build process rather than after an incident. * Ability to work effectively within unfamiliar business functions, build credibility quickly, and influence stakeholders while building relationships. * Ability to learn and adapt to a changing AI platform and tooling landscape. * Financial services, healthcare, benefits administration, or other regulated industry experience preferred, particularly environments handling PII, PHI, or fiduciary data. * Process improvement experience preferred, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or process mining. * Fluency in low\-code automation platforms alongside code\-first development preferred. * Experience with contact center, claims, or back\-office operations technology preferred. * Experience developing internal enablement materials, documentation, or practitioner communities preferred. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know growth comes from people who are willing to learn and challenge themselves, not just check every box. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The Sales Tech team is part of Intuit's Data, Growth, \& Experiences (DGX) organization, building the platform and intelligence that powers how Intuit's sellers connect with customers across the full lead\-to\-cash journey. We build agents that make every seller smarter and, increasingly, agents that do the selling: agents designed around entire sales personas that take on their most important jobs\-to\-be\-done, from account research and pipeline prioritization to outreach and deal execution, with sellers in the loop where it matters. They run on a governed data foundation, well\-defined platform services and APIs, and deep Salesforce interoperability. We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to own the design and delivery of these agents and the lead\-to\-cash services behind them. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for an engineer who treats Salesforce as a developer platform and builds production agentic systems. You will own big bets end to end, working directly with sellers, Sales Ops, and Marketing to turn their pain points into agents and experiences that change how Intuit sells. Intuit has embraced a hybrid working model and this role will be based out of our Mountain View office 3 days per week. **Responsibilities** **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, and ship agents that handle the key jobs\-to\-be\-done of sales personas end to end, from account research and prioritization through outreach, deal execution, and follow\-through, with clear handoffs to sellers. * Build agentic experiences that make sellers smarter: surface the right insight, recommendation, or next best action in the flow of work, and take action on the seller's behalf where it is safe to do so. * Architect multi\-step and multi\-agent systems, including orchestration, tool use, memory and context management, and Salesforce MCP integrations and Claude\-based workflows, built to run reliably in production. * Define how we evaluate and trust agents: evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and measurement against seller productivity and revenue outcomes. * Design, build, and operate the core lead\-to\-cash services and real\-time and batch data pipelines that agents depend on, built on Salesforce. * Stay deeply hands\-on, contributing roughly 70 to 80 percent to development across the software lifecycle, with the remaining time on design, technical alignment, and raising engineering quality. * Own complex, ambiguous problems within the lead\-to\-cash domain end to end, and drive cross\-team dependencies to resolution in partnership with Senior Staff and Principal engineers. * Partner closely with sellers, Sales Ops, Marketing, PMs, and downstream data teams to understand how each persona works today and translate their pain points into scoped, high\-impact agents and deliveries. * Build revenue\-critical systems with the correctness, auditability, and reliability bar they demand: idempotent processing, reconciliation, and clear failure handling. * Write clear design documents, communicate trade\-offs to engineers and cross\-functional partners, and mentor senior and mid\-level engineers on building agentic systems through code and design reviews. * Stay current with the fast\-moving AI and agent landscape and proactively identify new opportunities to apply agents within the sales domain. **Qualifications** **Qualifications** ------------------ * 8\+ years of relevant experience building web, software, or data\-intensive applications, with a track record of leading significant technical workstreams at the senior level or above. * Hands\-on experience designing and shipping agentic or LLM\-based systems in production (agent design, tool use, orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluation frameworks), with the ability to describe the problem solved, how results were evaluated, and why an agent was the right tool. * Hands\-on experience developing on Salesforce or a comparable CRM as a developer platform (APIs, integrations, extensibility), and an understanding of the sales process, sales personas, and the customer journey from lead to cash. * Strong proficiency in at least one object\-oriented language (Java/J2EE or C\#) and experience with React; sound design judgment across distributed systems. * Ability to influence technical decisions within and across teams, and to communicate trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $202,500 \- $274,000

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Remote in USA – Regular Full\-Time** **The Role** We are seeking a Cloud Engineer with hands\-on Microsoft 365 and Azure experience to deploy and configure secure solutions for mid\-market and enterprise customers. This role is 100% remote and requires availability during US time\-zone work hours and the ability to work in English. **Key Activities** * Implement Microsoft Entra configurations, including Conditional Access, PIM, hybrid identity, and agent identity controls through Agent 365\. * Deploy and configure Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Purview policies, including device compliance, endpoint security, sensitivity labels, and DLP. * Configure data access and permissions to support secure Copilot and AI agent rollouts. * Build and maintain Azure infrastructure across networking, compute, storage, backup, and monitoring. * Execute migrations across Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Azure workloads. * Test and validate deployments, troubleshoot issues, and resolve escalations during projects. * Produce as\-built documentation, runbooks, and handoff materials, and provide status updates to project leads. **Key Qualities** * Ownership of delivery quality and attention to detail. * Clear communication with customers and internal teams. * Methodical approach to troubleshooting and problem\-solving. **Required Experience \& Skills** * 3\+ years implementing Microsoft cloud solutions in consulting, MSP, or enterprise IT environments. * Hands\-on expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Purview, including hybrid environments. * Experience deploying and supporting Azure infrastructure. * Working knowledge of Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams, plus migration experience. * Proficiency with PowerShell and scripting for automation and repeatable deployments. **Desired Qualifications** * Microsoft certifications in Azure, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, identity, or security. * Experience with Copilot or Agent 365 deployments. * Experience delivering Microsoft\-funded or time\-boxed engagements. * Success Criteria * Reliable, well\-documented deployments; on\-time, on\-budget delivery; high customer satisfaction; and achievement of utilization targets. **Compensation** At Inviso, we believe great talent should be rewarded with competitive pay, meaningful benefits, and room to grow. The salary for this role ranges from $70,000\-130,000 annually, reflecting the cost of labor across multiple US geographic markets. Beyond base pay, we offer a strong benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, annual training reimbursement, paid time off, paid holidays, and additional perks designed to support your well\-being and long\-term success. **Why You’ll Love Working at Inviso:** * **Do work that matters.** We are a global technology and business consulting firm that helps organizations implement AI, modern data platforms, and digital marketing strategies. * **Work somewhere people choose to stay.** Our low attrition, strong average tenure, and employees who have spent 10, 15, or even 20 years with Inviso speak volumes about our culture and how we care for our people. * **Bring your ideas and be heard**. You will join a collaborative, people\-first environment where ideas matter, contributions are recognized, and excellent work creates real opportunities for growth. * **Keep learning and growing**. Inviso invests in employees through continuous learning, mentorship, collaboration, and career development across a diverse global organization. * **Join a company with deep industry credibility.** Inviso has worked closely with Microsoft for more than 20 years and is proud to be a top\-rated supplier and Managed Partner with numerous credentials.

jobs.title: MECM Administrator and Engineer
jobs.description: Grow, innovate, and generate progress: Harness your expertise to solve challenges and celebrate success! **Job Summary** JCS Solutions is looking for an experienced **MECM Administrator and Engineer** to join the Defense Enclave Services (DES) program. You'll support a large migration program for DISA and the DoD Fourth Estate Agencies, moving endpoints from each agency's own network enclave to a common provider. As the senior MECM and operating system deployment (OSD) engineer on the team, you'll check whether each agency's Configuration Manager environment is healthy and ready for migration. You'll build and troubleshoot the task sequences that prepare devices and reimage Windows, and you'll support provisioning that joins devices to Microsoft Entra and enrolls them in Intune. You'll also provide Tier III support until deployments are stable. Your work affects how quickly and reliably DoD users move to the new environment. **Location:** Fort Meade, MD **Clearance:** Secret **Certification:** Active DoD 8140/8570 IAT Level II certification **What’s in it for you:*** Join a premier technology firm specializing in innovative solutions. * Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative work culture. * Enjoy tremendous growth potential in a high\-performing team environment. * A robust benefits package: + Health, dental, and vision insurance + Life insurance + Short\-and\-long term disability + Paid time off (PTO) + 401k retirement plan with employer match + Annual Professional Development Reimbursement Program + And more! **What you will do:*** Check the health and deployment readiness of each agency's existing Microsoft Configuration Manager environment. * Document readiness findings, migration blockers, who owns each fix, and retest evidence. * Before rollout, confirm that clients are healthy and can reach management points, that distribution points have the right content, that boundaries work as expected, and that task\-sequence dependencies are in place. * Build, test, deploy, and troubleshoot approved task sequences for migration preparation and Windows reimaging. * Add approved PowerShell steps that include prerequisite checks, safe error handling, coordinated reboots, and saved diagnostic evidence. * Before any destructive step, confirm that the required data protection and recovery arrangements are in place, following the approved deployment process. * Coordinate pilots, deployment targeting, rollout controls, and approved fixes with each agency's infrastructure owners and the migration team. * Support the approved provisioning\-package process for Microsoft Entra join and Intune enrollment, and pinpoint whether a failure happened at the Windows, Entra identity, or Intune enrollment stage. * Capture separate evidence that the old environment's steps finished and that the device enrolled in the new environment. Coordinate checks of required policies, applications, and the final management state. * Track deployment results, investigate recurring failures, and provide Tier III support until deployments are stable. **What you will bring:*** 7\+ years of hands\-on experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) in enterprise Windows environments. * 12\+ years of hands\-on experience administering endpoints. * Managerial or leadership experience (required by the LCAT). * Proven ability to assess site and component health, operational problems, and readiness for enterprise operating system deployment (OSD). * Strong understanding of management points, distribution points, boundary groups, content validation, and the SQL Server, DNS, certificate, and network services they depend on. * Experience using diagnostic evidence to assess client health, site assignment, policy retrieval, WMI, service status, content downloads, and communication failures. * Extensive experience building, changing, running, and troubleshooting OSD task sequences for Windows reimaging and endpoint provisioning. * Ability to confirm which versions of Configuration Manager, the Windows ADK, Windows PE, and the target Windows release work together, including boot\-image and driver compatibility. * Experience troubleshooting boot images, PXE where used, storage and network drivers, disk partitioning, and deployment\-related connectivity. * Strong PowerShell skills for discovery, migration preparation, validation, automated remediation, logging, error handling, and deployment reporting. * Ability to compare smsts.log with client\-health, policy, content\-transfer, management\-point, and distribution\-point logs to find where a failure happened. * Experience setting up the checks required before a device is wiped and reimaged: readiness checks, data\-protection validation, stop conditions, deployment targeting, and recovery options. * Understanding of Windows 11 deployment, Active Directory domain membership, Microsoft Entra registration, hybrid join, and Entra join. * Working knowledge of Intune ethods, automatic MDM enrollment, Windows Configuration Designer, provisioning packages (.ppkg), and bulk enrollment tokens. * Ability to tell a successful Windows deployment apart from a completed Entra join, Intune enrollment, and delivery of required policies and applications. * Ability to investigate complex failures on your own and to work with the source infrastructure, Intune, identity, network, and cybersecurity teams. * Experience writing readiness assessments, troubleshooting procedures, and handoff documentation under formal change control and least\-privilege processes. * **Required Certifications:** DoD 8140 (formerly 8570\) IAT Level II. Your certification must be active. Any one of these qualifies: CASP\+ CE, CCNA\-Security, CCNP Security, CCSP, CISA, CISSP (or Associate), CND, CySA\+, GCED, GCIH, GICSP, GSEC, Security\+ CE, or SSCP. * **Education Requirements:** BA/BS in a technical or managerial discipline with 10 years of experience relevant to the position responsibilities. **How you will wow us*** Experience supporting DoD, DISA, or other federal enterprise endpoint management environments. * Experience assessing customer\-owned MECM infrastructure and coordinating fixes with the existing system owners. * Experience with large\-scale migrations that reimage Windows and move devices to cloud\-only Intune management rather than ongoing co\-management. * Knowledge of provisioning\-package security, how bulk tokens expire and are revoked, and enrollment troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Intune enrollment restrictions, device compliance, configuration profiles, and the cloud identity, licensing, and connectivity prerequisites. * Experience diagnosing deployments across multiple geographic locations, network segments, or restricted\-connectivity environments. * Familiarity with DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), DoD cybersecurity requirements, and endpoint hardening. * Experience with deployment dashboards, phased rollouts, representative pilots, failure\-trend analysis, and documented recovery procedures. jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer, Professional Services
jobs.description: About Kinaxis: **About Kinaxis** ----------------- Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because *People matter* at Kinaxis. In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, with a brand\-new HQ based in Kanata North in Ottawa. As one of Canada’s Top Employers, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today. At Kinaxis, we power the world’s supply chains to help preserve the planet’s resources and enrich the human experience. As a global leader in end\-to\-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries, with more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries. We are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers. About the team: **Location** This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada, Mexico or the US**About the team** ------------------ We are embedding AI directly into how we implement, assure and support Maestro, and we are growing our Professional Services AI Development capability. As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will work side by side with consultants, Solution Architects and subject\-matter experts to find high\-value Maestro and delivery problems, build AI\-enabled solutions quickly, and scale the ones that work across our global Professional Services organization. This is a hands\-on, field\-embedded engineering role. You will take problems from observation through prototype, production, adoption and measurable impact. This is not a data science or AI strategy role. About the role: **What you will do** -------------------- * Build AI solutions for Professional Services: design, prototype and productionize AI agents, automations and reusable components for implementation quality and knowledge, blueprinting and configuration, risk identification, UAT planning, documentation, integration, data readiness and validation and solution performance diagnostics. * Turn expertise into scalable AI: learn how experienced practitioners make decisions, then encode that expertise into governed AI workflows, keeping human judgment in the loop. * Prototype with the field: work in short cycles (observe, prototype, pilot, measure, improve, scale), embedding with delivery teams to validate solutions against real Maestro solution and implementation scenarios. * Engineer production\-quality applications: build agent orchestration, retrieval and grounding, API and enterprise integrations, evaluation and regression testing, observability, security and release management. * Create reusable patterns: contribute to a common PS AI development foundation, including agent patterns, connectors, evaluation frameworks, development standards, CI/CD and implementation playbooks. * Measure business impact: work with PS project manager and leadership to baseline and track time to value, configuration effort, PS hours per deployment, rework, adoption, AI operating cost and customer outcomes. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * Strong Python development experience * Hands\-on experience building applications with large language models, including agentic workflows and orchestration * Retrieval, grounding and context engineering techniques * Azure or comparable enterprise cloud engineering, plus API and enterprise integration experience * Git and modern CI/CD practices * Experience evaluating and testing probabilistic AI systems * Working knowledge of authentication, authorization and enterprise security fundamentals * Practical experience with several of: Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry, Claude / Claude Code, the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, tool/function calling, RAG, structured outputs and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows **Nice to have** * Experience in enterprise software implementation, supply\-chain technology, professional services, solution architecture, enterprise SaaS or business\-process automation * Kinaxis Maestro experience is a plus but not required. We value a strong applied\-AI engineer who can learn Professional Services and Maestro quickly. **Who you are** * Builder\-oriented: you prefer shipping working solutions to producing strategy decks * Field\-oriented: you are comfortable observing consultants and customers to find the real problem * AI\-native and pragmatic: you build in evaluation, feedback loops and guardrails, and know when conventional software is the better answer * Product\-minded and collaborative: you turn one\-off solutions into reusable capabilities and work with experts rather than replacing them * Outcome\-driven: you measure success by customer quality, delivery speed and efficiency **What success looks like** In your first 90 days, you will learn the delivery lifecycle and current AI architecture, become productive in our common development environment, and take at least one use case from problem definition to a working prototype with a measurable baseline. Within 6 to 12 months, you will own several production AI capabilities, contribute reusable components used across multiple agents, and help scale proven solutions across regions and delivery teams. Associate \- **\#Associate** Why join Kinaxis?: **Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more. **Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Yamaha, P\&G, Honda, and more. **Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net\-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact. *People matter* at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team: * Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide day off on the last Friday of every month) * Flexible work options * Physical and mental well\-being programs * Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes * Mentorship programs and training and career development * Recognition programs and referral rewards * Hackathons For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com. Kinaxis strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply to our welcoming community. We strive to make our website and application process accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend, Infrastructure Focus)
jobs.description: As a Software Engineer at Kira, you will build and own backend services that power critical product workflows, and you will grow quickly while doing it. This role is for an engineer who has already seen a system grow fast and wants more ownership: real design decisions, close collaboration with our VP of Engineering, and mentorship from senior engineers. This is a product\-minded backend role with meaningful work in performance, reliability, and infrastructure. You’ll partner with product and design to ship complete features, contribute across the stack when needed, and have opportunities to meet directly with teachers and students to learn how they use Kira and where we can improve. This is a full\-time position that requires flexibility with work hours and availability outside of regular business hours. We have offices in San Francisco, CA and New York City, NY. We ask that employees work from one of the two locations and come into the office in person 4 days a week (Wednesdays WFH). **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Ship impactful, end\-to\-end features that improve student and teacher experiences * Own scoped initiatives from design through rollout, making real design decisions with increasing independence * Build and scale backend services, APIs, and event\-driven systems as our traffic and customer base grow rapidly * Improve engineering foundations, including code quality, observability, testing, and CI/CD * Take part in operational excellence: performance, reliability, security, and incident response * Partner closely with product managers and designers on UX, interaction design, and execution * Use AI coding tools (such as Cursor and Claude Code) as a daily workflow, and review and understand everything they produce * Contribute to design discussions and code reviews, and grow through mentorship from senior engineers **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience * Roughly 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience. We will consider standout candidates outside this range * Strong backend experience in at least one modern language (for example Kotlin, Python, Go, Rust, Scala, Elixir, or Haskell). Kotlin is a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement, and we expect you to ramp up on Kira's stack (Kotlin, Python) * Hands\-on experience scaling a system through real growth, such as taking users or requests from tens or hundreds of thousands to millions, not only operating mature large\-company services * Experience designing APIs and event\-driven systems (queues, messaging), with a practical approach to scalable architecture * Experience with relational databases (for example MySQL) and operating production systems on cloud infrastructure (ideally AWS) * A track record of owning a multi\-week feature or initiative, including design decisions, and a clear, specific story about its impact * AI\-enabled development as a real daily workflow (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar), with good judgment about when to use AI and when to solve or review code yourself. You can explain, debug, and fix AI\-generated code * Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and reliable deployment practices * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain your thinking to technical and non\-technical colleagues * A mix of larger\-company and startup experience is a plus, along with comfort in a fast\-paced, early\-stage environment with changing priorities * Hunger to grow, a positive can\-do attitude, and impeccable attention to detail **Nice To Have** ---------------- * Experience contributing to frontend codebases (for example React and TypeScript), so you can go full\-stack when a feature needs it * Experience shipping LLM\-backed features, including handling latency, cost, model failures, and fallbacks. * Experience building or maintaining AI evaluations, including representative datasets, task\-specific quality checks, and regression tests for prompt or model changes. * Experience building workflows where models call tools or coordinate multiple steps, including managing state, retries, timeouts, and human review. * Experience at a company that grew quickly during your tenure **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation and equity. For applicants in the US, the salary range for this role is $165,000 \- $195,000, depending on relevant considerations like professional experience and related skill sets * Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including a medical insurance plan with 100% coverage of employee premiums * Flexible PTO policy and company holidays * DoorDash credit for lunch daily * Wellhub Membership: 100% company\-paid access to premium gym networks (Orangetheory, SoulCycle), 60\+ wellness apps (Headspace, MyFitnessPal, Apple Fitness\+), and 1:1 coaching sessions spanning fitness, mental health, nutrition, and sleep * 401(k) matching * Dog friendly office ***Equal Employment Opportunity Employer*** *At Kira, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.description: **Location:** Hybrid **Pay Rate:** $100–$140/hr, depending on level and experience **About the Role** We’re hiring three engineers to analyze and characterize multicore SoC performance in safety\-critical, mixed\-criticality systems. You’ll build the tooling and processes used to monitor cache, memory, and on\-chip fabric behavior. You’ll also set the bandwidth and QoS limits that keep critical workloads deterministic. We have openings at two levels: * **Senior Engineer (1 opening):** 8\+ years of SoC performance analysis experience * **Principal Engineer (2 openings):** 15\+ years of overall experience, including 10\+ years of SoC performance analysis. Principals also act as the top\-level technical specialists on complex projects. **Must\-Have Qualifications (Both Levels)** * SoC performance analysis experience that includes building performance\-monitoring tooling and processes * Experience monitoring usage, throughput, and contention of traffic through L2/L3 cache and the network\-on\-chip (NoC) / communication fabric between on\-die elements * Proven ability to characterize and establish limits for bandwidth allocation, QoS values, channel priorities, and related mechanisms * Hands\-on experience with Intel Tiger Lake, Ice Lake, and/or Alder Lake processors * AC 20\-193 (multicore processor certification) experience. Strongly preferred, and candidates with it will be prioritized **What Strong Candidates Have Done** * Developed tooling to monitor LLC occupancy, memory\-controller bandwidth utilization, and inter\-core interference using Intel PMU/uncore counters * Characterized worst\-case latency from cache and fabric contention, and set QoS and bandwidth\-allocation limits for mixed\-criticality workloads * Built automated performance\-monitoring infrastructure for Intel Xeon and Tiger Lake platforms to track cache misses, memory traffic, and QoS effectiveness **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, modify, and implement software applications, operating systems, and performance\-analysis tooling * Take part in testing through test review and analysis, test witnessing, and software certification * Lead, direct, and coordinate the work of team members, and provide technical support across the project * Principal level: provide consultation on the most complex projects as the program’s top\-level contributor **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field Pay: $100\.00 \- $140\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Product Engineer 2 - AI/Data Science
jobs.description: **The group you’ll be a part of** --------------------------------- In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting\-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. **The impact you’ll make** -------------------------- Join Lam as a Product Engineer with expertise in Data Science and Advanced Analytics, where you'll combine hands\-on semiconductor experimentation with modern analytical methods to solve complex process and hardware challenges. In this role, you will work directly with process development, technology development, product engineering, and customer escalations. You will design and execute experiments, develop advanced test vehicles, analyze data from multiple sources, and apply statistical and machine learning techniques to identify root causes, optimize processes, and uncover underlying physical mechanisms. Operating at the intersection of semiconductor engineering, experimental science, and data analytics, you will transform laboratory and field data into actionable insights that improve product performance, accelerate technology development, and support data\-driven engineering decisions. **What you’ll do** ------------------ This position is for a Product Engineer with Data Science specialization within the Selective Etch Product Group, part of the Global Products Group, based in Fremont, CA. **Process Development \& Engineering** * Perform process engineering research, development, characterization, and evaluation in support of Lam's semiconductor capital equipment and systems. * Support new technology development, product qualification, and customer deployment activities. * Design, execute, and analyze experiments to investigate process, hardware, and system\-level performance. * Develop advanced test vehicles and apply systematic problem\-solving methodologies to improve product capability and reliability. * Compile and evaluate experimental data to establish process understanding and engineering recommendations. **Customer Escalations \& Root Cause Analysis** * Lead technical investigations associated with customer escalations by combining engineering fundamentals, experimental observations, and advanced analytics. * Apply statistical analysis, engineering judgment, and structured root\-cause methodologies to identify failure mechanisms and drive corrective actions. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to rapidly resolve product and process issues impacting customer performance. **Data Science, AI \& Advanced Analytics** * Develop predictive models and data\-driven methodologies that improve understanding of process behavior and equipment performance. * Apply machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics techniques to laboratory, manufacturing, and field data sets. * Develop analytics tools, automated workflows, and visualization methods that enable engineers to efficiently analyze complex datasets. * Utilize data science methodologies to optimize experiments, improve process windows, accelerate root cause analysis, and support technology development. **Collaboration \& Communication** * Collaborate closely with process engineers, hardware engineers, systems engineers, field organizations, and customers to solve challenging technical problems. * Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, management, and customer stakeholders. * Contribute to building a culture of scientific rigor and data\-driven decision making across the organization. **Who we’re looking for** ------------------------- * PhD or Master's degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering Physics, or a related engineering or scientific discipline. * Demonstrated expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Statistics, Scientific Computing, or Advanced Analytics. * Strong foundation in engineering fundamentals, experimental methods, and quantitative analysis. * Experience designing, executing, and interpreting laboratory, research, or engineering experiments. * Proven ability to apply statistical methods, machine learning, or AI techniques to scientific or engineering problems. * Programming experience with Python and commonly used scientific computing, machine learning, and data analytics libraries. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to audiences with varied levels of expertise. * Passion for solving real\-world engineering challenges through a combination of experimentation, data analysis, and scientific reasoning. **Candidates with advanced degrees in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative disciplines may also be considered if they have demonstrated experience applying data science techniques to experimental, scientific, manufacturing, semiconductor, or engineering problems.** **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Semiconductor process, equipment, product engineering, or technology development experience. * Experience with semiconductor plasma, etch, deposition, surface science, or related applications. * Experience applying AI and machine learning techniques to physical systems, manufacturing processes, or scientific data. * Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DOE), Statistical Process Control (SPC), multivariate statistics, regression analysis, and predictive modeling. * Experience developing predictive models, anomaly detection algorithms, or engineering analytics tools. * Laboratory experience involving physics, chemistry, materials characterization, or semiconductor process development. * Experience translating experimental observations into predictive models and actionable engineering recommendations. * Familiarity with root cause analysis methodologies and failure analysis techniques. * Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical projects simultaneously. * Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and matrixed environments. **Our commitment** jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Research \& Engineering Overview **Role:** Member of Technical Staff \- GPU Inference Engineer **Team:** Research \& Engineering **Location:** San Francisco; Boston; Remote **Location Type:** Hybrid **Employment Type:** Full\-time **About Liquid AI** ------------------- Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general\-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on\-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there. **The Opportunity** ------------------- GPU inference sits underneath much of how we build and ship models at Liquid. Evaluation runs, synthetic data generation, and our API service all depend on how fast and how cheaply we can serve Liquid Foundation Models on GPUs, and demand for that work is growing. You will join the small team that owns our GPU serving stack, built on vLLM and SGLang, and make it faster and cheaper to run. This is a high\-ownership role: you will be pointed at whichever inference bottleneck matters most and carry it from profiling to a benchmarked result. The work sits at the serving\-framework level rather than in custom CUDA kernels, which is a separate role on the team. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We need someone who: * **Reasons from first principles:** Explains why a workload is slow before changing it, working from what the model and the GPU are actually doing rather than from framework defaults. * **Picks up the next problem and owns it:** Moves from evaluation throughput to data generation to API serving as priorities shift, and takes each one through to a measured result. * **Makes other teams faster:** Works directly with the researchers and engineers who depend on inference, and treats their throughput as the result that counts. **The Work** ------------ * Own and improve our GPU serving stack on vLLM and SGLang, from configuration and scheduling choices to changes in the frameworks themselves * Speed up large\-scale evaluation and synthetic data generation, and design the inference pipelines those workloads run on * Select, profile, and benchmark the inference engine behind our API service, and adapt the API layer around it * Integrate Liquid Foundation Models into vLLM, SGLang, and Hugging Face Transformers, and maintain those public integrations as models and frameworks change * Diagnose throughput and latency problems alongside the researchers and serving engineers who hit them **Experience \& Capabilities** ------------------------------ **What you'll need:** * Hands\-on experience running LLM inference on GPUs with a serving framework such as vLLM or SGLang, beyond default configuration * First\-principles understanding of LLM inference: the transformer forward pass, autoregressive decoding on a GPU, and the latency, throughput, and memory trade\-offs that follow * Solid grasp of GPU fundamentals as they bear on inference. You do not need to have written CUDA kernels * Experience profiling and benchmarking inference workloads and acting on what the numbers show * Strong Python and PyTorch, and comfort reading and changing large open\-source codebases **Helpful, not required:** * Merged contributions to vLLM, SGLang, or FlashInfer * Lower\-level GPU optimization experience, such as CUDA or Triton kernels * Experience building high\-throughput batch inference for evaluation or synthetic data generation **What Success Looks Like (Year One)** -------------------------------------- * Evaluation and synthetic data generation run measurably faster and at lower cost per token on the same hardware, freeing GPU capacity for other work * The inference engine and configuration behind our API service are chosen on benchmark evidence, and have been profiled and tuned for latency and throughput * Liquid models run correctly and efficiently in the public serving frameworks and libraries our users rely on, including vLLM, SGLang, and Transformers **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Problems standard stacks don't solve:** Our hybrid architectures do not drop into off\-the\-shelf serving frameworks unchanged, and the inference you speed up feeds how every Liquid model is evaluated and trained. High ownership from day one. \[INFERRED \- review this line] * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location. * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company\-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location. * **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Manifest Financial \| Solutions Engineer ======================================== **Job Title:** Solutions Engineer **Department:** Growth **Location:** Remote **Status:** Full\-time Exempt **About Manifest Financial, Inc.** Manifest is an embedded banking platform built for the platforms that power today's entrepreneurs, creators, and micro\-businesses. Through our APIs, platforms can embed business banking, payouts, and card acceptance directly into their products, giving their users one place to get paid, manage money, and grow. What sets Manifest apart is our infrastructure. We operate with direct banking rails and direct acquiring rails, so we can move money both into and out of a platform's ecosystem through a single partner. That positioning lets platforms cut the cost and complexity of paying their users, increase user satisfaction and retention, and create new revenue from payments and payouts—without stitching together multiple processors and third\-party banks. We serve creator platforms, financial institutions, NIL programs, and independent software vendors (ISVs), with a deliberate focus on platform\-led businesses and long\-term partnerships. **Role Overview** We are hiring a Solutions Engineer to be the technical bridge from first sales conversation to live volume, across both sides of our platform: acquiring (card acceptance) and payouts/embedded banking. Before the deal closes, you will work alongside Sales to shape the solution, building the sales and implementation roadmap that shows a prospect exactly how they will launch with Manifest. After signature, you will lead onboarding through go\-live and a clean handoff. Your goal is that every new platform launches quickly and cleanly, with nothing left unresolved. **Key Responsibilities** **Pre\-Sales and Solutions Design** * Partner with Sales to develop account\-level sales and implementation roadmaps that align the prospect's goals, technical requirements, timeline, and launch plan. * Lead technical discovery: map the prospect's funds flow, tech stack, user onboarding, and integration requirements across acquiring and payouts. * Design solutions and produce funds\-flow diagrams, integration overviews, and phased rollout plans that help prospects say yes with confidence. * Deliver technical demos and API walkthroughs to engineering, product, and finance stakeholders. * Answer technical, security, and compliance questions; support RFPs and due diligence questionnaires. * Identify implementation risks early and set realistic launch expectations before contract, so deals close cleanly and launch on time. * Help Sales build repeatable playbooks, roadmap templates, and technical collateral for target verticals. **Implementation and Onboarding** * Lead post\-sale onboarding end to end for both acquiring and payouts: kickoff, project plans, milestones, sandbox testing, certification, and production go\-live. * Guide customers' engineering teams through API, SDK, webhook, hosted\-page, and reporting integrations. * Coordinate merchant and sub\-merchant boarding, KYC/KYB documentation, and underwriting handoffs with Risk and banking and processing partners. * Configure accounts, pricing, settlement, and payout settings; validate end\-to\-end transaction, settlement, payout, and reconciliation flows before launch. * Troubleshoot integration issues and escalate to Product and Engineering with clear reproduction steps and business impact. * Run a structured handoff to Account Management/Support at go\-live, including documentation, open items, and success criteria. * Build reusable implementation assets (runbooks, checklists, sample code) and feed customer insights back to Product. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Minimum 3 years in a sales engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or technical onboarding role at a payments, fintech, or B2B SaaS company. * Demonstrated pre\-sales experience: supporting discovery, solution design, and technical sales cycles alongside account executives. * Working knowledge of card acquiring: authorization, capture, settlement, chargebacks, interchange, and merchant/sub\-merchant onboarding. * Familiarity with payouts and money movement: ACH, RTP/FedNow, push\-to\-card, wires, and virtual accounts or embedded banking. * Hands\-on comfort with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and tools such as Postman; able to debug integrations alongside developers. * Proven ability to run multiple concurrent pre\-sales engagements and implementations with clear timelines and accountability. * Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical concepts to executives and engineers alike. * Understanding of KYC/KYB, PCI DSS, and bank compliance expectations as they relate to onboarding. * Self\-directed and organized in a fully remote environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with platform/PayFac or ISV payment models and sub\-merchant onboarding. * Background with creator platforms, marketplaces, or financial institution partners. * Experience working with banks, card networks, or processors. * Scripting or light development experience (JavaScript, Python, or SQL) for testing and data validation. * Experience with CRM and project tools such as HubSpot, Jira, or Asana. * Payments certifications (e.g., ETA CPP) or prior solutions consulting experience. **Compensation** The posted compensation range for this role is a base salary of $95,000 – $135,000, plus variable compensation of approximately 10–20% of base, for a total target compensation of approximately $105,000 – $160,000\. Final placement within the range depends on experience and qualifications. **What We Offer** * Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance. * Opportunities for professional growth and development. * Dynamic and inclusive work environment. * Remote work options and flexible PTO. * Direct access to leadership and ownership of meaningful work at a growing company. **Equal Opportunity** Manifest Financial is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Lab Applications
jobs.description: Manifold Bio is a platform biotechnology company pioneering AI\-guided protein design and massively multiplexed in vivo screening to unlock tissue\-targeted medicines and organism\-scale models of living systems. Using proprietary molecular barcoding technology, we screen hundreds of thousands of protein designs simultaneously in living systems, producing in vivo\-validated datasets at a scale no one else can match. The datasets power our computational models, which leads to better drug designs, creating a flywheel that gets stronger with every campaign. Our team of protein engineers, biologists, and computational scientists works across this full stack to pursue programs both internally and with leading pharma companies. **Position** Manifold Bio is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to own the applications our scientists use to plan and run experiments. LabFlow is where they set up automated assay workflows: it pulls samples from Benchling and produces the plate layouts, liquid\-handler worklists and sample sheets a run needs. mSeq is where they request, batch and schedule sequencing. You will inherit working software with daily users and be accountable for keeping it reliable, modernizing it, and building what comes next, including AI agents that help scientists set up their experiments. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role with full ownership of architecture, code quality, releases and user support, working directly with scientists, automation engineers, and our data engineering team on Benchling and Snowflake. This is an on\-site role based in our Boston, Massachusetts office and lab. Please only apply if you reside in the Boston area or are open to relocate. **Responsibilities** * Own LabFlow and mSeq end\-to\-end: architecture, code quality, releases, infrastructure and user support * Maintain and extend LabFlow's production assay workflows, including ELISA, bioconjugation, barcode decoding, liquid\-handler worklists and NGS sample sheets * Make mSeq the way all sequencing is requested, batched and scheduled * Turn the parts every workflow shares (Benchling data pull, plate layouts, worklist generation, sample registration, run tracing and re\-runs) into building blocks, so a new assay type is mostly configuration instead of a new project * Bring AI agents into the lab tools: a scientist describes the experiment, and an agent pulls the samples, proposes the plate layout and worklists, checks them against the assay's rules, and hands back a setup to approve * Sit with the lab teams to learn new assays, gather requirements, and deliver the next workflows and apps as needs appear * Own deployments on AWS, testing, monitoring and documentation, and support the users who rely on your software **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Full\-stack depth: Python backends (FastAPI or similar), React and TypeScript frontends, REST APIs and PostgreSQL * Experience building software that reads from and writes to a LIMS or sample\-tracking system through its API (Benchling preferred) * Experience owning a user\-facing production application end\-to\-end: design, release and support for its users * Experience taking over an existing codebase and modernizing it without breaking its users * Experience integrating AI agents or assistants into a user\-facing application, with care for the UI/UX of how users ask, review and approve what the agent proposes * Cloud deployment and operations: AWS, containers, CI/CD * Strong testing practice: unit, integration and end\-to\-end * Ability to gather requirements directly from non\-engineer users and turn them into shipped software * Proficiency with AI\-powered development tools * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a strong sense of ownership and follow\-through **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience designing or extending a framework that others build on, such as a plugin or configuration\-driven system * Hands\-on Benchling experience: registry schemas, the SDK, the warehouse * Snowflake or other data\-warehouse integration * Familiarity with biotech workflows: assay plates, sample tracking, screening, NGS sample sheets and run scheduling * Exposure to lab automation, such as liquid\-handler worklists for Hamilton or Echo instruments * Experience exposing internal tools to agents, for example through MCP servers or an agent SDK * Infrastructure as code with Terraform **This Role Might Be Perfect For You If** You want to build the software scientists rely on every day to run their experiments * You enjoy sitting with users, learning their workflow first\-hand, and shipping what they actually need * You like inheriting working software and making it better without breaking it * You have genuine curiosity about biology and lab science and want your code close to the bench If you're excited to own the tools that power Manifold's experiments, please reach out to careers@manifold.bio. This role is eligible for: * Annual performance\-based target bonus * Stock options * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) plan * Flexible paid time off and holidays * Perks including on\-site gym, onsite lunch, and commuter support *We value different experiences and ways of thinking and believe the most talented teams are built by bringing together people of diverse cultures, genders, and backgrounds.*

tasks such as provisioning, licensing and AI credit allocation, inventory, clean\-up of inactive and orphaned resources, and access reviews, using PowerShell, Power Platform CLI, Microsoft Graph and Power Automate. * Build reusable solutions, templates, agents and starter kits that help makers and business teams adopt AI quickly and within established guardrails. * Partner with business jobs.title: Vulnerability & Patch Management Analyst
jobs.description: Mastronardi Produce pioneered the commercial greenhouse industry in North America, and we’re now the leading greenhouse vegetable company on the continent. Our award\-winning, flavorful produce is packed under the SUNSET® brand and is available at leading grocery retailers across North America. Family owned for over 70 years, we pride ourselves on having the most flavorful products and the best people in the industry. We are constantly pushing boundaries to be a leader in fresh produce innovation. We seek individuals that demonstrate our PRIDE values (Passion, Respect, Innovation, Drive, Excellence) to help us fulfill our mission to inspire healthy living through WOW flavor experiences. Our corporate office in Livonia, Michigan is seeking a Vulnerability \& Patch Management Analyst. This role runs the program that finds, prioritizes and closes security weaknesses across Mastronardi’s technology estate: Azure virtual machines and on\-premises servers, Azure SQL databases and SQL Server VMs, hundreds of web apps and function apps, network devices across multiple sites, and the endpoints and mobile devices used by staff in warehouses, greenhouses and offices in three countries. This is an analyst role with real ownership. You operate the scanning and reporting, you set the remediation priorities with the Infrastructure team and application owners, you chase the fixes to closure, and you report compliance to the CISO. The role sits in the Cyber Security team and works every day with the Infrastructure team, who performs most of the server and network patching, and the Service Delivery team, who manage endpoints. **Values:** To perform the job successfully, the incumbent’s behavior must be consistent with the PRIDE values expected of all Mastronardi Produce employees: be Passionate; have Respect; be Innovative; be Driven and strive for Excellence. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Operate the vulnerability management platform: asset coverage, scan schedules, authenticated scanning, agent deployment and integration with Azure (Microsoft Defender for Cloud / Defender Vulnerability Management or equivalent). * Maintain the authoritative asset inventory for vulnerability management — servers, cloud resources, endpoints, network devices, warehouse and OT devices — and reconcile it against discovery scans. * Run external attack\-surface monitoring (internet\-facing hosts, certificates, DNS, exposed services) and drive closure of exposures. * Analyze and prioritize findings by exploitability, exposure and business impact — Tier\-1 systems such as the ERP, WMS and internet\-facing apps first — and translate them into clear remediation tickets with owners and due dates. * Run the patch\-management program across Windows servers, Azure VMs and PaaS, SQL Server, network and security appliances, endpoints and third\-party applications: define cadences and maintenance windows with the Infrastructure and Service Delivery teams, track compliance and handle exceptions. * Administer and tune the patching and endpoint\-management tooling (ConnectWise Automate, Microsoft Intune / Configuration Manager or equivalent) with the Infrastructure team. * Manage third\-party and application patching — browsers, Java, Adobe, vendor applications, WMS and ERP components — with application owners. * Coordinate remediation of cloud configuration findings (Defender for Cloud recommendations, secure score) with the Infrastructure team. * Track remediation to closure: validate fixes with re\-scans, manage risk acceptances and compensating controls, and escalate overdue items. * Monitor vendor advisories, threat intelligence and zero\-day announcements; run the emergency patching process when needed. * Coordinate periodic penetration tests and vulnerability assessments with external providers; track findings to closure. * Publish patch\-cycle communications and maintenance notices to the business so planned work is expected and understood. * Report weekly and monthly on vulnerability posture — open findings by severity and age, patch compliance by platform, SLA performance, trends — to the Security Operations Manager and CISO, and provide evidence for audits and customer security questionnaires. * Maintain the configuration baselines and hardening standards (CIS benchmarks or equivalent) for servers, cloud resources and network devices, and report drift. * Contribute to incident response when a vulnerability is involved, and to the security review of new systems before go\-live. * Document the program — procedures**, SLAs, exception process, runbooks — and keep it current.** **Education/Background Requirements:** * 3\+ years in vulnerability management, security operations or systems administration with patching responsibility in a multi\-site environment. * Hands\-on experience with a vulnerability scanning platform (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7 or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) and with patch/endpoint\-management tooling (ConnectWise Automate, Intune, SCCM/MECM, WSUS or equivalent). * Solid understanding of Windows Server, Azure (VMs, PaaS, Defender for Cloud), networking and common application stacks, and how patches and configuration changes affect them. * Ability to assess risk, prioritize and communicate clearly with engineers and managers; persistent about closure. * Working knowledge of CVSS, CIS benchmarks and frameworks such as NIST CSF or ISO 27001\. * Scripting (PowerShell or Python) for reporting and automation. **Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:** * Experience in manufacturing, distribution, food or agriculture, including operational technology on warehouse and greenhouse floors. * Exposure to Fortinet, Cisco and SD\-WAN platforms, and to SQL Server patching in availability groups **Working Conditions:** * Office environment **Please note:** Mastronardi Produce has accommodation processes and policies in place and provides accommodation for employees with disabilities. If you require a specific accommodation because of a disability or documented medical need, please contact the Human Resource office so that arrangements can be made for the appropriate accommodation to be put in place. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Intermediate Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Intermediate Electrical Engineer** **McCoy Global** **THIS JOB IS FOR YOU** **IF YOU** ACT LIKE AN OWNER AND OWN YOUR ACTIONS; **IF YOU** EMBRACE CHALLENGE AND LEAD CHANGE; **IF YOU** EVOLVE, ADAPT AND CELEBRATE SUCCESS; **IF YOU** APPROACH ALL INTERACTIONS POSTIVELY, COURAGEOULSY AND HONESTLY; **IF YOU** HAVE YOUR TEAMS BACK; **IF YOU** ARE THE BEST AT EVERYTHING YOU DO! **What We Need:** Are you passionate about creating innovative technology that performs in some of the world's toughest operating environments? We are seeking an **Intermediate Electrical Engineer** to help design, develop, and test embedded systems that power our industrial sensor and control products. In this role, you'll work across the entire product development lifecycle, contributing from concept and prototyping through validation, testing, and production release. You'll apply your expertise in embedded hardware and firmware development to build reliable, high\-performing solutions that enable our customers to operate safely and efficiently. As part of a collaborative engineering team, you'll develop software for microcontrollers and microprocessors, contribute to electronic circuit design, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and help bring new products to market. If you're a hands\-on engineer who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and working on products that make a real impact in industrial environments, we'd like to hear from you. **What you’ll bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in embedded systems development. **What you’ll do:** * Hands\-on experience programming microcontrollers and microprocessors across common architectures. * Solid programming skills in C and C\+\+ for embedded applications. * Working knowledge of common hardware interfaces and peripherals (timers, analog I/O, serial communication buses). * Practical experience with firmware update and bootloader implementation for devices deployed in the field. * Working knowledge of electronic circuit design, including power and signal basics. * Applies low\-power design considerations to battery operated devices. * Uses standard lab and debugging equipment to independently troubleshoot hardware and software issues. * Demonstrated experience with wireless or wired communication technologies. * Applies product testing and compliance requirements to designs. * Works with cross functional teams and contributes to project planning and code reviews. **Who Are We?** Over a century ago, blacksmith Henry McCoy established the Edmonton Auto Spring Works in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Back in 1914, the name McCoy meant a commitment to quality; and that, along with a desire to continually innovate, is what we stand for today. **KEEPING AHEAD OF THE CURVE** Always ahead of the curve, we’ve evolved from auto springs, axle manufacturing, trucking, and trailers, to hydraulic power tongs, advanced engineering for wellbore integrity, data acquisition for harsh environments, and cloud\-based automated Smart technology solutions. Our evolution has been relentless – just the way we love it. **LEADING CHANGE** All along the way, we have aggressively embraced change to support our customers at every turn, anticipating their needs and delivering highly customized solutions. It is no surprise that our company today bears little resemblance to the blacksmith shop of 1914\. **AN UNWAVERING FOCUS** Yet it is also no surprise that our spirit remains fundamentally unchanged: our focus on quality and customization ensures the products and services we provide live up to our promises, so you can live up to yours. **When you work at McCoy, you work with:** * A great teamwork environment that challenges your ability while having fun. * A voice to help us continuously improve our processes and teams. * A chance to help us deliver innovative solutions to our customers provide energy to the world. * An opportunity to grow within our company as we succeed in growing our customers. * An organization that recognizes and cares about its employee’s well\-being. **So, what can McCoy offer you?** * We offer competitive time\-off * 4 wellness days PER YEAR plus your birthday off! * 3 weeks of vacation accrued throughout the year * We match your 401K * Matching Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) * Work with a company that CARES **We are 1\-McCoy and We want YOU!**

jobs.title: Jr Process Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Mechanical Dynamics and Analysis LLC, a world\-class supplier of power generation services, parts, and repairs, has an immediate opening for a qualified individual who has a desire to join a growing organization and an appetite for diverse and technically challenging work. The Houston Service Center (HSC), one of MD\&A's Gas Turbine Parts Service Facilities, is seeking a Junior Process Engineer to support production operations repairing combustion and hot gas path components for GE and Siemens heavy\-duty gas turbines. **Summary:** The primary purpose of the position is to develop, document, and improve the repair processes applied to gas turbine components at HSC, ensuring each part is repaired through a controlled, repeatable process that meets customer, OEM, and MD\&A quality requirements. The position serves as the engineering link between incoming inspection findings, the repair work scope, and the shop floor. **Core Functions:** **Repair Process Development:** * Prepare and maintain repair work instructions, routings, and inspection plans for combustion and hot gas path components (liners, transition pieces, fuel nozzles, blades, vanes, and shrouds). * Translate incoming inspection findings into a defined repair work scope, including weld, blend, braze, machining, heat treatment, and coating steps, with acceptance criteria for each step. * Develop and revise process parameters (weld procedures, heat treatment cycles, coating specifications, machining tolerances) under the direction of the Engineering Manager. * Support First Article Inspection (FAI) books and process qualification for new repair families and customer\-specific programs. **Production Support:** * Serve as the first engineering point of contact on the shop floor for technicians, inspectors, and planners; resolve routine technical questions to keep work in progress moving. * Disposition nonconforming parts within delegated authority and escalate out\-of\-limit findings to the Engineering Manager with a documented recommendation. * Review strip and inspect reports, dimensional data, and NDT results to confirm repairability and identify parts requiring further engineering evaluation. * Coordinate with production planning to identify engineering constraints on turnaround time and flag schedule risk early. **Quality:** * Ensure every repair is performed to a controlled, revision\-managed procedure consistent with MD\&A's quality management system and applicable customer or OEM requirements. * Participate in root cause and corrective action (RCCA) investigations for repair escapes, rework, and customer complaints, using structured methods such as 5 Why, fishbone, and 8D. * Compile final component repair reports with full traceability from incoming conditions through final inspection. **Continuous Improvement:** * Collect and analyze process data (yield, rework rate, cycle time, first pass acceptance) to identify the operation that constrains throughput or quality. * Propose and implement fixture, tooling, sequence, and parameter improvements that reduce cycle time or rework without compromising component life. * Contribute to the development and resolution of ECRs. * Support evaluation, installation, and qualification of new shop equipment (furnaces, balancing equipment, inspection systems). * Any special projects as assigned. Requirements: * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical, Materials or Metallurgical, Manufacturing, or Aerospace Engineering from an ABET\-accredited program. * 0 to 3 years of engineering experience in a manufacturing, repair, or MRO environment, and internship assignments count toward this requirement. * Working knowledge of engineering drawings, GD\&T, and dimensional inspection methods. * Proficiency with Microsoft Excel for data analysis and with at least one 3D CAD package (SolidWorks, Inventor, NX, or equivalent). * Clear technical writing ability, demonstrated through reports, procedures, or academic work. * Excellent communication and organizational skills. * Must be able to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays when business requires. * Authorization to work in the United States. * Ability to stand and walk on the shop floor for extended periods, climb stairs, and lift up to 50 lb. occasionally.

jobs.title: Engineer, Matching Software
jobs.description: Are you interested in joining a purpose\-driven company in the music industry? Do you thrive in a collaborative, hybrid work environment? If you do, we would like to get to know you. **WORKING AT THE MLC** The MLC is committed to excellence, service and transparency. Our culture is collaborative, and our team works in a hybrid environment. On our team, you are respected, valued for your unique strengths and experiences, and empowered to identify and resolve your own challenges. The Mechanical Licensing Collective (The MLC) is a nonprofit organization designated by the U.S. Copyright Office to administer blanket mechanical licenses for digital music services in the United States. Our mission is to ensure that songwriters, composers, and music publishers are accurately paid for the use of their music in the digital ecosystem. While our foundation is rooted in music licensing and rights administration, the scale and complexity of the data we process\-billions of usage records from digital service providers\-has positioned The MLC at the intersection of music and technology. As we continue to build and refine the systems that power matching, royalty processing, and rights management, we are increasingly operating like a technology company, developing sophisticated platforms, data infrastructure, and automation to support the future of digital music licensing. **THE ROLE** As a Software Engineer, you will build, enhance, and maintain the workflows and systems that operationalize our machine learning models. You will focus on building data pipelines, orchestration workflows, APIs, and cloud infrastructure that support the matching process at scale. Working with other software engineer, data scientists and QA engineers, you will deliver reliable, well\-tested software and help improve the performance and maintainability of the Matching Platform. technical support or a related field. * Any customer service experience.
