**Certifications, Licenses \& Registrations** Required * Complete the New Hire Assessment within 90 days of employment. **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities** * AVAILABLE TO   Willing to work holidays and weekends. * Understands or can quickly learn Mesa error codes and their implications across unit types. * Familiar with field operational and safety protocols, including weather and fatigue\-related risks. * Working knowledge of Mesa’s proprietary software systems and operational data analysis. * Strong ability to collect, interpret, and respond to data in fast\-paced environments. * Skilled in identifying system faults, trends, and sizing issues fleet\-wide. * Capable of independently troubleshooting and escalating operational or safety issues. * Excellent verbal jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: Monaco is building an AI\-native revenue platform that replaces the fragmented GTM stack \- CRM, sequencing, call recording, enrichment, pipeline management with one unified system, consolidating 6–10 disconnected tools into a single platform built for the AI era. We launched publicly in Feb 2026, are already 65 people, and have strong early product\-market fit generating millions in ARR within months of launch. You'll have the chance to both scale our core systems and build new features from 0 to 1\. We've raised $85M in our Series B from Founders Fund, Benchmark, and Human Capital, and our founders previously led Brex, Apollo, and Clari. Come join us if you want to be part of a high autonomy, high pace team reinventing one of the biggest categories in enterprise software. **About the role** ------------------ You'll join Monaco's security team early, and you'll wear several hats. The work spans security operations (detecting and responding to threats across our cloud, endpoints and SaaS) and corporate security (identity, devices and access for everyone who works here). The foundations are in place: Okta, Jamf, CrowdStrike and cloud threat detection are rolled out. You'll take ownership of them and turn them into a program that runs on automation instead of tickets, with a lot of say in how it's built. **What you'll do** ------------------ ### **Security operations** * **Detect and respond.** Triage alerts from cloud threat detection (GuardDuty), our SIEM and EDR (CrowdStrike), tune out the noise, and lead incident response from first alert to postmortem. * **Run the security queue.** Own the internal security intake (access requests, suspicious\-activity and phishing reports, questions from engineers) with clear SLAs. * **Manage vulnerabilities.** Triage findings from scanners, AI code reviewers, dependency alerts and pentests, and drive fixes with the owning teams. * **Harden the cloud.** Least\-privilege IAM and SSO for AWS, Kubernetes runtime controls, and security review of infrastructure\-as\-code changes. ### **Corporate security** * **Own workforce identity.** Run Okta as the front door to everything: SSO and SCIM for every app, MFA and passkeys, device assurance, and joiner/mover/leaver automation from our HR system. * **Make privileged access temporary.** Build approval\-based, time\-bound elevated access (for example with Okta Workflows) for production and admin roles, and run quarterly access reviews. * **Run endpoint security.** Keep the Mac fleet enrolled and baselined in Jamf (encryption, OS updates, configuration profiles), and keep EDR coverage complete. * **Secure Google Workspace and SaaS.** Govern third\-party OAuth apps, shared drives and external sharing, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). ### **Across both** * **Automate the toil.** Write the scripts, workflows, and integrations (Python, APIs, Terraform) that make the secure path the easy one. * **Partner with GRC.** Make sure the controls you build produce the SOC 2 and GDPR evidence our GRC analyst needs, and help answer the technical parts of customer security reviews. * **Educate.** Run security onboarding and awareness for the company. **What you bring** ------------------ * 4\+ years in security engineering, security operations, or corporate/IT security at a cloud\-first company. * Hands\-on incident response and alert triage across cloud (AWS preferred), endpoints and SaaS. * Depth with an identity provider (Okta preferred): SAML and OIDC, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and MFA policy. * Experience with an MDM (Jamf preferred) and an EDR (CrowdStrike preferred). * Comfort scripting (Python or similar), working with APIs, and reading infrastructure as code. * Good judgement about risk versus friction, and you're comfortable switching hats without dropping anything. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Detection engineering in a SIEM (Datadog Cloud SIEM, Panther, or similar). * Kubernetes and EKS security. * Okta Workflows or similar identity automation. * SOC 2 or ISO 27001 control ownership. * Experience safely rolling out AI tools across a company, or securing AI agents and MCP servers. * Early\-stage startup experience. Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.title: AWS/Databricks Cloud Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Moser** =============== For more than 25 years we have formed partnerships and grown through open and honest collaboration with our clients, partners, and employees. We are best known for taking great care of our clients, our dedication to creating a work environment where employees do their best work, and our deep commitment to continuous improvement. Our consultants work in a collaborative and fast\-paced environment, are self\-motivated, and are passionate about evolving technology. It is no accident that we are recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in Indiana for 10 consecutive years. Internally, we believe in building strong teams from the top down with a focus on values in our Model\-Coach\-Care philosophy. Our leadership are encouraged and trained to model good practices, mentor other employees and each other, and show empathy and caring in all interactions. This is the base of our core values: Accountability, Balance, Collaboration, Focus, Integrity, Social Responsibility, Support and Transparency. Moser Consulting believes in equal opportunity for all people and is committed to enabling a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture. We foster a spirit of unity that respects the remarkable individuality of everyone's culture, history, and service. **Description** =============== We are seeking a Senior Cloud Data Engineer to join our consulting team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and acquisition workflows across cloud and on\-premises environments, contributing to the full spectrum of data engineering – from ingestion through transformation and delivery. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data solutions, while upholding best practices in architecture, cloud infrastructure, documentation, and continuous improvement. This position sits within our genomics organization, providing senior\-level, strategic technical leadership alongside two existing engineers to build out AWS\-based data pipelines that support genomic data science models — hands\-on, production AWS pipeline\-building experience is the top priority for this role. **Role Responsibilities** ========================= * Participate in team stand\-ups and other agile ceremonies to support project delivery * Assist in building and maintaining data acquisition pipelines from diverse sources including databases, flat\-files, and REST APIs * Leverage development design patterns and best practices across workloads. * Support data modeling efforts including dimensional models and semantic layers for analytics under senior guidance * Proactively troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures, query performance issues, data quality concerns, notebook timeouts, data model inconsistencies, semantic model refresh errors, and capacity throttling using monitoring tools and query optimization techniques * Participate in requirement gathering meetings and translate business needs into technical specifications * Engage in ongoing learning through online trainings, certifications, and mentorship opportunities * Create and maintain technical documentation, operational documentation, data flow diagrams, and data mapping documents * Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and communicate progress to technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Build and maintain AWS\-native pipelines (Lambda, ECS, EKS, S3\) that ingest and store genomic data retrieved via API calls * Generate and manage sequencing and post\-sequencing data processing workflows in support of genomics data science models **Requirements** ================ * Top priority: proven, hands\-on experience designing and building AWS\-based data pipelines end\-to\-end (API ingestion through storage and delivery) * Must\-have: hands\-on experience working with High Performance Computing (HPC) clusters * Experience with dimensional modeling, SCDs, and medallion architecture * Previous cloud experience required; AWS preferred with hands\-on exposure to Lambda, S3, and Docker * Experience implementing and managing role\-based access control (RBAC), including group/permissions management for secure system access * Strong Python experience across pipeline development, ETL, and data engineering tasks, with exposure to complex datasets from disparate batch and streaming sources and an emphasis on low latency, high throughput, and cost\-efficiency; pandas experience a plus * Leveraging SQL and python data tooling develop scalable, optimized ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load large, complex datasets from disparate sources (batch and streaming). Streamlining for low latency, high throughput and cost\-efficiency. * Experience with API development in both consumer and producer capacities (REST APIs) * CI/CD experience with modern DevOps tooling and deployment pipelines * Experience with API\-based access patterns for retrieving and integrating data from external systems * Lambda functions must be developed and deployed via code/infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK, SAM) — GUI/console\-based Lambda creation is not acceptable * Hands\-on experience with Amazon ECS and/or EKS for container orchestration * Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them to solve problems * Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high\-quality work * Excellent oral and written communication skills * Professionalism and ethics including trust, positive attitude, commitment, honesty, collaboration, and approachability * Proven ability to adapt in a fast\-paced consulting environment, including managing time effectively and handling multiple tasks simultaneously **Preferred Skills** ==================== * Experience with version control systems (Git) and agile development frameworks * Design and document end\-to\-end testing plans for Python\-based applications * PySpark experience for large\-scale distributed data processing * Experience with Datadog or similar observability and monitoring platforms * Familiarity with Dagster or other modern data orchestration frameworks * Terraform or infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) experience for cloud resource provisioning * Database experience with databases such as AWS RDS, MySQL, or PostgreSQL * Familiarity with D3\.js for building custom data visualizations **Where You'll Work** ===================== Moser Consulting has 2 local, Indianapolis, IN offices. You will be able to work a hybrid/onsite schedule, flexing your time between either office. **Salary** ========== At Moser Consulting, we believe in pay transparency and fairness. The $85k\-$125k salary range for this role is not just a number—it's a reflection of the value we place on the skills and experience our employees bring to our team. We are committed to offering a competitive salary that aligns with the industry standards and the unique competencies you bring to our community. **Benefits** ============ For over a quarter of a century, Moser Consulting has been a beacon for top\-tier IT talent who excel in self\-management. Our people are our greatest asset. jobs.title: Data Science Analyst/Engineer - Tan Lab
jobs.description: NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top\-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge. *For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*. **Position Summary:** We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Data Science Analyst/Engineer. The Tan Lab at NYU is recruiting a Data Science Analyst/Engineer to develop and maintain computational infrastructure for machine learning in genomics. Our mission is to understand how elements of our genome regulate gene expression and its implications for human diseases. We combine machine learning, biological mechanisms, and large\-scale data to understand how regulatory elements control transcription factors, 3D genome organization, and transcription. This position will maintain the lab's data and ML infrastructure, including processing, organizing, and managing terabyte\-scale datasets; designing robust bioinformatics pipelines; and optimizing ML training pipelines and model architectures to accelerate and scale genomics research in the lab. **Job Responsibilities:** * Prepare and present results, reports, both oral and written, to a variety of audiences, concerning processes, models, evaluation, and impact * Performs other duties as assigned. * Independently design, execute, and communicate computational research projects in machine learning and functional genomics that advance the labs research mission. **Additional Position Specific Responsibilities:** * Build, maintain, and troubleshoot end\-to\-end bioinformatics infrastructure for sequencing data processing using workflow\-management systems such as Nextflow, Snakemake, or WDL. * Develop and validate pipelines for assays such as RNA\-seq, ATAC\-seq, ChIP\-seq, CUT\&RUN/CUT\&Tag, Hi\-C, Micro\-C, single\-cell sequencing, and related emerging technologies. * Containerize computational environments using Docker, Apptainer/Singularity, Conda, or related technologies. * Develop new bioinformatics pipelines and work with wet\-lab people to support new molecular assays or improve processing of current assays. * Perform quality analysis of the generated sequencing data and develop solutions to enhance future performance. * Develop distributed and mixed\-precision training workflows for multi\-GPU and multi\-node environments. * Manage our compute space on HPC and cloud providers such as AWS and Google Cloud. Monitor storage and compute costs. * Profile and optimize model training, inference, memory use, data loading, and communication overhead. * Evaluate emerging machine\-learning frameworks and modeling approaches for potential adoption. * Design and maintain biological and real\-world evaluation frameworks by collaborating with domain experts within and outside of the lab. * Maintain internal and open\-source software repositories, technical documentation, and onboarding materials. * Assist lab members with model development and data processing. Host routine workshops to keep the lab informed of the available tools and infrastructure. * Develop agentic workflows for dataset preparation, model generation, training, evaluation, and in silico experimentation. **Minimum Qualifications:** To qualify you must have a Masters degree in a quantitative discipline (Biomedical Informatics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Stascs, Mathematics or similar field) and 3 years of experience in machine learning/ data science. Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, R) and machine learning tools (scikitlearn, R) Knowledge of predictive modeling and machine learning concepts, including design, development, evaluation, deployment and scaling to large datasets Familiarity with computing models for big data Hadoop / MapReduce, Spark etc. Knowledge of databases (Relational / SQL, NOSQL MongoDB etc.) Good grasp of soware engineering principles. Experience in integrating modern software architectures. Knowledge and some experience in operational aspects of soware development and deployment, including automation, testing, virtualization and container technology Knowledge of clinical and operational aspects of healthcare delivery. Excellent written and oral communication skills for a variety of audiences **Preferred Qualifications:** Experience training deep\-learning models on multiple GPUs or distributed computing clusters. Familiarity with distributed\-training technologies such as PyTorch Distributed, FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Ray. Experience with HPC schedulers such as Slurm. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud. Knowledge of functional genomics, gene regulation, transcription factors, epigenomics, chromatin accessibility, or 3D genome organization. Experience analyzing bulk, single\-cell, or spatial multi\-omic datasets. Experience developing sequence models, transformers, diffusion models, graph neural networks, or other generative architectures. Familiarity with genomic foundation models, representation learning, transfer learning, and parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning. Experience with optimizing neural network architectures. Familiarity with CUDA and tools like NVIDIA Nsight. Familiarity with MLOps tools for experiment tracking and model or dataset versioning, such as Weights \& Biases, MLflow, DVC, or equivalent platforms. Strong programming skills in Python and experience writing production\-quality or research\-grade scientific software. Experience with modern machine\-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow. Experience developing or maintaining bioinformatics workflows. Experience with containerization and environment\-management tools such as Docker, Apptainer/Singularity, Conda, or similar technologies. Understanding of machine\-learning fundamentals, including optimization, generalization, model evaluation, and experimental design. Passion for data governance and a strong desire to learn. *Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.* NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time\-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well\-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family. NYU Grossman School of Medicine is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online. View Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, specialty, education, and hospital need. Our team uses AI\-assisted development tools (such as Cursor and Claude Code) as part of day\-to\-day engineering work. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** ---------------------------- * Own full\-stack delivery of features for Fulfillment Tracker — from requirements clarification through design, implementation, testing, and production rollout * Work with the engineering team to make key design and technical implementation decisions; propose pragmatic trade\-offs for maintainability, performance, and operational risk * Partner closely with stakeholders and end users (lab ops, fulfillment, product) to define requirements and transform them into reliable, extensible, operations\-friendly applications * Design, build, and maintain sustainable application and service stacks (frontend modules, REST APIs, domain services, provider integrations, and supporting infrastructure) * Improve integrations with the Lab Informatics Management System and other upstream/downstream operational data sources used by fulfillment workflows * Improve development process and procedure; MS preferred * **5\+ years** of professional software development experience, preferably building complex data\- or process\-management applications * Proven full\-stack experience delivering production web applications (frontend \+ backend) with ownership of features end\-to\-end * Strong experience with **object\-oriented programming in Java**, preferably using **Spring Boot / Spring Framework** * Strong experience with **modern frontend development** using **TypeScript** and **React** (hooks, component architecture, routing, forms, and client\-side data fetching) * Experience building and consuming **REST APIs** and integrating with external service providers * Experience with **relational databases** and SQL (MySQL preferred), including schema design and query troubleshooting * Demonstrated ability to ship carefully in production\-critical systems used by operational users * Demonstrated teamwork skills; solid analytical background; excellent written and verbal communication * Commitment to diversity in engineering * Healthcare IT, biotech, laboratory, or Lab Informatics Management System experience is beneficial but not required **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** ------------------------------------ ### **Core (required / strongly expected for SW3\)** * Full\-stack web application programming with ownership across UI and API layers * **Java** (17/21\+) and **Spring Boot** (REST services, dependency injection, configuration, testing) * **TypeScript** and **React** (React 18\+), component\-driven UI, and modern frontend tooling * Client\-side data fetching and caching patterns (**TanStack React Query** / React Query or comparable) * **REST API** design and consumption; We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. *If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.* Link: https://www.natera.com/notice\-of\-data\-collection\-california\-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. jobs.description: If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. **The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) will help improve the stability, availability, performance, and operability of Nationwide’s Imaging \& Workflow (IW) application portfolio. The role will focus on services including AWD\-NF, Vision, Views, Capture, NRS, and URBO, and will partner closely with IW product, application development, infrastructure, and platform teams.** **The SRE will bring a production\-first perspective to the full\-service lifecycle: understanding how applications behave in production, identifying and reducing reliability risks, strengthening operational readiness, and helping teams deliver changes safely. This role is hands\-on and collaborative. It applies practical SRE principles in a way that supports business needs, customer and associate experience, security, and the delivery commitments of IW teams.** **Key responsibilities** ======================== **Reliability, service health, and observability** * **Establish and maintain a clear view of service health, including availability, latency, error rates, capacity, dependencies, and other relevant production signals.** * **Assess existing monitoring and observability coverage; identify blind spots, noisy alerts, unclear ownership, and signals that do not lead to an actionable response.** * **Implement and improve instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, and service health reporting using New Relic and other team\-standard tools as appropriate.** * **Make alerts actionable by defining meaningful thresholds, routing and escalation expectations, and response guidance in partnership with the teams that own each service.** * **Identify reliability risks across application components and their dependencies, including databases, messaging, APIs, infrastructure, and deployment platforms.** **Service\-level objectives and reliability planning** * **Partner with product and engineering teams to define and evolve service\-level indicators (SLIs) and service\-level objectives (SLOs) that reflect user and business outcomes.** * **Use production signals, incidents, service\-level performance, and operational trends to identify and prioritize reliability improvements.** * **Help teams make informed trade\-offs among reliability, performance, security, resilience, and delivery speed, using evidence from production wherever possible.** * **Contribute to reliability reviews and planning for existing services, significant changes, and new initiatives, identifying operational requirements and risks early.** * **Help establish appropriate reliability targets and service expectations with stakeholders; document assumptions, ownership, and escalation paths.** **Incident response and continuous improvement** * **Investigate complex production incidents across application and infrastructure boundaries; help coordinate response, mitigation, communications, and service restoration with the appropriate owners.** * **Use logs, metrics, traces, deployment history, and other available evidence to support timely diagnosis and informed recovery decisions.** * **Participate in incident reviews and document contributing factors, impact, timeline, and lessons learned in a blameless, improvement\-oriented manner.** * **Track corrective actions through completion and validate that changes reduce recurrence, improve recovery, or lower operational risk.** * **Identify patterns in incidents, alerts, and support demand to address systemic causes rather than relying on repeated manual intervention.** **Automation, deployment, and recovery** * **Automate repeatable operational tasks, health checks, diagnostics, and reliability controls to reduce manual effort and operational toil.** * **Partner with application and platform teams to improve deployment safety, including release validation, change visibility, rollback or recovery readiness, and post\-deployment checks.** * **Strengthen recovery practices by identifying and testing appropriate recovery procedures, dependencies, and operational handoffs.** * **Contribute to resilience and capacity practices, including failure\-mode analysis, resource utilization review, and service behavior under expected operating conditions.** * **Promote consistent, maintainable automation that fits the team’s approved platforms, security controls, and support model.** **Operational readiness and knowledge sharing** * **Ensure services have practical, current runbooks covering health checks, common failure modes, triage, escalation, mitigation, and recovery steps.** * **Improve ope /CD, infrastructure as code and other modern IT practices, with at least five years of experience building and operating complex distributed systems. Experience modifying code and configurations to improve availability, latency and performance with a systematic problem\-solving approach coupled with effective communication skills and a sense of drive. **Knowledge, Abilities and Skills:** Strong communication and negotiation skills, knowledge of planning, management and execution of the Accelerated Solutions Deliver framework, and Information Security acumen. Vendor management skills preferred. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus. Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence. Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the Vice President and HR Business Partner. **Values**: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values. **Job Conditions:** **Overtime Eligibility**: Exempt (Not Eligible) **Working Conditions**: Hybrid to normal office environment. Non\-standard or extended work may be required based on project needs. Some travel may be required. **ADA**: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties. **Benefits** We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision, life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro\-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company\-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law. **NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:** We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. jobs.title: AI Forward Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview** As an **AI Forward Engineer**, you will operate at the intersection of deep software engineering, customer operations, and product strategy. Unlike standard back\-office ML engineers who build foundational algorithms, you will be embedded on the front lines to solve real\-world, high\-impact business challenges. You will work directly with enterprise stakeholders to identify operational bottlenecks, design custom AI solutions leveraging LLM tool\-calling and RAG architectures, and integrate these systems into complex legacy infrastructure and Navan's API suite. **What You'll Do:** * **Bridge Pilot\-to\-Production:** Build, test, and ship production\-ready AI agents and autonomous workflows that streamline travel booking, expense policy auditing, and financial reconciliation. * **Translate Business to Code:** Engage directly with internal operational teams and external enterprise clients to audit complex manual workflows and codify "tribal knowledge" into custom software solutions. * **Architect \& Integrate:** Integrate advanced LLM pipelines, vector databases, and agentic frameworks into Navan's core backend platforms, enterprise data lakes, and third\-party ERP/HRIS systems (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Workday). * **Rapid Prototyping \& Feedback Loops:** Develop proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) on\-site or in close collaboration with end\-users, gather real\-time usage data, and iterate rapidly to maximize user adoption and business impact. * **Governance \& Security:** Ensure all custom AI solutions comply with strict enterprise data privacy standards, SOC 2 compliance, and financial auditing frameworks. * **Collaborate with Core Product Teams:** Act as a critical feedback loop to Navan's core Product and AI Engineering teams, bringing real\-world edge cases and customer requirements into the core platform roadmap. **What We're Looking For:** * 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, technical consulting, forward deployed engineering, or solutions architecture. * Experience in corporate travel, fintech, expense management, or enterprise SaaS domains are a plus. * Familiarity with enterprise compliance, audit logs, and security protocols surrounding generative AI. * Strong proficiency in **Python**, **TypeScript/JavaScript**, or **Go**, along with solid experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and asynchronous architecture. * Hands\-on experience building with modern AI stacks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs), agentic architectures (tool\-calling, multi\-agent frameworks), and RAG pipelines (vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or Qdrant). * Proficiency in SQL, data pipeline integration, containerization (**Docker**, **Kubernetes**), and cloud deployment platforms (**AWS**, **GCP**, or **Azure**). * Ability to design scalable, secure, and fault\-tolerant enterprise software integrations. Navan uses AI\-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers. **Human oversight:** Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application. * **Your rights:** If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. We build end\-to\-end observability for ML and GenAI workloads, capturing model inputs, features, predictions, outcomes, and behavior across online and batch systems. Our platform enables teams to monitor model performance, data quality, drift, latency, and failures, turning the ML system from a black box into an explainable, debuggable system. We provide developer\-friendly libraries, dashboards, and alerts so teams can debug issues, respond to incidents, and ship AI\-powered products with confidence. We're looking for a hands\-on senior engineer to build the frameworks behind Netflix's AI Observability platform, model performance, evaluation, and vendor integration surfaces. You will design reusable infrastructure that enables ML/AI practitioners across domains to monitor model quality in production, evaluate LLM and agentic systems, and adopt vendor tooling through a consistent, self\-serve platform. AIP owns the generic, reusable infrastructure; domain teams own their domain\-specific evals and remediation. You will partner closely with engineering, product, machine learning, and data teams to turn their needs into reusable platform capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong background in AI or ML infrastructure and a passion for building scalable, robust systems. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Build the observability framework and platform capabilities that give ML and GenAI systems metrics, logs, and distributed traces across online inference, batch scoring, feature pipelines, and agent orchestration, so teams can instrument their systems consistently. * Build the primitives that let teams monitor model performance (accuracy, calibration, error rates), data quality, drift, and degradation on their own systems, rather than monitoring individual models yourself. * Build and extend evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems that support response quality, grounding and hallucination, task success, tool\-use and trajectory correctness, and LLM\-as\-a\-judge and human\-in\-the\-loop scoring, giving teams reusable building blocks to define and run their own evals. * product teams can onboard models and agents with minimal friction. * Build reusable libraries, SDKs, and templates that make observability and evaluation the default for new systems ("observability\-by\-default"), lowering the barrier for teams to instrument and evaluate their work. * Provide the dashboarding, alerting, and SLO/SLI building blocks (plus sensible out\-of\-the\-box templates) that teams use to track model performance, latency, cost, and reliability. **To succeed in this role, you will need:** ------------------------------------------- * Experience in software, other teams build on and adopt, reflecting a platform and enablement mindset rather than shipping features for a single use case. * Strong coding skills in Python and at least one of Java, Go, or Scala, with experience building production services * Practical experience operating ML models in production (online serving and/or batch), including drift, model performance, and data quality. * Hands\-on experience with modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo, or similar). * Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Ability to work cross\-functionally with ML, data, infra, and product teams, and to communicate clearly about system behavior, quality, and risk. * Experience with vendor integration and VPC deployment. * An AI\-Native Engineering Mindset who uses AI tools as a core part of their own workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, and code review. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Hands\-on experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g., Arize, Braintrust, LangFuse, Weights \& Biases, Galileo, Vertex AI Model Monitoring, SageMaker Model Monitor). * Experience building or shipping LLM/GenAI applications and evaluating them: prompt/result logging, evaluation metrics, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Experience evaluating agentic systems: tool use, multi\-step reasoning, and trajectory/task\-success measurement. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Search
jobs.description: #### **\#TeamNextdoor** Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at **nextdoor.com**. #### **Meet Your Future Neighbors** At Nextdoor, Machine Learning and Search are two of the most important areas we are growing. Search is a strategic priority for us as we work to make Nextdoor the neighborhood hub for local information, recommendations, and exchange. Machine Learning is helping transform the search experience by making it more relevant, personalized, and useful—connecting members with the people, places, services, conversations, and insights that matter most in their communities. Our machine learning team is lean but hungry to drive impact across the platform, including search, newsfeed, notifications, ads relevance, connections, and trust. We believe ML will be integral to making Nextdoor more valuable to our members, while also ensuring that Search helps people discover meaningful local information—not simply more content. We believe ML should be developed ethically, encouraging healthy habits and interactions rather than addictive behavior. We are looking for great engineers who believe in the power of local community and want to help empower members to make their neighborhoods great places to live. At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI\-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we're looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI\-assisted outputs. We also offer a warm, inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model, blending in\-office presence with work\-from\-home flexibility for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London. #### **The Impact You'll Make** * Join a high\-impact Machine Learning Engineering team developing data\-intensive products, including feature engineering, predictive modeling, real\-time inference, and data\-driven experimentation. * Partner closely with Product Management, Data Science, and Software Engineering teams to translate product requirements into scalable machine learning systems and platform capabilities. * Collect, curate, and process large\-scale datasets for supervised learning, real\-time prediction, recommendation systems, ranking, classification, and other production ML use cases. * Develop and optimize low\-latency machine learning models and real\-time decision systems that meet strict production performance, scalability, and reliability requirements. * Deploy, integrate, and maintain machine learning models in production environments, including model serving, inference pipelines, monitoring, automation, and integration with customer\-facing product features. * Conduct online A/B tests and user\-facing experiments to evaluate model performance, measure causal impact, and improve business metrics such as engagement, retention, and user experience. * Analyze experiment results using statistical methods, model evaluation metrics, and product KPIs to guide iterative improvements to model quality and platform functionality. * Collaborate with ML engineers, Data Scientists, Backend Engineers, Product Managers, and other cross\-functional partners to build safe, effective, and scalable user experiences. * Participate in Nextdoor's in\-person trainings, off\-sites, volunteer events, and team\-building activities. * Build strong in\-person relationships with colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and mission\-driven Nextdoor company culture. #### **What You'll Bring To The Team** * M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Applied Math, Statistics, or a related field * 5\+ years of industry experience in applying machine learning at scale * Experience with recommendation systems, deep learning models, search/feed/notification relevance, knowledge graphs, Ads, or NLP at scale is required * Experience building ML models for consumer\-facing products * Proven engineering skills, with experience in writing and maintaining high\-quality production code * Ability to work with and analyze large amounts of data * Ability to succeed in a dynamic startup environment #### **Rewards** Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. The starting salary for this role is expected to range from $195,000 to $276,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate's geographic location. We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date. When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care. At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. For information about our collection and use of applicants' personal information, please see Nextdoor's Personnel Privacy Notice, found here. ##### **\#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-Remote**

jobs.description: #### **\#TeamNextdoor** Nextdoor is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at **nextdoor.com**. #### **Meet Your Future Neighbors** At Nextdoor, Cloud Engineers are responsible for building, deploying, managing, and securing the underlying cloud\-based architecture that powers communities on the Nextdoor platform worldwide. These engineers have designed, built and implemented a globally scalable container and "serverless" based infrastructure that serves billions of requests a day, millions of active users, and hundreds of developers. We build infrastructure and tooling that is iterable, scalable, and secure. We write everything in code from network infrastructure to server management, database provisioning, and data pipelines. Recently we have focused on scaling up our Kubernetes infrastructure. We created a dedicated management cluster to run ArgoCD, Loki, Prometheus, and Grafana. Additionally, we have created a second Kubernetes cluster for Nextdoor applications to ensure we can scale beyond the limitations of a single cluster. This will ensure Nextdoor's infrastructure is able to scale for many years to come. Additionally our team has focused efforts to modernize our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) by leveraging CDK to manage our AWS resources and Pulumi to manage our other core infrastructure systems such as PagerDuty, Datadog, and Sentry. At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI\-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. In this team you will work in the ways of reliability engineering, design scalable systems from the ground up, and generally build systems that never page you. You serve all of our engineering teams by providing them with reliable and scalable infrastructure. Here are just some of our team's most recent deliverables: * Operationalizing a second Kubernetes cluster to ensure Nextdoor can continue to scale beyond the limits of a single Kubernetes cluster * Building automation for our developer's workflows including applying 3rd party dependency updates automatically as well as distributing Helm chart updates * Modernizing our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) by leveraging CDK and Pulumi * Optimizing our Kubernetes resource management by leveraging Spot Ocean and Karpenter * Providing self\-service infrastructure\-as\-code systems to developers that automate the full lifecycle of managing, deploying and operating cloud services including blob/block storage, relational databases, key\-value databases, caches and document search services * Developing tooling for horizontally and vertically autoscaling our developers compute workloads * Providing upstream open source patches to well known community projects like AWS Bottlerocket, the Istio Service Mesh, Keiko IAM Manager, Kyverno, Strimzi.io's Kafka Operator and more! #### **What You'll Bring to The Team** * 7\+ years experience in a DevOps or Cloud role * Solid understanding of Kubernetes (k8s) * Experience using TypeScript * Experience with infrastructure as code (CDK, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Puppet, Salt, Ansible, Terraform, Packer) * Thorough understanding of Linux and networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP/S, eBPF) * Strong debugging and performance tuning skills using software like gdb, perf, strace, ltrace, tcpdump, Wireshark, etc. * Experience with performance, automation, monitoring, and capacity planning * Experience automating configuration and bootstrapping of Linux systems * Eagerness to explore and apply AI and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done * Participate in in\-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off\-sites, volunteer days, and team building exercises * Build in\-person relationships with team members and contribute to Nextdoor's company culture #### **Bonus Points** * Experience using Docker or other containerization software * Linux certifications such as Linux\+, Network\+, RHCSA/RHCE/RHCA or similar * Experience in a large scale compute environment with hundreds or thousands of servers #### **Rewards** Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.** At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation. Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are. If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong. **Location:** While this role is open to remote candidates across the United States, team members located within 40 miles of our Scottsdale headquarters (9451 E. Via de Ventura, Scottsdale, AZ 85256\) are expected to work onsite four days per week to support collaboration, speed, and execution. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity. We are seeking a Staff AI Engineer to help accelerate new AI initiatives and support Nextiva’s mission of delivering exceptional customer experiences through a unified, modern platform powered by AI and automation. The Staff AI Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor role for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and system design. This role will help design, build, and launch new AI\-focused initiatives while working across Nextiva engineering teams and with external technology partners. As a Staff Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of hands\-on engineering, system design, and early\-stage solutioning. You will take ownership of new capabilities from initial technical discussions through design, development, and launch. This is not an architecture\-only position; we are looking for someone who remains close to the code and is comfortable building alongside the team. You will work on initiatives involving NextIQ capabilities, including collaboration with the Google Gemini team to bring capabilities built within Nextiva into partner environments. You will also work closely with global Nextiva product and engineering teams, including teams working on NextOS, to extend NextIQ capabilities across the Nextiva ecosystem. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building new capabilities from the ground up, and taking end\-to\-end technical ownership while contributing as a deeply hands\-on individual contributor. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and launch new AI\-focused engineering capabilities and modules. * Own engineering initiatives end to end, from early\-stage solutioning and architecture through implementation and launch. * Remain deeply hands\-on with software development and contribute production code. * Build solutions using Python and apply strong distributed\-systems engineering principles. * Participate in system design, architecture, and solutioning discussions with engineering teams. * Work closely with the Google Gemini team on initiatives designed to bring NextIQ capabilities into Gemini. * Collaborate with other external technology partners to extend Nextiva capabilities into their environments. * Partner with U.S.\-based Nextiva product and engineering teams on new initiatives. * Work with teams supporting NextOS to help bring NextIQ capabilities into other areas of the Nextiva ecosystem. * Navigate ambiguous, early\-stage technical problems and translate them into practical engineering solutions. * Take accountability for designing, building, and successfully launching the capabilities you own. **Requirements** **Basic Qualifications** * 7–10\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with strong hands\-on experience building and delivering production software. * Very strong hands\-on Python engineering skills. * Strong system design capabilities. * Experience designing and building distributed systems. * Demonstrated experience owning and launching software modules or capabilities end to end. * Experience taking technical initiatives from solutioning and design through development and launch. * Ability and willingness to remain hands\-on with coding at Staff Engineer level. * Experience contributing to architecture and technical solutioning discussions. * Ability to work effectively on new initiatives where requirements and technical approaches may still be evolving. * Ability to collaborate effectively with internal engineering teams and external technology partners. * Ability to work remotely within a time zone reasonably aligned with the Arizona\-based team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience operating as a Staff Engineer or at a comparable level in a similarly sized or slightly larger organization. * Experience building new produ practices and apply them where they improve engineering effectiveness. * Contribute directly to AI\-related initiatives involving NextIQ and partner environments such as Google Gemini. **Additional Qualities** * Strong sense of ownership and accountability. * Comfortable working through ambiguity and early\-stage technical challenges. * Able to move effectively between system design and hands\-on implementation. * Strong problem\-solving and technical decision\-making skills. * Collaborative approach to working across engineering teams and external partners. * Ability to take ownership of a capability through design, build, and launch. * Self\-directed and comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor. Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies) Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors: * Drives Results: Action\-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go. * Critical Thinker: Data\-driven, forward\-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision\-making, and focus on higher\-value work. * Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates. #### **Total Rewards** Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office. Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses. The expected hiring range is $115,000 \- $200,000\. A different level in the job hierarchy may apply to a specific candidate, resulting in a different hiring range. * Health: Multiple health plan options to suit your needs, including medical, dental, vision, and telemedicine coverage * Insurance: Life, disability, and supplemental indemnity plans * + ️ Work\-Life Balance: Flexible Time Off for salaried employees, PTO for hourly employees, Paid Sick Time, Paid Parental Bonding Leave, and holiday pay * Financial Security: 401(k) with company match, Health Savings Accounts with company contributions, Dependent Care FSA * ‍ Wellness: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and comprehensive wellness initiatives * Growth: Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well\-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career! Nextiva is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Nextiva participates in the E\-Verify Program where and as required by law. . \#LI\-MS1 \#LI\-Remote Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M\+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI\-powered, conversation\-centric platform. Want to see what life at Nextiva is all about?

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python + TypeScript)
jobs.description: ### **About Northbeam** Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions. We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey. We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Fullstack Engineer** to build Northbeam's mobile attribution product and the data collection layer underneath it. You'll own our client\-side SDKs (JavaScript today, iOS next) and the high\-throughput APIs that ingest the events they send. This is a **fullstack role** with a **strong backend and scaling bent.** Our microservices run in both **TypeScript and Python**, so you'll move between the two daily, and ship React UI when a feature needs it. You'll also partner with our Conversions API (CAPI) team on event ingestion. The ideal person has built web analytics or event tracking at real volume and cares as much about a reliable SDK as about the systems that catch its data. **Your Impact** --------------- * Build Northbeam's mobile attribution solution end to end: SDK, ingestion APIs, data model, and the dashboard views customers use to act on it. * Design and own our client\-side SDKs in JavaScript/TypeScript, and help shape our iOS SDK, so they capture events accurately with minimal impact on customer site and app performance. * Build and scale high\-throughput APIs and microservices in TypeScript and Python that ingest, validate, and route event data from our customers' sites and apps. * Partner with the CAPI team to ingest server\-side conversion events and deliver them reliably to ad platforms. * Own the reliability of these ingestion paths: load testing, monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning. * Ship frontend features in React and TypeScript when a product experience needs them. * Scope projects with product managers, data scientists, and customer success, and help set technical direction for how Northbeam collects data. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years building production software, with deep fullstack experience in TypeScript/JavaScript across frontend and backend. * Professional experience building services or APIs in Python, and comfort working across TypeScript and Python microservices in the same system. * A track record designing and scaling high\-throughput APIs: you've handled request volume, latency, queuing, retries, and idempotency in production. * Hands\-on experience with web analytics or event tracking: building tracking SDKs, pixels, or tag libraries, designing event schemas, and working within browser constraints like cookie restrictions and ad blockers. * Proficiency in SQL; experience with BigQuery or a similar cloud data warehouse. * Startup instincts: you turn ambiguous product needs into sound architecture and ship production\-ready code with minimal guidance. * Interest in mentoring other engineers and raising the bar for what the team ships. **Bonus Skills \& Experience** ------------------------------ * iOS SDK development in Swift, or building SDKs that third\-party developers install and depend on. * Familiarity with mobile attribution: mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), SKAdNetwork or AdAttributionKit, and Apple's App Tracking Transparency. * Experience with server\-side conversion APIs such as Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or the TikTok Events API. * Streaming or event pipeline experience (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar) on GCP or another major cloud. * Experience in marketing, e\-commerce, or ad\-tech. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup. **Interview Process** The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Head of Software & Automation
jobs.description: **About Omicelo** ================= Omicelo is a private investment group focused on investing in businesses that increase access to quality healthcare, viable housing, wealth creation opportunities, and a thriving environment. Through its investments and partnerships, Omicelo works to help mission\-aligned businesses scale while creating meaningful, measurable impact. Omicelo values trust, listening, strong partnerships, innovation, and accountability. We believe that timely access to accurate information and effective technology are essential to making better decisions and scaling our impact.**Position Overview** --------------------- The Head of Software \& Automation is responsible for building and leading Omicelo’s Software and Automation team, a small, senior engineering group that serves Omicelo and its portfolio companies, including Havenside and Oakwell. This leader sets the technical direction for how the company builds and automates software, writes production code, and is accountable for delivering reliable systems that people across the portfolio companies actually use. Over the past several years, Omicelo has standardized on Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Fabric, built its own internal application where off\-the\-shelf software fell short, and rented proven tools where building would cost more. The Head of Software \& Automation will turn it into a shared engineering platform, a paved road, that every current and future portfolio company can build on with confidence. This is the founding leadership hire for a three\-person team: the Head, a Test Automation Engineer the Head will help hire, and a Business Automation Specialist already in seat. The role reports to one of the three Managing Partners at Omicelo and works closely with Omicelo’s Strategic Communications team (product manager, UX designer and go\-to\-market associate) and its IT team. The ideal candidate is a builder and teacher who ships working software and makes the people around them more capable with AI. They are disciplined with cost and scope: they rent before they build, automate before they add agents, and say no clearly when work isn’t worth doing. Where compliance requires completeness, “mostly done” is never good enough, and they set that standard for the team. **This is a full\-time, hybrid position based in Pittsburgh, PA. We prefer candidates within commuting distance of Pittsburgh, but welcome applicants from across the U.S.****Job Duties \& Responsibilities** ---------------------------------- ### ***Platform and Architecture*** * Design, build and own the paved road: the consolidated set of technologies, security posture and shared services (sign\-in, tenancy, audit, background jobs) that augments Omicelo’s existing tools and lets the team build with confidence. * Own the integration layer that connects core platforms such as Salesforce, Sage, Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft 365, favoring direct, reliable API automations over AI agents wherever possible to keep costs low. * Own the coded component library and the back ends of internally built software. ### ***Delivery and Leadership*** * Decide what is rented, built or declined, weighing each case on its merits and recording the reason for every decline. * Deliver the paved road and a steady flow of new systems and major features each year, while keeping support work from crowding out new development. * Hire, lead and develop the team; run a monthly portfolio intake review and a weekly demo with business leaders, Strategic Communications and IT. ### ***AI, Quality and Security*** * Build the infrastructure that keeps AI costs low, including a model gateway with spend limits, and optimize the agents and automations that colleagues across Omicelo build themselves. * Set up agentic development tooling for building, testing and security review, and teach the whole organization, not only engineers, to use AI tools with discipline. * Own the security pipeline (scanning, threat models and release gates), and work with the SVP of IT and a fractional security advisor on a library of pre\-approved security patterns, so compliance\-bound work is complete before it ships. **Required Skills** ------------------- * Production experience on Azure, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID; Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Spark strongly preferred. * Fluency in JavaScript or TypeScript on Node.js, Python and SQL, with front\-end experience building component libraries. * AI and LLM features shipped in production, with a record of keeping costs low. * CI/CD, infrastructure as code and secure\-by\-default engineering. * Experience integrating with SaaS platforms such as Salesforce and Sage, including vendors that restrict API access. **Qualifications and Experience** --------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Minimum of 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including at least five years in management leading engineers or a platform. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Success in this role means that every current and future Omicelo portfolio company can build on a shared, secure and cost\-conscious platform with confidence. The Head of Software \& Automation will be a trusted technology leader who:* Delivers a map of the technology infrastructure Omicelo needs within the first month, built from time spent learning its systems and its people. * Establishes the paved road as the default way portfolio companies build. * Ships reliable systems that people across the portfolio companies actually use. * Keeps AI and automation costs low. * Makes sure compliance\-bound work is complete before it ships. * Helps colleagues across Omicelo use AI tools with discipline. * Builds a strong team and trusted relationships with business leaders, Strategic Communications and IT. **Competitive Benefits** ------------------------ * Compensation of $150,000–$200,000, depending on experience and skills * Medical, dental \& vision coverage * Company\-paid life and short/long\-term disability insurance * HSA \+ FSA programs * Voluntary accident \& critical\-illness coverage * 401(k) with company match * Paid company holidays, floating holiday, and PTO * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) *Omicelo is an E\-Verify and equal opportunity employer.* sbG3Xxm2Aa

jobs.title: AI Enablement Architect - Product AI Engineering
jobs.description: Overview: The AI Enablement Architect is responsible for enabling the adoption and effective use of AI across the organization’s end\-to\-end product and software delivery lifecycle. This role operates at the intersection of enablement, operations, and governance, helping teams integrate AI into their workflows in a way that improves productivity, consistency, and quality while aligning with enterprise standards. Rather than focusing on a single function, the AI Enablement Architect contributes to how AI is applied across multiple domains, including product research, prototyping, engineering, quality, DevOps, and operations. This role translates domain expertise into AI\-enabled workflows, prompts, automation, and guardrails, ensuring AI is used in a scalable, consistent, and practical way across the organization. Starting base pay for this role is between $140,000 and $175,000\. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states). Responsibilities: *AI Enablement** Defines how AI tools are used within real workflows across Product and Engineering functions. * Designs and implements AI\-assisted workflows that integrate naturally into day\-to\-day work. * Enables teams to effectively adopt AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Replit, and similar platforms. * Identifies opportunities where AI can accelerate delivery, improve quality, or reduce manual effort. *AI Operations** Develops and maintains prompts, instruction sets, and reusable AI patterns. * Builds and refines AI\-assisted workflows such as: * Requirements generation and refinement * Code and prototype generation * Test creation and validation * Documentation generation * Incident analysis and operational support * Continuously improves AI outputs based on feedback and observed usage. *AI Governance** Ensures AI usage aligns with enterprise architecture, security policies, and Engineering standards. * Embeds guardrails into prompts, workflows, and AI\-assisted processes. * Standardizes how AI is used across teams to reduce fragmentation and inconsistency. * Partners with Architecture and Security teams to evolve governance approaches for AI\-enabled delivery. *Functional Focus (Role Specialization)** This role is typically aligned to a primary functional domain of our Product AI Engineering team while maintaining the same core responsibilities. * The primary AI harness used by this team is Replit and key responsibilities would center around optimizing the Replit harness. * The PAIE team’s use of Replit operates as its own software factory nested within the organization’s cross\-functional SDLC. This role designs and governs the interfaces between the two so that Replit\-based delivery stays consistent with enterprise standards. + Examples include: - Aiding in the overall administration of Replit such managing workspaces or other Admin level features. - Enabling source control and other devops controls. - Agent skill building, management and governance. - Template building, management and governance. - Partner with design system implementation and management - Overall context engineering by managing Replit instructions, skills and mcp’s. - Education around use best practices for the engineering team. - Governance/Adoption planning and implementation - Defining how the Replit\-based software factory connects to the cross\-functional SDLC, including handoffs, review gates, and shared delivery standards. - Enabling the ability to track devops metrics to determine ROI for Replit and AIDLC. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field * 3\+ years of experience in software engineering or product engineering * Strong understanding of modern software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices * Experience working with developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud\-based environments * 1\+ years of demonstrated experience with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Replit, or similar) * Ability to translate technical workflows into repeatable processes or automation * Strong collaboration and communication skills across technical and non\-technical teams *Preferred Qualifications:** Experience with .NET/C\#, React, and AWS * Experience in software architecture, platform engineering, or developer experience roles * Experience with prompt engineering or AI workflow design * Familiarity with governance, security, or compliance considerations in software delivery * Experience enabling or scaling developer productivity across teams * Exposure to multiple functional domains (e.g., engineering \+ DevOps, or product \+ engineering) Benefits: * Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses * Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available\*\* * All full\-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote * Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance * Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements * Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account * Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4% * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential \& Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work\-related complications * Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role\-specific certifications * Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management * Additional coverages available – Pet Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Voluntary Life \& AD\&D coverage *\*\*Flexible PTO not available in California or the UK* Who We Are: Origami Risk delivers single\-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management. Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results. A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award\-winning software solutions. *Origami Risk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We thrive and benefit from diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We do not discriminate against any individual based upon race, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, color, sex, national origin, age, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* ***Caution****: Be alert to recruiting scams. We have received reports of individuals impersonating Origami Risk recruiters to deceive candidates into disclosing personal information. These impostors use fake Origami Risk domain names and email addresses. Please double\-check that any email address from an Origami Risk recruiter ends with* *origamirisk.com* *or* *talent.icims.com**. And to confirm the legitimacy of any recruiting communication, feel free to email* *transparencycheck@origamirisk.com**.*

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer

jobs.description: **There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!** **Principal AI Engineer \- OutSystems** Location: Hybrid, Menlo Park, California (at least 2 days in the office). **About the Role** Join OutSystems, a global leader in software innovation, and contribute to a truly unique and evolving global culture.
