jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role.** PURE Insurance is actively investing in our data, analytics, data science, machine learning (ML), and artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. We are building IDEAS (Innovation in Data Engineering, Analytics \& Science), a centralized Data \& AI department that brings together specialists across data architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, and advanced modeling. This structure creates opportunities for collaboration and impact across every function of the insurance ecosystem, including Claims, Underwriting, Actuarial, Product, Distribution, and Finance. We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI solutions that leverage unstructured and semi\-structured data to improve business processes and member outcomes. From claim notes and inspection reports to property photos, policy documents, call recordings, and correspondence, this role will focus on transforming complex information into actionable business value. As an early member of PURE's AI Engineering function, you will play a key role in building production\-ready AI solutions, establishing engineering best practices, and helping shape the team's future capabilities. **What You'll Do.** * Design and build end\-to\-end AI solutions, from initial scoping with business partners through development, evaluation, and production deployment. * Identify and apply the most effective AI or machine learning techniques for each business problem, including large language models (LLMs) and other approaches as appropriate. * Make key technical design decisions related to document parsing, information extraction, retrieval, and context engineering. * Partner with the AVP of AI Engineering to identify common patterns across solutions and develop reusable components for PURE's AI platform. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to define success criteria and develop evaluation and validation strategies that measure real\-world performance. * Monitor AI solutions in production, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve performance as business needs evolve. * Help establish engineering standards, development practices, and technical processes as PURE's AI Engineering function grows. Mentor junior AI engineers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance as the team expands. * **What We're Looking For.** * 3–5\+ years of experience developing Python\-based AI or machine learning solutions. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building solutions that leverage large language models (LLMs). * Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and evaluating AI solutions in production environments. * Experience extracting and processing information from documents, images, and other unstructured data sources. * Strong understanding of LLM\-based applications, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and context engineering. * Experience developing evaluation frameworks and using performance metrics to guide AI solution development. * Strong engineering fundamentals, including Git, testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code reviews. * Working knowledge of major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Ability to communicate technical concepts, design decisions, and trade\-offs effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Strong problem\-solving skills and a business\-focused mindset, with an emphasis on delivering measurable results. * **What Will Make You Stand Out.** * Experience working in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry. * Experience developing computer vision solutions. * Previous experience mentoring engineers or data scientists. * Experience building APIs or endpoints using FastAPI or Flask. * Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tools such as Arize or MLflow. ‌ **What We Do** We're a member\-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices. We aim for our members to *love their insurance* . It is our mission is to create a membership experience so compelling that our members never want to leave. **Who We Are** We want to be transparent about what we expect from each other. From PURE, you can expect: *Opportunities to stretch and grow:* your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on\-the\-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards. *Clarity and kindness:* you can rely on us to be open, honest and supportive, offering clarity on what success looks like. *Support in good times and bad:* we believe in showing up for each other consistently, not only when it’s easy. You can expect a thoughtful partner, even when we disagree. *A community that cares:* we are committed to sustaining a community in which each person feels cared for as an individual. We lift each other up, celebrate wins together and support one another through challenges in work and life. **Who You Are** All of the strongest relationships are a partnership\- a two way street. So here’s what we ask of you: * Aim to bring your best every day: you’re here because you want to be part of a team that makes a real impact and aims high. * Be a student and a teacher: share your knowledge and talents and be willing to listen and learn from those around you. * Get comfortable being uncomfortable: we face tough moments and obstacles with a “courage over comfort” approach and a positive, solutions\-oriented mindset. * Be a culture builder: building a positive culture is everyone's responsibility, based on care, respect and openness to diverse perspectives. ‌ The base salary for this role can range from $130,000 to $155,000 based on a full\-time work schedule. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role.** PURE is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to help take our internal developer platform from a strong delivery foundation to a production\-grade operating platform. We are in a hardening phase prior to production launch, with meaningful opportunities to shape and build the capabilities that come next. You’ll report to, and work closely with, the AVP of Platform Engineering to build and evolve the product our teams build on. You'll treat the platform as a product: its users are engineers, its interface is a contract they build against, and its success is measured by how much they can do without us. Platform Engineering sits within PURE’s AI Engineering group, but this isn’t an AI role: dedicated AI engineers build the applications, and you’ll build the platform that they, and teams across IDEAS, run on. The platform’s build\-and\-release foundation is substantially in place: declarative service registration, versioned Terraform modules, and PR\-gated promotion of immutable artifacts across four environments. We run on ECS today, a deliberate choice that keeps our time on platform capabilities rather than cluster operations. The next chapter is making it production\-grade and enabling additional self\-service. This is a hands\-on execution role that values quality over speed: we build reliability in up front rather than relying on heroics later. You’ll own meaningful work early on, with decision\-making scope that grows over time, and your contributions will help define a platform that is still taking shape. **What you'll do.** * Own the platform’s HCP Terraform Stacks and modules end to end, shipping versioned, backward\-compatible releases so consuming teams can adopt new capabilities without disrupting what they already run. * Build and extend the reusable GitHub Actions workflows that take every service from commit to production, keeping promotion across environments safe and consistent. * Own the platform’s observability and reliability, recommend and implement the tools, standards, and practices that make reliability a property of the platform, so problems are caught early and rarely reach the teams who depend on it. * Build the self\-service experience: golden paths, automated onboarding, and the documentation that lets a new team ship. * Work directly with teams onboarding to the platform, treating their feedback as product input and turning recurring friction into platform features. * Own the quality gates every service inherits, building tests, scans, and policies into the platform so the right way is the default. * Contribute to how the platform’s compute layer, language support, and shared libraries evolve, evaluating options and bringing recommendations as the services and teams on it diversify. Make the platform measurable, from delivery performance through DORA to cost by service and business area, so the team can see where to invest next. * **What you'll need.** We are looking for a hands\-on platform engineer who has built and operated production infrastructure, not just provisioned it. If a narrowly scoped role would bore you, this one won’t. Experience in insurance or financial services is a plus. * **Why join PURE.** * Be the first hire on a platform team that is genuinely building something new, with a working foundation already in place and real influence over what comes next. * Work on infrastructure that matters: the platform underpins data, analytics, and ML/AI services that teams across PURE rely on, and every capability you build is inherited by every service on it. * Work on hard problems with room to explore, experiment, and build, guided by a high quality bar rather than unnecessary process. * Operate in a culture that takes curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship seriously, and that measures platform success by the velocity and stability it gives the teams who use it. * Join a well\-funded, growing IDEAS organization, working alongside colleagues driven by excellence and building the relationships and trust that great engineering depends on. * This is a remote position. The team tries to meet in person approximately 1\-2 times per year for department on\-sites (typically 3–4 days per trip, including travel), with optional opportunities to attend relevant industry or technology conferences. ‌ **What We Do** We're a member\-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices. From PURE, you can expect: *Opportunities to stretch and grow:* your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on\-the\-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards. *Clarity and kindness:* you can rely on us to be open, honest and supportive, offering clarity on what success looks like. *Support in good times and bad:* we believe in showing up for each other consistently, not only when it’s easy. We lift each other up, celebrate wins together and support one another through challenges in work and life. **Who You Are** All of the strongest relationships are a partnership\- a two way street. So here’s what we ask of you: * Aim to bring your best every day: you’re here because you want to be part of a team that makes a real impact and aims high. * Be a student and a teacher: share your knowledge and talents and be willing to listen and learn from those around you. * Get comfortable being uncomfortable: we face tough moments and obstacles with a “courage over comfort” approach and a positive, solutions\-oriented mindset. * Be a culture builder: building a positive culture is everyone's responsibility, based on care, respect and openness to diverse perspectives. ‌ The base salary for this role can range from $145,000 to $175,000 based on a full\-time work schedule. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Growth Engineer (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description: **The Mission** --------------- More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2\.6 billion and 12\.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people. AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data. What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk. Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford\-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences. We run these experiments in an AI\-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature. It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised \~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3\.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way. The opportunity is generational. We're building the first scaled engine for real human biological data, and using it to know which drugs will work in people before they ever reach a trial. **Your Skills** --------------- Must have experience in high\-scale B2C Growth (Acquisition, Activation, and Retention) and be able to design AI\-powered growth loops **Parallel Bio is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: **Build the Path Forward** ========================== At Path Robotics, we're building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI\-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field\-ready AI that is risk\-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real\-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. You'll frame real robot problems as well\-defined ML problems, train models on data that a fleet of production robotic cells generates every day, and ship them into a production stack where they work alongside classical planning and perception. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Frame open\-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well\-defined ML problems. * Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models. * Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits. * Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines. * Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics. * Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure\-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods. * Own your models end to end, from prototype to deployment on live robotic cells, with low\-latency inference and monitoring. **Who You Are** --------------- * An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field. * 2\+ years of applied machine learning for robotics or autonomy, in research or industry. * Fluent in Python with PyTorch or JAX, and experienced training, evaluating, and deploying deep learning models. * Strong foundations in linear algebra, 3D geometry, kinematics, and optimization. * You've run your methods on real robot hardware. * You explain model results and their limits clearly, so planning, perception, and field teams know when to trust them. **Preferred** ------------- * C\+\+, and experience deploying models into a C\+\+ or ROS 2 production stack. * Motion planning, trajectory optimization, or collision checking. * Active perception, next\-best\-view or informative path planning, or 3D point cloud learning. * Uncertainty estimation and calibration, or Bayesian and information\-theoretic planning. * GPU inference optimization (CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX). * Simulation and sim\-to\-real transfer (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo). * Publications at RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or similar venues. **Why You'll Love Working Here** * Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team * Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total) * 401(k) retirement plan through Empower * Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team! **Who We Are** -------------- At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path\-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Sustaining
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Electrical Engineer, Sustaining **Department:** Hardware Engineering **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Location:** Houston, TX (on\-site) **Travel:** 10% **Who We Are** Persona is building humanoid robots for the most demanding environments in heavy industry — shipyards, steel mills, fabrication facilities, and offshore platforms — performing welding, grinding, maintenance, inspection, and material\-handling work that is dangerous, physically demanding, and increasingly difficult to staff. We are backed by leading strategic and financial investors and engaged with global industrial leaders across Korea, Japan, the United States, and Singapore. Korea is the center of gravity for our early commercial strategy, anchored by relationships with the world’s leading shipbuilders and steelmakers. Our work spans both the robot platform itself and the systems, partners, and playbooks required to deploy it at scale. **Why Join Persona?** * We offer competitive compensation, a performance\-based bonus, 100% employer covered medical benefits for most healthcare plans, early\-stage equity, competitive PTO, and company\-wide paid winter break between December 24th and January 2nd. * You’ll shape technology that’s redefining the possibilities of robotics and human interaction. * Work alongside passionate teammates who value creativity, and continuous learning. **About the Role** We’re looking for a Senior Sustaining Electrical Engineer to own the electronics we already have deployed on our robots. As we scale production, this role ensures our deployed and in\-production designs stay healthy, easy to build, and flexible enough to meet new customer needs. You will sit between our product\-focused design engineers and our manufacturing and field operations teams. When a board fails on the line, a robot misbehaves in the field, or a customer application needs something added or done differently, you are the person who troubleshoots it, finds the root cause, and drives the fix — whether that’s a rework, a component change, a design modification, or a documentation update. This is not a forward\-looking design role. It’s a role for an experienced, hands\-on engineer who thrives on variety, can juggle many inputs at once, and has the people skills to work across manufacturing, field ops, firmware, and design teams. Expect broad scope and lots of different problems: you’ll often be the filter and the bridge that closes the gap between manufacturing and operations. If you’ve supported products through their lifecycle and enjoy making shipped hardware work better at scale, we’d love to hear from you. **What You Will Be Doing** * Own deployed electrical designs across the robot — PCBAs, harnesses, and rigid\-flex assemblies for actuators, sensors, perception, compute, and power — keeping them reliable, manufacturable, and supportable through their lifecycle. * Serve as the primary electrical interface to manufacturing and field operations: triage incoming issues, prioritize across many inputs, and act as the filter between production, ops, and the product design team. * Troubleshoot and root\-cause failures on the production line and in the field, from board\-level faults to full\-robot system issues, using schematics, firmware knowledge, and lab tools (scope, logic analyzer, DMM). * Develop and implement fixes: reworks, component substitutions, ECOs, and targeted design modifications to existing boards. * Adapt existing designs for new or varied customer applications when something needs to be added or done differently. * Support the battery and battery management system (BMS) in the field and in production, including diagnostics and corrective actions. * Partner with manufacturing and EMS partners on yield, DFM/DFA/DFT improvements, test coverage, and production ramp. * Design and improve test fixtures and test procedures for production and failure analysis, including test software where needed. * Own documentation for sustained designs: failure analysis reports, ECOs, troubleshooting guides, work instructions, and revision control of schematics and BOMs. * Work across sustaining and product design teams to feed field and manufacturing learnings back into future designs. * Collaborate with firmware and software teams to diagnose issues that span hardware and code. **What We Are Looking For:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. * 8\+ years of industry experience supporting production electronics, with project or program\-level ownership later in your career. * Very hands\-on: strong lab fluency with scope, logic analyzer, and DMM; you trust your measurements and can debug at both the board and system level. * Proven track record troubleshooting, root\-causing, and fixing issues in deployed or in\-production hardware. * Experience working directly with manufacturing, EMS partners, and field operations teams. * Ability to read and modify schematics and layouts in a modern ECAD tool (KiCAD, Altium, Cadence Allegro). * Solid fundamentals across mixed\-signal systems: power conversion, analog sensing, and embedded digital communication (CAN\-FD, EtherCAT, SPI, I2C, USB, Ethernet, RS485\). * A juggler: comfortable managing many simultaneous issues from many stakeholders and prioritizing what matters most. * Strong communication and people skills; you can translate between design engineers, technicians, and operations staff. * Disciplined documentation habits: ECOs, failure analysis reports, and revision control. **Bonus Skills:** * Prior experience in a sustaining engineering role. * Product lifecycle experience: supporting designs from launch through end\-of\-life, including obsolescence and component substitutions. * Test engineering experience, including designing test fixtures and writing test software. * Software development experience (Python, embedded C) for diagnostics, test automation, or firmware support. * Experience with battery systems and battery management (BMS). * Robotics, automation, or motor drive experience (BLDC/PMSM, gate drive, current sensing). * Experience supporting NPI and production ramp with overseas EMS partners. * Familiarity with IPC Class 2/3 standards and compliance requirements (FCC, CE, UL). * Experience using GitLab for revision control and reviews. ***Persona is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** ***All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.***

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Payments
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ USA \- Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Technology **About Polygon Labs** ---------------------- Polygon Labs is a global blockchain payments company building and operating infrastructure to move money instantly, reliably, and at internet scale, with the mission to move all money onchain. It is building the Polygon Open Money Stack, an open and integrated stack of services and technologies to instantly and reliably move money anywhere, and put it to work. Its infrastructure has facilitated trillions of dollars in onchain value transfer and supported millions of transactions daily for some of the globe's largest banks, fintechs, enterprises, and consumer applications. **Your Role** ------------- Polygon is building the Open Money Stack: one API for moving money anywhere and putting it to work. It's live, and the work spans US and international money movement. A typical integration takes four to eight weeks. The path from contract to production is split across Sales, Compliance, Customer Success, and Engineering. Core product managers and engineers get pulled into enablement and troubleshooting. No one owns the hands\-on integration work end to end. This role does. You'll embed with a customer's product managers and engineers, write code next to them, and drive the integration live. You own the technical execution, from the pre\-sales conversations to the first production transaction. Then you work yourself out of the loop, so the next customer, or their AI, can integrate without asking anyone on our side. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **Embedded integration and delivery (the core of the job)** * Own the path from contract to production: discovery, solution design, environment setup, API and webhook enablement, testing through UAT and failure modes, go\-live sign\-off, and first\-transaction hypercare. * Embed with the customer's engineers, on\-site if it moves the work faster, and hold them to milestones so weeks become days. * Integrate customers across the OMS APIs. * Handle the hard parts: key rotation, webhook signing, retries, idempotency, error handling, and reconciliation. ### **Pre\-sales and solution design** * Answer the technical questions on prospect calls with BD and in the follow\-ups, going deeper than Sales or Product can. Then write the answer down in KB articles so nobody asks it again. * Lead discovery on legacy payments systems, fund flows, and compliance constraints, and write the integration plan we share early in the sale. ### **Keep core Engineering building** * Triage partner issues yourself, with access to code, logs, and transaction data, so most never reach core Engineering. * When one is a real bug, bring Engineering a scoped ticket: reproduction, impact, logs, recommended fix. ### **Automate the integration path (out of the work, not instead of it)** * Turn each bespoke integration into reusable assets: SDKs, runbooks, partner docs, and automation for the steps that repeat, like KYB intake, staging keys, and go\-live gates. * Raise the API and integration docs and machine\-readable specs to where a developer, or the customer's own AI coding agent, can integrate us without talking to anyone on our side. * Build the agents that answer partners' integration questions, so the same question is never answered twice. ### **Product and roadmap feedback** * Bring Product and Engineering feedback grounded in demand across several customers, not one\-off asks. **The reality of this role** ---------------------------- We want this clear up front, because fit matters. * This is hands\-on. You will write code every day. It is not a pre\-sales\-only or architecture\-only seat, and not a coordinator seat: you solve the problem; you don't track it. * The stack is proprietary and parts of it are still being documented. You will often build the docs and tooling that don't exist yet. * Most partners are large, slow\-moving organizations, many outside the US. * The stack changes weekly and nobody will hand you a plan. You should want that. What You'll Need **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Deep US payments rails experience: ACH pull and push, settlement windows, reconciliation, fund flows, money movement. This is the top thing we're hiring for. You don't need to have lived in the US. * 5\+ years shipping production software, ideally payments. Forward deployed or implementation experience is ideal. A solutions engineer who codes is absolute the floor, not the target. * Hard integrations you shipped to production and can walk through, in at least one mainstream language (TypeScript, Python, Go, or similar). Not prototypes and slideware. * Comfortable embedding with a customer's team, working from incomplete docs (and helping complete them), and explaining the system to a developer and a CFO. * A reflex to automate. Once you've done a step twice, you build the tool, doc, or agent that removes it. ### **Technical profile and AI fluency** * Hands\-on with APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and authentication. You've built systems that scale and can read and contribute to a customer's codebase. * AI\-native in how you work: AI coding tools for demos and middleware, AI for docs, and building agents as needs come up. Be ready to show it. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Wallets, stablecoins, onchain payments, or crypto rails. We'll teach the crypto side to the right payments engineer. * Non\-US rails and regulation (SPEI, PIX, SEPA, PSD2, SCA, Open Banking). * Compliance\-driven design in regulated environments (KYB, KYC, transaction monitoring). **Polygon Labs Perks** ---------------------- The goal of the Polygon Labs total rewards program is to support the health and well\-being of you and your family. Our comprehensive compensation plan includes the following benefits for our full time employees: * Remote first global workforce * Industry leading Medical, Dental and Vision health insurance\* * Company matching 401k with 3% match\* * $1,500 Home Office Set Up Allowance (life\-time max) * $200 Annual AI Allowance * $75 Monthly internet or phone reimbursement * Flexible Time Off * Company issued laptop * Egg freezing, mental health, and employee wellness benefits * In certain countries medical, dental and vision is fully covered for employees \& their dependents. This is country and plan specific. * 401k is for United States employees only Polygon Labs is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Polygon Labs is committed to treating all people in a way that allows them to maintain their dignity and independence. We believe in integration and equal opportunity. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. If you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

jobs.title: Head of Digital Platforms Engineering & AI
jobs.description: **Location Address:** 9521 San Mateo NE Albuquerque, NM 87113\-2237 **Summary:** Presbyterian Healthcare Services (PHS) seeks an experienced technology executive to lead the engineering, delivery, and ongoing evolution of our patient\- and member\-facing digital platforms across our integrated health system and health plan. This is a senior technology leadership position requiring a strong foundation in software engineering, application architecture, as well as adaptive leadership. The successful candidate will have a demonstrated track record of building and leading technical teams responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and reliable digital solutions. The executive will lead the technology strategy, engineering execution, and operational performance of digital capabilities, including patient and member portals, mobile applications, digital access and scheduling, CRM integrations, self\-service solutions, and AI\-enabled digital interactions. The role requires someone who can operate effectively at both strategic and technical levels—setting direction with executive stakeholders while providing credible technical leadership to engineering teams, architects, and technology partners. Work Arrangement * Remote: Open to applicants in the United States, excluding IL, ND, NY, WA, and WY. * Hybrid (Strongly Preferred): For individuals within 60 miles of Albuquerque, in\-office presence is required Tuesday through Thursday. **Job Description:** **Key Areas of Accountability** **Digital Engineering \& Technology Leadership** * Lead and develop multidisciplinary technology teams responsible for digital applications, software engineering, platform integration, and technical delivery. * Own technical execution across the digital portfolio, including architecture, engineering standards, solution design, development, integration, deployment, and production support. * Establish modern software engineering practices, including Agile delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and application performance management. * Make informed technology decisions involving custom development, vendor platforms, cloud services, and enterprise integration. * Ensure solutions meet standards for scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and performance. **Digital Platforms \& Enterprise Integration** * Lead technology delivery for digital patient and member experiences, including portals, mobile applications, digital front door, scheduling, access, virtual care, and omnichannel communication. * Provide technical oversight of API\-driven architectures, middleware, identity management, CRM integrations, and interoperability. * Oversee the integration of digital solutions with Epic, health plan technology platforms, and other enterprise systems. * Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and data teams to ensure sound technology decisions and alignment with enterprise standards. * Manage technology partners and vendors, with accountability for architecture, implementation quality, integration, and operational performance. **AI\-Enabled Digital Solutions** * Lead the technical evaluation, integration, implementation, and scaling of AI\-enabled capabilities within patient\- and member\-facing digital platforms. * Oversee solutions involving conversational AI, virtual assistants, intelligent self\-service, personalization, and workflow automation. * Evaluate AI technology architectures, including vendor solutions, APIs, model integration approaches, security requirements, and operational readiness. * Ensure AI\-enabled applications align with enterprise AI governance, data privacy, security, and responsible AI standards. * Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, supportable technology solutions that deliver measurable business value. *This position is accountable for AI within digital applications, not the overall enterprise AI strategy.* **Technology Strategy, Execution \& Operational Accountability** * Develop and execute a multiyear digital technology roadmap aligned with organizational and business priorities. * Lead technology planning, engineering capacity management, portfolio prioritization, budgeting, and vendor performance. * Establish measurable accountability for delivery quality, platform reliability, adoption, technical debt, and business outcomes. * Balance innovation with operational stability, cybersecurity, cost management, and long\-term platform sustainability. * Serve as a senior technology leader and trusted partner to clinical, health plan, operational, and executive stakeholders. **Additional Job Description:** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrated technical experience. * 15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise technology, software engineering, application development, or digital platform delivery, includ logy platform teams in a complex enterprise environment. * Strong working knowledge of modern application architectures, APIs, cloud platforms, systems integration, software development lifecycle practices, and enterprise technology delivery. * Proven accountability for delivering and operating complex, business\-critical technology platforms. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical architectures, challenge engineering decisions constructively, and communicate technical tradeoffs effectively. * Experience managing technology leaders, engineering organizations, budgets, external vendors, and complex delivery portfolios. * Strong executive communication skills and the ability to translate business objectives into executable technology strategies. **Candidates must demonstrate substantial technology and engineering leadership experience. Clinical, operational, product, or digital transformation leadership experience alone, without direct accountability for technical teams and technology delivery, does not meet the requirements of this position.** **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading technology platforms in healthcare, health insurance, or other complex, highly regulated industries. * Experience with Epic integration, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, health plan platforms, or CRM technologies. * Experience delivering consumer\-facing applications at enterprise scale. * Experience deploying AI\-enabled applications, conversational AI, or intelligent automation in production environments. * Experience with cloud\-native architectures, API management, modern DevOps practices, and enterprise identity solutions. * Experience operating in an integrated payer\-provider environment. **Benefits** Benefits are effective day\-one (for .45 FTE and above) and include: * Competitive salaries * Full medical, dental and vision insurance * Flexible spending accounts (FSAs) * Free wellness programs * Paid time off (PTO) * Retirement plans, including matching employer contributions * Continuing education and career development opportunities * Life insurance and short/long term disability programs **About Us** Presbyterian Healthcare Services is a locally owned, not\-for\-profit healthcare system of nine hospitals, a statewide health plan and a growing multi\-specialty medical group. Founded in New Mexico in 1908, it is the state's largest private employer with approximately 11,000 employees. Presbyterian's story is really the story of the remarkable people who have chosen to work here. Starting with Reverend Cooper who began our journey in 1908, the hard work of thousands of physicians, employees, board members, and other volunteers brought Presbyterian from a tiny tuberculosis sanatorium to a statewide healthcare system, serving more than 700,000 New Mexicans. We are part of New Mexico's history \- and committed to its future. That is why we will continue to work just as hard and care just as deeply to serve New Mexico for years to come. **About New Mexico** New Mexico's unique blend of Spanish, Mexican and Native American influences contribute to a culturally rich lifestyle. Add in Albuquerque's International Balloon Fiesta, Los Alamos' nuclear scientists, Roswell's visitors from outer space, and Santa Fe's artists, and you get an eclectic mix of people, places and experiences that make this state great. Cities in New Mexico are continually ranked among the nation's best places to work and live by Forbes magazine, Kiplinger's Personal Finance, and other corporate and government relocation managers like Worldwide ERC. New Mexico offers endless recreational opportunities to explore, and enjoy an active lifestyle. Venture off the beaten path, challenge your body in the elements, or open yourself up to the expansive sky. From hiking, golfing and biking to skiing, snowboarding and boating, it's all available among our beautiful wonders of the west. AA/EOE/VET/DISABLED. PHS is a drug\-free and tobacco\-free employer with smoke free campuses.

jobs.description: **Job title:** Director, Engineering \- Quality Assurance**Reports to:** Chief Information Officer**Division:** Central Services**Location:** US or Waterloo**Grade:** 23 **About Priority Commerce:** Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue \- empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter. We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities. At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** \- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive. **About the Role:** The Director of QA plays a key role in protecting the reliability and integrity of Priority’s commerce platform by owning the strategy, people, and practices that ensure software is tested thoroughly before it reaches our clients. predictable delivery across Priority’s products. **Responsibilities:*** Defines and owns the enterprise QA strategy, roadmap, standards, and quality governance across all engineering teams and products. * Builds, leads, and develops a high\-performing QA organization of managers, QA engineers, and automation (SDET) engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning. * Directs the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) covering UI, API, integration, and regression testing. * Partners with Engineering and DevOps to integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling shift\-left testing and fast, reliable release cycles. * Oversees performance, load, and capacity testing, and partners with Security to incorporate security testing (SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation) into the release process. * Establishes and reports QA metrics and KPIs (e.g., defect escape rate, defect density, automation coverage, test pass rate, mean time to detect/resolve, release quality) to engineering and executive leadership. * Owns defect management and triage processes, including severity/priority standards, root cause analysis, and closing the loop on production incidents with targeted regression coverage. * Embeds QA practices within Agile/Scrum teams and the SDLC, ensuring testability, clear acceptance criteria, and test planning from requirements through production. * Ensures testing practices, test data management, and release evidence support PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, and other applicable regulatory and audit requirements. * Manages QA tooling, test environments, budget, and any outsourced or partner QA resources to deliver quality at scale and at an appropriate cost. * Collaborates cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, SRE, Application Support, Security, and Compliance to align quality goals with business priorities and customer outcomes. **What Success Looks Like:*** Customer\-impacting incidents and production defects attributable to escaped defects are measurably and consistently reduced. * Releases ship on a predictable cadence with automated quality gates in CI/CD, and teams trust the test suite to tell them when something is wrong. * Automation coverage of critical payment, funding, and user journeys grows steadily, while manual regression effort and cycle time decline. * Performance and load testing identify capacity and scalability risks before they reach production. * QA metrics and KPIs are visible, trusted, and used by engineering and executive leadership to make release and investment decisions. * Audits and customer assessments find well\-evidenced testing and change controls with no surprises. * The QA organization is viewed as a trusted partner that accelerates delivery rather than a bottleneck, with strong talent retention and a clear growth path for team members. **Candidate Requirements:**### **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 10\+ years of experience in software quality assurance and testing, including 5\+ years in QA leadership roles managing managers and/or multiple teams. * Proven track record of building and scaling QA organizations and establishing QA strategy, standards, and processes across multiple products or teams. * Hands\-on expertise with modern test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured). * Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps). * Experience leading performance/load testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, LoadRunner) and partnering on security testing practices. * Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, the SDLC, and defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray). * Demonstrated ability to define, track, and report QA metrics and KPIs to drive continuous improvement. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences. ### **Preferred** * Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated financial services environments. * Working awareness of PCI\-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and related compliance requirements as they apply to testing, test data, and change management. * Experience testing cloud\-native and distributed architectures (AWS preferred), microservices, and high\-volume transaction systems. * Experience managing offshore, nearshore, or outsourced QA partners. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C\#) used for test automation. * Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level, CSTE, or Certified Scrum Master (CSM). **Work Environment \& Culture:** We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand \- *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real\-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600\+ sensors deployed across 25\+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission\-driven, high\-velocity team building dual\-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators. **Job Description** ------------------- The SmartMast is a sophisticated, vessel\-mounted edge computing platform running a dense software stack on NVIDIA Jetson hardware in maritime environments: salt air, vibration, intermittent connectivity, and real operational pressure. We need a Senior Embedded Linux / Platform Software Engineer who can own the software that runs at the tip of our spear. You will build and maintain the embedded Linux platform that integrates HD cameras, radar, SDR, AIS receivers, GPS, and thermal sensors into a unified, AI\-capable sensing system. You will work at the intersection of hardware bringup, ROS2\-based sensor middleware, edge inference pipelines, and the cloud connectivity layer that gets data from the vessel to our analysts in near real time. This is complex, meaningful work, and it ships to sea. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own and evolve the embedded Linux platform for SmartMast edge devices. * Integrate and maintain sensor interfaces across cameras, radar, SDR, AIS, GPS/GNSS, and thermal systems. * Build and maintain modular middleware and services (including ROS2\-based components) for reliable inter\-process and inter\-sensor communication. * Develop and optimize edge AI inference pipelines for detection, segmentation, and classification under real compute and bandwidth constraints. * Design and improve edge\-to\-cloud data paths for latency, resilience, and efficient bandwidth usage in constrained maritime networks. * Manage OTA update workflows for fleet\-deployed devices, including staged rollout validation and rollback strategies. * Debug production issues from field signals/telemetry, drive root\-cause analysis, and ship durable fixes quickly. * Partner closely with hardware, software, and operations teams to bring systems from lab to vessel deployment. * Lead PTZ camera integration decisions spanning lens selection, sensor convergence/alignment, and stabilization tuning, and translate those tradeoffs into measurable improvements in edge ML performance (detection, classification, tracking robustness). **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * 4\+ years of experience in software development for robotics, electronics, and embedded systems. * Over 4 years of proficiency in Python, C\+\+, and shell scripting. Rust is a bonus. * Solid experience with Linux, particularly the Ubuntu flavor. * Experience with robotics frameworks such as ROS/ROS2\. * Experience in mobile/embedded platform development, specifically with NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, and Yocto. * Familiarity with various sensors and hardware, including GPS, IMU, cameras, Radar, and weather sensors, as well as driver development for these devices. * Experience with industrial PTZ network cameras and video streaming technologies. * Hands\-on experience with sensor fusion techniques (Kalman/EKF, particle filters, or learned fusion approaches) across radar, EO/IR, and positioning data. * Expertise in developing and deploying AI/ML models for visual tasks, including detection, segmentation, and classification. * Experience with OTA update systems and device fleet management at scale. * Experience working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, including cloud\-native ingestion services. * Solid foundational networking skills, including diagnosing and resolving connectivity issues. * Experience with remote access management protocols like SSH and VNC. * Problem\-solving and results\-driven mindset. * Flexibility and resilience to thrive in a dynamic environment. Compensation Range: $200K \- $225K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robotics Simulation & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Multimedia Systems **General Summary:** **About Qualcomm Robotics** The Qualcomm Advanced Robotics Team is building the AI\-first stack for the next generation of general\-purpose robots — from AMRs and cobots to emerging humanoids — pairing heterogeneous compute (CPU/GPU/DSP/NPU) with a full Robotics SDK, an integrated simulation platform, and AI operations infrastructure. With our high\-performance robotics SoCs, workloads that previously required the cloud now run on\-device, at the edge, at scale. **About This Team** We build AI infrastructure for modern robotics. The simulator is a central tool in it: a modern platform developed in\-house, built on high\-performance computing and open data formats such as OpenUSD, URDF, and glTF, intended to be best\-in\-class, and tuned for Qualcomm robotics SoCs and the robots they run on. The robots span the field — tabletop manipulation with robotic arms, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long\-horizon tasks that carry a robot through multi\-stage scenes requiring reasoning over many steps. This is a ground\-up software effort: runtime architecture, performance, clean APIs, and developer tooling. The simulator is a first\-class target on both developer workstations and cloud compute — interactive authoring and vectorized GPU environments locally, orchestrated headless jobs at scale in the cloud. We use it to train policies, generate synthetic data for robot foundation models, gate software releases in CI, run hardware\-in\-the\-loop against real silicon, and close the sim\-to\-real gap on deployed robots. We deliver jointly with Qualcomm’s AI operations workstreams, and a meaningful slice of the engineering sits where simulation plugs into the training, dataset, and deployment infrastructure they own. **The Opportunity** You will own significant pieces of a simulation platform on the critical path of Qualcomm’s robotics products — the runtime and its abstractions, the physics and rendering integrations, the training and data\-generation paths, the HIL and CI plumbing, or the developer experience that makes all of it usable by robotics engineers who are not simulation specialists — across robot arms, legged platforms, and mobile robots. This is first and foremost a simulation role — roughly 80% of the work is the simulator itself as a critical platform component. The remaining \~20% is AI infrastructure enablement: integrating simulation into the training, dataset, and deployment pipelines owned by the AI operations team, working with them rather than replacing them. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build core simulator subsystems — scene representation and authoring, physics backends, sensor models, rendering — across the scenarios our robots work in: tabletop manipulation, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long\-horizon, multi\-stage tasks. * Profile and optimize simulation and training workloads — physics solvers, rendering, data pipelines — so interactive workstation sessions and training throughput at scale stay high. * Integrate and extend best\-in\-class open engines — GPU physics, USD/Hydra rendering, offline path tracing — behind clean, swappable interfaces. * Build high\-throughput paths for policy training and synthetic data generation: vectorized environments, GPU\-resident state, procedural scene variation, domain randomization, and ground\-truth labeling — consistent from an interactive workstation session to scheduled headless runs in the cloud. * Make simulation a release gate: scenario suites, deterministic replay, benchmarks, and metrics that catch regressions before they reach hardware. * Enable the continuous learning workflows that simulation feeds into, in partnership with the AI operations team: make simulation a first\-class, config\-driven stage in collect–merge–train–eval pipelines with reproducible run manifests and artifacts, so the same experiment runs locally and as containerized GPU jobs (Argo Workflows on Kubernetes) without the sim engineer owning the surrounding infrastructure. * Stand up hardware\-in\-the\-loop configurations: production robotics software running on Qualcomm silicon in communication with the simulator on the host workstation or cloud, and quantify where simulation and reality diverge — system identification, contact and actuator modeling, sensor noise, measured transfer results. * Partner with AI operations, perception, controls, and silicon teams, and own the design docs, reviews, tests, and APIs others depend on. **Who We Look For** * Strong software engineering fundamentals, with production code you can talk through in depth. * A working grasp of simulation as applied to robotics: rigid\-body dynamics, kinematics, coordinate frames, numerical integration, or sensor models. — or the aptitude to build one quickly; engineers from games, graphics, and ML infrastructure back achine learning for robotics: reinforcement learning at scale, imitation learning, robot foundation models and VLAs, PyTorch. * 3D graphics and scene pipelines: OpenUSD composition, PBR materials, real\-time and offline rendering, sensor simulation. * Robotics and distributed systems: ROS 2/DDS, URDF/MJCF, pub/sub and schema\-driven wire formats, containers, cluster orchestration, and CI/CD for compute\-heavy workloads. * Working fluency in the AI infrastructure around simulation — enough to integrate with it and partner effectively with the AI operations team (who own it), not to run it yourself: Kubernetes\-native workflow orchestration (Argo Workflows or similar), containerized GPU jobs and shared\-storage datalakes (NFS/PVC volumes), config\-driven experiment frameworks, checkpoint/resume semantics, and experiment tracking (TensorBoard, Weights \& Biases). * Effective leverage of modern AI tools as a core engineering skill: frontier AI models, AI coding and agentic workflows, AI\-assisted learning for ramping on new domains quickly, and building knowledge bases — personal or team — to accelerate on\-boarding and future work. We are not able to provide current or future sponsorship. **Compensation \& Rewards** Compensation for this role is $125,000 \- $145,000 with the potential for discretionary incentive compensation based on both company and individual performance. **Benefits That Support You** * Excellent health insurance packages with a Health Reimbursement Account option * Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term Disability and Travel Insurance * 401k plan with company match dollar for dollar up to 6 percent\* * Generous time\-off policy with paid time off (PTO), volunteer time off (VTO), birthday PTO, and company\-observed holidays * Monthly stipend for wellness activities and mental health\* * Tuition reimbursement * Pet Benefits, including insurance, discounts, “pawternity” PTO day, and more * Bonus/commission plan for qualifying roles * Employee perks (including mortgage discounts!) * PTO purchase and sell\-back programs * Rewards and peer recognition programs * Trust\-based, out\-come oriented remote work environment for most roles * *After 6 months of service* **Interview Process \& AI Usage** We embrace technology and are enthusiastic about the role AI can play in helping people work more effectively. jobs.title: GCP Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** RCH Solutions is a rapidly growing global provider of computational science expertise within Life Sciences and Healthcare. At RCH, our team rallies around a culture crafted for learning and achieving. We’re relentless in our pursuit for innovation and demanding of ourselves to deliver a ground\-breaking computing experience for our clients, so that they can deliver life\-saving science to humanity. **Core Values** At RCH, our Core Values are more than just words—they represent the threads that weave together the fabric of our culture. Used as a guide when interviewing new team members; as a barometer when evaluating our performance as individuals and teams, and even when deciding which customers to work with, RCH’s Values embody the behaviors upon which we measure our success and create a framework for our growth as people and professionals. Our Core Values:* Embrace Excellence: We strive for best\-in\-class delivery of innovation and service. * Be Accountable: Integrity, ownership and accountability are non\-negotiables. * Adventure Together: We are committed to fostering a culture that embraces continuous improvement. * Succeed as a Team: We believe harnessing the power of a team drives outcomes not achievable by individuals. * Boundaries and Balance: Work\-life balance is a core facet of our culture. If you share in our core values, then we encourage you to continue reading this posting as you may have found a great home for your career. **Job Description** RCH Solutions is seeking a Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate cloud\-native services on Google Cloud Platform in support of research and bioinformatics workloads. The right candidate will develop microservices and web applications that put scientific computing directly in the hands of researchers and will build and maintain the workflow orchestration that runs bioinformatics pipelines at scale. You will function as a team member integrating cloud services, scientific applications, and upstream and downstream data systems into a coherent platform. Our ideal candidate is an experienced and talented engineer who is equally comfortable writing production code and reasoning about infrastructure, and who will be instrumental in transforming how computing services are leveraged to support our client's science. This role will involve driving architecture, roadmaps, and execution of projects that deliver GCP\-based platform services to scientific end users. You will develop and implement engineering best practices for customers and RCH applications teams; engaging in the fast\-moving realm of Life Sciences, prioritizing innovation. The cloud landscape and the bioinformatics tooling ecosystem are both continuously evolving, with new services and pipeline frameworks released constantly. You know how to distinguish hype from reality and are comfortable making recommendations that best suit our clients’ needs. **Responsibilities:*** Design, build, and deploy microservices and APIs on Google Cloud Platform to support scientific and bioinformatics workloads * Develop and maintain web applications that give researchers self\-service access to data, pipelines, and compute * Build, operate, and tune workflow orchestration for bioinformatics pipelines, including scheduling, error handling, and runtime and cost optimization * Integrate cloud services, scientific applications, and internal and third\-party data systems through well\-documented, maintainable interfaces * Ensure that all systems are compliant with company security standards and applicable regulatory requirements * Troubleshoot operational issues as they arise on supported platforms, and escalate to other IT units as necessary **Essential Qualifications:*** 3\+ years of professional experience in cloud engineering or software engineering, including production workloads on Google Cloud Platform * Experience designing and deploying microservices, including containerization and REST or gRPC API development * Experience with a workflow orchestration framework for scientific or data pipelines, such as Nextflow, Cromwell, Snakemake, or Airflow * Demonstrated systems integration experience connecting cloud services, applications, and external data sources * Web application development experience, either full stack or strong backend skills paired with working front\-end proficiency * Proficiency in Python and comfort working in a Linux environment * Excellent communication skills, including preparation of written documentation for IT colleagues and scientific end users * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Bioinformatics, or equivalent work experience **Preferred Qualifications:*** Hands\-on experience supporting bioinformatics or computational biology workloads, such as genomics and NGS pipelines, structural biology, or cheminformatics * Familiarity with GCP services including GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage * Experience with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform * Proficient in building Docker images * Experience with CI/CD for building and deploying containerized services * R, or other programming languages common in scientific computing * Has good knowledge of deploying or supporting GxP systems * Git, BitBucket, or other version control tools **Additional information** Great talent should benefit from a great work environment. If you join our team, you’ll have access to:* A competitive salary and bonus package based on experience. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance. * Company\-provided Life and Long\-Term Disability Insurance. * Company\-sponsored 401(k) Plan. * Team\-focused culture and unlimited opportunity for advancement. ***\*\*This is an onsite position and the candidate will be required to be onsite in our client facility in Collegeville, PA at least 3 days per week.*** ***\*\*Role is only open to applicants not needing sponsorship now or in the future, no third parties please.*** GsGonmNoRd

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Client Success
jobs.description: **About Rebar** --------------- Construction is a $2 trillion industry in the US alone. Most of it still runs like it’s 1995: PDFs, spreadsheets, and email. Every commercial building starts the same way. Someone opens a few hundred pages of blueprints and counts every piece of equipment, duct, and pipe by hand. Then they price it, bid it, and chase it for months. That work decides who builds what, and for how much. It has barely changed in 30 years. Rebar is building the AI platform the trades run on. Our models read blueprints the way a veteran in the trades does. Our agents then do the work that follows: counting the job, pricing it, managing the bid, and tracking it through to the order. Counts that took three days now take one. Customers spend hours a day in Rebar, and thousands of new plan sets flow through it every week. We started with HVAC contractors and their suppliers. Every other trade comes next. Here’s where we go: when a building goes up, the trades that build it run on Rebar. Agents win the job, run the job, and buy the equipment. We’re about 50 people in Union Square, growing fast, and backed by top investors. We’ve built only a fraction of what we need to. **About the Engineering Org** ----------------------------- The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware, and we're being intentional about adapting with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. Our core values are: * Everyone operates like an owner * Find a way * We win together That being said, the whole company still works really hard! This is something that you should read and internalize. This might not be the place for everyone. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a software engineer to be the technical arm of our Client Success and Implementation teams. As we sign bigger customers, every deployment comes with more technical work attached. A contractor wants their historical projects loaded in. Another wants our analytics piped into their ERP or BI tool. Another needs an API change, so their internal systems can pull takeoff data. Today, that work lands on the core engineering team as one\-off requests, pulling them off the roadmap. We want one engineer who owns it. You will still sit in the engineering org and have strong mentorship and learning. You'll come to engineering stand\-ups, ship through our normal review process, and attend retros. Your priorities come from our customers. You can think about this role almost as a forward\-deployed engineer. You'll be on calls with customers, figuring out what they actually need and then building it. You’ll get to work with messy data, API integrations, and customer expansion. We understand the challenges and sacrifices that come with joining an early\-stage startup, and we want to emphasize that we're committed to ensuring you leave as a better, more experienced engineer and leader than when you joined. Here you'll own a hard piece of client\-side engineering, and watch it scale from hundreds to thousands of users. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own customer data work * Build and maintain integrations * Handle customer API requests * Scope technical requirements with customers * Be the escalation path for technical issues * Turn one\-offs into product **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We want an engineer who likes talking to customers. You should be able to sit on a call with an estimator, understand how their team works, and then go write the script that fixes their problem. You'll be working with messy real\-world data, so you should enjoy digging into it and not be scared of a 50,000\-row CSV with inconsistent columns. We are looking for engineers with good judgment, an inquisitive attitude, and the maturity to represent engineering in front of a customer. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 2\+ years of software engineering experience, or a technical client\-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation engineer, forward deployed engineer) where you wrote real code * Strong Python for scripting and data work * Comfortable with SQL and relational databases (we're on Postgres) * Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks * Comfortable talking directly with customers, from end users to technical stakeholders * Writes things down. Your integrations and scripts should be documented well enough that someone else can run them. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Familiarity with TypeScript and React * Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) * Experience with GraphQL * Experience with integration platforms or unified APIs (e.g., Merge) * Background in construction, HVAC/mechanical, or another legacy industry * Familiarity with estimating, takeoff, ERP, or project management tools used in construction * Worked at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * **Salary**: Competitive base salary * **Equity**: Meaningful equity package, commensurate with experience * **Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * **Perks**: + Agentic tooling budget + Lunches provided, dinners provided (after a set time) + Great culture in a high\-energy office This is a full\-time, on\-site role in NYC’s Flatiron District, steps from Madison Square Park and Union Square. Occasional travel for on\-site customer visits. *Equal Opportunity* *Rebar is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $165K
