jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: You desire impactful work. **You’re** **RGA ready** RGA is a purpose\-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its *World’s Most Admired Companies*, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life\- and health\-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all. **A Brief Overview** The Lead AI Engineer leads the design and delivery of assigned AI initiatives within Americas Data Solutions, owning the architecture of complex AI systems and the engineering standards the team uses to build them. The role leads cross\-functional project teams, guides Senior AI Engineers through design review, and recommends model, platform, and vendor options to AI leadership. Impact is measured by the delivery, reliability, cost, and risk posture of the initiatives led. * Architecture \& Technical Direction: Own the architecture of assigned AI initiatives, and recommend model, build\-versus\-buy, vendor, and platform options to AI leadership, informed by structured pilots of emerging models and techniques. * Engineering Standards \& Shared Components: Build and use shared components (evaluation harnesses, guardrail libraries, observability, and deployment pipelines), applying the team's established engineering standards for quality and compliance. * Agentic Engineering Practice: Set the team's standards for building with coding agents — shared agent context, approved tools and MCP servers, permissions that prevent destructive actions, and review gates — and evolve them as tools change. * Cost \& Performance: Drive inference cost and performance for assigned initiatives through model routing and right\-sizing, caching, token budgets, and cost\-per\-transaction targets. * Program Delivery \& Shaping: Participate in and, where assigned, lead cross\-functional project teams of moderate complexity with Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, IT, Legal, and Compliance, and partner with AI Product Management to deliver measurable business outcomes. * Design Authority \& Talent Development: Participate in design reviews for assigned projects, help resolve technical questions, and act as a technical resource for colleagues with less experience. * Responsible AI \& Assurance: Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance to apply AI governance practices — human oversight, AI inventory, and audit\-ready evidence aligned to the NAIC AI Model Bulletin, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and applicable regulations. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field; OR equivalent practical software engineering experience. * 8\-12 years of software engineering experience, including 4\+ years delivering production AI/ML or LLM systems and leading their design and delivery at scale. * Experience delivering technology in a regulated industry such as insurance, healthcare, or financial services. * Building \& Deploying AI Applications: Strong ability to build multi\-component AI systems that are reliable, secure, observable, and cost\-efficient, with breadth across foundation models, grounding, agents, inference serving, and LLMOps. * Evaluation\-Driven Development: Deep expertise in evaluation and monitoring strategies that hold up under internal audit and regulatory review. * Software Engineering Fundamentals: Hands\-on currency to review design and code within the project team, and to apply architecture, data, and platform choices across AWS, Databricks, and Snowflake. * Using Coding Agents: Skilled practitioner who uses coding agents effectively — shared context, parallel workflows, verification, and safety. * Business \& User Context: Understands where AI changes the cost and risk structure of reinsurance operations and contributes to the business case for AI investments. * Business \& User Context: Quantifies where AI changes the cost and risk structure of reinsurance operations, and builds the business case for a portfolio of AI investments. * Machine Learning Foundations: Working knowledge of machine learning and deep learning sufficient to guide when ML, LLMs, or both fit a problem, and to partner effectively with Data Science. * AI Risk \& Governance: Advanced understanding of AI threat models, agent permissioning, PHI protection, and third\-party AI risk. Recommends controls that satisfy Risk and Compliance without stalling delivery. * Ownership \& Influence: Contributes to cross\-functional programs and may lead project teams without formal authority; communicates difficult concepts and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Preferred * Experience in life and health insurance or reinsurance. * Experience leading cross\-functional technical projects, engineering teams or building AI platforms used by multiple delivery teams. * Working knowledge of actuarial and underwriting workflows. * Publications, conference presentations, or open\-source contributions in applied AI. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-SP2 **What you can expect from RGA:** * Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world. * Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought. * Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential. We’re excited to get to know you and connect your unique skills with our global opportunities. To create a modern and seamless experience, we use artificial intelligence (AI) in parts of our preliminary screening process. This technology helps us personalize job recommendations, automate interview scheduling, evaluate candidates based solely on experience—without considering name, gender, or other personal details—and provide real\-time answers through our chatbot. AI is used only during early screening and never makes hiring decisions. Your RGA recruiter will work closely with you every step of the way to ensure the process feels personal, thoughtful, and focused on you. **Compensation Range:** $126,710\.00 \- $188,840\.00 Annual Base pay varies depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience and market location. In addition, RGA provides an annual bonus plan that includes all roles and some positions are eligible for participation in our long\-term equity incentive plan. RGA also maintains a full range of health, retirement, and other employee benefits. RGA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, gender identity or expression, sex, disability, veteran status, religion, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

jobs.title: Software Eng - SDK Infrastructure (Associate)
jobs.description: ROC is a cutting\-edge developer of computer vision based biometric and video analytic technologies whose product portfolio includes industry leading AI/ML algorithms and a full\-stack computer vision platform. Founded in 2015, ROC is headquartered in Denver, CO. with offices in Morgantown, WV, and Grand Rapids, MI. With over 100 full\-time employees, ROC licenses software in support of a wide range of applications including financial services, law enforcement, military, and consumer electronics. We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer to help build, test and ship the ROC SDK reliably across a wide range of platforms. In this role you will take ownership of the SDK’s build and release processing, keeping our CI/CD pipelines functioning, packaging releases across operating systems and automating manual steps so every release is faster and more reliable than the last. You will also help bring our models to edge devices by integrating, packaging, and validating them on neural processing units (NPUs) using vendor runtimes such as Qualcomm QNN and Apple Core ML. This is also a unique opportunity to work alongside scientists developing advanced computer vision algorithms. Please note that this position is strictly software engineering and will not include directly training or building machine learning models. This position is a great fit for someone who enjoys making systems work reliably across platforms and wants to build a strong foundation in C/C\+\+ and build infrastructure. Most work is performed in the Denver area, with occasional travel as needed. We encourage applications from students graduating in spring 2027 as well as experienced candidates who can join on that timeline. **The start date for this position is June 2027\.** **Responsibilities include:*** Own day\-to\-day operation of the SDK’s Buildbot CI: monitor builds, triage failures, and keep build workers healthy. * Package and release the SDK across supported platforms, including versioning, artifact verification, and release notes. * Automate manual steps in the build, test, and release process, and document what can’t be automated. * Develop, debug, and maintain features in the ROC SDK's C/C\+\+ codebase. * Help integrate machine learning models from research into the SDK. * Write and maintain unit tests, and help run and improve the test and accuracy evaluation frameworks. * Maintain and extend the SDK's language wrappers. * Integrate and maintain NPU inference backends in the SDK (e.g., Qualcomm QNN/SNPE, Apple Core ML), including converting models from research into NPU\-ready formats. **Required Skills and Experience:** * 0 to 3 years of experience in software engineering or a related field (including internships, research, or academic projects). * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or closely related field. * Proficiency in C/C\+\+, including debugging and writing clean, maintainable code. * Familiarity with version control tools such as Git. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment. * Problem\-solving mindset and willingness to learn. * Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate within a technical team. **Other Relevant Skills and Experience:*** Experience with CMake or other C/C\+\+ build systems. * Exposure to CI/CD tools and automated testing. * Experience with C/C\+\+ debugging and analysis tools such as GDB or Valgrind. * Experience with CUDA and writing high performance kernels * Exposure to building, packaging, or deploying models with ML inference runtimes such as Core ML, NPU, TensorRT, Qualcomm QNN, or SNPE. * Experience developing on Linux, as well as on macOS or Windows. * Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Basic knowledge of machine learning or computer vision concepts. **Compensation for this role includes:** * Competitive salary with opportunities for growth. * This position is eligible to participate in our annual performance bonus program and our equity incentive plan (restricted stock units). * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans. * 401(k) retirement plan with a 3% non\-elective employer contribution (ROC contributes 3% of your salary automatically, regardless of your individual contribution level). This is an exceptional opportunity for individuals eager to contribute to a cutting\-edge computer vision and machine learning company where you will collaborate with a team of experts to support state\-of\-the\-art products that serve a wide range of industries. ROC believes in a healthy work / life balance, and pays particular attention to employee needs and wellbeing. ROC provides employees with unlimited PTO, a flexible work schedule, and a hybrid work environment. Employees are dedicated and hardworking, but are encouraged to take time off to rest, reset, and focus on family and personal health. *ROC is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all races, colors, religions, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, national origins, identities, and protected veteran statuses. If you’re excited about this role and the impact you can make, we strongly encourage you to apply.* Applications for this role will be accepted until 12/09/2026\.

jobs.title: AI Enablement & Infrastructure Engineer (Contract)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **Help shape how AI works at sea, at one of the most unique communities on the planet.** We are a private residential community on a ship that never stops travelling. We're growing with AI, and what feels advanced today will look simple in a few years. We'd like you to be part of that journey: supporting our teams as they learn and build, and helping IT keep it all secure. Our teams already use AI every day, and we have a clear AI policy in place. Your job is to help them go further, faster and safely. * **Educate.** Run practical sessions for office and shipboard teams, share prompting best practices, and turn our AI Usage Policy into quick guides people actually use. * **Mature our AI products and services.** Help improve the AI tools, agents and automations we already have, so they become more reliable, useful and well supported over time. * **Support the business.** Work side by side with teams and department champions to turn good ideas into agents and apps on our approved platforms, and share the wins. * **Evaluate and manage risk.** Help teams register new agents and apps, assess their data, access and security risks, and keep safeguards in place as they grow. You'll support our Infrastructure \& Cybersecurity Manager across day\-to\-day operations and security, ashore and on board. * **Keep people productive.** Install and troubleshoot desktop apps (Microsoft 365, Teams, Adobe, browsers, AI tools) and hardware, from laptops and docks to printers, phones and meeting\-room AV. * **Run the Microsoft backbone.** Manage accounts, groups and device policies in Active Directory, Entra ID and Intune. Support SharePoint sites, permissions and sync, and Exchange Online mail flow, lists and filtering. * **Keep everyone connected.** Support wired and wireless networks, VPN, zero trust access, web security, remote desktop, and our Teams phone system and call queues. * **Onboard and offboard.** Set up laptops, accounts and apps for new joiners, and close access cleanly for leavers. * **Stay patched.** Track exploitable vulnerabilities and drive operating system and application updates and hardening, automating where possible. * **Protect and recover.** Monitor backups across cloud and on\-premises, run test restores, and help with recovery. * **Respond to threats.** Help contain and investigate incidents with our endpoint, SIEM and SOC tools, and handle phishing alerts. * **Support our cloud.** Provision, size and maintain virtual servers in Azure and AWS. * **Secure our AI.** Help assess agents and apps before go\-live, set up agent identities and approved connectors, and spot shadow AI. Who we think is the right candidate * **AI application development** — Has built and deployed an internal AI application, such as a knowledge assistant or workflow tool, using model APIs and approved company data. Can explain how the application enforces user permissions and how its outputs were tested. * **Autonomous agent development** — Has built and deployed an agent that can carry out a multi\-step business workflow and take authorized actions in connected systems. Can explain what triggers the agent, which actions it can take independently, and when it asks for human approval. * **Technical skills** — Proficient in Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, authentication, and Git. jobs.title: OT Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** RRC is seeking a talented OT Network Engineer to help us build the future of U.S. energy production from our Broomfield, Colorado office. RRC is a multi\-disciplinary engineering firm that specializes in energy projects, particularly renewable energy, throughout the United States. Founded in 2007, RRC provides a culture where employees are valued while contributing to meaningful projects. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of the evolving energy production landscape. **RRC CORE VALUES** Must understand and personify RRC’s core values:* **Client Satisfaction** – understands the goal of always exceeding our client’s expectations * **Employee Happiness** – able to work well with others, communicate clearly with coworkers, promote a positive work environment, and mediate conflicts between team members * **Quality Work** \- able to take ownership, work independently, prioritize workload, and deliver quality results on time while working on multiple projects simultaneously * **Above and Beyond** \- versatile, flexible, able to anticipate the needs of the company, take the initiative, and willing to go out of your way to assist others **Position overview** We are seeking a mid to senior\-level OT Network Administrator to design, build, deploy, secure, and support network infrastructure for renewable energy projects, including solar, battery energy storage systems (BESS), wind, and hybrid sites. This position is primarily focused on industrial networking and firewall engineering, with opportunities to provide secondary support for systems and virtualization infrastructure. The successful candidate will take ownership of hands\-on network delivery, from initial configuration and bench testing through site commissioning, troubleshooting, and ongoing lifecycle support. They will work with OT, SCADA, engineering, and project teams to provide reliable connectivity for remote facilities and critical operational systems. This hands\-on role requires an experienced professional who can independently deploy production\-grade switches, configure firewall policies and high\-availability pairs, diagnose complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues, and document the final solution. Network engineering is the primary focus; systems and virtualization support are secondary. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, stage, configure, test, commission, and support secure OT networks for renewable energy facilities and remote field deployments. * Build and commission firewalls from factory\-default condition, including PAN\-OS/FortiOS initialization, licensing and updates, management and WAN interfaces, routing, security zones/policies, source and destination NAT, IPsec and remote\-access VPNs, HA pairing, configuration synchronization, and tested failover; Palo Alto is the highest\-priority platform. * Configure and troubleshoot Cisco and Hirschmann switches, including VLANs, 802\.1Q trunks, inter\-VLAN routing, switch stacking where supported, industrial Ethernet, and redundant fiber topologies. * Implement and troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 connectivity, including RSTP, loop prevention, routing, IP addressing, subnetting, and segmentation. * Deploy and maintain secure remote\-access and site\-to\-site VPN solutions, including integration with Duo multi\-factor authentication (MFA). * Support multiple WAN/ISP technologies, including fiber, cellular, and satellite connections, dynamic DNS (DDNS), SD\-WAN, ISP failover, and BGP where required. * Configure source and destination NAT, access\-control rules, network services, and connectivity between SCADA servers, controllers, field devices, and external interfaces. * Create and maintain network diagrams, IP address plans, firewall rule documentation, switch configurations, configuration backups, and commissioning test records. * Own incident diagnosis and recovery for remote OT sites, using secured management paths, device logs, packet captures, command\-line diagnostics, out\-of\-band access, local hands, and ISP/vendor escalation; perform root\-cause analysis and controlled maintenance with attention to operational availability. * Coordinate ISP circuit turn\-up and escalation, remote site access, field technician instructions, and contingency planning when the primary WAN or management path is unavailable. * Maintain secure configurations, golden backups, equipment inventory, change records, port maps, fiber/uplink documentation, monitoring and alerting; validate rollback and recovery plans for maintenance changes. * Work within OT change\-management and safety practices, including approved maintenance windows, rollback plans, minimized operational disruption, and coordination with SCADA and commissioning teams. * Partner with systems engineers to support VMware/Hyper\-V environments, Windows Server, Active Directory, and backup and replication when needed. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES)*** Experience working with OT, trol, and incident\-response coordination. * Relevant certifications such as PCNSE/PCNSA, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet certifications, or comparable demonstrated technical proficiency. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Approximately 5\+ years of hands\-on network administration or network engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production deployments. * Demonstrated personal ownership of at least one production firewall deployment from factory defaults through WAN, routing, policy, NAT, VPN, HA configuration, and failover testing; Palo Alto hands\-on expertise is strongly preferred. * Strong Cisco switching experience and practical knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 networking, VLANs, 802\.1Q trunks, RSTP, IP subnetting, and routing. * Experience commissioning or substantially reconfiguring network equipment from a factory\-default or greenfield state, not solely monitoring an existing environment. * Demonstrated experience remotely troubleshooting and restoring distributed network connectivity without direct physical access, including safe use of alternate access paths, field technicians, and diagnostic tools. * Ability to produce accurate technical documentation and collaborate with distributed engineering and project teams. * Ability to meet the assigned office’s on\-site schedule, with a minimum of three days per week in office. **CRITICAL TECHNICAL COMPENTENCIES****Competency** **Expected capability / platform priority** Firewall engineering Palo Alto Networks is the primary platform: HA pairs, interfaces and zones, security/NAT policies, routing, IPsec and remote\-access VPNs, logging, upgrades, and tested failover. FortiGate deployment, HA, policy, routing, VPN, SD\-WAN, and troubleshooting are highly valued. Cisco ASA / Firepower / FTD experience is advantageous and lower priority. Switching and routing Strong Cisco provisioning, VLANs, 802\.1Q trunks, Layer 2/3 interfaces, subnetting, static/dynamic routing, RSTP, and stacking where supported. Hirschmann industrial Ethernet, redundant fiber/ring topologies, and field resiliency experience are valued. Security and remote access Segmentation, least privilege, SNAT/DNAT, secure vendor access, and VPN connectivity, including Duo MFA integration. WAN and diagnostics Multiple ISP handoffs; DDNS, SD\-WAN and failover; console/OOB access and remote hands. Troubleshoot loops, spanning tree, asymmetric routing, IP conflicts, fiber/uplinks, DHCP/DNS, ARP, TCP/IP, MTU, packet loss, route selection, and IPsec negotiation. BGP familiarity is desirable. **BENEFITS** RRC is committed to investing in talented employees because we recognize that healthy, happy employees provide the best path to sustaining a successful business. RRC offers competitive salaries and benefits for full\-time employees, including:* Flexible work hours to accommodate work\-life balance. * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401k matching * Bonus eligibility * Tuition reimbursement for certain pre\-approved education pursuits * 401k matching (US) RRC thanks you for your interest in joining RRC. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Visit our website www.RRCcompanies.com for more information. No recruiters or staffing firms please. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire. RRC Companies is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment and assessment process. If you require an accommodation, please contact Human Resources or the recruitment contact listed in this posting. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Lead AEM Solution Architect Engineer - Remote
jobs.description: **Job Summary** As a Lead AEM Solution Architect Engineer, you’ll shape and guide the architecture of enterprise web applications, including solutions built with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). You’ll turn business and technical requirements into secure, scalable designs; align teams on implementation choices; and support delivery from planning through release. This is a remote role requiring clear collaboration across engineering, product, and operations teams. **Responsibilities** * Lead requirements gathering, system design, application architecture design, and solution architecture for AEM and integrated enterprise solutions. * Define service\-oriented architecture, microservices, APIs, RESTful APIs, SOAP and web services, using UML, design patterns, and application integration practices. * Guide software development and implementation across cloud architecture, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, scalable systems, and DevOps automation; support SDLC, Agile software development, Scrum, and release management. * Review architecture, code, security, accessibility, and deployment plans; coordinate continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), version control, and production readiness. * Your impact: By aligning architecture and delivery teams around clear, scalable designs, you help users access reliable digital experiences and help teams integrate applications effectively. **Skills** * **Core:** Proven software architecture and system architecture design expertise; strong requirements management, system design for system development, and enterprise solutions implementation skills. * **Platforms and data:** AEM, Java, JavaScript,.NET, C\#, ASP.NET Core, SQL, NoSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, Hibernate, Entity Framework, Salesforce, and cloud computing with AWS, Azure, and S3\. * **Web and frameworks:** HTML, CSS, web design, web development, front\-end development, Angular, React, React Express, Node.js, Kendo, Ext JS, Ember.js, Backbone.js, Bootstrap, AJAX, MVC, JSP, Struts, Spring Framework, WordPress, and Ruby on Rails. * **Infrastructure and tools:** Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Maven, Git, SVN, Linux, Bash (Unix shell), shell scripting, Ansible, Kafka, JBoss, Weblogic, WebSphere, Tomcat, Visual Studio, WCF, Perl, Python, C, C\+\+, ActionScript, PL/SQL, JSON, XML, JUnit, Burp Suite, and HTTPS. * **Additional knowledge:** Identity and access management, distributed computing, cloud development, Agile, REST, scalability, and web accessibility. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Internal Tools
jobs.description: Healthcare is complex. We're here to change that. RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone. Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other. **At a Glance** --------------- RVO Health is looking for a Staff AI Engineer to build AI\-powered tools that save our internal teams time, reduce costs, and help enable new revenue opportunities. This is an exciting role on a highly focused and autonomous team doing meaningful greenfield work. You will be building production\-grade systems that people at RVO Health use every day. You will work directly with Content Operations, Editorial, Sales, and other departments to identify the highest\-impact opportunities, propose solutions, and ship software. This is a software engineering role first. You should be comfortable owning backend systems, APIs, and production architecture, with AI and agentic experience as the layer on top. The ideal candidate moves quickly without cutting corners on quality or security. You can translate a business workflow into a technical architecture, and you are just as comfortable running a discovery session with non\-technical stakeholders as you are writing code. When a use case or the underlying data isn't ready for a bigger build, you can scope a right\-sized first iteration and show the value. **Where You'll Be** ------------------- **Location: Charlotte Metro Area (Fort Mill, SC) \| Hybrid** We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we're in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish. Office address: 1101 Red Ventures Dr Fort Mill, SC 29707 **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and maintain AI applications on AWS using Bedrock and AgentCore (preferred), including APIs, MCP servers, backend services, and integrations that connect to tools and data teams already use * Run product discovery with stakeholders: clarify the problem, define scope and success metrics, and propose a right\-sized first iteration * Deliver quickly while meeting production standards for security, observability, and maintainability * As applicable, apply security and data\-privacy practices appropriate to a healthcare company (PII, PHI), and review others' code for vulnerabilities and risky AI behavior * Share best practices with peers and other engineering teams through code reviews, mentorship, and tech talks * Identify and mitigate risks related to AI outputs, data handling, and responsible use * Write and maintain documentation, runbooks, and onboarding material that helps the team scale what gets built **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science, a related field, or equivalent professional experience * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 year building AI\-powered applications, preferably on AWS * Hands\-on experience with LLMs and the practical realities of prompt engineering in production * Experience with an agentic harness library (e.g. Strands) * Experience using Claude Code or similar tools for agentic coding * Experience integrating with third\-party APIs and enterprise tools * Experience building tools on top of internal data * Solid engineering fundamentals such as version control, testing, CI/CD, and code review * Working knowledge of security and privacy requirements for sensitive data (HIPAA, PII/PHI) preferred * Strong communication skills, with a track record of working with non\-technical stakeholders to understand workflows, quantify impact, and translate them into technical requirements * Strong bias for action, proactively working to find opportunities and craft solutions **Pursuant to various state Fair Pay Acts, below is a summary of compensation elements for this role at the company. The following benefits are provided by RVO Health, subject to eligibility requirements.** * Starting Salary: $170,000 \- $200,000\* + *Note actual salary is based on geographic location, qualifications and experience* * Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision) * Life Insurance * Short and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts * Paid Time Off * Holiday Pay * 401(k) with match * Employee Assistance Program * Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program * Pharmacy Benefits * Income Protection Plans * Pet Services Plans * Mental Health Support * Wellness Coaching * HSA\- Health Savings Account * Commuter Benefits * Gym \& Fitness Center Discount Program **Who We Are:** RVO Health is a health\-technology company created through a joint venture between Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group's Optum. Together, we've brought some of the most trusted names in healthcare under one roof, including Healthline, Healthgrades, Fullspan Health, Medical News Today, Optum Perks, and more. We're the \#1 source for doctor search in the U.S. Every day, people turn to our brands in moments that matter to find reliable health information, connect with doctors, save money on prescriptions, and take meaningful action on their wellbeing. RVO Health is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or any other basis protected by law. Employment at RVO Health is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. This includes providing reasonable accommodation where appropriate. Should you require a reasonable accommodation to apply or participate in the job application or interview process, please contact accommodations@rvohealth.com . **We do not provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.** \#LI\-Hybrid RVO Health Privacy Policy: https://rvohealth.com/legal/privacy

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Production Engineering, FinOps
jobs.description: **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7\.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. Production Engineering is Ramp's infrastructure ownership layer. We exist to make Ramp faster, more reliable, and more scalable — and we do that by being embedded in the problems, not adjacent to them. A few things that define how we operate: * **One team, one company, one objective.** There is no "infra team" and "product team" — there is Ramp. We share the company's goals as our own. When a product team struggles with reliability or scalability, that is our struggle. * **If reliability or scalability is at risk, we own it.** We don't wait to be invited, and we don't ask whose code it is. If a system is slow, if it breaks, if it won't scale — that's ours to lead, regardless of where it lives in the stack. * **We go first, and we go fast.** When the path isn't obvious, we don't wait for someone else to find it. We move with urgency, propose the solution, align the stakeholders, and stay in until it's done — not until our ticket is closed. * **We lead the way.** We find the next problem before it finds us. And when we solve it, we don't just fix it for ourselves — the patterns and standards we establish become the foundation the rest of Ramp builds on. That's not a side effect of the job; it's the job. * **We stay calibrated.** Speed means nothing if we're moving in the wrong direction. We regularly stop and ask honestly whether what we're working on is still the highest\-leverage thing we could be doing — the discipline that makes sure our effort compounds toward what actually matters. **You cannot build the future of finance on shaky infrastructure.** **Our Teams** ------------- Production Engineering is organized into teams — but we think about teams differently. Teams are mutable. We build them around what needs to be done, not around what we need to do given the teams we already have. The structure below reflects our current priorities; it will evolve as Ramp does. Right now, we operate across five areas: * **Compute** — the foundation for running Ramp’s services and financial workflows: container orchestration, networking, load balancing, edge infrastructure, and asynchronous execution and messaging systems, including Temporal. The team owns production runtime reliability, scaling, isolation, and safe rollouts. * **Storage** — the production data foundations that underpin Ramp: databases, caching, and object storage, with ownership of reliability, performance, capacity, recovery, and safe data movement. * **Developer Infrastructure** — the shared infrastructure that helps engineers ship and understand production: CI/CD systems, observability foundations for logs, metrics, and traces, and visibility into infrastructure usage and cost. * **Compliance Platform** — the infrastructure and operational capabilities for Ramp’s government environments and compliance needs: secure access, deployment paths, environment validation, and technical controls that let product teams deliver reliably within regulatory and compliance requirements. * **Reliability Platform** — the tools and operating model for understanding and improving customer\-facing reliability and performance: SLA/SLO measurement and reporting, customer\-health visibility, monitoring and paging, and incident response and follow\-through. The team helps product teams remain accountable for the health of what they build. **What You'll Do** ------------------ As a FinOps Specialist within Production Engineering, you’ll help Ramp make better decisions about infrastructure spend – from resource usage and cloud commitments to vendor contracts and new investments. You’ll work closely with Production Engineering leadership, Developer Infrastructure, Finance, Procurement, and engineering teams across Ramp. You’ll bring financial depth, investigate opportunities independently, and partner with engineers to turn recommendations into measurable results. This is a senior individual contributor role. Day to day, you will: * **Set direction for infrastructure cost management.** Identify the highest\-impact opportunities acr ship between usage and cost. AWS experience is especially relevant. * **Strong technical fluency.** You can reason about compute, storage, networking, and managed services, and navigate Terraform or similar infrastructure\-as\-code tools to understand how systems are configured. You can investigate technical questions independently, connect infrastructure choices to cost, and work with engineers on concrete changes. * **Experience with cost attribution and analysis.** You can connect infrastructure spend to teams, services, products, and usage drivers, including shared resources. You work directly with cost and usage data, reconcile conflicting sources, and develop practical allocation methods with clear assumptions. * A record of initiating and driving work across teams, from identifying an opportunity and building the case to coordinating implementation and validating the result. * Practical experience using AI tools and coding agents to analyze data, build dashboards or automations, and investigate technical questions. You can evaluate their output and recognize when deeper engineering review is needed. Relevant backgrounds include FinOps, infrastructure finance, strategic sourcing, analytics, data, and infrastructure engineering. A software engineering background is welcome, but not required. **Bonus (not required):** * Deep experience with AWS Cost and Usage Reports, Savings Plans, or Reserved Instances. * Cost management for Datadog, other observability platforms, or AI providers. * Product unit economics or infrastructure accounting classifications. * Financial analysis of large migrations, dedicated compute, or data center investments. * Experience in fintech, payments, or regulated industries, with an understanding of how compliance, security, and data residency requirements shape infrastructure choices and costs. **Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Flexible PTO * Centralized home\-office equipment ordering * Health and wellness stipend * Budget for intra\-office travel * Weekly coffee stipend **United States** ----------------- * 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents * One Medical annual membership * 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp * Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay * Pet insurance * In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more * Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) **Canada** ---------- * Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life * Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage * Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) * Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay * Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health **United Kingdom** ------------------ * Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite * Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi * Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay **Referral Instructions** ------------------------- If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. **Other notices** ----------------- Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. *Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.* Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $180K \- $247K

The team helps product teams remain accountable for the health of what they build. **What You'll Do** ------------------ As a FinOps Specialist within Production Engineering, you’ll help Ramp make better decisions about infrastructure spend – from resource usage and cloud commitments to vendor contracts and new investments. You’ll work closely with Production Engineering leadership, Developer Infrastructure, Finance, Procurement, and engineeri ation, commitment discounts, payment structures, and the relationship between usage and cost. center investments. * Experience in fintech, payments, or regulated industries, with an understanding of how compliance, security, and data residency requirements shape infrastructure choices and jobs.title: DevOps Engineer I
jobs.description: Redwood Credit Union is seeking a DevOps Engineer I, who will evaluate and support the implementation, administration, and security of RCU Infrastructure through DevOps tools and practices in pursuit of an excellent RCU Member experience. Work collaboratively with administrators, engineers, developers, and leadership to add observability and automation to systems and procedures. Evaluate systems and operational processes to identify opportunities for automation, improved repeatability, reduce manual operations, and recommend technical solutions across infrastructure and development teams. The DevOps Engineer I contributes technical analysis and recommendations to project teams where automation services are required and determines appropriate methods for completing assigned technical objectives within established project management practices to support initiatives. Analyze incidents and outages, perform root cause analysis, evaluate potential solutions, recommend appropriate corrective action and document and implement solutions escalating complex or high\-risk matters to senior team members as appropriate. **Key Responsibilities** **System Automation:** o Develop and maintain automation by evaluating technical requirements and selecting appropriate tools, scripts, and approaches within established architecture, security and operational standards in a Windows, VMware, Azure environment to support developer and IT Operations functions. o Develop and maintain assigned components of test automation systems, evaluating automation requirements and recommending appropriate solutions while collaborating with Programming and QA to support established CI/CD practices and tools. o Evaluate system monitoring requirements and configure and maintain monitoring, metrics collection, dashboards, and alerts using appropriate observability tools and standards to identify system conditions, trends, and potential operational risks to provide timely information about systems and processes. o Analyze IT systems and processes to identify opportunities to automate IT systems and processes; evaluate available solutions and recommend appropriate custom\-built or off\-the\-shelf tools based on technical requirements, operational impact, risk, and maintainability. o Share automation knowledge, follow established practices, and contribute to continuous improvement within the IT department. o Coordinate assigned work with other DevOps team members and escalate risks or blockers as needed. **System Administration:** o Participate in system administration, troubleshooting, and other areas of IT Operations duties. o Develop operational processes and guides for existing systems that provide other teams with the ability to manage and support day\-to\-day needs. o Contribute to technical projects by evaluating requirements and independently performing design, configuration, testing, documentation, and implementation activities within the scope of assigned responsibilities, consulting with senior engineers on complex or high\-impact decisions. o Analyze, prioritize, and resolve end\-user and infrastructure related problems. o Independently prioritize problem resolution and daily work based on business impact, operational risk, urgency, and service requirements. o Formulate and ensure adherence to quality assurance standards internal to the department and external to end\-users. o Develop and maintain guides, network diagrams, procedures, and business continuity information for system administration. o Maintain availability via phone or e\-mail for communication during scheduled work hours and on\-call assignments as applicable. o Communicate with third\-party vendors and internal team members to analyze technical issues, evaluate solutions, and make recommendations regarding resolution, service, or escalation. o Uphold established department service standards. **Security:** o Evaluate systems against established security standards and documented hardening procedures for servers, VMware, Microsoft platforms, databases, storage, and network systems. Monitor logs and service alerts, analyze events, assess potential impact and risk, determine appropriate remediation within assigned authority, and escalate significant security issues as appropriate. o Evaluate and maintain the availability, patching, and security controls of Microsoft and VMware\-based server platforms; assess system conditions and operational impact to determine appropriate implementation actions with established schedules, procedures, and change controls. o Respond to and report security issues involving hardware and software. o Research assigned security practices and technologies, analyzing alternatives, risks, operational impacts and technical requirements to develop recommendations for consideration by senior engineers and IT management. o Update core operating systems and apply appropriate patches as security flaws are identified. o Solve outstanding security issues through r to interpret and apply security standards. * Ability to incorporate feedback, share knowledge with peers, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team. * Ability to independently analyze assigned technical issues, evaluate available options, determine appropriate approaches within established parameters, and exercise judgement regarding when matters require escalation. * Ability to contribute to technology projects by completing assigned configuration, scripting, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation tasks. * Ability to communicate professionally with vendors and internal clients, document issues clearly, and follow through on assigned actions. * Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with a diverse group of people. * Ability to travel 5% of the time. * Ability to work nights and weekends as required to support system deployment, maintenance and management during non\-business and reduced Member impact hours. * Ability to work on call as needed. The ideal candidate has a combination of education and experience equivalent to a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a closely related field, with a minimum of three years of IT experience, to include a minimum of two years’ experience in systems administration, infrastructure, software development, technical support, or automation. **Compensation: Base starting range: $100,604 to $118,351 annually commensurate with experience.** *Our base salary starting range is based on scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, and internal peer equity. We offer a competitive total rewards package including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.* **Redwood Credit Union offers a robust benefits package to our eligible employees including:** * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health offerings * Employee performance incentive plan * Salary Advancement– Merit increase based on performance * 401(k) program with employer match * Time Off\- Competitive PTO accrual plus 11 paid company holidays and your birthday off! **RCU Discounts and Perks:** * RCU employees are eligible for a .75% discount off RCU standard collateral auto loans * RCU employees are eligible for a 1% discount on all recreational or boat loan products * 2% discount off Visas and LOC Loans through RCU * 0% interest loan to support employees with various immigration related expenses such as visa application fees and relocation costs. Loan amount up to $1,000\. * 0% interest loan to support employees with expenses associated with the naturalization process. Loan amount up to $15,000\. * 0% interest on garment, fitness, or home office equipment loan of up to $500 * 100% financing for employee purchased homes! **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to stand for extended periods of time occasionally. * Ability to stand, bend, stoop, sit, walk, twist, and turn. * Ability to lift 50 pounds. * Ability to use a computer keyboard, calculator, and mouse. * Work environment is indoors; majority of the time is spent sitting/standing at a desk. * **Redwood Credit Union is not offering Visa transfers and/or sponsorships for this position.** Internal Team Members: If you are a current Team Member, please apply through the internal careers page located in RCUNET. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us at careers@redwoodcu.org. To ensure fairness and consistency, we’re unable to respond to individual inquiries about application status.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Remote/Hybrid ***Job Overview*** Job Overview WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work. WHAT WE DO claiR is Relativity's conversational AI experience, built for lawyers at the world's leading law firms. Running inside the Relativity aiR platform, claiR is an agentic surface into Relativity's petabytes of matter intelligence, letting users search, enrich, and generate work product from their data, with answers grounded in the matter's documents and backed by citations. The claiR team builds and ships this experience, from the AI and retrieval systems that reason across a matter to the web interface that lawyers and case teams use to explore their data and collaborate. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **ABOUT THE ROLE** This role offers an opportunity to grow as a full\-stack AI engineer on the team building claiR, the conversational AI experience lawyers use to ask questions, search, and draft from their matter data. You will work alongside the engineers and applied scientists who build claiR and gain direct exposure to how agentic features are designed, evaluated, and shipped. You will begin with well\-defined features across the stack and grow toward end\-to\-end ownership of agentic features. This Senior AI Engineer role is designed for a mid\-to\-high level engineer ready to grow quickly. The role reports to a Lead Engineer on claiR at Relativity and may be based remotely in the United States or in our Chicago office. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Build features across the full stack of claiR, including agent tools, prompt and context changes, services and API endpoints, and front\-end work in the claiR web app. * Work with applied scientists to extend claiR’s agentic functionality with new capabilities and features. * Write and extend evaluations, run them, and learn to interpret the results. Ship changes behind feature flags and monitor production outcomes. * Learn and practice a modern software development lifecycle from day one through small, frequent commits, feature\-flagged deployments, fast rollbacks, and best\-in\-class agentic engineering tools. * Fix bugs, improve reliability, and add tests while developing an understanding of how agentic systems fail. * Pair with Senior and Lead engineers on design and code reviews. Ask questions and document what you learn so others can benefit. * Take on increasingly ambiguous problems as you demonstrate readiness. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** **Required** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience or equivalent demonstrated ability, such as a strong open\-source track record, a shipped product, or substantial internship experience. * Working proficiency in Python and C\#, plus hands\-on experience building full\-stack web applications with a front end such as React, services, and a relational database using SQL. * Hands\-on experience building an agentic solution with LLMs, even at a small scale, such as an agent, a retrieval\-augmented generation application, or a tool\-using assistant. Ability to explain system prompts, tool calls, embeddings, and common failure points. * Basic familiarity with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, containers, and CI/CD. * Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and writing clean, tested code. * Clear written and spoken English and a preference for simple solutions over clever ones. **WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT** **Impactful Mission** * Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high\-stakes legal matters. **Engineering at Scale** * Work on distributed, cloud\-native systems that process large volumes of data. **Cutting\-Edge Technology** * Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech. **Growth and Ownership** * Gain experience owning systems end\-to\-end across cloud and distributed environments. **Collaborative Culture** * Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. **Inclusive Environment** * Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes. **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $143,000 and $215,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Algorithms, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Computer Vision, Data Science, Deep Learning, Natural Language, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Project Management, Software Engineering

jobs.title: Account Executive, Data Cloud & AI (Mid Market)
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ The AI \& Data Cloud Account Executive role at Rippling is one of the highest\-impact opportunities in the company today. We are experiencing explosive customer demand for our AI Agents and underlying data platform, as companies look to automate away massive amounts of manual back\-office work across HR, IT, Finance, and Operations. We are building a team of highly driven, technical, and commercially sharp “hunters” who can operate in high\-velocity sales cycles while navigating complex, strategic conversations with senior stakeholders. This role sits at the center of Rippling’s next major growth vector: enabling customers to deploy AI Agents powered by unified data and custom applications built directly on the Rippling platform. Working closely with Account Manager partners, you will own the end\-to\-end cross\-sell motion for Rippling’s Agent Platform — including Data Cloud, custom Solutions, and Rippling AI. You will help customers move from fragmented systems and manual workflows to a unified, intelligent infrastructure where AI Agents can execute work autonomously across the back office. This is a rare opportunity to: * Sell a category\-defining platform at the intersection of data, applications, and AI Agents * Capitalize on surging inbound and outbound demand from customers actively seeking AI\-driven automation * Shape how modern companies adopt and scale Agent\-based automation across their core operations If you’re looking to operate at the forefront of AI, own a greenfield growth motion, and drive meaningful revenue impact in a rapidly scaling business, this role offers unmatched upside. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Drive Revenue:** Manage the full sales cycle for AI \& Data Cloud, from initial discovery and technical scoping to closing deals. * **Technical Partnership:** Collaborate extensively with Solutions Engineers (SEs), Professional Services, or Forward Deployed Engineers to bridge the gap between "vision" and "execution". * **Pipeline Management:** Maintain rigorous discipline in Salesforce to accurately forecast revenue and consistently achieve monthly or quarterly quotas. * **Subject Matter Expertise:** Become an expert on Rippling’s Data Cloud, understanding our positioning across the competitive landscape and serving as a product advocate. * **Build \& Improve:** Exercise the courage to challenge the status quo; if you see a process that is broken, take the initiative to fix it. **What you will need** ---------------------- * **Closing Experience:** 3\+ years of closing experience, specifically selling complex SaaS platforms (preferably B2B solutions) that require integration, customization, and multi\-stakeholder implementation. * **Proven Upward Mobility:** A clear track record of internal promotion (e.g., SDR to Sr. SDR to AE) at a single high\-growth company. We value "builders" who stay to see the results of their work. * **High\-Velocity Discipline:** Experience in a fast\-paced environment. * **Startup Fluency:** Prior experience in a Series A–D startup environment where you were required to build your own playbooks rather than just follow existing ones. **Additional Information** Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive On\-Target Earnings (base salary \+ sales commission) \+ benefits \+ equity. jobs.title: SLM Training Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description **Job Description** Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced SLM and Decision Model Training Engineer to build the small, fast, specialized models that make our enterprise AI agents reliable and affordable at scale. This role sits within our AI Engineering organization and focuses on two model families: small language models (SLMs) fine\-tuned for Rockwell domains and tasks, and decision models that return typed, calibrated judgments (choices, scores, and yes/no probabilities) instead of free\-form text, in the style of "System One" models such as TypeSafe's Jev. These models will route requests, classify and triage work, act as guardrails on agent actions, and evaluate agent outputs, so that large language models are used only where open\-ended reasoning is truly needed. You have a proven track record of training, fine\-tuning, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production, with a strong grounding in probability calibration and model evaluation. This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. **Your Responsibilities** * Train, fine\-tune, and distill small language models for Rockwell\-specific domains and agent tasks, such as tool selection, structured extraction, summarization, and industrial and product terminology. * Build decision models that take text or structured state plus developer\-defined questions and return typed choices, ordered scores, or yes/no probabilities that software can act on directly. * Train decision models to produce well\-calibrated probabilities, so confidence scores can drive thresholds for automating confident cases and escalating uncertain ones to people. * Apply decision models across the agent platform for model routing, request triage, guardrails (for example, whether an agent should make a tool call), and automated evaluation of LLM and agent outputs. * Build data pipelines for training and evaluation, including data curation, labeling strategies, synthetic data generation, and distillation from larger teacher models. * Design evaluation suites that measure accuracy, calibration, latency, and cost against LLM baselines, and run model\-versus\-model comparisons to guide when to use an SLM, a decision model, a classical classifier, or a large model. * Optimize models for production and edge deployment through quantization, pruning, and efficient serving, including scenarios close to industrial and plant\-floor environments. * Operate the model lifecycle with MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registry, version pinning, monitoring for drift and calibration decay, and retraining. * Partner with agent, platform, and business teams across the enterprise to identify high\-volume, bounded decisions that benefit from specialized models, and to make build vs. buy recommendations against commercial decision and small\-model offerings. **Key Technical Skill Expectations** **Small Language Model Training:** Fine\-tune and adapt open\-weight SLMs (e.g., Phi, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma) using supervised fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient methods such as LoRA and QLoRA, and preference optimization (e.g., DPO), with frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TRL, and DeepSpeed. **Decision \& Discriminative Models:** Build transformer\-based classifiers, rankers, and scoring models (e.g., encoder models and cross\-encoders) that output typed decisions over a fixed answer space, including multi\-label, ordinal, and zero\-shot setups where categories are supplied at inference time. **Calibration \& Uncertainty:** Apply probability calibration methods (e.g., temperature scaling, isotonic regression) and reward\-based training for calibrated decisions, and measure calibration with reliability diagrams, expected calibration error, and Brier score. **Distillation \& Data Engineering:** Generate and curate training data, including LLM\-labeled and synthetic data, apply knowledge distillation from larger teacher models, and manage data quality, bias, and label noise. **Evaluation \& Benchmarking:** Build offline and online evaluations that compare SLMs, decision models, and LLMs on accuracy, calibration, latency, and cost, and use LLM\-as\-judge and decision\-model\-as\-judge patterns responsibly. **Model Optimization \& Serving:** Quantize and compress models (e.g., GGUF, ONNX, INT8/INT4\), and serve them efficiently with tools such as vLLM, ONNX Runtime, Triton Inference Server, or Azure AI Foundry, including edge and on\-premises deployment. **MLOps \& Governance:** Use MLflow or Azure Machine Learning for experiment tracking, model registry, CI/CD for models, monitoring, and responsible AI practices that comply with enterprise governance and security policies. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\+ years training and deploying machine learning or NLP models in production. * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a similar discipline. * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning, distilling, and deploying small language models for specific enterprise tasks. * Familiarity with System One decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev, and with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD) or similar approaches that reward calibrated probabilities. * Experience with reinforcement learning methods for language models (e.g., RLHF, RLAIF, GRPO) and reward modeling. * Experience building model routing, guardrail, or LLM evaluation systems for agentic AI applications. * Experience deploying models to edge or industrial environments, or working with industrial and manufacturing data. * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, and experience with GPU training infrastructure and distributed training. * 3\+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience working and coordinating with a geographically diverse team across multiple time zones. * Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. **What We Offer** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com * We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LIfeAtRok \#LI\-SB1 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at \+1 (844\) 404\-7247\. Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

jobs.title: Semantic AI Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description **Job Description** Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced Semantic AI Engineer to build the knowledge foundation that our enterprise AI agents depend on. This role sits within our AI Engineering organization and focuses on how agents remember, reason over, and share what the company knows. You will design and build a corporate knowledge graph that agents both draw from and contribute to, along with the agentic memory systems that let agents keep context across tasks, users, and time. You have a proven track record of modeling complex business domains, building production knowledge graphs or semantic layers, and connecting them to LLM\-based applications. This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. **Your Responsibilities** * Design, build, and evolve a knowledge graph that represents Rockwell's people, products, customers, processes, systems, and data, and serves as shared context for AI agents across functions. * Design write\-back patterns that let agents contribute new facts, relationships, and learnings to the knowledge graph safely, with provenance, confidence, validation, and human review where needed. * Architect agentic memory for our agent platform, including short\-term (working) memory, long\-term episodic and semantic memory, and shared organizational memory, with clear policies for retention, summarization, and forgetting. * Develop ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic models with business and data owners, and keep business definitions consistent across analytics, BI, and AI tools. * Build ingestion and extraction pipelines that turn structured and unstructured enterprise content (documents, tickets, ERP and CRM records, engineering data) into graph entities and relationships using LLM\-assisted entity and relation extraction. * Implement GraphRAG and hybrid retrieval (graph traversal combined with vector and keyword search) to ground agent responses and reduce hallucinations. * Expose the knowledge graph and memory services to agents through standard interfaces such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and APIs. * Establish governance for the knowledge graph, including access control, data lineage, quality checks, freshness, and alignment with enterprise data governance and security policies. * Partner with stakeholders across the enterprise to prioritize knowledge domains and measure the impact on agent accuracy and usefulness. **Key Technical Skill Expectations** **Knowledge Graphs \& Semantic Modeling:** Design ontologies and graph schemas using property graph (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin) and/or RDF/OWL approaches, with query languages such as Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL. Apply entity resolution, schema alignment, and graph data quality techniques. **Agentic Memory:** Architect memory layers for AI agents, including working memory, episodic and semantic long\-term memory, memory consolidation and retrieval, and shared memory across multi\-agent systems, using frameworks such as LangGraph, Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Hindsight, LLMWiki etc. **Corporate Knowledge Graph for Agents:** Build a living, agent\-writable knowledge graph with provenance, trust levels, versioning, and conflict resolution so that knowledge produced by agents can be reviewed, trusted, and reused across the enterprise. **GraphRAG \& Retrieval:** Implement retrieval pipelines that combine knowledge graph traversal with vector search (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector, Redis) and embeddings to deliver accurate, explainable context to LLMs. **Semantic Layer \& Open Standards:** Understand semantic layers and metric definitions, and how open standards keep business meaning consistent as it moves between AI agents, BI platforms, and data tools. **Agent Integration \& Security:** Expose knowledge and memory services through MCP servers and APIs, with fine\-grained access control, PII handling, and audit logging that comply with enterprise governance and security policies. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science, or a related field. * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or search and retrieval systems. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Knowledge Engineering, or a similar discipline. * Hands\-on experience building and operating a production knowledge graph in an enterprise setting. * Experience designing memory for LLM agents and multi\-agent systems in production. * Familiarity with Apache Ossie (incubating, formerly Open Semantic Interchange), the vendor\-neutral standard for exchanging semantic models and metric definitions across AI, BI, and analytics tools. * Familiarity with the Open Knowledge Format (OKF), the open specification for representing agent\- and human\-readable knowledge as markdown with YAML frontmatter, including its provenance, trust, and freshness conventions. * Experience with W3C semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SKOS) and industrial information models such as ISA\-95 or the Asset Administration Shell. * Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with graph query languages (Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL). * Experience with LLM\-based information extraction, entity resolution, and evaluation of retrieval quality. * Experience with data catalogs and metadata platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra, DataHub). * 3\+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience working and coordinating with a geographically diverse team across multiple time zones. * Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. **What We Offer** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com * We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. *At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.* \#LI\-Hybrid \#LifeAtRok \#LI\-SB1 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at \+1 (844\) 404\-7247\.
