jobs.title: Associate Solutions Engineer - AI
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ **Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.** **Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:** * **Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority\- and woman\-owned enterprise in the U.S.** * **Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.** * **Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.** * **World\-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.** **Job Summary** =============== The Associate Solutions Engineer / Data Center Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting physical server infrastructure within lab and data center environments. This role supports the full server hardware lifecycle, including equipment installation and cabling, server configuration, out\-of\-band management, Linux administration, diagnostics, firmware management, hardware replacement, and production\-ready handoff. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable working at a Linux command line and physically installing or troubleshooting enterprise server equipment, with the ability to identify and resolve issues across hardware, BMC, networking, storage, firmware, and operating system layers. **Role Description** **Server Hardware Management** * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise server hardware. * Diagnose failures involving CPUs, DIMMs, storage devices, RAID controllers, power supplies, network interface cards (NICs), GPUs, fans, and system boards. * Perform hardware swaps, component upgrades, firmware updates, and break/fix activities. * Review system health, hardware inventory, event logs, temperatures, power consumption, and component status. Work with enterprise GPU server platforms such as Dell XE Series, NVIDIA H200, Cisco UCS, or equivalent systems. * **Baseboard Management Controller (BMC)** * Configure and manage server BMC interfaces and out\-of\-band management using technologies such as Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, IPMI, and Redfish. * Configure BMC networking, credentials, firmware, remote consoles, virtual media, and power controls. * Use BMC logs and hardware telemetry to diagnose server faults. Perform remote power cycling, system configuration, and operating system installation when appropriate. * **Equipment Racking and Cabling** * Rack and unrack servers, switches, storage equipment, Power Distribution Units (PDUs), and related infrastructure. * Install rails, cable\-management hardware, and other rack components. * Perform structured copper and fiber cabling, including Ethernet connections and management networks. * Maintain accurate port, cable, rack\-unit, hostname, and asset labeling. * Follow rack elevation, power distribution, airflow, and cable\-management standards. Trace and troubleshoot physical connectivity issues throughout the rack infrastructure. * **Linux Administration** * Install, configure, and support Linux operating systems, including Ubuntu Server or equivalent distributions. * Troubleshoot Linux boot, kernel, storage, networking, service, and hardware\-related issues. * Perform system administration using SSH and command\-line tools. * Configure interfaces, IP addressing, DNS, routes, bonding, and VLAN\-related settings. * Use Linux utilities such as systemctl, journalctl, dmesg, ip, ethtool, lsblk, lspci, dmidecode, and smartctl. Create Bash or Python scripts to automate repetitive server\-management activities where appropriate. * **Behaviors and Competencies** ------------------------------ * **Problem\-Solving:** Can systematically identify, isolate, and resolve hardware, firmware, networking, storage, and operating system issues. * **Detail\-Oriented:** Can identify errors or inconsistencies in configurations, logs, cabling, labeling, and component status and make necessary corrections. * **Organization:** Can prioritize technical tasks, manage personal workflow, and maintain accurate infrastructure records. * **Follow\-Up:** Can independently track assigned work and technical issues through completion without requiring reminders. * **Communication:** Can clearly communicate technical issues, findings, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions to appropriate stakeholders. * **Documentation:** Can independently create and maintain accurate technical, infrastructure, and troubleshooting documentation. * **Collaboration:** Can work effectively with engineers, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other technical resources. * **Results Orientation:** Can take ownership of assigned server infrastructure activities and drive work through successful validation and handoff. **Skill Level Requirements** **Required Skills** * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting physical servers, data center infrastructure, hardware labs, or a comparable environment. * Strong knowledge of enterprise server hardware and component\-level troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience with BMC and out\-of\-band management technologies, including IPMI, Redfish, Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, or comparable technologies. * Demonstrated experience racking, unracking, installing, and cabling server equipment. * Strong working knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting. * Understanding of TCP/IP networking, Ethernet, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and basic network troubleshooting. Ability to interpret hardware logs and systematically isolate hardware, firmware, network, storage, and operating system problems. * **Preferred Skills** * Experience supporting GPU or AI compute infrastructure, including NVIDIA GPU\-based servers. * Familiarity with high\-density or high\-performance computing environments. * Experience with IPMI tools, Ansible, Bash, or Python for server automation. * Experience with PXE/network\-based provisioning and automated Linux installation. * Familiarity with RAID, NVMe, SAS/SATA storage, and enterprise storage concepts. * Experience performing firmware and BIOS/UEFI configuration at scale. * Familiarity with server asset\-management or Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems. Linux certification such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) is a plus. * **Other Requirements** ---------------------- * Ability to safely lift, install, move, rack, and unrack server and other rack\-mounted equipment in accordance with applicable workplace safety requirements. * Ability to perform hands\-on equipment installation, cabling, component replacement, and troubleshooting within lab and data center environments. * Ability to work independently on assigned infrastructure activities and escalate issues appropriately when additional support is required. * Ability to manage a server through the deployment lifecycle, including rack installation, power and network cabling, BMC configuration, firmware/BIOS setup, Linux installation, hardware and network validation, and production\-ready handoff. The estimated annual pay range for this position is $75,000 \- $150,000 which includes a base salary. The compensation for this position is dependent on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending. Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

jobs.title: Senior API Engineer
jobs.description: **CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES OR CANADA** **About SafelyYou** SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person\-centered care across senior living through world\-leading AI, industry\-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities. Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals. SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019\), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation. **Your Role at SafelyYou** As a Senior API Engineer at SafelyYou, you will be the technical lead responsible for designing, building, and operating our core backend services and platform infrastructure. You will be the primary technical owner of the External Data API, building and improving the critical bridge between SafelyYou's data systems and our customers. This is a fully remote, senior\-level engineering role. You are expected to bring hands\-on experience building APIs, deep technical expertise, operate with minimal guidance, and proactively mentor other engineers while actively writing code and building our data and API platforms. **Key Responsibilities:** * This is a heavily hands\-on development role. You will spend the majority of your time writing clean, scalable backend code while establishing patterns and supporting the systems you build. We would love someone who wants to take on more architecture ownership as the role evolves. * Own the design, development, and operation of scalable APIs, microservices, and backend platform infrastructure using Python and AWS. * Lead the implementation, continuous improvement, and lifecycle of the External Data API, serving as the technical bridge between our internal data systems and our customers. * Contribute to and implement data governance practices including registries and data dictionaries, such as the Event Registry. Establish patterns and best practices for schema governance, versioning, documentation, and compatibility as our architecture evolves. * Support and evolve internal APIs used to provide information from data systems to applications built by other SafelyYou engineers, such as the feature enablement cache. Providing documentation, implementation examples, and support while enforcing best practices and driving adoption. * Support and evolve a webhook subscription and distribution system allowing third parties to get notifications of changes in near real time. * Draft and maintain comprehensive Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), API specifications, and system documentation to establish robust engineering patterns. * Improve developer workflow and experience by optimizing CI/CD pipelines, updating repository documentation, and establishing best practices. * Security of the API systems, including vulnerability management, authentication and authorization, and best practices around data segregation. * Introduce and leverage AI agent workflows to enhance engineering efficiency and keep the team updated on industry trends. * Develop AI skills that third\-parties may use when interacting with SafelyYou APIs and data products. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align engineering execution with business goals, supporting new product launches and cross\-team tiger initiatives. * Mentor team members, share deep technical expertise, and participate in on\-call rotations to ensure high availability of critical services. **Requirements** * 7\+ years of professional experience in software, backend, or platform engineering, preferably in a startup environment. * Deep expertise in designing, building, operating, and scaling RESTful APIs, web services, and distributed backend systems. * Experience with designing and implementing API gateways and management systems such as Kong Hybrid or other similar systems. Have a practical understanding of authentication, routing, policy enforcement, observability and deployment of a gateway solution. * Strong programming proficiency in Python or similar backend languages, with a focus on writing clean, scalable, and maintainable backend code. * Proven experience with streaming data architecture and technologies (e.g. Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Spark Streaming). Experience making architectural and cost trade offs between batch streaming and synchronous processing. * Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and light DevOps practices, including containerization and deployment tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Helm charts). * Strong technical communication skills with a track record of writing ADRs, API specs, and comprehensive architectural documentation. * Experience managing CI/CD pipelines and improving developer environments. * Prioritize quality over speed. When it is done, it is really done. **The Ideal Candidate:** * Hands\-on experience with modern AI\-assisted and agentic development workflows, including coding agents, MCP, AI pair programming, and LLM\-powered research * Advanced proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Terraform. * Experience with designing and implementing webhook distribution using a tool such as Svix or other similar system. * Experience consuming data models and architectures across ETL/ELT, warehouses, lakehouses, event\-driven systems, and backend APIs and how these intersect with backend API design. Strong foundations in data quality, reliability, governance, and scalability. * Experience with electronic health records (EHR), healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR, and associated data privacy regulations such as HIPAA. * Experience with remote work and distributed, async\-first engineering teams. **Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!** SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to: **Salary Range**: *$170,000 \- $190,000 USD / $145,000 \- $165,000 CAD* * A mission\-driven company culture * Fully remote * Competitive salary \& benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision * 401k Program * Monthly Education, Well\-being \& WFH stipends * Non\-accrual PTO * Growth Potential * Company Retreats * Medical \& Family/Parental Leave At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. We're investing heavily in AI. Our AI Infrastructure team is building the platform that lets AI agents take engineering intent and carry it through the software development lifecycle end to end: planning, coding, testing, review and merge, with controls that let each team increase agent autonomy as trust builds. The team designs and runs everything that makes that work: orchestration, isolated development environments, agent identity and access, model access and routing, context and memory, evaluation, and the feedback loops that make agents better over time. It's an unusual mix of distributed systems, systems engineering and applied AI, much of it not yet done at enterprise scale, and you'll be building it from the early stages with engineering teams across Sage as your first users. \*\*\* Please note that this role is hybrid and requires working 3 days a week from our San Jose office. \*\*\* **Key Responsibilities** - Build and ship well\-scoped features in platform components such as workflows, sandboxes, gateways, evaluation tooling or developer SDKs. - Write design notes for your work and take part in design reviews. - Write clean, tested code, with the logging, metrics and traces needed to support it in production. - Build integrations with Jira, GitHub, CI/CD and Slack, and help teams onboard their repositories. - Investigate agent failures and production issues, and fix the root cause. - Take part in code reviews, on\-call and incident reviews. - Keep up with fast\-moving AI tooling and share what you learn with the team. What You'll Own - Implementation and testing of your assigned work, raising risks and questions early, and keeping your code production\-ready. What We're Looking For - Software engineering experience, ideally with hands\-on experience using LLM\-powered tools or agents. - Solid programming skills in one or more of Python, TypeScript, Go, Java or Rust. - A good grasp of system and API design, data modelling and testing. - Experience building and deploying services in the cloud with containers; exposure to Kubernetes and infrastructure as code. - Understanding of async processing, queues and handling failures in distributed systems. - Hands\-on experience building with LLM APIs: tool use, prompts, RAG or simple agents. Side projects count. - Usage of AI coding tools day to day. In this location, the base salary range is $120,000 to $150,000, depending on experience. \#LI\-AS1

jobs.title: Developer - Scala
jobs.description: **Job Description** We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our HCM Localisation engineering team and help evolve a large\-scale, cloud\-based enterprise product. This role is focused on building and maintaining scalable backend services supporting complex product workflows, integrations, performance improvements, and ongoing platform modernisation. \*\*\* Please note: This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our San Jose office \*\*\* **Key Responsibilities** In this role you'll: - Design, develop, and maintain robust backend services using Scala 2\.13 and Play Framework in a Pekko\-based environment. - Build clean, testable, and maintainable code using functional programming principles, immutability, pattern matching, and asynchronous programming with Futures. - Work with MySQL to design efficient data access patterns, optimize queries, tune indexes, and profile database performance. - Develop, deploy, and support services in AWS, working closely with DevOps and platform teams to ensure reliable delivery. - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based pull request workflows, code reviews, and engineering best practices. - Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, product owners, solution designers, and other backend developers to deliver high\-quality product increments. - Support production stability by investigating issues, improving observability, and continuously reducing technical debt. Required Skills and Experience: - Professional backend development experience, ideally in enterprise, SaaS, or cloud\-based product environments. - Strong hands\-on experience with Scala, including collections, Futures, immutability, pattern matching, error handling, and clean functional design. - Commercial experience with Play Framework or comparable JVM backend frameworks; Pekko or Akka experience is highly relevant. - Strong understanding of relational databases, especially MySQL, with practical knowledge of SQL optimization, indexes, query profiling, and transaction behaviour. - Experience using Redis or similar technologies for caching, session handling, or performance\-sensitive workloads. - Deep understanding of OOP principles, functional programming, concurrency, the Scala type system, and advanced architectural patterns (e.g., Tagless Final, type classes, effect systems). - Ability to design and evolve complex distributed systems while promoting engineering best practices across the team - Hands\-on experience with AWS services and cloud\-native delivery practices. - Good understanding of CI/CD, Git, branching strategies, pull request flows, automated testing, and release practices. - Ability to work effectively in distributed Agile teams, communicate clearly, and take ownership of complex technical problems. Nice to Have: - Experience with Squeryl, Doobie, or similar Scala data access libraries. - Familiarity with Grafana or Kibana dashboards, alerting, logging, and production observability practices. - Experience with large distributed systems, horizontal scaling, resilient service design, or high\-throughput Play / Pekko applications. - Previous experience in Payroll, HR, HCM, ERP, compliance\-heavy, or localisation\-focused product domains. - Russian, Ukrainian, or Polish language skills would be beneficial, but are not essential. Ways of Working: - Pragmatic, delivery\-focused, and able to balance new feature development with maintenance, bug fixing, and technical improvement work. - Proactive in code reviews, design discussions, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing across the engineering team. - Strong problem\-solving mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to work with an established codebase while helping modernise it over time. Want to know more about our Product?: https://hcm.sage.com/ Plenty of perks: - Competitive salaries - Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage - 401(k) retirement match (100% matching up to 4%) - 32 days paid time off (21 personal days, 10 national holidays, 1 floating holiday) - 18 weeks paid parental leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy offered 1 year after start date - 5 days paid yearly to volunteer (through Sage Foundation) - $5,250 tuition reimbursement per calendar year starting 6 months after hire date - Sage Wellness Rewards Program ($600 wellness credit and $360 fitness reimbursement annually)Library of on\-demand career development options and ongoing training offerings What it’s like to work at Sage: - Careers homepage \- https://www.sage.com/en\-us/company/careers/ - Glassdoor reviews \- https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Sage\-Reviews\-E1150\.htm - LinkedIn page \- https://www.linkedin.com/company/sage\-software \#LI\-MD1

As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25\+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end\-to\-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field. As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high\-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve. **This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the US.** #### **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper\-growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. #### **In this role, you will:** * Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be. * Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten. * Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one\-by\-one review. * Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team. * Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly. * Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear. * Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end. * Participate in security incident investigations involving high\-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure. * Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 10\+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands\-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi\-product enterprise environment — not a single product or team's slice of it. * Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript. * Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi\-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing. re and embedded systems. * Background at a cloud\-native, AI\-forward company actively building agentic or AI\-driven products. * Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda). * Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift\-left" mentality. * Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line. * Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP\-certified environment. * Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting). **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

The role involves supporting and managing distributed network infrastructure, as well as troubleshooting and resolving network\-related incidents for the company and its customers. **Tools and technologies:** Cisco FMC, Fortimanager, VPNs, Windows and domain services, NPS, Azure, AWS. **Vendors:** Cisco, Fortinet. **Requirements:** ----------------- **4\-5 years of experience with:** * Routers: Cisco ISR 29xx, ISR 44xx; Catalyst 8200/8300\. * Firewalls: Cisco ASA, Firewall Management Center (FMC), Firepower Threat Defense (FTD); * Switches: Cisco, Fortinet, HP, Aruba; * Technologies: routing, switching, OSPF, BGP, STP, MST, VLAN, LACP, IPsec, SSL VPN, NAT, IPS, 802\.1X, IPS, NTP, SNMP; * Windows domain services understanding, * English \- intermediate. **Big plus will be experience with:** ------------------------------------- * Cisco certificates: CCNA, CCNP * Azure/AWS/GCP experience. * Scripting on Linux, and Windows. * VoIP knowledge. * VMware ESX/ESXi (VMware vSphere, vCloud, HyperV). **Duties:** ----------- * network architecture design, * network configuration and security management, * network related incidents and problems resolution, * network devices configuration (routers, switches, firewalls, WLAN controllers), * network related activities on customers projects, * work with Windows domain services (AD, DNS, DHCP, NPS) within network management activities, * documentation management; * Potential VoIP solutions configuration.

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Java Developer to join a project for a large US\-based global investment and technology company operating in the Investment Management / FinTech domain. This is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Dallas, TX. The role provides an opportunity to work in a highly technical financial environment with complex enterprise systems, business\-critical applications, and demanding engineering standards. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, develop, and maintain web applications and backend services using Java. * Develop and support backend APIs and enterprise application components. * Participate in technical design and code reviews. * Write and maintain unit and integration tests. * Investigate and resolve business\-critical incidents. * Work with Product Managers and business stakeholders to gather and clarify requirements. * Collaborate closely with other engineers and customer\-side stakeholders. * Contribute to solution and component design. * Write clean, maintainable, production\-quality code. * Investigate and resolve technical issues. * Contribute to improvements in application architecture, code quality, and maintainability. * Mentor less experienced engineers where appropriate. * Work independently within the customer’s engineering team and take ownership of assigned development tasks. **Required Skills \& Experience** --------------------------------- * 6\+ years of commercial Java development experience. * Strong knowledge of Core Java. * Strong understanding of multithreading and collections. * Practical experience with Spring / Spring Boot. * Strong experience designing and developing backend services and APIs. * Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases. * Experience participating in technical design and code reviews. * Experience writing unit and integration tests. * Strong software engineering fundamentals. * Ability to work independently in a senior engineering role. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders. * English level B2\+/C1 for daily written and verbal communication with the US\-based team and business users. * Valid US work authorization. * Ability to work on\-site full\-time and reside within approximately 30–60 minutes of the client’s office. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with TypeScript and React for full\-stack development. * Experience in the investment or financial services domain, including trading systems, investment services, or compliance\-related platforms. * Experience with messaging middleware, such as Kafka or similar technologies. * Experience with Python. * Experience with GenAI technologies, including RAG pipelines, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar tools.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Sales), Backend
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! **Overview** As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Sales Engineering team, you will be a core contributor to the systems that power our end\-to\-end customer vehicle purchase journey. From trade\-in and vehicle configuration through finance, leasing, and delivery — you will build reliable, well\-crafted backend services and work hands\-on with the third\-party integrations that bring those capabilities to life. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and external partners to ship features that directly impact how customers experience buying a vehicle. You'll take ownership of meaningful pieces of the stack, contribute to technical decisions within your team, and grow your scope over time. This role is ideal for an engineer who writes thoughtful, production\-quality code, takes pride in building things that work reliably, and wants to deepen their experience in a complex, high\-stakes transactional domain. **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Build and maintain backend services across the customer purchase journey — writing clean, well\-tested, production\-quality code that your teammates can rely on and build upon. * Design and implement APIs, data models, and service logic that are correct, performant, and easy to evolve as requirements change. * Integrate with third\-party providers \- valuation services, lender platforms, logistics APIs, and factory systems \- building integration layers that are reliable and well\-abstracted. * Apply sound engineering patterns to the challenges of distributed systems: error handling, retries, idempotency, and observability \- both within our own services and across external dependencies. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of features: from scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring in production. * Participate actively in code and design reviews: sharing knowledge, catching issues early, and helping maintain a high engineering bar across the team. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and partner teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet real user needs. * Contribute to improving team practices: documentation, testing standards, on\-call processes, and the day\-to\-day reliability of the systems you own. * Use AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully to increase your own velocity and share effective practices with teammates. **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. * 4\+ years in software development, with a focus on back\-end technologies * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment, both independently and as part of a team * Proficiency in one of Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or Ruby * Experience with both relational and/or non\-relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) * Experience with identity management systems (e.g., Azure AD, AWS Cognito, LDAP, Okta, Keyclock) and directory services for user authentication and management * Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a passion for finding elegant solutions to complex challenges **Location \& Travel Expectations**: This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in San Ramon, California or Charlotte, North Carolina. * The responsibilities of this role require 1 day per week attendance in office with in\-person meetings and events regularly. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. ***Nice to have*** * *Experience building AI/ML platform foundations or developer AI tooling.* * *Experience in automotive, mobility, retail, ecommerce, or digital consumer products.* * *Experience building multi\-tenant platforms and shared enterprise services.* * Passport required #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $140,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Initial California base salary range\= $154,000 \- $187,000 Internal leveling code: IC9 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Application Developer - Security Engineering
jobs.description: By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work\-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve. Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies Certified as a Great Place to Work® Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services \& Insurance Application Developer \- Security Engineering**PRIMARY PURPOSE** =================== Designs, develops, and maintains applications, integrations, and automation that support enterprise security operations. Partners with Security Operations, IAM, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture to turn detection and response requirements into working software. Builds and tunes content within the organization’s SIEM platform, develops data pipelines that feed it, and automates response workflows. Applies secure\-by\-default engineering practices, least privilege, and documented change control to everything delivered. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities** ============================================ **Application development** --------------------------- * Develops, tests, and maintains applications, APIs, and services supporting security operations and compliance reporting. * Writes code that follows secure development standards, including input validation, output encoding, secrets management through an approved vault, and dependency scanning in the build pipeline. * Participates in peer code review, maintains unit and integration test coverage, and supports CI/CD pipelines for application and detection content releases. * Produces and maintains technical documentation, including design decisions, data flows, interface contracts, and runbooks with named ownership. **SIEM engineering and detection content** ------------------------------------------ * Builds, tests, and tunes SIEM detection rules, correlation searches, dashboards, and scheduled reports. * Develops and maintains log ingestion pipelines: source onboarding, parsing, field extraction, normalization to a common schema, and enrichment. * Troubleshoots ingestion gaps, parsing failures, licensing and volume issues, and data quality problems affecting detection reliability. * Manages detection content as code in version control, with documented test cases, promotion through non\-production environments, and rollback procedures. * Maps detection coverage to a recognized framework such as MITRE ATT\&CK and reports coverage gaps to Security leadership. **Automation and integration** ------------------------------ * Develops integrations between the SIEM and adjacent platforms, including EDR, identity, ticketing, vulnerability management, and cloud\-native security services. * Builds SOAR playbooks and automation scripts that reduce manual analyst effort, with approval gates on any action that is destructive or privileged. * Instruments applications and infrastructure for security\-relevant logging and validates that required audit events reach the SIEM. **Governance and collaboration** -------------------------------- * Works with Security, Cloud Engineering, IAM, and application teams to gather requirements and validate that delivered tooling meets operational need. * Supports audit and compliance evidence requests related to logging, monitoring, and alerting controls. * Follows enterprise change management for all production changes, including approvals, testing evidence, and defined back\-out plans. * Participates in an on\-call or escalation rotation for critical security tooling. **Qualifications** ================== * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience considered. * Four or more years of professional software development experience. * Two or more years working directly with a SIEM platform, **Google Security Operations (Google SecOps) preferred**; comparable experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic Security, or IBM QRadar considered. * Proficiency writing SIEM query and detection logic — for example YARA\-L 2\.0 in Google SecOps, or KQL, SPL, or an equivalent query language — including performance tuning of scheduled rules and searches. * Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, C\#/.NET, Java, or Go, plus scripting with PowerShell or Bash. * Working knowledge of REST API development and consumption, JSON, authentication patterns including OAuth 2\.0, and webhook\-based integration. * Experience with Git\-based version control and CI/CD pipelines. * Practical understanding of core security concepts: authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at\-rest, logging and audit requirements, least privilege, and common attack techniques. * Demonstrated ability to document assumptions, dependencies, and operation Detection\-as\-code practices, including Sigma rules, automated detection testing, and content promotion pipelines. * SOAR development experience, **Google SecOps SOAR (formerly Siemplify) preferred**; Microsoft Sentinel playbooks, Splunk SOAR, or Cortex XSOAR also considered. Includes playbook design, custom integration and action development in Python, and case management workflow configuration. * Cloud security engineering in **Azure or AWS**, including native logging services, managed identities, and private networking patterns; working familiarity with Google Cloud a plus given the SecOps platform. * Infrastructure as code with Terraform or Bicep. * Experience supporting regulated data environments and control frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOX, or NIST CSF. * Relevant certifications, for example Google Cloud Professional Security Engineer, Google SecOps platform training or credentials, Microsoft SC\-200, GIAC GCDA or GCIA, CompTIA Security\+, or CISSP. * Experience with containerized workloads and Kubernetes. **Core Competencies** ===================== * Translates security requirements into maintainable software rather than one\-off scripts. * Communicates technical risk clearly to operations, engineering, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Exercises judgment about blast radius before acting on production systems. * Works effectively across security, infrastructure, and application teams with competing priorities. * Maintains confidentiality when handling sensitive security, customer, or employee data. **Work environment** ==================== * When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodation. * **Mental:** Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work\-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines * **Physical:** Computer keyboarding, travel as required * **Auditory/Visual:** Hearing, vision and talking * The statements contained in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by a colleague assigned to this description. They are not intended to constitute a comprehensive list of functions, duties, or local variances. Management retains the discretion to add or to change the duties of the position at any time. *As required by law, Sedgwick provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in jurisdictions requiring pay transparency in job postings. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and cost of specific location. For the jurisdiction noted in this job posting only, the range of starting pay for this role is (****$80,000\-$90,000****). A comprehensive benefits package is offered including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, 401k and matching, PTO, disability and life insurance, employee assistance, flexible spending or health savings account, and other additional voluntary benefits.* ***Always accepting applications.*** Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug\-Free Workplace. **If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Serko.ai
jobs.description: At Serko, we believe something incredible happens when people come face\-to\-face. That’s why we’re on a mission to engineer a frictionless, next\-generation business travel marketplace. We don’t just manage travel; we are leveraging advanced AI and cutting\-edge tech to eliminate the complexity of global movement. When you join Serko, you join a global collective of passionate technologists who show up as their true selves to build world\-class products. With established hubs across New Zealand, Australia, North America, India and China \- your code and ideas will impact millions of corporate travelers worldwide. If you're ready to challenge the status quo and build the future of travel tech, your next journey starts here. Working within a highly supportive team, you will shape the application experience layer—building the web apps, BFFs, and orchestration services that connect our platform directly to the customer. With light\-touch guidance, you will elevate the craft, accessibility, and quality of our user\-facing products. **Requirements** You are someone who understands the "why" behind the work, operates with high agency, and ships small, high\-impact changes frequently. **What you'll do** * Work closely with Product, Design and Engineering, modelling strong engineering standards and teamwork. * Understand the customer problem and success measure, and check that what you ship moves it. * Help shape work into small, shippable slices with requirements anyone, or any agent, could check. * Independently deliver well\-scoped features to production, in line with our stack and design system. * Implement designs faithfully and accessibly, including responsive behaviour and empty, error and loading states. * Build and extend the BFF endpoints your features need in Python. * Build AI and agent\-powered features for customers using our established patterns for streaming, latency, errors and non\-deterministic output. * Work agentically by default, giving agents clear tasks and context, writing tests from requirements first and verifying output before it ships. * Make reversible calls yourself; escalate anything that changes what ships or is costly to undo. * Lead small projects with coaching, planning the work, running stand\-ups and keeping stakeholders informed. * Deploy and support what you build, including on\-call and infrastructure changes with guidance, and instrument both system health and customer outcomes. * Contribute ideas that improve how the team works and what it ships. **What you'll bring** * Solid React/Next.js and TypeScript, and customer\-facing features shipped to production. * Working experience building APIs in Python or another backend language. * Accessibility fundamentals, including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, colour contrast and ARIA. * Plans and executes work effectively, balancing speed and quality and adapting when priorities shift. * Designs small, simple, maintainable solutions that avoid common security vulnerabilities. * Contributes to team technical discussions and recognises dependencies in the team's system. * Uses tests, metrics and dashboards to improve quality and reliability. * Deliberately builds understanding of the code you ship, so judgement grows alongside agentic productivity. * Supports peers through review and knowledge sharing, helps align the team around agreed approaches, and shows awareness of others' perspectives. * Own your growth, setting goals, seeking feedback and keeping a record of your impact. **Benefits** At Serko, we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work. This means you’ll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high\-quality and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact. Some of the benefits of working at Serko are: * A competitive base salary * Short Term Incentive Scheme * Focus on development: Access to a learning \& development platform, committed budget and opportunity for you to own your career pathways. * The pay range is between $130,000 \- $160,000 USD as a base salary offering annually.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** At Shaker, we believe people can do impactful things. Especially our people. In this role, you’ll help us transform companies by connecting them to the right solutions for their most complex talent needs. Focused on helping organizations enhance their recruitment and retention results, you’ll collaborate with co\-workers, partners, and clients to make it happen. Within our tight\-knit community, you’ll see the future you create and enjoy the team support to learn, grow, and thrive. What could be more powerful than that? Connect to the Power of People, with Shaker. **Job Description** Shaker’s Analytics team turns media, job board, applicant tracking, and client data into information our clients use to hire better and spend smarter. The Data Engineer owns the ingestion, transformation, and architecture behind that work across ad platforms, job boards, ATS data, and web analytics. We use Fivetran for automated ingestion, dbt for transformation, Snowflake as our central warehouse, and AWS for custom pipelines. You will build and maintain the pipelines, models, and data quality checks that feed our Tableau dashboards, including Track\-to\-Hire reporting, and you will be the primary owner of our media data sets and their collection. Data engineering is a growing discipline at Shaker, and this role is an opportunity to play a formative part in establishing best\-in\-class practices and procedures for how we build, document, and run our data platform. **RESPONSIBILITIES** **Data ingestion and pipelines** * Configure, manage, and monitor pipelines that ingest media platform data (Google Ads, Meta etc.), job board data, and third\-party SaaS sources into Snowflake. * Collect and maintain the core data sets used across client reporting, ensuring completeness and accuracy. * Ingest data from ATS integrations and ensure those pipelines run on schedule. * Design and maintain custom AWS pipelines that land and process API\-restricted, unstructured, or file\-based data. **Data modeling and transformation** * Build, test, and maintain modular dbt models that turn raw data into business\-ready views of campaign performance, cost metrics and candidate flow reporting. * Document data sources, definitions, pipelines, and runbooks so the team can work independently. **Data quality and monitoring** * Establish data quality checks using dbt tests and monitoring and resolve pipeline failures and data discrepancies quickly. * Automate manual data processes and build scalable workflows that reduce time spent on repetitive tasks. * Own virtual warehouse sizing, query performance, cost control, and role\-based access controls. **Stakeholder collaboration** * Partner with agency teams to translate data needs into reliable data solutions. * Support and maintain the data sources behind the dashboards used by clients and internal teams. **Qualifications*** **Experience:** + 3\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience building production\-grade data platforms and ELT/ETL pipelines. + Hands\-on experience running a cloud data warehouse in production, preferably Snowflake. + Experience with marketing or advertising data sources (e.g., Google Ads, Meta, GA4, job boards) and familiarity with using media data to report on performance and delivery. * **Technical Skills:** + Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, transformations, and query performance optimization. + Experience building and maintaining modular data models in dbt, including tests, lineage, and documentation. + Experience setting up, troubleshooting, and managing Fivetran or similar ingestion connectors. + Experience with core AWS data services (S3, Lambda, etc.) + Proficiency in Python for API data extraction, scripting, and pipeline automation. + Experience with structured and semi\-structured data, including JSON and APIs. + Familiarity with Git and version control. * **Personal Traits:** + Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. + Self\-starter who can own problems end to end and communicate status clearly. + Able to explain technical issues to non\-technical colleagues in simple, actionable terms. + Values respect, inclusion, and teamwork. + Comfortable working independently across multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. **Good to have Skills:** * Experience with ATS or recruitment marketing data, including job board and applicant data. * Experience with automated testing and deployment of data pipeline code. * Familiarity with Tableau or other BI tools. **Additional Information** **Rewards and Career Advantages** Within a culture defined by energy, fun, and talent, our team enjoys competitive pay, health and financial benefits, and the opportunity to work among innovative, friendly colleagues. **About Us** Shaker Recruitment Marketing is the leading full\-service talent marketing agency redefining how organizations attract, hire, and retain talent. With 75 years of expertise in branding, talent attraction, media, MarTech, and analytics, Shaker delivers strategies that lead with insight, fueled by creativity, and grounded in a legacy of trust and innovation.

jobs.title: Factory Data Engineer
jobs.description: **A Snapshot of Your Day** As the Factory Data Engineer, you will play a critical role in building the reliable data foundation for our new Large Power Transformer factory in Charlotte, NC. You will develop and maintain data pipelines, integrations, and scalable data infrastructure that connect operational and enterprise data and make it accessible for analytics, reporting, and digital manufacturing solutions. This role is based in Charlotte, North Carolina and closely connected to on\-site operations. You will work side\-by\-side with manufacturing, operations, digitalization, IT data teams, system owners, and external vendors. If you enjoy solving complex integration challenges and turning fragmented factory data into dependable, well\-documented data products, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the data foundation of a factory of the future. **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Build reliable data foundations by designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data ingestion pipelines and integrations for factory operations. * Connect critical data sources, integrating operational and enterprise systems including MES, SAP, PLM, IIoT connectors, APIs, and other factory platforms. * Enable the Factory Data Cloud, supporting its architecture, data flows, and dependable use as a foundation for analytics and digital solutions. * Improve data accessibility, making trusted data available to analysts, process owners, and digital use cases while supporting appropriate access controls. * Strengthen data quality and reliability by implementing quality checks, monitoring data availability, troubleshooting failures, and addressing source\-system issues. * Document data assets and interfaces, maintaining clear technical documentation for pipelines, mappings, dependencies, and data definitions. * Partner across functions, working with the Digital Transformation Officer, Data Analyst, IT data teams, operations, and MES/SAP/PLM system owners to translate business needs into sustainable data solutions. * Coordinate integration delivery, managing dependencies with internal stakeholders and external vendors and proactively addressing risks caused by non\-harmonized sources or access constraints. **What You Bring** * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, systems integration, industrial data, automation, or a related role, preferably in manufacturing or another operational environment. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Automation, Industrial Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining data pipelines, integrations, and scalable data infrastructure. * Strong working knowledge of SQL, APIs, data platforms, and data integration patterns. * Experience integrating enterprise and operational systems; exposure to MES, SAP, PLM, IIoT, or factory data platforms is strongly preferred. * Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring data availability, troubleshooting integration issues, and maintaining technical documentation. * Strong problem\-solving and systems\-thinking skills, with a reliable and methodical approach to delivery. * Experience with modern cloud\-based data platforms (Azure preferred), AWS, Snowflake, Python, SQL, ETL/ELT frameworks, and industrial connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, or similar platforms is preferred. * Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and collaborate across operations, IT, digitalization, and external partners. * Candidates must be willing to relocate to Charlotte, NC, if they are not already based in the area. * Legal authorization to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer\-sponsored work authorization. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. At Siemens Energy, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about making a difference in the energy sector. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth and development. Be a part of our mission to deliver superior transformer solutions to the world. **Who is Siemens Energy?** At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \+100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo **Rewards** * Career growth and development opportunities * Supportive work culture * Company paid Health and wellness benefits * Paid Time Off and paid holidays * 401K savings plan with company match * Family building benefits * Parental leave **Jobs \& Careers:** https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs \#LI\-KM1

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: **About the Company** ===================== Pilots don't train with real passengers. Actors don't rehearse with real audiences. Yet, the most consequential decisions in society are often pushed straight to production. Simile is changing that. We have built the first AI simulation of society, populated by generative agents based on real humans. Our research pioneered the field of AI\-based simulation, proving it is possible to model human behavior with high accuracy. Today, we are developing a Foundation Model to predict human behavior in any situation, at any scale. We have raised $300M in total funding, with a $2B post\-money valuation in our latest round. Our investors include Greenoaks, Index Ventures, Hanabi, A\*, Bain Capital Ventures, Factory, CVS Health Ventures, and Definition. **About the Team** ================== The Security team is the guardian of our simulation’s integrity. We ensure that as we model human society, we do so with uncompromising privacy and world\-class defenses. We operate at the intersection of application security, AI safety, and enterprise\-grade privacy to protect our foundation models and our customers' most sensitive data. We organize our work into three core pillars: * **Application Security:** Partnering with engineers to "shift left," conducting threat models and secure design reviews to catch vulnerabilities before they reach production. * **Product and AI/ML Security:** Defending our generative agents against emerging threats like prompt injection, data poisoning, and model extraction. * **Infrastructure \& Compliance:** Hardening our multi\-cloud footprint (AWS/GCP) and automating identity management (SAML/SCIM) to maintain SOC2 and HIPAA standards. **About the Role** ================== We are looking for a Security Engineer who thrives on securing novel AI products. You will own the security roadmap, ensuring our platform is resilient, compliant, and stays ahead of an ever\-evolving threat landscape. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Customer Security \& Trust:** Partner with our largest enterprise customers to navigate the procurement process , leading technical discussions regarding security agreements, providing comprehensive posture overviews, and ensuring alignment on rigorous data handling requirements * **Lead Secure Design:** Conduct threat modeling and secure design reviews for new features, ensuring security is a core consideration from initial design through implementation. * **Automate Defenses:** Develop tooling and "paved paths" that allow our engineering and research teams to ship code safely without sacrificing velocity. * **Own Vulnerability Management:** Oversee our bug bounty program and internal vulnerability scanning, prioritizing fixes based on actual risk to our foundation models. * **Secure AI/ML Pipelines:** Build specific defenses against AI\-novel risks, including protecting high\-throughput inference systems and GPU\-accelerated computing environments. * **Champion GitOps Security:** Manage security configurations via Terraform/Pulumi, ensuring "security\-as\-code" is the truth across all multi\-region environments. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Must Haves** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in application or infrastructure security within a high\-growth environment. * **Security Polyglot:** Deep expertise in securing AWS environments; experience with GCP or Azure is a major plus. * **Offensive Mindset:** Ability to think like an attacker to anticipate risks, paired with a collaborative spirit to help engineers remediate them. * **Operational Mindset:** Experience with modern observability and a "you build it, you run it" mentality toward security infrastructure. * **Agentic Security Tooling:** Experience integrating agentic AI workflows into the developer lifecycle to provide real\-time security feedback, enabling engineers to be "secure\-by\-design" as code is written rather than after the fact. ### **Nice to Haves** * **AI/ML Security:** Experience securing AI/ML workloads, specifically defending against prompt injection or protecting model weights. * **Kubernetes Mastery:** Strong K8s (EKS/GKE) experience, specifically around multi\-tenant security and resource isolation. * **Compliance Expertise:** Proven track record of navigating SOC2, HIPAA, or similar regulatory frameworks in a cloud\-native environment. **Compensation \& Benefits** ============================ At **Simile**, we provide competitive compensation packages that include base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. * **Salary Range:** $200,000 – $400,000 USD + *Note: Final offers are based on experience, specialized skills, interview performance, and relevant training.* * **Equity:** Grants are available for eligible roles, subject to board approval. * **Health \& Wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. * **Time Off:** Flexible time off policies to support work\-life balance. **Our Process** =============== We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring journey is designed to help both sides align on fit, working style, and expectations. **Reapplication Policy:** To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Simile observes a **90\-day waiting period** before reconsidering candidates for the same role. **Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** ======================================== **Equal Opportunity:** Simile is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities, valuing an environment where everyone can contribute authentically. **Accommodations:** If you require support or reasonable accommodations during the application process due to a disability, please let us know. We are happy to assist.

jobs.title: Senior IOS Engineer
jobs.description: **About SimpliSafe** We're a high\-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here. We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state\-of\-the\-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done. **Why are we hiring?** Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. **What We're Doing** The Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) organization owns the full user experience from the moment someone unboxes their SimpliSafe system through their entire life as a subscriber. The Onboarding Experience team owns one of the first steps in that journey: setting up and pairing new hardware devices like doorbells and cameras. Your work will ensure the pairing and setup experience is a seamless and straightforward introduction to SimpliSafe's app and monitoring features. **What You'll Bring** * **Domain expertise:** You've shipped and maintained production iOS apps. You're comfortable, or can quickly get comfortable, building UX in UIKit and SwiftUI. Experience with Bluetooth LE, CoreBluetooth, Wi\-Fi provisioning, or video is a nice\-to\-have, but not required to apply. * **Technical judgement:** You've shipped a short term fix, and then gone back and done it right. You can navigate real\-world tradeoffs with a good design in mind. You know when to use AI agents and when to do things yourself. * **A UX focus:** You've advocated for users even when the technical problems got hard. * **Ownership:** You've taken a feature from idea to production and stayed with it after launch. When something breaks, you dig in without waiting to be asked. * **Curiosity:** You're curious about every part of the stack (hardware, firmware, cloud services), and you get excited to partner with engineers in other specialties to build something cool. **What You'll Be Doing** * Designing, building, and maintaining the app pairing and setup flows for hardware: from device discovery and Bluetooth LE connection, to Wi\-Fi setup and first\-run experience, to camera live streaming and audio. * Getting your hands on early versions of devices; partnering with UX designers, hardware, firmware, and backend peers to create good user experiences across our stack. * Owning broad swaths of features from idea to definition to implementation. * Improving the reliability, testability, and observability of the setup experience. * Growing the team around you through feedback and code reviews. **How We'll Evaluate You** * New devices ship on time and are delightful to use. * Setup and pairing success rates improve, and customers reach a working device faster. * The technical designs you lead hold up in production, and risks surface early rather than late. * You are a solid contributor to the day\-to\-day work of the team: design discussions, technical documents and threads, PR reviews, and of course the code itself. **How We'll Support You** We've kept the team intentionally small, but we cover all our bases. You'll have dedicated product and design partners and an engineering manager who cares about your growth and provides regular feedback. You'll have iOS, Android, and backend developers as peers. You'll have a Digital Foundations team that supports the app as a whole and builds tools to make your life easier. You'll have access to an agent with custom skills and context (we use Claude Code) and plenty of tokens to drive it. **What Values You'll Share** * Customer Obsessed \- Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long\-term relationships with them. * Aim High \- Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar. * No Ego \- Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style. * One Team \- Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success. * Lift As We Climb \- Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. * Lean \& Nimble \- Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. **What We Offer** * A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive * A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families *(For more information on our total rewards please* *click here**)* * Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. The target annual base pay range for this role is $117,300 \- $156,400 This target annual base pay range represents our good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role.
