jobs.title: Revenue Operations (RevOps) AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Singlewire Software, based in Madison, Wisconsin, is dedicated to shaping a future where every organization can protect its people with confidence. We deliver innovative solutions, including InformaCast critical communication and incident management software, the InformaCast Wearable Alert Badge, and Visitor Aware visitor and safety management software. Our technology helps organizations instantly reach the right people, coordinate responses, and manage critical events — empowering schools, healthcare systems, manufacturers, enterprises, and public organizations to create safer environments. Just as important as what we build is how we work. We’re a collaborative, supportive team that cares deeply about our mission, our customers, and each other. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Our business and our solutions are growing. We are creating a position to support Revenue Operations (RevOps), which supports Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. You will help leadership shape critical go\-to\-market insights and actions through various technologies and data analytics. We are looking for this role to build out the workflows, data integrations, and intelligence layers that turn our operational data into high\-leverage business decisions. Your focus will be acting as a pragmatic engineer and system builder: connecting cross\-platform data pipelines, designing autonomous or human\-in\-the\-loop AI agents, building automated GTM workflows, and helping drive enterprise AI governance. Are you motivated, have a growth mindset, and want to build the revenue engine from scratch rather than inherit someone else's legacy system? Then you might be just the person we’re looking for to join our dynamic, growing company consistently rated as one of the best places to work in Madison. **What You’ll Do** Your responsibilities may include: * Architect the GTM Data Foundation: Partner with IT to evaluate and improve our centralized GTM data warehouse layer and ingestion pipelines, building reliable cross\-system extraction from Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, Orum, 6sense, ZoomInfo, etc. * Collaborate on Data Definitions \& Quality: Partner with RevOps, Sales, Marketing, and Finance leadership to refine and align on existing funnel definitions (MQL, SQL, pipeline stages) and data models; implement identity resolution across platforms and build automated checks to catch and resolve discrepancies before they reach reporting. * Build AI Workflows and Agents: Prototype, test, and ship end\-to\-end automations — from deterministic API workflows to autonomous multi\-step agents — to deliver real\-time GTM intelligence, including automated deal\-risk alerts, cross\-system pipeline summaries, meeting prep briefs, account intent signals, and hygiene nudges. * Business Process Improvement: Understand current business processes, develop tools to support or redefine processes to optimize workflows and go to market effectiveness driving business goals including Revenue growth. * Lead Build vs. Buy Strategy: Audit native AI capabilities embedded within our existing SaaS licenses (Gong, Outreach, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Salesforce) and make clear recommendations on whether to extend native tools or build custom AI agents based on business impact and cost considerations. * Adhere to and Operationalize AI Governance \& Security: Partner directly with IT and Security to operationalize enterprise AI policies and data\-security standards. Implement technical guardrails—including access control tiers, sandbox environments, audit logging, and data\-scrubbing workflows for regulated customer data (education, healthcare, government)—while actively providing feedback to security leadership regarding security policy and controls. * Integrate with Modern Protocols: Integrate LLMs directly with business data via direct REST APIs, SDKs, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) connections, building effective execution harnesses and guardrails. * Collaborate with Admins \& Stakeholders: Work day\-to\-day with the Director of RevOps and Salesforce Administrator, translating business bottlenecks into automated technical solutions without getting bogged down in routine CRM ticket administration. * Measure Impact: Track every automation and agent by tangible operational leverage: hours saved, data latency reduction, and pipeline conversion impact. * Partner with key stakeholders to ensure adoption of automations through user training, tuning and support. **The Person We’re Looking For** -------------------------------- **Required Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical work experience. * 4\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or technical RevOps/GTM engineering, including hands\-on pipeline building. * Experience standing up or working with cloud data warehouses and implementing automated pipelines to ingest, clean, and model SaaS data into analytics\-ready tables. * Strong SQL proficiency and hands\-on programming skills (e.g., Python or TypeScript) with practical experience writing scripts and connecting to third\-party REST APIs. * Hands\-on experience developing or connecting AI ingestion models to business systems. * Hands\-on experience building production applications with LLMs, including API integrations, agentic workflows, prompt design, tool/function calling, retrieval, and output validation. * A pragmatic builder mindset with a bias toward shipping, rapid iteration, and business outcomes over theoretical perfection — knowing how to establish testing guardrails, sandbox harnesses, and access controls while moving fast. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into plain business terms for senior leaders. **Other Skills That Will Make You Stand Out:** * Working knowledge of Salesforce data structures (standard/custom objects, Opportunity history, lead lifecycles, and security models) and experience collaborating effectively with Salesforce Admins. * Prior integration experience with our specific stack: Gong, Outreach, Orum, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Qualified, or Tableau. * Experience closing the loop by syncing data, signals, and model outputs back into frontline operational systems (CRM, engagement platforms) so teams can take immediate action * Experience implementing technical security controls, data\-masking routines, and audit logging for applications handling sensitive customer data in regulated sectors (such as education, healthcare, or government). * Experience operating as a founding technical contributor in a high\-growth SaaS business. **More About this Role** ------------------------ Our current application stack includes: * Salesforce (Sales Cloud, CPQ, Account Engagement, Experience Cloud) * Tableau Next \& Cloud Data Infrastructure (BigQuery / Warehouse layer) * 6sense, ZoomInfo, Qualified, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, BriteVerify * Gong, Outreach, Orum * Jira (to track work) * Enterprise LLM platforms, custom Python/API connectors, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations **Our Culture** --------------- At Singlewire, we believe what we do truly matters. We’re passionate about protecting people and helping organizations respond when it counts. We’re a team of collaborators who support each other, work hard toward shared goals, and celebrate successes together. Singlewire Software LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability. jobs.description: We invite you to review our current business services professionals openings to learn about the opportunities available across the firm. **About Us** Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher \& Flom LLP has forged a reputation as one of the most prestigious law firms in the world. Relying on innovation, intellect, teamwork and tenacity, our lawyers deliver the highest quality advice and novel solutions to our clients’ legal issues. We are known for handling the most complex transactions, litigation/controversy issues, and regulatory matters, as well as for the strong partnerships we build with clients and each other. Our attorneys, who reflect a broad range of experiences and perspectives, work together seamlessly across 50\-plus practices and 21 offices in the world’s major financial centers. **The Opportunity** We are seeking a **Legal Technology Support and Site Reliability Engineer** to join our Firm. This position will be based in our New York office (hybrid). **Position Overview** Applies a strong hands\-on software development background to support the secure operation of the Firm’s legal technology applications and supporting infrastructure. Serves as an escalation point for application support, triaging requests, providing L2/L3 application support, and leading the response to outages and incidents in coordination with stakeholders across the Firm. Improves service availability through monitoring, code\-level troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and automation, and turns support insights into prioritized improvements for the development team. Reads and debugs application code, implements fixes, builds services, APIs, and tools, and helps deploy and maintain applications in production. Partners with users, development teams, and infrastructure and security teams to resolve issues and improve the support experience. Also helps build and support the Firm’s AI infrastructure, contributes to AI agent development, and participates in AI research and development projects as operational priorities permit. **Responsibilities** * Triages incoming support requests, assesses business impact and urgency, prioritizes work, and tracks requests through resolution, escalating issues as appropriate. * Provides L2/L3 support for web\-based and desktop applications, troubleshooting complex application, database, API, integration, and environment issues escalated from the Help Desk. Reads source code, reproduces defects, uses debugging tools, and implements and tests code fixes in coordination with development teams and established code review and release processes. * Responds to application outages and service degradation, coordinates investigation and service restoration with technical teams and vendors, and keeps stakeholders informed of impact, status, workarounds, and resolution. * Monitors application and infrastructure health, including service status, logs, performance metrics, and server resource usage; responds to alerts and improves dashboards and alert thresholds to identify issues early and reduce noise. * Diagnoses, fixes, and updates application configurations using established change control procedures, documenting changes and validating results and rollback steps. * Creates and maintains technical runbooks for common issues, FAQs, and internal troubleshooting guides; shares knowledge with support teams. * Sets up and maintains departments and related organizational structures within applications, coordinating approved changes with business owners and validating associated access, workflows, and configuration. * Investigates recurring issues, performs root cause analysis, prepares post\-incident reviews, and tracks corrective and preventive actions to completion to reduce repeat incidents and support requests. * Analyzes support ticket trends, identifies recurring issues and user pain points, and provides reproducible defect reports and recommendations to development teams to inform prioritization of fixes and improvements. * Designs, develops, tests, and maintains services, APIs, and integrations that support business needs and improve application reliability and operations. Build’s automation tools, scripts, internal dashboards, and diagnostic queries to automate repetitive fixes, speed up diagnosis, and reduce manual support work. * Partners with application and infrastructure teams to define and monitor service health and reliability measures, identify capacity and resilience risks, and improve recovery procedures. * Helps build and deploy applications and services across development, test, and production environments; contributes to CI/CD pipelines, troubleshoots build and deployment failures, and performs operational readiness checks, deployment validation, and rollback activities using established change control procedures. * Helps build, deploy, and operate AI infrastructure and services, including model endpoints, integrations, monitoring, and access controls, in partnership with development, infrastruct ly during incidents, and coordinate issue resolution across users, developers, infrastructure teams, and vendors. * Knowledge of legal technology applications or law firm environments a plus * Strong problem solving abilities and an aptitude for learning new technologies * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and planning skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to prioritize work effectively. * Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters. * Proven ability to thrive in demanding, fast\-paced environments, manage multiple projects and shifting priorities, and work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team. * Flexibility to adjust hours and work the hours necessary to meet operating and business needs **Education and Experience Required** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience * Minimum of four years’ experience in software development, site reliability engineering, or application support, including at least two years of professional software development and experience supporting production applications and responding to incidents **Culture \& Life at Skadden** What makes Skadden special is our people and the culture, community and spirit of collaboration we have created. We believe in teamwork and inspiring each other to be our best in an atmosphere that promotes professionalism and excellence in all that we do. We know that inclusion and drawing on the strength of a wide spectrum of talent only make us better and is vital to the firm's success. Our goal is for everyone at the firm to enjoy a challenging career with opportunities for development and growth and to support the well\-being of our attorneys and business services professionals. **Benefits** The overall well\-being of our team is important to us. We offer generous benefits to help you achieve wellness in all areas of your life. * Competitive salaries and year\-end discretionary bonuses. * Comprehensive health care (medical, dental, vision), savings plan/401(k) and voluntary benefits. * Generous paid time off. * Paid leave options, including parental. * In\-classroom, remote, and on\-demand learning and professional development opportunities. * Robust well\-being classes and programs. * Opportunities to give back and make an impact in local communities. For further details, please visit: https://www.skadden.com/careers/staff/employee\-benefits The starting base salary for this position is expected to be within the range listed under Salary Details. It does not discriminate against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor including, but not limited to, race, color, religion, creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, alienage or citizenship status, marital or familial status, domestic partnership status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, change of sex or transgender status, genetic information, medical condition, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual and reproductive health decisions, disability, any protected military or veteran status, or status as a victim of domestic or dating violence, sexual assault or offense, or stalking. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Financial Services
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. **Senior Software Engineer Financial Services** At the heart of the PlayStation Network is the Commerce Platform, servicing 30\+ million customers daily. The platform delivers services including product browsing, purchasing, subscription fulfillment, and payment options. **About the Role:** ------------------- We are seeking a Senior level Engineer to help drive the ongoing evolution of PlayStation's Global Financial Systems, with a strong focus on building event\-driven pipelines and intuitive frontends. While your initial focus will be delivering scalable solutions for PlayStation's finance systems, anticipate growth potential to expand into other areas across the business, driving efficiency and innovation. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Lead \& Innovate: Architect and develop robust, event\-driven microservices in Go, designed to manage high\-volume, real\-time financial transactions and data flows. * Modernize \& Refine: Translate legacy ETL and reporting systems into the modern tech stack, moving from NodeJS, Informatica to primarily React and Go * Collaborate \& Impact: Work multi\-functionally with teams across engineering, product management, finance, and compliance to ensure solutions are resilient, compliant, and strategically aligned. * Leverage AI/ML: Pioneer the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning to automate manual finance tasks such as reconciliations, reporting, forecasting, and financial journal creation\-enhancing accuracy, efficiency, and innovation. * Real\-Time Excellence: Design, deploy, and optimize streaming technologies like Kafka to deliver real\-time financial insights and ensure rapid response capabilities. * Strategic Integration: Advocate and facilitate seamless integration of microservices across diverse financial applications and services, driving scalability, reliability, and future\-proof solutions. **Skills and Qualifications:** ------------------------------ * Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field – or equivalent professional experience * 6\+ years of experience in large\-scale software engineering, specializing in event\-driven architectures and distributed systems. * Expertise in Golang or similar languages, building highly scalable, real\-time microservices as well as REST APIs * Proficiency in designing, building and maintaining single\-page applications using React or similar frameworks * Capability to automate financial processes such as payment settlements and reconciliation, revenue recognition, and royalties, with consideration of how to extend similar solutions to non\-financial systems. * Proficiency in SQL and data modeling with a wide variety of databases. Nice to have experience with additional reporting databases such as Oracle and Snowflake. * Experience working with cloud platforms, including managing hybrid cloud/on\-prem environments in AWS. * Proficiency with the following tools (or similar): Issue Tracking (e.g. JIRA, Service Now), Collaboration (e.g. Confluence, Trello), Communication (e.g. Slack, Webex, Skype for Business), Version Control (e.g. Github), Automation (e.g. Jenkins, Ansible, CloudFormation, Terraform) * Extensive experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD). You should be proficient in automating build, test, and deployment processes using modern CI/CD tools and platforms (e.g. Github Actions, Jenkins, etc). **Why SIE?** ------------ This is your opportunity to be at the forefront of designing and implementing pioneering technology that powers a global entertainment leader. You'll work on exciting, impactful systems that touch millions of users, while also having the flexibility to grow your skills and contribute across various business areas. **Benefits \& Perks:** ---------------------- * Competitive salary * 401K with company match, education assistance, generous paid leave, and more * On\-site gym and café * Break rooms with networked PlayStation consoles and monthly game voucher * Remote work flexibility with opportunities to collaborate across global teams Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

alerting). * Strong Python development skills with experience building production\-grade services or tooling. * Experience building LLM agents in production, including tool use, prompt and context design, and evaluation of agent behavior. * Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable tool integrations that let LLM agents call internal APIs and data sources. * AWS\-based applications. * Develop and maintain APIs and integrations supporting Life Agency Compensation and dependent enterprise capabilities. * Apply current coding, testing, security, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and automated testing practices. * Diagnose and resolve application, integration, cloud, and production\-support issues. * Participate in technical design and architecture discussions and contribute to repeatable engineering approaches for modernization. * Support operational responsibilities associated with Life Agency Compensation to help ensure compensation\-related processing continues to operate timely and accurately throughout modernization. * Demonstrate a DevOps and Agile mindset with shared product accountability from development through production support and eventual retirement. * Employ continuous\-learning and continuous\-improvement practices and remain current on relevant technologies and software engineering methods. Qualifications: ### **Primary Technical Capabilities** * Full\-stack application development * AWS / public cloud application development * Python * js / JavaScript * Angular / modern UI development * REST APIs and service integration * Git / GitLab * CI/CD and DevSecOps practices * Automated unit and integration testing * JSON and SQL and/or NoSQL data technologies * Application logging, monitoring, and observability * Secure software\-development practices ### **Strongly Desired Experience** * AWS application development and cloud\-native solut o understand complex business rules, data flows, integrations, and financially sensitive transactional processing. ### **Mainframe Experience** **Mainframe development experience is beneficial but not required.** The strategic priority for this position is modern full\-stack and AWS engineering capability. jobs.title: AI Engineer – Agentic Systems, Officer - State Street Investment Management
jobs.description: **About the Role** State Street Investment Management’s Data, Analytics and AI Services team is seeking an AI Engineer – Agentic Systems to build, test, deploy, and measure agentic AI solutions that transform business workflows across the investment management organization. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who takes defined and scoped AI use cases from prototype to production, turning them into reliable, governed, and auditable AI agents that connect to enterprise data and applications. The successful candidate will address data readiness and integration challenges, build rigorous evaluation and auditability into every solution, and ensure deployed agents deliver measurable workflow improvements while meeting the strong governance, risk, and control standards of a regulated financial\-services environment. Working closely with the Senior Principal Architect for Agentic and MLOps Operations, business stakeholders, data and platform teams, and control partners, this role is an opportunity to be a founding member of a growing agentic AI engineering capability. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and deliver production\-grade agentic AI solutions, from prototype through deployment, that automate and enhance business workflows across the investment management organization. * Assess and address data readiness at the outset of each solution: profile, map, and validate source data; resolve quality and access gaps; and build pipelines, APIs, or semantic layers that make existing systems and data consumable by AI agents. * Develop agent logic, including prompts, retrieval, tool/API integrations, and orchestration, connecting agents to enterprise data sources and business applications. * Implement deterministic validation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval steps to ensure AI outputs are accurate and safe for business decisions. * Build end\-to\-end auditability into every solution capturing inputs, data sources, model versions, tool calls, outputs, and human approvals. Produce documentation and evidence for governance, risk, compliance, and audit reviews. * Create test sets and evaluation pipelines to verify accuracy, grounding, reliability, and resilience against edge cases and adversarial inputs such as prompt injection. * Partner with business users during user acceptance testing to validate that solutions deliver the intended workflow improvements, and refine solutions based on feedback. * Deploy, monitor, and maintain solutions via CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code, tracking quality, latency, cost, and business outcome metrics, and troubleshooting, tuning, and upgrading solutions in production. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, including hands\-on experience building AI/ML or LLM\-based applications (production experience preferred). * Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production\-grade APIs, services, and integrations with enterprise systems. * Strong SQL and data engineering skills, including data profiling, quality validation, transformation, and pipeline development across structured and unstructured enterprise data sources. * Hands\-on experience building agentic AI solutions, including LLM tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and multi\-step orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK, or similar. * Solid working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, particularly Vertex AI, Gemini models, and BigQuery, along with core GCP compute, storage, networking, and IAM services. * Experience designing LLM evaluation and testing approaches, including test datasets, accuracy and grounding metrics, regression testing, and guardrails against prompt injection and unsafe outputs. * Experience building auditable AI systems, including decision traceability, audit logging, lineage of data and model versions, and records of human approvals. * Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), containerization, observability, and cloud security practices such as identity federation, secrets management, and least\-privilege access. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with business users through acceptance testing and to document solutions for technical, risk, and governance audiences. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Microsoft Azure and Entra ID, and building on Microsoft 365 data (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) via Microsoft Graph or Copilot extensibility. * Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise SaaS and data sources such as Salesforce CRM, Marketo, master data management (MDM), and cloud\-hosted or on\-premises systems, including via Model Context Protocol (MCP) or API enablement of legacy systems; familiarity with TypeScript or Java for building integrations and services. * Experience delivering AI solutions in financial services or another regulated industry, including familiarity with model risk management, Responsible AI, data privacy, and investment management data. **Salary Range:** $70,000 \- $118,750 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. *Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long\-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid\-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance\-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.* *For a full overview, visit* *https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home* *.* **About State Street** ====================== Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law. Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers Read our CEO Statement **Job Application Disclosure:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Publications Specialist 3
jobs.description: **Welcome to the Department of Health!** **We’d be delighted to have you join our team.** **If you envision yourself in this role and are ready to start an exciting career with us, apply today!** **This position is open to Alaskan Residents only.** **Please check out the**residency definition**to determine if you qualify.** **What you will be doing:** In this role, you will provide crucial support to our Publications Specialists in maintaining and improving the Department of Health’s public website on the Umbraco CMS platform and Employee Hub on SharePoint 365\. You will: * Collaborate with subject matter experts to draft, edit, and publish clear, engaging content tailored to public and employee audiences. * Provide written and technical support, creating user\-friendly webpages, forms, graphics, and imagery that meet department standards and accessibility requirements. * Assist with website enhancements, including Azure Search and translation features, to help users find and access department information. * Use Siteimprove to monitor content performance, identify accessibility issues, and guide data\-driven improvements to website content and the user experience. **Our organization, mission, and culture:** The Department of Health's mission is to promote and protect the health and well\-being of Alaskans. Our team members are expected to be high\-performing professionals who can work independently with limited direct supervision. Our office values positive attitudes, teamwork, innovation, efficiency, and a growth mindset. To be successful in this environment, team members must demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively, both in the work we produce for the department and with our clients, fellow coworkers, and other collaborators. **The benefits of joining our team:** At the Department of Health, we believe in taking care of the people who take care of Alaska. In addition to the meaningful work you will do every day, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your career, well\-being, and life outside of work. Benefits include: * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family * Generous retirement plans to help you build long\-term financial security * Paid leave * Professional development and training opportunities to support career growth * Job stability and career advancement within a statewide public service system * Employee wellness programs and support resources Most importantly, you will gain the opportunity to build a purpose\-driven career where your work directly improves the lives of Alaskans and strengthens communities across the state. **The working environment you can expect:** This Anchorage\-based position is part of the Department’s centralized Communications Team and Rural Healthcare Transformation Program and currently follows a hybrid schedule combining remote and in\-office work, as appropriate. Because DOH is one of the State of Alaska’s largest and broadest departments, the daily environment is fast\-paced, varied, challenging, and creative, requiring independent and collaborative work on both long\-term projects and time\-sensitive communications for audiences across the state. **Who we are looking for:** The ideal candidate will possess some or all of the following position\-specific competencies in addition to the minimum qualifications listed below: * **Professionalism:** Consistently displays the collection of competencies and skill expected of a professional. Professionalism is defined by its key behaviors including being accountable for actions and assigned projects; practicing efficient work habits to effectively manage time and workload; clearly communicating and expressing thoughts and ideas in writing and in person; possessing the ability to understand how non\-verbal communication impacts the workplace; working effectively as part of a team to achieve productive outcomes; and consistently demonstrating, emotional intelligence, integrity, and ethical behavior. * **Accessibility:** Knowledge of tools, equipment, and technologies used to help individuals with disabilities use computer equipment and software. * **Quality Assurance:** Knowledge of the principles, methods, and tools of quality assurance and quality control used to ensure a product fulfills functional requirements and standards. **Special Notice**: * This position may require travel within the state of Alaska. ***To view the general description and example of duties for this job class, please go to the following link and search for*** **Publications Specialist 3*****:*** ***https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/Alaska/classspecs*** **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- **Competency\-Based Minimum Qualifications Instructions** This job class uses competency\-based minimum qualifications. **Please ensure your application** (through work history, volunteer experience (duties summary), training, education, licenses, certifications, etc.) support llowing emails from the 'governmentjobs.com' domain, visit the Lost Password Help page at: https://www.governmentjobs.com/OnlineApplication/User/ResetPassword. **EEO STATEMENT** The State of Alaska complies with Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Box 110201, Juneau, AK 99811\-0201\. The State of Alaska is an equal\-opportunity employer. **WORKPLACE ALASKA APPLICATION QUESTIONS \& ASSISTANCE** Questions regarding application submission or system operation errors should be directed to the Workplace Alaska hotline at 1\-800\-587\-0430 (toll\-free) or (907\) 465\-4095 if you are in the Juneau area. Requests for information may also be emailed to recruitment.services@alaska.gov **For assistance with applying for a password, please visit** **https://www.governmentjobs.com/OnlineApplication/User/ResetPassword** **Contact Information** ----------------------- **For specific information in reference to the position, feel free to contact the hiring manager at:** Sara Tennis, Department Communications Manager **Phone:** (907\)720\-3640 **Email:** **sara.tennis@alaska.gov** **Careers with the State of Alaska offer MANY benefits** The following information describes **typical** benefits available to employees of the State of Alaska. Actual benefits received may differ by bargaining unit or branch of government, position type, or be prorated for other than full time work. For a quick breakdown of the insurance, health, and retirement benefits available for State Employees you can view an orientation video from Division of Retirement and Benefits. Edgecumbe Teachers - Supervisory - Unlicensed Vessel Personnel/Inland Boatman's Union - Exempt employees (not covered by collective bargaining) + The following employee groups are covered by Union health trusts. Contact the appropriate Union for additional information. - General Government - Labor, Trades and Crafts - Public Safety Employees Association - Masters, Mates \& Pilots * Employer paid Basic Life insurance with additional coverage available (amount depends on Bargaining Unit) **Optional Insurance Benefits** * Group\-based insurance premiums for + Term life (employee, spouse or qualified same sex partner, and dependents) + Long\-term and short\-term disability + Accidental Death and Dismemberment + Long\-term care (self and eligible family members) + Supplemental Survivor Benefits * Employee\-funded flexible spending accounts for tax savings on eligible health care or dependent care expenses **Retirement Benefits*** Membership in the Public Employees Retirement System (PERS)/Teachers' Retirement System (TRS) * Matching employer contribution into a defined contribution program (new employees) * Employer contribution into a defined benefit or defined contribution program (current employees) * Contributions to the Alaska Supplemental Annuity Plan in lieu of contributions to Social Security * Option to enroll in the Alaska Deferred Compensation Program * ***Note: The Defined Contribution Plan, Supplemental Annuity Plan and Deferred Compensation Program offer a variety of investment options*** See https://drb.alaska.gov/retiree/ for additional information **Paid Leave \& Other Benefits** * Personal leave with an accrual rate increase based on time served * Twelve (12\) paid holidays a year

jobs.title: AI Developer (Austin)
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- WHO WE ARE: Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) connects people with careers across the state. While we are based in Austin on the north lawn of the Texas State Capitol, we have offices statewide. We're a Family Friendly Certified Workplace with great work\-life balance, competitive salaries, extensive opportunities for training and development, and fantastic benefits. This position is based at 1411 Brazos Street, Austin in the Information Technology Division. TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H\-1B, F\-1 (OPT/CPT), or H\-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. WHO YOU ARE: A Multi\-Language (Python/Java) Developer: You are a versatile engineer who thrives on using the right tool for the job. You have a strong background in Python for building modern, high\-performance web applications and integrating advanced AI APIs, combined with solid experience in Java to support enterprise\-level systems. A Legacy\-to\-Modern Bridge Builder: You aren't intimidated by legacy infrastructure. You are excited by the challenge of translating, modernizing, and migrating critical state workflows away from legacy mainframes (like COBOL and Natural) and rewriting them into robust, modern Java environments. An AI\-Driven Problem Solver: You are passionate about the intersection of software engineering and Artificial Intelligence. You want to apply your Python skills to design, build, and deploy the next generation of secure, agency\-wide AI utilities (such as high\-capacity transcription engines and division\-specific intelligent agents) that improve public service delivery. A Collaborative Communicator: You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams of developers, database administrators, and business leads. You can talk legacy mainframe logic with senior database engineers, and modern API architecture with AI developers, bringing people and systems together. WHAT YOU WILL DO: The AI Developer (Programmer V\-VI) performs highly advanced to supervisory (senior\-level) computer programming and systems analysis work for TWC. In this role, you will play a key part in connecting the agency’s technical ecosystem by securely integrating new applications with existing vendor solutions, ensuring optimal performance, compliance, security, and scalability. This work is performed under minimal supervision, with opportunities for considerable to extensive latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. You will split your focus between driving modern, Python\-based AI innovations and executing critical legacy system migrations into modern Java architectures. YOU WILL BE TRUSTED TO: * Develop Modern AI Solutions (Python): Partner with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and integrate secure, in\-house AI tools, high\-capacity transcription engines, and custom division\-level agents. * Modernize Legacy Systems (Java): Analyze existing business logic within mainframe systems (Natural/COBOL) and systematically refactor and rewrite those processes into clean, maintainable, and efficient Java code. * Build REST APIs \& Data Pipelines: Build and optimize secure REST APIs, web services, and data pipelines to connect frontend AI applications with core agency databases (such as Oracle and Google BigQuery). * Leverage Enterprise Cloud AI: Learn, utilize, and integrate generative AI SDKs and services from major cloud providers (e.g., Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud) to build scalable, production\-ready solutions. * Maintain Agency Governance Standards: Ensure all software solutions strictly adhere to TWC policies, data privacy guidelines, accessibility standards (Section 508/Texas EIR), and strict cybersecurity protocols. * Own the SDLC: Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from initial concept and architectural design to deployment, maintenance, and technical documentation. * Provide Technical Direction: Offer guidance, peer reviews, and mentorship to other developers on the team to foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning. * Perform other duties as assigned. YOU QUALIFY WITH: * Programmer V: Five years of full\-time experience in data processing, computer science, computer programming, systems analysis, and/or related field. * Programmer VI: Six years of full\-time experience in data processing, computer science, computer programming, systems analysis, and/or related field. * Relevant academic credits may be applied toward experience qualifications for both of these levels. YOU ARE A GREAT FIT WITH: * Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Core Programming Proficiency: Hands\-on professional experience in both Python and Java. * Database \& Big Data Experience: Familiarity with enterprise cloud data platforms (such as Google BigQuery or AWS Redshift). * Cloud AI Platforms: Familiarity with major enterprise Cloud AI Platforms (such as Google Cloud Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI Studio) and experience leveraging managed foundation models. * API Development: Proven experience building, consuming, and securing REST APIs and managing high\-capacity data pipelines. * Prompt Engineering: Proficiency in generative AI prompting, understanding prompt management techniques, and designing prompt templates for improved, consistent model outcomes. * Modern Tooling \& DevOps: Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, Git version control, and standard CI/CD / DevOps practices. * Mission \& Passion: A strong desire to continuously learn about emerging AI/ML technologies and apply them to solve highly complex, real\-world problems in the public sector. * Public Sector Experience: Professional experience working within, or contracting for, local, state, or federal government agencies, with a solid understanding of public sector operational and security standards. YOU GAIN: * A Family Friendly Certified Workplace \- Competitive salary: $8,000 \- $10,000/month (Depending on experience) * Defined Retirement Benefit Plan * Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts * Medical Insurance * Paid time off, including time for vacation, sick and family care leave * Additional benefits for active employees can be found at https://www.ers.texas.gov/Active\-Employees/Health\-Benefits VETERANS: Use your military skills to qualify for this position or other jobs! Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications, and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser: https://hr.sao.texas.gov/Compensation/MilitaryCrosswalk/MOSC\_InformationTechnology.pdf HOW TO APPLY: To be considered, please complete a State of Texas Application for Employment and apply online at www.workintexas.com or on Taleo (Job Search). TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H\-1B, F\-1 (OPT/CPT), or H\-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire. A position utilizing this classification will be designated as security sensitive according to the Texas Labor Code, Section 301\.042\. **Primary Location** -------------------- : United States\-Texas\-Austin**Work Locations** ------------------ : Austin:1411 Brazos 1411 Brazos St Austin 78701**Job** ------- : Computer Programmers**Organization** ---------------- : TWC Business Unit**Schedule** ------------ : Full\-time**Employee Status** ------------------- : Regular**Job Type** ------------ : Standard**Job Level** ------------- : Non\-Management**Travel** ---------- : No**Job Posting** --------------- : Nov 19, 2026, 12:00:00 AM Work From Home: No

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Video
jobs.description: Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. The terms of our culture should not be set by gate\-keeping legacy media or chaos\-fueling social media, but by the people who make and participate in that culture. Substack’s model, based on direct subscriptions, has fueled an explosion of independent publishing. It empowers creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences. As a Software Engineer at Substack, you are responsible for the core product platform, from APIs, low\-level services, and database operations, to frontend UI and testing. On the Video team you’ll be working on podcasting, live streaming, video and audio recording, uploading, clipping, and everything related to an excellent video product experience. Full Stack Engineers work in close partnership with designers, product thinkers, and customers directly to build out new product offerings and tooling across the platform. They are on the front\-lines of product development and are responsible for creating what’s next for Substack. **Responsibilities** * With the support of the engineering team, develop the core Substack product for creators and consumers. This is a dynamic organization with needs across the board. We expect that engineers will be able to jump into any area of the product, learn quickly and add value. * Support and collaborate with other team members, including engineers, designers, creators, support staff, and many others. * Own your work and deliver high\-quality solutions from product concept and proposal to implementation, experimentation, and measurement. * Work directly with customers to solve their problems. The entire company (CEO included) participates in customer support in order to drive empathy for our users and help us build better products. * We work with TypeScript, especially Node/Express and React, and Postgres. It’s helpful if you know these technologies already, if not, we’ll be excited to help you learn. * We work to stay on the leading edge of AI tooling, to both improve our internal workflows, as well as utilize them in product to improve publisher capabilities and experiences **Requirements** * 4\+ years of non\-internship professional full stack web software development. * Proficiency with Node.js and React is an advantage. * Have a degree in Computer Science or have the equivalent industry experience. * Independent and autonomous. We’re too small to micromanage, and expect that every person at the company owns their work and can be a leader. * Take pride in building elegant and delightful product experiences. Substack works best when it gets out of the way so creators can focus on creating and connecting with their readers. * Enjoy collaboration with a diverse group of thinkers while bringing our own unique experience and background to the team. * Believe in Substack’s mission to build a better business model for content creation. * Proficiency with video processing frameworks and libraries such as FFmpeg is an advantage. * Experience with workflow systems such as Temporal is an advantage. Substack’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $260,000\. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above. Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here.

Substack’s model, based on direct subscriptions, has fueled an explosion of independent publishing. It empowers creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences. As a Software Engineer at Substack, you are responsible for the core product platform, from APIs, low\-level services, and database operations, to frontend UI and testing. On the Video team you’ll be working on podcasting, live streaming, video and audio recording, uploading, clipping, and everything related to an excellent video product experience. Full Stack Engineers work in close partnership with designers, product thinkers, and customers directly to build out new product offerings and tooling across the platform. They are on the front\-lines of product development and are responsible for creating what’s next for Substack. **Responsibilities** * With the support of the engineering team, develop the core Substack product for creators and consumers. This is a dynamic organization with needs across the board. We expect that engineers will be able to jump into any area of the product, learn quickly and add value. * Support and collaborate with other team members, including engineers, designers, creators, support staff, and many others. * Own your work and deliver high\-quality solutions from product concept and proposal to implementation, experimentation, and measurement. * Work directly with customers to solve their problems. The entire company (CEO included) participates in customer support in order to drive empathy for our users and help us build better products. * We work with TypeScript, especially Node/Express and React, and Postgres. It’s helpful if you know these technologies already, if not, we’ll be excited to help you learn. * We work to stay on the leading edge of AI tooling, to both improve our internal workflows, as well as utilize them in product to improve publisher capabilities and experiences **Requirements** * 4\+ years of non\-internship professional full stack web software development. * Proficiency with Node.js and React is an advantage. * Have a degree in Computer Science or have the equivalent industry experience. * Independent and autonomous. We’re too small to micromanage, and expect that every person at the company owns their work and can be a leader. * Take pride in building elegant and delightful product experiences. Substack works best when it gets out of the way so creators can focus on creating and connecting with their readers. * Enjoy collaboration with a diverse group of thinkers while bringing our own unique experience and background to the team. * Believe in Substack’s mission to build a better business model for content creation. * Proficiency with video processing frameworks and libraries such as FFmpeg is an advantage. * Experience with workflow systems such as Temporal is an advantage. Substack’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $260,000\. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above. Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Supernova Technology** Founded in 2014, we offer the industry’s first and only cloud\-based, fully\-customizable, end\-to\-end software solution to automate securities\-based lending from origination through the life of the loan. By combining thought leadership in suitability and risk management with industry\-leading education and the latest technology, Supernova enables advisors to deliver holistic, goals\-based advice and to help their clients achieve financial wellness. We partner with the industry’s largest banks, most prominent insurance companies and leading online brokerages to democratize access to securities\-based lending and better the entire financial ecosystem. **Why Join Supernova?** At Supernova Technology, we believe that the best results come from a team that is passionate, driven, and supported in all aspects of their professional lives. Here, you’ll work alongside talented and innovative individuals who are committed to driving the future of securities\-based lending technology. We foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and growth, where each person’s contributions make a real impact. **About the Role** As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in defining the architecture and technical vision for Supernova’s cloud\-based Security\-Based Lending (SBL) SaaS platform. You will be responsible for designing scalable, high\-performing, and secure systems that support our business services and APIs. We are looking for a technical leader who is passionate about software design, architecture, and emerging technologies, with a proven track record of building and evolving complex software systems. This role will work closely with engineering teams, product managers, and business stakeholders to ensure the platform’s architecture supports the company’s growth and long\-term objectives. This is a strategic and hands\-on role that will directly influence Supernova’s technical roadmap, guiding the development of robust, scalable, and secure solutions. The Senior Software Engineer will be instrumental in driving innovation and excellence across our technology stack. **Responsibilities** * Lead the effort in the development, and maintenance of our platform software modules. * Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to define and prioritize requirements and translate them into actionable technical tasks. * Ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions that adhere to best practices and meet business requirements. * Review code, providing constructive feedback, and ensure adherence to coding standards and guidelines. * Participate in architecture and design discussions, contributing to the overall technical vision and direction of the team. * Build and maintain unit tests and integration tests to ensure code quality and reliability. * Continuously improve the performance, reliability, and security of our web services and ETL jobs. * Address technical debt, refactor code as necessary, and drive improvements in the team's software development processes and practices. * Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in ETL job and API development, and share knowledge and insights with the team. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus * At least 5 years of software development experience with a focus on backend development, either in ETL job design and development, or Web Service API development. * Either expertise in Java and Spring Boot, or comparable expertise in Python and Pandas for backend development. * Hands\-on experience with AWS Lambda development in Python is a plus. * Experience in Java or Python library is a plus. * Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining unit tests and integration tests * Familiarity with test automation tools and frameworks * Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines * Knowledge of micro\-services, event\-driven architecture and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is preferred. * Strong analytical, detail\-oriented problem\-solving abilities and excellent communication, capable of both independent work and effective collaboration in a team environment. **Our Employee Benefits** At Supernova Technology, we provide a robust benefits package to support the health and well\-being of our employees. Our offerings include: * **Paid Time Off:** Flexible PTO policies. * **Compensation:** $100,000 \- $150,000 per year *Note: Actual salary at the time of hire may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to, the candidate's relevant qualifications, skills and experience, and the location where this position may be filled.* **Our Core Values** Our core values drive everything we do. At Supernova, we... * Form, execute, and communicate new ideas that add value to our employees and customers * Strive through obstacles and failures * Follow\-through on promises or commitments to others, accept responsibility, and answer for actions \& decisions * Listen to, understand, and support our employees and customers * Act with speed, positive attitude, and flexibility * Exceed expectations and surpass ourselves every day; we embrace a sense of pride and never stop growing **Join us and make an impact while growing your career at Supernova!**

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **About Switch** At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. These systems run on on\-premises Kubernetes clusters and support facilities that operate around the clock. You will be responsible for platform architecture, reliability, scalability, and engineering standards while remaining directly involved in design, implementation, and complex troubleshooting. ------------------ * Define and evolve the architecture and technical roadmap for Kubernetes infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and related platform services. * Lead complex infrastructure design and implementation efforts, making technical decisions that balance reliability, performance, cost, and maintainability. * Improve production reliability through service\-level objectives (SLOs), effective alerting, root cause analysis, and long\-term remediation. * Troubleshoot complex production issues involving cluster failures, messaging systems, storage performance, and application infrastructure. * Establish observability standards across metrics, logging, tracing, and monitoring to improve visibility into platform health. * Improve CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and deployment practices to support reliable delivery and change management. * Partner with Security to strengthen infrastructure security, access controls, secrets management, and compliance practices. * Plan infrastructure capacity and scalability as telemetry volumes, services, and data center operations expand. * Mentor engineers, review technical designs, and establish engineering practices that improve consistency and reliability across teams. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Strong technical judgment and the ability to make informed decisions across from investigation through resolution, with a focus on preventing recurring issues. * Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations to different audiences. * A collaborative approach to working with engineers, technical leaders, and cross\-functional partners. * A commitment to building reliable, maintainable systems and continuously improving how engineering teams operate. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- **Required:** * 10\+ years of relevant experience designing, building, and operating production infrastructure, storage, upgrades, and troubleshooting. * Experience operating distributed messaging or streaming platforms such as NATS/JetStream, Kafka, or similar technologies. * Strong experience with observability platforms, including Prometheus\-style metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, and SLO\-based monitoring. * Experience with infrastructure as code, GitOps, and automated delivery tools such as Terraform, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines. * Demonstrated experience leading complex incident investigations, identifying root causes, and implementing lasting improvements. * Experience designing infrastructure for high availability, scalability, performance, and operational reliability. **Preferred:** * Experience supporting infrastructure connected to physical systems, including data centers, industrial controls, energy systems, or IoT telemetry. * Experience operating time\-series databases such as TimescaleDB at scale. * Experience leading major infrastructure migrations or platform modernization initiatives with minimal service disruption. * Familiarity with formal change management, audit requirements, or compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001\. ### **Why Switch?** * A Culture of Karma – We are self\-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward\-thinking environment. * Industry Leading Designs – we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive. * Career Stability \& Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities \& advancement in a stable, growing company. * Generous Benefits Package \- Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more! ### **Join Us \& If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you. Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together. **Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice** Your privacy rights may vary by location. jobs.description: **Job Role: Java Developer (Agentic AI)** **Location: Alpharetta, GA (Hybrid – 3 days onsite)\- F2F Interview** **Position Overview** Our client is looking for experienced **Senior Full Stack Developers with hands\-on Agentic AI development experience** to design, build, and deploy scalable enterprise applications integrated with AI agents and Large Language Models (LLMs). Candidates must have strong full stack development skills and practical experience developing Agentic AI solutions within the last two years. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and develop full stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, React, Angular, Node.js, or equivalent technologies. * Build and deploy Agentic AI solutions involving autonomous agents, multi\-agent workflows, and intelligent automation. * Integrate LLMs using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent platforms. * Develop AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel. * Implement tool calling, API integrations, RAG, and agent orchestration. * Develop scalable REST APIs, microservices, and distributed applications. * Optimize application performance, databases, and backend services. * Deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. * Troubleshoot production issues, monitor performance, and ensure application reliability. * Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and business teams to deliver enterprise AI solutions. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of hands\-on full stack software development experience. * **Recent hands\-on Agentic AI development experience (2025–2026\) is mandatory.** * Strong backend development experience with Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, or equivalent. * Experience with frontend frameworks such as React or Angular. * Practical experience building AI agents using LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar frameworks. * Experience integrating LLM APIs into enterprise applications. * Strong knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, databases, and distributed systems. * Experience with cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD. * Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
