jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Storage) - North America Software Center
jobs.description: **Principal Software Engineer (Storage) \- North America Software Center** ========================================================================== Join TSMC Washington and help power the future of technology. At TSMC, we don't just make semiconductors; we innovate to transform industries and enhance lives. As the world’s leading semiconductor foundry, we partner with top tech companies to drive advancements in industries such as healthcare, automotive, consumer electronics, and renewable energy. At TSMC Washington, you'll thrive where innovation meets precision manufacturing, and integrity guides our high standards and customer trust. Our visionary leaders collaborate with clients to achieve groundbreaking results, ensuring our leadership in the semiconductor sector. Explore career opportunities with TSMC Washington and join a company with a commitment to excellence and innovation. **Who We're Looking For:** At TSMC, we are dedicated to building world\-class, scalable infrastructure to support our global mission\-critical operations. Our North America Software Center is seeking an experienced **Principal Software Engineer specialized in Storage** with deep expertise in storage systems architecture, distributed data platforms, and large\-scale data migration/movement engineering. This position is ideal for a seasoned technical leader who is passionate about architecting resilient storage ecosystems, designing high\-throughput data migration engines, and solving complex performance and concurrency challenges at petabyte scale. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Data Movement \& Migration Engineering:** Architect, design, and lead the development of high\-performance, resilient data migration engines and pipelines across heterogeneous enterprise storage platforms. Ensure data consistency, metadata preservation, access\-control integrity, and zero\-data\-loss validation at scale. * **Architecture \& Scalability:** Define the long\-term technical vision for multi\-petabyte storage infrastructure, bridging on\-premises enterprise environments with modern cloud\-native architectures. * **Storage Triage \& Performance Engineering:** Lead root\-cause analysis for complex, systemic I/O bottlenecks, high\-concurrency contention, and distributed storage anomalies across multiple layers (filesystem, network, kernel, and storage controllers). * **Automation \& Reliability:** Drive engineering initiatives for automated storage orchestration, continuous health monitoring, automated tiering, and real\-time data integrity verification workflows. * **Strategic Planning:** Establish enterprise\-wide standards and best practices for data lifecycle management, disaster recovery (DR), business continuity, capacity planning, and high availability (HA). * **Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:** Serve as the subject matter expert across global engineering teams; mentor senior engineers on storage internals, kernel I/O paths, distributed consensus, and systems\-level troubleshooting. **Minimum Requirements:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. * **Storage Fundamentals:** 8\+ years of deep experience in storage systems engineering, distributed storage architectures, file/block/object concepts, POSIX compliance, and metadata management at petabyte scale. * **Software Engineering:** Proven track record in systems\-level programming using languages such as **Go, Rust or Python** to build high\-throughput data movement engines, storage management tooling, or distributed systems. * **Systems \& I/O Internals:** Strong understanding of operating system internals, Linux kernel I/O subsystems, caching layers, network storage protocols, and storage concurrency control. * **Technical Leadership:** 3\+ years of experience in a Principal, Staff, or Lead capacity, driving architectural roadmaps and guiding cross\-functional teams through complex, large\-scale infrastructure initiatives. * **Collaboration \& Tooling:** Proficiency with modern CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), and version control systems (Git, GitLab, GitHub), alongside excellent cross\-cultural communication skills for engaging with global stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications / Pluses:** * Experience with enterprise storage vendor platforms and solutions (e.g., **NetApp, Dell/EMC, Pure Storage, HPE**). * Hands\-on experience architecting, managing, or integrating with major **Cloud Storage services** (AWS, Azure, GCP). * Familiarity with containerized storage orchestration (CSI, Kubernetes storage) and software\-defined storage (SDS) architectures. **Eligibility:** Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We currently cannot provide sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa. Employment at TSMC is contingent upon passing a background check and drug screening. In compliance with Washington state regulations, cannabis (marijuana) use will not be included in the drug screening. **Work Location \& Schedule:** This position is based on\-site at our Vancouver, Washington location during core business hours, Monday through Friday from 8 am to 5 pm. Additional hours may be required to meet project demands. **Compensation and Benefits:** * At TSMC, your base pay is just one component of your comprehensive compensation package. For new hires in this position, the starting base salary typically ranges between **$137,300 and $183,650** per year. The full base salary range for this Job Grade extends from **$137,300 \- $199,100** depending on factors such as skills, qualifications, education, experience, tenure, and position level. TSMC’s total compensation package also includes market\-competitive pay, profit sharing and incentive bonuses, and tuition assistance. * Comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, and access to a 401(k) plan with employer match. * Employees enjoy 12 holidays per year and accrue paid time off annually. * Onsite amenities include a fitness center, game room, physical therapist, and subsidized café. **If you have questions or want to learn more about our offered benefits, email recruitingwa@tsmc.com**. **EOE Statement:** TSMC Washington, LLC is committed to employing a diverse workforce and provides Equal Employment Opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. TSMC is an equal opportunity employer prizing diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity. If you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please feel free to notify us at recruitingwa@tsmc.com. TSMC confirms to all applicants its commitment to meet TSMC’s obligations under applicable employment law. **TSMC Core Values** At TSMC, we invite talented individuals who share our vision and values to contribute to our continued success. Our core values are the foundation of our culture, guiding every decision and action. We seek applicants who deeply resonate with these principles and embody them in their work: • Integrity: Tell the truth. We do not brag. We do not make commitments lightly. Once we make a commitment, we devote ourselves completely to meeting that commitment. • Commitment: Employees are dedicated to the company, view the company’s success as their own and work diligently to make their best contributions. As commitment is mutual, the Company strives to serve the best interests of its employees. • Innovation: Innovation is the wellspring of the Company's growth. It means more than new ideas; it means putting ideas into practice. • Customer Trust: We strive to build deep and enduring relationships with our customers, who trust and rely on us to be part of their success over the long term. (For more details on TSMC’s Core Values, please visit：https://www.tsmc.com/english/aboutTSMC/values Date: Nov 18, 2026 Country/Region: US City: Vancouver Company: TSMC Washington **Nearest Major Market:** Portland Oregon **Nearest Secondary Market:** Tacoma

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging. **About the Role** ================== Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most. **Your Area of Focus** ====================== * **Data Modeling \& Shared Datasets:** Design, build, and maintain enterprise\-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team. * **Metric Definition \& Semantic Layer:** Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over. * **Self\-Service Enablement:** Build easy\-to\-use datasets that let non\-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins. * **Platform Migration:** Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools. * **Data Quality \& Testing:** Build automated tests and pull\-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support. * **Performance \& Efficiency:** Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check. * **Forecasting \& Machine Learning:** Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections. * **Code Review \& Mentorship:** Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards. * **Governance \& Documentation:** Follow data\-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira. **Your Professional Qualifications** ==================================== * **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2\+ years hands\-on in dbt in production. * **SQL Fluency:** Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets. * **Data Modeling:** Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams. * **Tech Stack:** Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt. * **Business Partnership:** Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems. * **Software Mindset:** Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation. * **Communication:** Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision. * **Growth Mindset:** Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills. * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Semantic Layer:** Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred. * **Domain Knowledge:** Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred. * **Forecasting \& ML:** Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred. * **Healthcare:** Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred. * **Additional Tools:** Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus. * **Certifications:** dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred. **\#LI\-SS1 \#LI\-Remote** **About Tebra** =============== Tebra is the only all\-in\-one EHR\+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at www.tebra.com. **Our Values** ============== **Start with the Customer** --------------------------- We get to know our customers \- and their patients \- and look at the world through their lens. **Keep It Simple** ------------------ Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone. **Stay Entrepreneurial** ------------------------ We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action. **Better Together** ------------------- We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. **Celebrate Success** --------------------- Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success. **Perks \& Benefits** ===================== United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. Costa Rica: To assist with all of life's needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. **Compliance \& Privacy Disclosures** ===================================== *NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.* *California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California\-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here:* *https://www.tebra.com/privacy\-policy/california\-supplemental\-notice/* *If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at* *talentacquisition@tebra.com* *and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too.* *As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes Greenhouse Notetaker, Greenhouse's native interview intelligence tool, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. jobs.title: SAP MM Consultant
jobs.description: **About Tessera** ----------------- Tessera is an AI platform that drives business transformation and unlocks new value for enterprises. The Platform's agents deliver governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. **Role Summary** ---------------- We are seeking a senior SAP MM Consultant to own materials management and its data on SAP S/4HANA migrations and data harmonisation: the material master, purchasing, inventory and the open documents that run them. You own the target design, the MM data migration from mapping to cutover, and the proof that it works after the load. This is a doer role, not an advisory one. **How the Work Is Different** ----------------------------- Tessera is a software company, not a services firm: we do not sell hours, and the Platform's AI agents do the heavy lifting — process analysis, data profiling, conversion and validation. You bring the SAP judgment: you specify the work, check what comes back against SAP models, tables and real data, and own the calls a client signs. Our success measure is the client's adoption of the Platform. A consultant leaves and takes the capability with them; when you leave, the capability stays with the client. That is why we hire SMEs on a path to become Forward Deployed Engineers, one of the most sought\-after roles in tech, with Platform certification and support from our FDE team along the way. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **1\. Materials and procurement design.** Own the material master design — views, plant and storage data, MRP data, units of measure — and the interfaces with plant maintenance, projects and finance. Work through the MM simplification items and use fit\-to\-standard to decide what to keep, change or retire. **2\. MM data migration ownership.** Own the MM data migration workstream end to end: object scope, source\-to\-target field mapping, value mapping and transformation rules, load order and sign\-off criteria. Keep the mapping document as the system of record for every mapping decision, and track each open point from workshop to closure. **3\. Mock loads, validation and reconciliation.** Run iterative mock loads and dress rehearsals. Pilot on a selective test batch before full loads. Read the load logs and classify each failure as a data defect, a mapping defect, a configuration gap or a tooling issue. Check units of measure, material types, valuation classes, blanks and duplicates before each load, and show a reconciliation after it: record counts, field\-level samples and checks in target transactions. **4\. Cutover and hypercare.** Set the open PO and requisition cut\-off rules, the inventory freeze and the load timing for cutover. Support dress rehearsals and production loads, and own data issues in your object scope during hypercare. **5\. Client engagement.** Lead mapping workshops with business data owners and drive each issue to sign\-off, on several engagements at once, with clear written handoffs. **6\. AI agents and adoption.** Set the requirements and acceptance criteria the agents work to, act as the final quality gate on their output, turn findings into reusable rules, and enable the client's team to run the Platform on their own. **Data Objects in Scope** ------------------------- You own the functional design, mapping, validation and sign\-off for MM data objects. The core objects cover the procure\-to\-pay chain: material master, suppliers, purchasing master data, requisitions and agreements, purchase orders, and goods receipts and invoices. Inventory, valuation, classification and batches are desired. Maintenance, project and service procurement and supplier EDI set you apart. **Technical \& Functional Skills** ---------------------------------- **Material master:** material types, views and organisational levels, field selection, units of measure and conversions, valuation classes, MRP data and classification. **Purchasing:** requisitions and purchase orders, account assignment categories, info records, source lists, contracts and scheduling agreements, release strategies and pricing in purchasing. **Inventory management and valuation:** goods movements and movement types, stock types, physical inventory, price control and valuation areas, posting period dependencies, and the SAP S/4HANA inventory data model (MATDOC). **Invoice verification and integration:** logistics invoice verification, GR/IR clearing, account determination for inventory postings, and integration with FI, CO, PM, PS and SD. **Business Partner and CVI:** supplier conversion to Business Partner through CVI — BP roles and groupings, number ranges, field mapping, the CVI Cockpit and synchronisation, the usual tax and bank data errors, and their impact on procure\-to\-pay. **Data migration:** field and value mapping, SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (staging tables), BAPI and IDoc\-based loads, load order driven by master data dependencies, error\-log analysis, validation before the load, and a reconciliation you can show — including mapping from Oracle or another ERP where fields have no direct target. **Client\-facing:** run workshops with procurement, inventory, maintenance and plant owners; present design decisions, trade\-offs and risks to business and technical stakeholders; hold the scope boundary and say no in a way that keeps the relationship; get decisions recorded and signed off. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 10\+ years in SAP MM configuration, used in the last 2 to 3 years. * 2\+ full data migration lifecycles to SAP S/4HANA (from SAP ECC, Oracle or another ERP) with functional ownership of MM data objects — mapping, validation and sign\-off, not only process or configuration roles. * Several mock loads or dress rehearsals, with data defects resolved across cycles, and at least one production cutover. * Hands\-on CVI: supplier conversion to Business Partner on at least one SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration. * A CV with named engagements: client, year and your own deliverable. * One concrete case of AI or automation in your own SAP work: the task, the tool and the result. Drafting documents with a chatbot does not count. * Experience delivering to large enterprise clients in a distributed team, with strong written discipline. * Based in the United States. * Fluent English. * Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Maintenance and project procurement: MRO and spare parts, reservations, and MM–PM and MM–PS integration. * Experience in utilities or another asset\-intensive industry. * Migration and cleansing tools such as SAP Data Services, Syniti or SNP. * SQL or basic ABAP literacy, to run reconciliation queries and read table structures. * SAP MDG for supplier and material data. * Central procurement on SAP S/4HANA. * More than one SAP S/4HANA transition path: greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition. * Work in regulated or audit\-heavy environments (SOX). * SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement certification. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs' name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $170K \- $220K

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Hunton Group is seeking to fill a hands\-on **Data Engineer** to design, build, and maintain our enterprise data platform using Microsoft Fabric. This role will lead the development of a scalable Lakehouse and Warehouse architecture that integrates data from Microsoft Dynamics GP/WennSoft, Salesforce.com, Excel and CSV files, SQL Server, APIs, and other enterprise data sources. The Data Engineer will work closely with Power BI Analysts and Business Analysts to transform business requirements into reliable, governed, and high\-performing data structures that support enterprise reporting, self\-service analytics, and future AI and advanced analytics initiatives.### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse that serve as the centralized foundation for enterprise reporting and analytics. * Design and implement Star Schema data models, including fact and dimension tables, optimized for Power BI, analytics, and self\-service BI. * Develop scalable data architecture using Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and Delta tables, selecting the appropriate technology and storage pattern for each workload. * Build and maintain data ingestion and transformation processes using Fabric Data Factory Pipelines, Dataflow Gen2, notebooks, SQL, and other Fabric\-native capabilities. * Integrate data from multiple enterprise sources, including Microsoft Dynamics GP/WennSoft, Salesforce.com, SQL Server, Excel and CSV files, APIs, and other operational systems. * Design appropriate Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers to separate raw source data, standardized and cleansed data, and business\-ready analytical data. * Develop robust transformation processes for data cleansing, validation, standardization, and deduplication * Standardize business logic, KPIs, key metrics, and data definitions across source systems to establish a consistent and trusted enterprise data foundation. * Design and implement incremental and delta\-loading strategies, including CDC, and other techniques to improve data freshness while minimizing unnecessary processing. * Evaluate and implement appropriate Fabric ingestion patterns, including Pipelines, Mirroring, Shortcuts, Dataflow Gen2, notebooks, and SQL\-based transformations. * Leverage Microsoft OneLake to centralize enterprise analytical data and reduce unnecessary movement and duplication of data. * Implement comprehensive data quality and reconciliation controls, including completeness, accuracy, duplicate detection, referential integrity, source\-to\-target balancing, and load validation. * Implement processes for data lineage, metadata management, auditability, and monitoring across the Fabric environment. * Maintain technical documentation including data dictionaries, source\-to\-target mappings, data flows, transformation logic, dependencies, business rules, and architecture documentation. * Ensure Fabric solutions align with organizational data governance, security, naming, workspace, development, deployment, and master data management standards. * Optimize Lakehouse, Warehouse, and SQL workloads for performance, scalability, efficient data processing, and large data volumes. * Collaborate closely with Power BI Analysts to ensure Fabric data structures effectively support Power BI semantic models, Direct Lake, Import, and DirectQuery, selecting the appropriate architecture based on performance and reporting requirements. * Support the development of centralized, reusable semantic models that provide consistent dimensions, measures, KPIs, and business logic across Power BI reports. * Implement Git/source control and deployment practices for Microsoft Fabric artifacts to support controlled development, testing, documentation, and production releases. * Design and implement operational processes for pipeline monitoring, logging, error handling, retries, notifications, reconciliation, and troubleshooting. * Document end\-to\-end data lineage and dependencies, from source systems through Fabric Lakehous and Warehous to Power BI semantic models and reporting. * Build the Microsoft Fabric platform with future capabilities in mind, including AI, machine learning, Copilot, real\-time analytics, and other advanced analytics use cases. ### **Required Skills \& Experience** * 15\+ years of experience designing and building Star Schema and dimensional data warehouse solutions, including fact and dimension table design. * Deep SQL and T\-SQL expertise, with extensive experience designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise data warehouse solutions. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, SQL Server, or comparable modern cloud data platforms, with the ability to transition traditional data warehouse architectures into Fabric. * Experience designing and building Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse architectures, including OneLake\-based data storage and analytical data structures. * Strong ETL/ELT experience using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory Pipelines, Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Dataflow Gen2, SQL, or similar data integration technologies. * Proven experience integrating data from enterprise systems including WennSoft/Dynamics GP, Salesforce.com, SQL Server, Excel and CSV files, APIs, and other operational data sources. * Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, surrogate keys, Slowly Changing Dimensions (Type 1 and Type 2\), incremental loading, data quality, reconciliation, and metadata management. * Experience implementing scalable Bronze, Silver, and Gold data architecture patterns within modern data platforms. * Experience documenting source\-to\-target mappings, data lineage, transformations, data dependencies, and business rules. * Experience collaborating closely with Power BI Analysts and Business Analysts to translate reporting and analytical requirements into reliable, reusable data structures. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Fabric OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, Delta tables, Data Factory Pipelines, Dataflow Gen2, Mirroring, and Shortcuts. * Familiarity with Power BI semantic models and Direct Lake, with an understanding of how Fabric data architecture and Star Schema design affect Power BI performance. * Familiarity with Git/source control and deployment practices for Microsoft Fabric development. * Experience establishing enterprise data quality, governance, lineage, auditing, and monitoring standards. * Strong documentation, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional teamwork skills.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Marketplace Quality Engineering
jobs.description: The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world's leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world's brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly. The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you're driven to solve meaningful challenges, we'd love to meet you. The Team: Marketplace Quality Engineering: Every second, our bidder evaluates millions of ad opportunities across thousands of publishers and supply paths. Not all of that supply is created equal — some of it is duplicated, some is structurally inaccessible, and some degrades advertiser outcomes. The Marketplace Quality Engineering team exists to make sure our platform is buying the right impressions, not just more impressions. We own the systems that assess, measure, and optimize supply quality across the programmatic ecosystem. Our work spans deduplication, supply path analysis, quality modeling, and the tooling that turns those signals into decisions at bid time. The problems are technically deep — think identity resolution across fragmented supply chains, statistical modeling to separate signal from noise, and real\-time decisioning at platform scale — and they have direct, measurable impact on both advertiser outcomes and platform economics. This is not theoretical work. When we ship a model update, spend distribution across the platform shifts. Our engineering decisions translate directly into tens of millions of dollars of measurable business impact. If you want to build systems where what you ship visibly matters, this is the team. You will work with C\# / .NET as a core strength, alongside Python and SQL where data and automation need it, and partner closely with product, data, and platform teams across time zones. Who you are: Our culture runs deeper than having fun together (though we do that well, too). We take pride in our engineers being trust\-builders, generous givers, scrappy problem solvers, and gritty pursuers of excellence. You do not need to meet every requirement below, but people who meet most of them tend to thrive in this role: * You are comfortable working on an agile, distributed team across time zones and continents. * You communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * You have a solid grasp of computer science and engineering fundamentals. * You have strong experience with distributed systems and data\-heavy backend work (services, pipelines, or both). * You are proficient in C\# / .NET. * You are productive with modern development tools: Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, Rider, and Git. * You bring 7\+ years of software development or engineering experience. Nice to have (not required): GraphQL or REST API design, large\-scale data processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Spark), workflow orchestration tools (e.g. Apache Airflow), schema\-based data serialization, Kubernetes, Kafka, database engines (Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Aerospike, Vertica, Redis), microservices, Python for data work or automation, and experience working across large codebases with multiple teams. A wide range of technical opportunities is one of the best parts of engineering at The Trade Desk, which is why we do not expect you to know every technology we use on day one. What matters is that you learn quickly and solve complex problems with the right tools. What you know today matters less than how well you learn, adapt, and innovate. We are not looking for people who already have all the answers — we want engineers who can invent answers no one has thought of yet and frame the questions we have not yet asked. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. Please reach out to us at accommodations@thetradedesk.com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process. When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Systems Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world's leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world's brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly. The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you're driven to solve meaningful challenges, we'd love to meet you. We are looking to hire a Systems Reliability Engineer to join our engineering team to continue building and maintaining our data\-driven platform. We leverage technologies like Aerospike, MongoDB, and Kafka to perform many real time activities, translating to over 75 million queries per second with a p99 latency under 1 millisecond on the back end! Do you enjoy tuning, performance testing, troubleshooting, automation, and operating at scale? Does testing next\-gen hardware, evaluating data access patterns, and designing automation around distributed systems excite you? **WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT:** * First in the Industry: The Trade Desk is the first company to run over 5MM QPS to NVMe in Aerospike on a single node, forcing core software redesigns to achieve this scale. * Work on Cutting\-Edge Hardware: Design clusters with nodes featuring 300TB of NVMe, 3TB RAM, and 512 cores, delivering a global 2,500GB/s throughput directly from flash. * Shape the Future of Infrastructure: Spec your own systems and collaborate directly with AMD and NoSQL vendors to run PoCs and optimize bleeding\-edge technology for internet\-scale workloads. * Deep Performance Engineering: Dive into kernel, hardware, and system interactions, leveraging tools like flamegraphs, NUMA counters, BIOS tuning, and synthetic testing to achieve world\-class performance. * Push Hardware Endurance Limits: Build clusters engineered to withstand over 1 zettabyte of endurance. **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** * Influence, manage, and plan work streams, systems, and data structures at scale within a global ecosystem, spanning multiple infrastructure providers (cloud and traditional datacenters). * Encourage, improve, and build infrastructure automation in a way that works with stateful systems at scale. * Own operations for Linux\-based systems running Aerospike, Kafka, and Mongo. * Serve as a point of contact to review new use cases, answer questions, and participate in on\-call rotation. * Learn to be a NoSQL SME. You do not need direct NOSQL operational experience to apply – we will train you. * Benchmark and analyze next generation hardware offerings. **WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:** **Skills and Experience** * Linux operating system * Troubleshooting * Techniques for isolation, scientific method * Identify bottlenecks (Is it CPU? IO?) * Nice\-To\-Have experience: * Physical hardware (on\-prem) internals, management, and operation * Performing testing and tuning * Databases (relational or NoSQL) * Ansible/PyInfra/Chef * Prometheus * Kubernetes * Python/Ruby/Rust/Bash/Golang/C\# As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. jobs.title: Senior/Lead Research Engineer (Foundation Models)
jobs.description: **Job Description** Thomson Reuters Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary\-grade AI. The Thomson LLM family was developed by training leading open\-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject\-matter\-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest\-stakes professional workflows. See the Thomson 1\.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face for more on the latest model release. Our research engineers build the systems that train, evaluate and run the Thomson models, and work closely with research scientists so that new algorithms, rewards and evaluations can be tested quickly and at scale. We are hiring at Senior and Lead level across two areas of emphasis. In your application, please tell us which one fits you best: * **Large\-scale RL training:** architecting and optimising infrastructure for training agentic Mixture\-of\-Experts models above 300 billion parameters with reinforcement learning, asynchronously and at long context, while the models interact with tools and agent harnesses. * **Evaluation engineering:** building, scaling and optimising the evaluation suite and leaderboard that run Thomson evaluations as new releases and product integrations arrive. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and operate the systems behind Thomson training, evaluation and experimentation, and keep them reliable as the models and their adoption grow. * Profile and optimise for cost, latency and GPU utilisation without sacrificing quality, and document the trade\-offs for the wider team. Root\-cause hard numerical, distributed and performance problems across training frameworks, inference engines and evaluation code. * Work directly with the training and evaluation pods to get new model releases trained, evaluated and live. * Contribute to Thomson's production footing, including the ISO 27001 compliance path. * Set standards for code quality, testing and reproducibility. At Lead level: own the architecture of your area, plan delivery and staffing with research leads, and mentor engineers. * **Required Qualifications** * MSc or PhD in computer science, machine learning or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. * Strong software engineering practice, including large\-scale distributed systems and the ability to work fluently in large open\-source codebases. * Experience keeping research or production systems reliable under real load, and debugging distributed systems and incidents. * Experience working closely with researchers and cross\-functional stakeholders to turn research ideas and requirements into scalable systems. * Depth in at least one area of emphasis: + Large\-scale RL training: multi\-node GPU training with PyTorch and Megatron\-Core, FSDP/DTensor or DeepSpeed; parallelism strategies (tensor, pipeline, context, expert) and their trade\-offs for MoE and long\-context models; LLM inference engines (vLLM, SGLang); GPU profiling (memory, NCCL, CUDA graphs). + Evaluation engineering: building, scaling and optimising evaluation suites for LLMs, with examples of the impact your work had. For Lead level: 3\+ years of professional experience in your area and a record of leading complex technical projects end to end and mentoring engineers. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building or extending RL post\-training frameworks (NeMo\-RL, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL), especially asynchronous or non\-colocated designs. * Familiarity with evaluation frameworks such as Inspect, Harbor or lm\-evaluation\-harness. * Experience with distributed runtimes and orchestration (Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm) on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. * Significant contributions to vLLM, Megatron, PyTorch or similar open\-source projects. Familiarity with AI\-assisted coding and using coding agents at scale. * Even if you don't have all of the above requirements, we encourage you to apply to explore a mutual fit! \#LI\-MW1 This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization. **What’s in it For You?** * **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance. * **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future. * **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans  ole. In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD\&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption \& Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.description: **About the role** The **Autonomous Mobility \& Delivery** team is pioneering Uber's autonomous future in Rides and Eats. As we advance toward a world of autonomous and human\-driven vehicles coexisting, Uber is building a hybrid marketplace that integrates autonomous vehicles seamlessly into mobility and delivery, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and scalability. Our work spans nearly every Uber service. Over the past year, we've partnered with leading Autonomous Vehicle OEMs, successfully integrating autonomous vehicles into Mobility and Delivery. Looking forward, we anticipate substantial growth and seek an **Engineering Manager II** to help drive this journey. This leader will build and lead the **AV Marketplace Optimization** team and own the technical strategy and execution for the optimization\-powered systems that decide where every autonomous vehicle on Uber should be, which trips it should serve, and how a fixed fleet of autonomous vehicles is allocated against demand. You will partner closely with Science, Product and Operations to deliver on an ambitious roadmap. Ideal candidates will bring deep algorithmic and systems depth, a track record of building and operating optimization or ML systems in production, strong instincts for partnering with scientists, and a commitment to rigorous, data\-driven decision\-making. **Basic Qualifications** * BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **5\+ years** of software engineering experience, including significant time on algorithmic or optimization problems. * **3\+ years** of experience directly managing high\-performing engineering teams, including engineers who build algorithmic or ML\-backed systems. * Experience building and operating ML or optimization systems in production at scale. * Proven ability to partner with Science, Product and Operations, and to make data\-driven decisions through experimentation. **Preferred Qualifications** * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics or a related field. * Experience with two\-sided marketplace systems such as matching, pricing, supply positioning or demand forecasting. * Experience applying optimization techniques (mathematical programming, heuristics, reinforcement learning) in large\-scale, real\-time systems. * Experience with simulation\-based policy evaluation and operating ML models in production across many markets. * Background in autonomous vehicles, fleet operations, robotics or logistics, including work with external partner engineering teams. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $232,000 per year \- USD $258,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. jobs.description: ### **General Information** Position Title Data Engineer Job Family Digital Technologies \& Information Duty Station(s) Home based Seniority Level Mid Level ICS Level ICS 10 Contract Type ICA \- LICA \- Specialist \- Regular Contract Level LICA 10 Posting Start Date 19\-Nov\-2026 Posting End Date 23\-Nov\-2026 Duration Until 30 July 2027 (subject to good performance, availability of funds, organizational requirements and project duration) ### **Job Highlight** An area of emerging interest in the humanitarian sector is data science and anticipatory action: asking what will happen in a particular humanitarian context and using available data and models to arrive at an answer. The Centre’s data science team has supported OCHA’s anticipatory action frameworks in a dozen countries, enabling humanitarian organisations to get ahead of shocks and mitigate their impact. After a successful pilot phase, OCHA is now looking at the modalities for scaling and mainstreaming anticipatory action, and the Data Engineer will support these efforts. ### **About the Region** The UNOPS Global Portfolios Office (GPO) brings together diverse expertise to help partners deliver impact worldwide. With hubs in New York, Geneva, and Vienna, and expert teams operating globally, GPO leads multi\-regional initiatives that advance sustainable development, climate action, and peacebuilding \- including in some of the world’s most challenging environments. By leveraging our collective expertise and global networks, GPO supports UNOPS’ strategic priorities and the Sustainable Development Goals across more than 130 countries. We work closely with major global partners \- including governments, international financial institutions, and UN agencies \- to deliver a wide range of services, such as project management, fund management, hosting services, and HR support. ### **About the Country/Multi\-Country Office** Not Required \- part of GPO/NYPO ### **Job Specific Context** UNOPS has signed an agreement with the United Nations to implement defined activities in support of the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA). The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) has a Centre for Humanitarian Data in The Hague, the Netherlands, which is focused on increasing the use and impact of data in the humanitarian sector. The vision is to create a future where all people involved in a humanitarian emergency have access to the data they need, when and how they need it, to make responsible and informed decisions. The Centre has four workstreams: data services (managing the Humanitarian Data Exchange platform), data responsibility, data literacy and data science. ### **Role Purpose** UNOPS is seeking to recruit a Data Engineer who has the skills and experience to develop data pipelines, tools and software to support the data scientists in the data science team. We are looking for a candidate who is familiar with the analytical methods used in the humanitarian sector, and can think strategically about how to use data to create value for crisis response. The right candidate has the skills and abilities to provide technical support to the broader team and contribute to shaping the development of the technical stack used by the Centre. They should also be self\-motivated and able to thrive in an international, multidisciplinary team. The incumbent of this position will be a personnel of UNOPS under its full responsibility. The Data Engineer will report to the Data Science Team Lead under the overall direction of the Lead for the Centre for Humanitarian Data. ### **Functions / Key Results Expected** The incumbent will be responsible for the following duties: * Understand the data workflow of the data science team and develop data pipelines to access the datasets typically used. * Design new tools and modules to be used for humanitarian action. * Maintain existing software packages and ensure consistency in the analytical tools used by the Centre. * Advise on the development of the tech stack used by the team. * Work with the other teams at the Centre to ensure coherence in the adoption of technology across work streams. ### **Skills** Analysis Services, Business Process Mapping, Data Architecture ### **Competencies** Develops and implements sustainable business strategies, thinks long term and externally in order to positively shape the organisation. Anticipates and perceives the impact and implications of future decisions and activities on other parts of the organisation. Treats all individuals with respect; responds sensitively to differences and encourages others to do the same. Upholds organisational and ethical norms. Maintains high standards of trustworthiness. Role model for diversity and inclusion. Acts as a positive role model contributing to the team spirit. Collaborates and supports the development of others. **For people managers only:** Acts as positive leadership role model, motivates, di ience is required. OR; * A first\-level university degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent), preferably in mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science, statistics, economics or a related field, with 7 (seven) years of relevant experience is required. ### **Experience Requirements** **Required:** * Relevant experience is defined as programming experience in areas like data transformation, pipelines, processing and/or analytics. * Programming experience in Python/R and an understanding of developer tools is required. **Desired:** * Experience in data visualisation and geospatial analytics is desirable. * Knowledge or experience in the humanitarian or development sectors is desirable. * Experience with climate data and climate modelling is desirable ### **Language Requirements** **Language** **Proficiency Level** **Requirement** English Fluent Required ### **Additional Information** * UNOPS does not accept unsolicited resumes. * UNOPS will at no stage of the recruitment process request candidates to make payments of any kind. * Applications to vacancies must be received before midnight Copenhagen time (CET) on the closing date of the announcement. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. * Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to proceed to the next stage of the selection process, which may include various assessments. * UNOPS embraces diversity and is committed to equal employment opportunity. Our workforce consists of a wide range of nationalities, cultures, languages, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, and abilities. We strive to sustain and strengthen this diversity, fostering an inclusive working environment where all personnel are treated with respect and have equal access to opportunities. * UNOPS evaluates all applications based on the skills, qualifications and experience outlined in the vacancy announcement. If you are shortlisted and require support or reasonable accommodation to complete any assessment, please inform our human resources team upon receiving your invitation. To uphold these standards, background checks are conducted for all final candidates to help ensure that individuals with a history of such conduct are not hired. By applying for a position with UNOPS, candidates acknowledge and consent to these verification processes. * **Terms and Conditions** * For staff positions only, UNOPS reserves the right to appoint a candidate at a lower level than the advertised level of the post. * For retainer contracts, you must complete a few mandatory courses (they take around 4 hours to complete) in your own time, before providing services to UNOPS. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, LLM
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we're united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that's both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We're proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn't mean distant. We're intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you'll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you're energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we'd love to hear from you. **The Team:** At Upstart, our Applied AI team's mission is threefold: * **Agent Platform:** Build and support the platform that makes it straightforward for non technical users across Upstart to build, launch, and operate AI agents (voice/chat/text) reliably. * **Borrower and Applicant Assistant Orchestration:** Build the orchestration layer behind a unified personal assistant that shares context across specialized agents, giving applicants and borrowers a cohesive, assistant\-like experience. * **Borrower\-Connected Internal Workflows:** Improve internal operational workflows that directly connect to applicant and borrower experiences, making them faster, smarter, and more efficient. As **Principal Engineer, LLM** you will serve as a technical pathfinder and force multiplier for this team and the product squads we partner with. Rather than owning internal developer\-tooling infrastructure or training foundation models from scratch, your mandate is to compress the time between an ambiguous idea and a reliable, user\-facing AI system, while raising the applied AI bar across every squad you touch. This role operates on an explicit **80/20 charter**: * **0\-to\-1 Product and Architecture Pathfinder (\~80%):** Rapidly prototype high\-ambiguity bets across our agent platform, cross\-agent context orchestration, borrower\-facing assistant experiences, and internal workflows. Partner directly with Product and Design to validate non\-deterministic UX, establish clean architectural patterns, and hand off battle\-tested evaluation contracts for engineering squads to scale. * **AI\-Native Engineering Catalyst (\~20%):** While dedicated internal teams own Upstart's broader AI developer tooling and software\-factory initiatives, you will serve as a visible practitioner on the product side. You will lead by example with agentic coding workflows and tight verification harnesses, partner with our internal tooling teams as an early adopter ("customer zero"), and help product squads adopt higher\-leverage ways of working. Because AI systems are non\-deterministic, user experience is part of the architecture. Whether you are designing cross\-agent handoffs, borrower\-facing assistant flows, or internal operational tools, you will navigate real\-world trade\-offs across latency, unit economics, reliability, and user trust, and push back constructively when a simpler deterministic approach is the right call. **How you'll make an impact** * **De\-risk 0\-to\-1 bets across the stack:** Rapidly prototype ambiguous initiatives spanning multi\-agent context sharing, UX for non technical users, platform primitives for launching agents, and borrower\-connected internal workflows. * **Deliver durable evaluation contracts, not throwaway handoffs:** Treat prototype code as disposable proof of concept, and hand off to engineers what they actually need to build production services with confidence: golden datasets, automated evaluation harnesses, documented failure\-mode maps, latency/cost benchmarks, and clean architectural blueprints. * **Partner cleanly from spike to production:** Align early with receiving squad tech leads to surface system constraints, support joint go/no\-go decisions with Engineering and Product leadership (including killing unviable bets early), and stay engaged through initial productionization to review early PRs and debug edge\-case model behavior. * **Design non\-deterministic **Agent platform and shared abstractions:** Experience designing reusable agent primitives, SDKs, or orchestration platforms that help peer engineering teams build, evaluate, and launch AI workflows safely and quickly. * **Production fine\-tuning and distillation reps:** Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning or distilling smaller models in production to improve latency, unit economics, or task reliability. * **AI\-native engineering habits:** Deep daily fluency with agentic coding workflows and automated verification harnesses, plus experience helping peer engineers adopt higher\-leverage development practices. * Experience in regulated or high\-trust consumer domains (such as fintech, lending, or healthcare) where accuracy, explainability, PII protection, and user trust are critical. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions' cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-MidSenior **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About WSI Technologies** WSI Technologies equips public safety and child advocacy professionals with mission\-critical tools for recording, managing and sharing interviews. Child advocacy centers, law enforcement agencies, prosecutors and health departments use our products in rooms where the recording may end up in court. Reliability, security and usability are non\-negotiable. ### **About the role** We're a small team and this is the most senior engineering seat on it. We're leaning harder into AI\-assisted development and tightening up our architecture, and we need an experienced backend engineer to lead both. You should be strong on the fundamentals (API design, databases, cloud infrastructure, security, performance), because you'll be making those calls every day. You're excited about how AI is changing the way software ships. You already use tools like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Gemini CLI to move faster, and you care that what they produce actually works. We want to merge a change and know it's tested, deployed and reversible without anyone holding their breath. Getting us there is the first six months of the job. You'll report to our VP of Technology and Operations, who sets product direction and still ships code. You'll direct a contract development team day to day. ### **What we expect you to challenge** We already know these could be better. You'll find more. * Too many manual steps between merging a change and seeing it in production. * Rolling a database change out to every customer safely. * How the platform performs and scales in production. * How much we trust code an AI agent wrote, and what we check before it ships. ### **What you'll own** **Architecture and code** * The architecture of the cloud platform, and the reasoning behind it. * Hands\-on development and code review. You write production code every week. * Technical lead on our next major product area and on our AI features. **Path to production** * Build, test and release pipelines from pull request to production, with rollback. * Schema changes and data migrations that roll out to every customer safely. **Azure production** * Production in Azure: access and identity, monitoring that catches problems before customers do, cost and incident response. * Reliability, performance and scale as customers and recordings grow. **Team** * How the team uses AI coding agents, and what has to be true before their code ships. * Day\-to\-day technical direction for a contract development and QA team. * Final technical escalation for the cloud platform and its integrations. ### **The stack you'll work in** * **Cloud platform (your focus):** C\# and ASP.NET Core, SQL Server with Entity Framework Core, and a TypeScript front end, hosted on Microsoft Azure. * **AI features:** transcription, speaker identification, translation and summaries. * **Build and test:** Azure DevOps, GitHub, and automated unit and end\-to\-end tests. * **Operations tooling:** PowerShell, Python and .NET. * **Also in the product family:** an on\-premises recording platform and a Windows tablet app. You won't lead these, but the cloud platform syncs with them. ### **What you bring** **Required** * Curiosity. jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer, Early Career
jobs.description: **About us** At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space. We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action. **What you'll do** The Viasat Engineering function is responsible for designing, building and maintaining a robust and flexible global satellite and ground network that incorporates Viasat and partner assets to deliver internet services to customers worldwide. By leveraging their expertise and innovative spirit, these teams at Viasat are helping to bridge the digital divide and connect people, businesses, and communities worldwide. **The day\-to\-day** We're seeking a highly motivated Associate Software Engineer to join our Integration \& Delivery team. * You will work on variety of projects including embedded (C, C\+\+) to full stack web services development (Python, Go, AWS, Google Cloud) * You will work with ground systems project teams, getting hands\-on experience solving problems, building, operating and validating software components for Viasat * Develop, test, and deploy software applications * Implement automation solutions to streamline workflows and reduce manual efforts * Participate in code reviews and regular team meetings * Collaborate with other developers and product managers * Adding new features to internal tools * Troubleshoot and resolve issues to maintain a high performing product **Additional Details** * This position is site\-based. Site‑based employees work 3\+ days (60%\+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day work week. Relocation assistance is available pending eligibility. **What you'll need** * Education: Completion of Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience: This role is intended for someone with 0\-3 years of full\-time, relevant industry experience. * Citizenship: This position requires a valid Work Permit or Visa for the country you would be located and working from. * Additional: + Demonstrated interest in generative AI and AI\-assisted software development through coursework, projects, or research. jobs.title: Assistant Professor - Artificial Intelligence in Civil and Environmental Engineering
jobs.description: * 538604 * Blacksburg, Virginia, United States * Civil \& Environmental Engineering * Engineering * Instructional / Teaching Faculty * Faculty (Salaried) * Virginia Tech **Job Description** The Charles E. Via, Jr. Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Virginia Tech invites applications for a tenure\-track Assistant Professor position from candidates with demonstrated expertise in developing, adapting, or applying artificial intelligence (AI) methods to address substantive civil and environmental engineering challenges. This open search welcomes candidates across all sub\-disciplines: construction engineering and management; environmental and water resources engineering; geotechnical engineering; structural engineering and materials; sustainable land development; and transportation infrastructure and systems engineering. The successful candidate will establish an externally funded research program and mentor students; contribute to undergraduate and graduate education that integrates AI with engineering fundamentals and professional practice; and contribute to departmental and professional service. Example research directions include AI\-enabled sensing and monitoring, physics\-informed modeling, digital twins, autonomous experimentation, and intelligent design and decision support for the built and natural environments. We particularly welcome approaches that integrate AI with engineering fundamentals to accelerate scientific discovery and address complex engineering challenges. Virginia Tech is making significant institutional investments in artificial intelligence, positioning AI as a strategic research priority. These investments include the Sanghani Center for Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics, the Institute for Advanced Computing, expanded high\-performance computing and GPU resources through Advanced Research Computing (ARC), and HokieAI, a university\-supported platform providing secure access to AI tools. Together with world\-class laboratory facilities and a substantial presence in the Washington, D.C., region, these resources create opportunities for interdisciplinary research, collaboration with industry and federal agencies, and AI\-driven innovation across the built and natural environments. The CEE Department has 52 tenured/tenure\-track faculty and 8 professors of practice. Eight faculty are recent early investigator award recipients, and numerous other faculty are recognized nationally and internationally. The department is home to 741 undergraduate students and 255 full\-time graduate students. The civil and environmental engineering graduate programs are currently ranked 8th and 5th, respectively, and the civil and environmental engineering undergraduate programs are ranked 10th and 7th, respectively, by U.S. News \& World Report (USN\&WR). Primary responsibilities include: * Develop and sustain an externally funded research program that develops, adapts, or applies AI methods to civil and environmental engineering challenges * Teach undergraduate and graduate courses supporting the department's educational mission, including AI applications across CEE program areas * Advise and mentor graduate and undergraduate students * Publish scholarly work and disseminate research to academic, practitioner and public audiences * Contribute service to the department, college, university and profession **Required Qualifications** * Doctoral degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a closely related discipline (such as computer science or electrical engineering), prior to the effective date of the appointment * Demonstrated research experience in developing, adapting or applying AI or machine learning methods to civil or environmental engineering problems, evidenced by peer\-reviewed publications or other substantive research outputs * A research plan in AI for civil and environmental engineering that could support external funding, as described in the research statement * Ability to teach undergraduate and graduate courses that integrate AI, computing, and data analytics with civil and environmental engineering, as described in the teaching statement * A strong record of academic accomplishments commensurate with rank, a proven ability to work collaboratively, and a commitment to interdisciplinary research and instruction **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience preparing or securing competitive external research funding, as PI, co\-PI or senior personnel * Experience applying AI methods to experimental, computational, field, or operational data from civil or environmental engineering systems * Experience with methods that combine AI with engineering knowledge, such as physics\-informed or hybrid models, uncertainty quantification, or interpretable models * Experience mentoring graduate or undergraduate students in research **Overtime Status** Exempt: Not eligible for overtime **Appointment Type** Regular **Salary Information** Commensurate with experience and qualifications. **Hours per week** 40 **Review Date** 1/4/2027 **Additional Information** The successful candidate will be required to have a criminal conviction check. **About Virginia Tech** Dedicated to its motto, *Ut Prosim* (That I May Serve), Virginia Tech pushes the boundaries of knowledge by taking a hands\-on, transdisciplinary approach to preparing scholars to be leaders and problem\-solvers. A comprehensive land\-grant institution that enhances the quality of life in Virginia and throughout the world, Virginia Tech is an inclusive community dedicated to knowledge, discovery, and creativity. The university offers more than 280 majors to a diverse enrollment of more than 36,000 undergraduate, graduate, and professional students in eight undergraduate colleges, a school of medicine, a veterinary medicine college, Graduate School, and Honors College. The university has a significant presence across Virginia, including Blacksburg, the greater Washington, D.C. area, the Health Sciences and Technology Campus in Roanoke, sites in Newport News and Richmond, and numerous Extension offices and research institutes. A leading global research institution, Virginia Tech conducts more than $650 million in research annually. Virginia Tech endorses and encourages participation in professional development opportunities and university shared governance. These valuable contributions to university shared governance provide important representation and perspective, along with opportunities for unique and impactful professional development. Virginia Tech does not discriminate against employees, students, or applicants on the basis of age, color, disability, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, ethnicity or national origin, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, or military status, or otherwise discriminate against employees or applicants who inquire about, discuss, or disclose their compensation or the compensation of other employees or applicants, or on any other basis protected by law. If you are an individual with a disability and desire an accommodation, please contact co\-chairs **Eric Jacques (ejacques@vt.edu)** and **Linsey Marr (lmarr@vt.edu)** during regular business hours at least 10 business days prior to the event.
