experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience. • Master's degree in Math, Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field AND minimum three (3\) years of experience in a directly related field OR Bachelor's degree in Math, Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field AND minimum five (5\) years of experience in a directly related field OR Minimum eight (8\) years of directly related experience • Experience with AI frameworks, LLMs, or generative AI (Claude, GPT, LangChain, etc.) • Knowledge of AI\-powered development tools or building AI\-enabled applications • Experience applying AI to engineering challenges or customer\-facing features • Understanding of commercial payments, money movement, B2B payables, or payment processing • Experience with cloud platforms, microservices, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) • Knowledge of API design, integration patterns, and distributed systems • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, or DevOps practices The Skills You Bring • Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale • Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, ‘hacking’ beyond traditional solutions • AI Experience: Familiarity with agentic AI, LLMs, AI frameworks, or machine learning applications • Language Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages (e.g., Java, C\#, C\+\+) • Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability • Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc. • Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev\-ops, and Agile/Scrum teams • We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $149,400\.00 to $ 238,500\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Develop agents that can perceive, reason, plan, act, and learn, utilizing Python and relevant AI libraries and frameworks. * Analyze and Evaluate Agent Behavior. Critically assess agent performance, understand the complexities of multi\-agent systems and human\-agent interaction, and identify risks. * Navigate Ethical Landscapes. Identify, analyze, and address the ethical challenges and safety considerations inherent in developing and deploying autonomous AI systems, applying principles of responsible AI. * Apply Agentic AI to Solve Problems. Conceptualize and build functional AI agents for practical applications, demonstrating the ability to integrate diverse concepts into cohesive business solutions. * Deep understanding of prompt engineering concepts, LLM fine\-tuning, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Familiarity with MCP servers or comparable model\-serving/hosting platforms. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, strong communication, and a collaborative attitude. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to extensively analyze and improve business processes and workflows. * Demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing AI\-driven functionalities integrated with ServiceNow, such as custom Agentic AI skills, GenAI integrations, and intelligent automation. * Strong technical background in ServiceNow\-specific development tools and frameworks (UI Policies, UI Macros, UI Pages, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Business Rules, Mid Server Configuration \& Architecture, Import Sets, Transform Maps, Update Sets). * Strong knowledge of the CMDB, data modeling, data strategies, and integrations. * Knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM/ITOM product portfolio including Change Management, Discovery, and Service Mapping. * Relevant certifications such as Certified ServiceNow Admin (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or Certified Application Developer (CAD) are highly desirable. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $127,000\.00 to $ 202,700\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Healthcare AI
jobs.description: About the Opportunity Our client is a fast\-growing healthcare AI startup that achieved **30x revenue growth over the past year**. Backgrounds We're Especially Interested In **Early\-Career Engineers (1–2 Years of Experience)** Candidates with experience at high\-growth technology startups, forward\-deployed engineering organizations, or strong computer science programs. **Experienced Engineers (3–6 Years of Experience)** Candidates with experience at high\-performing engineering organizations who have also worked in high\-growth, venture\-backed startups, founding engineering roles, or customer\-facing deployment environments. jobs.title: C-BRAIN Principal Software Development Engineer (Remote) - Neurology
jobs.description: **Location** ============ Remote, US **Scheduled Hours** =================== 40 **Position Summary** ==================== The Consortium for Brain Research and AI in Neurodegeneration (C\-BRAIN) is an academic\-industry consortium directed by Dr. Randall J. Bateman, Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis. C\-BRAIN brings together academic research institutions, pharmaceutical and biotech companies, technology partners, philanthropic organizations, and government agencies to develop AI\-powered tools to accelerate discovery in Alzheimer's disease and neurodegenerative disorders. Washington University serves as the coordinating center for C\-BRAIN. C\-BRAIN is currently deploying initial versions of the tools and developing plans for benchmarking and evaluation of the tools in addition to platform integration and scaling. C\-BRAIN is also working on development of foundational AI models for brain aging and neurodegeneration. See www.c\-brain.org. The C\-BRAIN Principal Software Development Engineer is the senior architect and technical lead for the platform behind C\-BRAIN's AI research tools, including InsightEngine and OpenScientist. Reporting to the C\-BRAIN Senior Technical Product Manager, who leads C\-BRAIN platform engineering, within the overall technical direction set by the C\-BRAIN Chief Technology Officer (CTO), this role owns the architecture, technical design, and technical delivery of the integrated platform: one system in which research tools, AI agents, and the foundation models C\-BRAIN builds share a common data model, permission model, and deployment path. The role turns the platform roadmap and its requirements for scale, security, cost, and interfaces into a target architecture, detailed designs, interface contracts, and working software, and leads the incremental move from today's services toward that target, including durable, sandboxed execution of long\-running agent jobs, a gateway through which agents reach C\-BRAIN tools, data, and models, Rust services for the security\-critical core (the job launcher, model proxy, and execution broker), an event\-driven data layer with fine\-grained access control, a web workspace with desktop and mobile clients where they add value, and inference on approved and self\-hosted open\-weight models, while keeping current tools reliable and secure. The ideal candidate has designed and operated systems at significant data and user scale, has led migrations of production systems without stopping delivery, and can turn an architecture into well\-scoped work that C\-BRAIN engineers and partner development teams can build to. This is not a prototyping position. C\-BRAIN\-specific context will be provided; architecture and production engineering fundamentals will not. Knowledge of neurodegeneration research data is a plus, not a requirement. **Job Description** =================== **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities:** Architecture and Technical Leadership * Own the architecture of the integrated platform: define the target system, service boundaries, interface contracts, and the migration path from current services so the platform meets its requirements for scale, security, cost, and interfaces, and record decisions in architecture decision records. * Break the architecture into well\-scoped work packages with clear interfaces and acceptance criteria that C\-BRAIN engineers and partner development teams can build to, and review delivered work against them. * Serve as technical lead for a team of about seven engineers, including engineers from partner development teams: set day\-to\-day technical direction, lead design and code reviews, and set coding standards and the definition of done. * Own technical planning and execution for the team: scope and sequence work, lead estimation and sprint planning, run stand\-ups and retrospectives when needed, and surface risks and dependencies early. * Maintain CI/CD with required tests, type checks, and security scans; branch protection; code owners; and staged promotion from development to staging to production. Mentor engineers through pairing and review, work with the open\-source maintainers of the tools C\-BRAIN builds on, including contributing C\-BRAIN's changes to upstream repositories under shared review, and set team practices for AI coding assistants with human review of every change. * Platform Integration and Migration * Lead the integration of InsightEngine and OpenScientist into one platform: bring existing capabilities in as modular tools behind a common agent and job framework and a shared tool gateway, and retire duplicated services. * Migrate incrementally toward the target architecture, replacing security\-critical and high\-throughput components (for example, the job launcher, model proxy, and execution broker) with Rust services behind stable interfaces, keeping agent and scientific code in Python, while current C\#/.NET, Python, and TypeScript services stay in production. * Bui ere in the job posting. **Skills:** Application Security, Cloud Security, Collaboration, Communication, Database Access Control, Data Consolidation, Escalation Management, LLM Architecture, Migration Software, Model Serving, Production Software, Python (Programming Language), Systemic Design, Technical Project Leadership **Grade** ========= G18 **Salary Range** ================ $129,800\.00 \- $228,400\.00 / Annually The salary range reflects base salaries paid for positions in a given job grade across the University. Individual rates within the range will be determined by factors including one's qualifications and performance, equity with others in the department, market rates for positions within the same grade and department budget. **Questions** ============= For frequently asked questions about the application process, please refer to our External Applicant FAQ . **Accommodation** ================= If you are unable to use our online application system and would like an accommodation, please email CandidateQuestions@wustl.edu or call the dedicated accommodation inquiry number at 314\-935\-1149 and leave a voicemail with the nature of your request. All qualified individuals must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. **Pre\-Employment Screening** ============================= All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre\-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening. **Benefits Statement** ====================== Personal * Up to 22 days of vacation, 10 recognized holidays, and sick time. * Competitive health insurance packages with priority appointments and lower copays/coinsurance. * Take advantage of our free Metro transit U\-Pass for eligible employees. * WashU provides eligible employees with a defined contribution (403(b)) Retirement Savings Plan, which combines employee contributions and university contributions starting at 7%. Wellness * Wellness challenges, annual health screenings, mental health resources, mindfulness programs and courses, employee assistance program (EAP), financial resources, access to dietitians, and more! Family * We offer 4 weeks of caregiver leave to bond with your new child. Family care resources are also available for your continued childcare needs. Need adult care? We’ve got you covered. * WashU covers the cost of tuition for you and your family, including dependent undergraduate\-level college tuition up to 100% at WashU and 40% elsewhere after seven years with us. For policies, detailed benefits, and eligibility, please visit: https://hr.wustl.edu/benefits/ **EEO Statement** ================= Washington University in St. Louis is committed to the principles and practices of equal employment opportunity. It is the University’s policy to provide equal opportunity and access to persons in all job titles without regard to race, ethnicity or shared ancestry, color, national origin, citizenship (where prohibited by federal law), age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. As a federal contractor, the university maintains affirmative action programs to implement its equal employment opportunity policy for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, in accordance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, as amended, and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 (VEVRAA), as amended.

C\-BRAIN\-specific context will be provided; software engineering fundamentals will not. Build and maintain versioned APIs and plug\-in interfaces for scientific tools, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. * Model Serving and AI Features * Integrate approved and self\-hosted open\-weight models into C\-BRAIN tools, including model gateway configuration, routing, and versioning. * Build agent and tool integrations with provenance on every result, and add hooks that let automated evaluations run before each release. Work with C\-BRAIN data scientists and applied scientists to package models and data services for production. * Collaboration and Documentation * Take part in design and code reviews, giving and receiving feedback that raises the quality bar. * Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and API references. Work with engineers from partner development teams and open\-source maintainers, including contributing changes to upstream repositories, and use AI coding assistants with human review of every change. * **Working Conditions:** * Remote within the United S ting, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Authentication, Authorizations, Collaboration, Growth Mindset, IT Implementation, Kubernetes, LLM Architecture, Migration Software, Neurodegeneration, OpenID, Open\-Source, Python (Programming Language), Scientific Research, Security Awareness, Software Product Engineering, UI Framework **Grade** ========= G16 **Salary Range** ================ $96,000\.00 \- $169,300\.00 / Annually The salary range reflects base salaries paid for positions in a given job grade across the University. jobs.title: Lead Architect – Databricks & Unity Catalog Governance
jobs.description: The Lead Architect owns the technical approach end to end: discovery across 90\+ workspaces, the target governance design for Unity Gateway, the pilot, and the wave plan for full rollout. This person is the client's senior technical counterpart and works directly with platform leadership and the Databricks account team. **Responsibilities** * Lead discovery of legacy AI usage across all workspaces using system.serving usage tables; coordinate with the Databricks account team on enforcement settings and feature gaps. * Set technical direction for the Platform Engineer and, in Phase 2, a team of 4–5 engineers. **Required qualifications** * 10\+ years in data platform engineering or architecture; 4\+ years hands\-on with Databricks at enterprise scale (dozens of workspaces). * Deep Unity Catalog expertise: metastore design, privilege model, governed tags/ABAC, system tables, cross\-workspace governance. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks Model Serving, Foundation Model APIs, external models, and AI Gateway (legacy) or Unity Gateway. * Working knowledge of LLM application patterns: OpenAI\-compatible SDKs, ai\_query, agents, RAG/vector search, MCP. * Experience leading a multi\-workspace or multi\-tenant platform migration with phased cutover. * Strong SQL and Python; jobs.title: Lead Engineer - Accounting Core
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Xero’s ledger is the source of truth for millions of businesses, and every product we ship is built on top of it. We are rebuilding this integrity layer for the next 20 years, and we are standing up the Vancouver engineering hub around it from day one. As Lead Engineer, you will make the architectural decisions that set the course for the platform and the team, and you will see those decisions reach every customer who depends on Xero to get their numbers right. **The Technical Challenges** ---------------------------- * **Correctness at scale.** Accounting data has to be consistent, auditable, and immutable. There is no “close enough,” and every change to the ledger has to preserve that guarantee across regions and regulations. * **Evolving a mature system.** We are adding real\-time expectations to a platform that millions of businesses depend on daily. That means strengthening service boundaries and clarifying data contracts without compromising reliability. * **Durable, high\-throughput services.** We use durable execution (for example, Temporal) to keep long\-running financial workflows accurate and recoverable under load. * **AI\-ready data.** We are structuring accounting data so it can power AI\-native experiences while maintaining trust in the numbers. **Impact** ---------- * **First six months:** You understand the ledger and its consumers, align the team on service boundaries and data contracts, and ship a first modernization increment with no loss of data integrity. * **First twelve months:** + You have set the architecture for the core accounting capabilities (general ledger, journals, chart of accounts, multi\-currency). + The Vancouver engineering team has clear ownership and quality standards, thanks in part to your leadership and role modeling. + Your work reaches customers through every product built on the ledger, and the decisions made now will shape Xero for years. **Ownership** ------------- You will own the technical direction for your area of the accounting platform, from design through production and on\-call. You will make architectural decisions on service boundaries, data contracts, and technology choices without needing sign\-off, and you will be accountable for reliability and data integrity end to end. You will also help set hiring, quality, and ownership practices for an early and growing team, which will compound over time. **Who You’ll Work With** ------------------------ Bernardo Farah is the Director of Engineering for Accounting Core. He has over 10 years of SaaS software experience, including six years building platforms and growing teams at Samsara. **What You Bring** ------------------ ### **Must\-have:** * You set the standard for your team in AI\-assisted development, operational excellence, and flexible architecture. * A track record delivering highly available, distributed backend systems and designing high\-throughput services under production constraints. * Depth in system architecture, API design, and both SQL and NoSQL databases * Proficiency in a modern backend stack such as C\#, Java, Go, or C\+\+, plus cloud\-native platforms like AWS. * You demonstrate strong ability in breaking down complex problems into clear, actionable solutions while driving agile execution to deliver results. ### **Nice to have:** * Experience with financial, ledger, or accounting systems, or other domains where data integrity is critical * Experience with durable execution or workflow engines such as Temporal * Experience modernizing a mature system without disrupting customers **How We Work** --------------- Process is a tool for impact and we adjust accordingly. We use an agile approach to ship outcomes, not to follow ceremony. Code and design reviews are where we trade ideas and hold the quality bar, and we are figuring out how to use LLMs to reduce how much code humans have to write and review by hand. Our on\-call rotation draws on a healthy pool of engineers and turns incidents into learning through postmortems. Decisions are made at every level, and we make sure everyone has the strategic context to raise proposals and drive innovation. **Our Hiring Process** ---------------------- * **TX phone screen** (45 minutes): a conversation with your Talent Specialist about your background, motivations and the role. * **Technical assessments:** a coding assessment and a systems design assessment, run through an independent third\-party provider and based on real\-world scenarios. * **Technical deep dive** (45–60 minutes): with a Principal Engineer and the hiring team. You'll walk through a past project you led, covering how you thought about it, executed it and led through its complexity. * **Values / Future Proof Xero** (45 minutes): how you show up day to day, aligned with Xero's values and capabilities such as adaptability, ownership, customer thinking and AI fluency. * **LEADership** (45–60 minutes): real examples of how you lead, influence and deliver in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments, assessed against Xero's leadership principles. **Compensation \& Total Rewards** --------------------------------- At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. We believe in a Total Package philosophy \- which means your value isn't just a single number on a paycheque. While base salary is a core component, we look at your compensation through a holistic lens that includes equity, performance incentives, and world\-class benefits. The expected base salary range for this role in: * Seattle, WA: **$206,000 \- $260,000 USD** Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role. In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation: * **Variable Pay:** Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance\-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and 21 days PTO, 10 days of Wellbeing leave, 5 days of Xtra Leave, 1 volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave. Further information included on our **Xero Perks** page *Xero uses AI to help screen applications based on job\-related qualifications. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make automated hiring decisions. A human recruiter reviews all candidates before any hiring action is taken.* This is a posting for an existing vacancy. Compensation Range: CA$186K \- CA$236K

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions** The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy's industry\-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real\-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real\-time trading decisions and mid\-to\-long\-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, collaborates well with teams across Yes Energy, and shows leadership by guiding technical decisions, mentoring others, and helping interview future teammates. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in data engineering, data modeling, or building and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines and distributed data warehouses. * 3 years of experience writing production code in Python or a general\-purpose programming language, and with SQL for data analysis. * Experience building or scaling text classification, natural language processing (NLP), or machine learning data pipelines. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline or equivalent professional experience. * Experience designing ontologies, versioned taxonomies, semantic layers, or metadata management platforms for large\-scale unstructured text, transcript, image, or video datasets. * Experience optimizing ML vs. LLM compute unit economics using vector embeddings, lightweight classifiers, evaluation golden sets, and AI coding tools. * Experience building APIs or architecting data models from the ground up. **About the job** ----------------- Much of the organization's most valuable signal sits in high\-volume unstructured data, including support call transcripts, partner feedback, images, and video metadata. Today, extracting insights often relies on fragmented spreadsheets and costly per\-document Large Language Model (LLM) inference. As a Senior Data Engineer in Technical Solutions, you will build the data foundation and metadata infrastructure that enables business teams and AI agents to understand YouTube's creator, partner, and support operations. You will replace ad\-hoc workflows with durable, deterministic infrastructure: versioned taxonomies and ontologies, vector\-embedding classification pipelines optimized for compute unit economics, and governed semantic data layers that allow stakeholders and AI tools to query business concepts accurately. Working across global engineering, analytics, and operations teams, you will own solutions end to end from scoping and data modeling through evaluation and production deployment. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C\+\+ and C\#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. You'll decide what the clients should do by talking to the developers who use them, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep Go expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: clickhouse\-go and ch\-go, and the collectors, pipelines, agents and tools that write millions of rows per second through your code. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Know who uses the clients and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, throughput, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap. * Be the voice of ClickHouse for Go developers. Speak at GopherCon and Go meetups, and write the posts, tutorials and examples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from Go (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them. * Own the Go clients and their ecosystem: clickhouse\-go, ch\-go, database/sql, releases and support. Evolve them without breaking the people who depend on them. * Keep the clients the fastest Go option for the fastest analytical database, and make sure the client is never the bottleneck. Performance is part of every release, not an afterthought: profile, change, measure again, catch regressions in CI, and publish the numbers. * Partner with the projects built on the clients, from the OpenTelemetry Collector to ClickHouse Grafana datasource and ClickPipes, and catch their regressions before they ship. * Review and co\-maintain other clients, and take part in cross\-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features. * Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it. * Make the clients enterprise\-ready: TLS and mTLS, cloud authentication, safe credential handling, vulnerability response, a small dependency footprint, and the questions large Go shops ask before they adopt. * Shape the clients for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try. * Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks. **About you** ------------- * Product\-minded with a bias for action. You'd rather run an experiment and bring back data than wait for approval, you measure whether it worked, and you can explain what you chose not to build. * 5\+ years in software, much of it on data\-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, ingestion, streaming, observability or analytics. * Deep Go expertise: the runtime and garbage collector, escape analysis, the memory model, pprof and the execution tracer. jobs.title: Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO)
jobs.description: **Company Description** ----------------------- Dcode is a team of doers dedicated to bridging the gap between the speed of technology and the federal government. We align people, culture, policies, and processes to get tech in the hands of those who need it most. Operating at the nexus of government leaders, emerging tech companies, and venture capital, we turn roadblocks into results. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for a **Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO)** to build and run Dcode’s product and engineering functions from the ground up. We need a rare combination of visionary product strategist and ruthless technical executor. This is a 0 1 role, and we will prioritize candidates with strong demonstrated product outcomes over candidates with domain\-specific experience in defense and government. As the company’s product leader, you will partner with the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to shape the company’s product vision and translate it into a strong, executable strategy. As the company’s senior technical authority and leader of the engineering organization, you will lead, grow, and set the standard for a highly technical engineering team to build a new class of software in one of the world's most complex enterprise environments. You should feel just as comfortable with evaluating production code and making tough but defensible architecture decisions as you do with holding a product to a high standard for craft and user experience. You thrive in a fast\-moving environment that demands exceptional judgment, adaptability, and comfort switching between strategic and hands\-on work. You’ll work to turn warfighter needs into deployable prototypes, make complex workflows simple and intuitive, review production code and contribute directly when needed, and apply rigor to our product thinking and polish to our core product surfaces. We’re looking for a visionary who challenges conventional thinking, sees opportunity where others don’t, and knows how to navigate institutional barriers without accepting “no” as the final answer. Someone who is energized by building what has never been built before and has the creativity, conviction, and execution skills to make it happen. This is an opportunity to build at the frontier of AI, agentic systems, and emerging technologies, creating an entirely new category of software that fundamentally changes how the government acquires, integrates, and deploys technology. **Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.** **What You’ll Do** ------------------ This is not a product\-dominant or engineering\-dominant position; you must be able to leverage your deep experience in both areas with equal fluency. You are an engineering leader with strong product sense and a high bar for craft, and a product leader who’s comfortable leading deeply technical engineering teams. In this role you will… **Lead our product and engineering functions.** * Build and lead the teams from the ground up: hire, coach, and develop world\-class product and engineering teams, setting a high bar for quality and helping each member grow * Own architecture, engineering quality and velocity, technical debt, testing and release practices, reliability, security, development standards, and build/buy/partner decisions * Architect for security, compliance, and government deployment requirements from day one, making deliberate decisions around data architecture, access controls, data isolation, and deployment environments that enable secure adoption and scale across federal customers * Stay hands\-on: review and directly contribute to prototypes and products; help unblock the hardest product and technical problems; and drive our transition from scrappy prototypes to enterprise\-grade platforms * Scale with the team: seamlessly transition from a hands\-on builder to a strategic executive as our headcount grows, and provide the standards and operational rigor needed without introducing unnecessary management layers or bureaucracy **Own our product strategy and execution.** * Turn Dcode’s services\-derived IP into configurable, scalable and repeatable software solutions * Push the boundaries of AI\-driven innovation. Identify, experiment with, and capitalize on the most advanced applications of artificial intelligence, agentic workflows, and emerging technologies to reimagine how complex government missions are executed * Challenge conventional approaches, pioneer capabilities that don't yet exist, and turn cutting\-edge technology into scalable, mission\-changing products * Build intelligent, data\-driven products that continuously learn from workflows, decisions, and outcomes, creating increasingly powerful capabilities and a compounding competitive advantage.Own the company's data strategy and architecture. Build scalable data infrastructure that captures, structures, and connects proprietary knowledge, customer workflows, and operational outcome * Own the product roadmap and drive the developm es for the business, with the implementation rigor and craft needed to take opportunities from idea to product * Partner closely with Customer Success and delivery teams to translate customer needs, implementation learnings, and field expertise into product improvements and reusable capabilities.Balance customer\-specific configuration and customization needs with the integrity and scalability of the core product, making disciplined decisions about what becomes a reusable platform capability versus a tailored implementation * Make and own critical trade\-offs between customer demand and product vision; these may include decisions on speed or technical debt, prototypes and production quality, and near\-term revenue versus longer\-term platform value **Demonstrate strong product judgement and taste.** * Model what “good” looks like to your team: demonstrate excellence in design and prototyping, rigor in product thinking, and strong problem solving in making complex concepts or features understandable and actionable * Stay close to detailed customer workflows and hands\-on in design; set a high bar for usability, interaction design, and information architecture, making complex workflows feel simple and intuitive * Own the quality of the user experience; treat latency, responsiveness, and reliability as first\-class concerns rather than afterthoughts, while advocating for user experience and design considerations early in the process **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 10 to 15\+ years of progressive engineering and product leadership (e.g. CTO, CPO, VP of Engineering, VP of Product, Founding Engineer, Principal\-Level FDE, etc.), with ownership of both product outcomes and technical direction * Strong understanding of federal security and compliance requirements (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST 800\-53, RMF/ATO processes, and government data handling requirements), with demonstrated ability to translate those requirements into early architectural and engineering decisions A demonstrated track record of 0* 1 product building; ideally building user\-facing products in enterprise environments, with experience taking sophisticated enterprise or mission\-critical software from concept through adoption and rapid growth * A powerful sense of product craft: we believe that a smooth user experience and beautiful product lead to the trust of our customers and great outcomes for our business, and **we will** **strongly prioritize demonstrated taste and product instincts** (candidates with strong portfolios or demonstrated outcomes with a history of strong product judgement) over domain\-specific experience in government or defense * Ability to operate effectively in an early\-stage environment where strategy, architecture, recruiting, customer conversations, and hands\-on problem solving frequently happen in the same day * Exceptional technical depth in modern software architecture, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms, and a strong understanding of modern AI systems and infrastructure * Experience building and deploying software in complex, high\-consequence, regulated, or technically constrained environments **Additional Information** -------------------------- **We look for resilient hustlers:** Our CEO busted her face on the balance beam in college and got back up… our COO has a habit of turning 'that can't be done' into 'watch me'… What's your story? **Equal Opportunity Statement** We provide equal opportunity to all persons without regard to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. We believe diversity is a strength and aim to build an innovative and welcoming culture where people from all backgrounds feel respected and included. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has the tools, resources, and opportunities to excel. EVm4WU3rx7

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. ### **About the Role** At eBay, we strive to build world\-class systems that ensure our global marketplace operates flawlessly and in strict compliance with evolving regulations. Our mission is to transform complex legal and regulatory requirements into scalable, reliable, and auditable engineering solutions. These solutions protect our platform's integrity and maintain trust for millions of buyers and sellers worldwide. establishing key performance metrics, debugging operational issues, and resolving pipeline failures. * Translate technical specifications and business/compliance requirements into clean, well\-tested, and maintainable production code. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Policy, Legal, and Platform Engineering teams to ship compliant, production\-grade solutions. * Participate in code reviews, contribute to technical documentation, and help uphold engineering guidelines across the team. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * Education: BS or MS or algorithms, data structures, and system development. * Production Delivery: Proven track record of implementing, testing, deploying, and maintaining production\-grade ML/AI services and data pipelines. * GenAI \& NLP: Hands\-on experience developing with LLMs, RAG architectures, timely engineering, context management, and vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone, OpenSearch vector). * Agentic Workflows: Practical experience implementing agentic components, function calling, tool use, or multi\-step execution flows. * Engineering Rigor: Strong background in writing unit/integration tests, implementing evaluation and monitoring frameworks, and debugging distributed services. * Data \& Distributed Systems: Experience with large\-scale data processing engines optimizing inference runtimes (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, batching/caching techniques). * Familiarity with AI governance concepts, model risk management (MRM), or safety guardrails (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard). * Experience working with high\-volume e\-commerce, fintech, or regulated cloud architectures. **Additional Details** The base pay range for this position is expected in the The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship. eBay is an equal opportunity employer. Our team operates across a distributed global environment, bringing together engineering, product development, commercial leadership, and operational expertise. We maintain centralized leadership, product ownership, security standards, and quality governance while leveraging global talent to accelerate innovation and execution. ### **Role Snapshot** * Location: In\-person at our Montvale, NJ area office, with hybrid flexibility for candidates based nearby * Team: Product \& Engineering * Type: Full\-time * Reports to Operations Manager ### **Role Overview** We're looking for a hybrid Designer / Full Stack Engineer who can both shape how our product looks and feels and build it end\-to\-end. You'll own the design of intuitive, trustworthy interfaces for healthcare users — pharmacists, technicians, and health system staff — and then bring those designs to life across the front end and back end. This is a rare, high\-ownership role for a versatile builder who moves fluidly between Figma and production code, and who cares deeply about crafting products that work beautifully in demanding clinical and pharmacy environments. ### **Core Responsibilities** * Own product design end\-to\-end: user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished, accessible UI * Translate complex pharmacy and healthcare workflows into clean, intuitive interfaces * Build and ship full\-stack features across the front end and back end * Develop responsive, accessible front\-end interfaces using modern frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) * Implement back\-end services, APIs, and data models that power the product * Integrate with EHR (Epic, athenahealth) and pharmacy management systems * Maintain and evolve a design system for consistency across the platform * Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and customers to iterate quickly * Ensure work meets security, privacy, and compliance standards (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITECH) * Balance craft with velocity — ship high\-quality work at startup pace ### **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of combined experience in product/UX design and full\-stack software development * Strong design portfolio demonstrating UX/UI work and shipped product interfaces * Proficiency with design tools (e.g., Figma) and design\-system thinking * Full\-stack development experience with a modern front\-end framework (e.g., React/TypeScript) and back\-end services * Solid understanding of APIs, databases, and web application architecture * Ability to work independently and own features from concept through production ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience designing and building for healthcare, clinical, or pharmacy users * Experience with EHR (Epic, athenahealth) or pharmacy management systems * Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and designing for high\-stakes workflows * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD * Experience at an early\- or growth\-stage company shaping product and design foundations ### **Why Join Us** HendrenAI is bringing modern voice AI and agentic jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:**Supports the delivery of solution or infrastructure development services for AI/ML initiatives, applying strong technical capability and hands\-on engineering experience. Contributes to the design, development, delivery, and maintenance of AI\-enabled solutions or infrastructure while aligning to relevant engineering standards and project delivery expectations. Understands user requirements and helps translate them into sound technical designs and implementation plans. Contributes to the integration of AI/ML capabilities into broader enterprise solutions, with a focus on quality, scalability, and user impact. **Your Key Responsibilities** * Develop, test, deploy, and support production\-grade AI/ML, generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions. * Solve complex technical problems across development, integration and production support through coding, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, and structured design remediation. * Translate user requirements into technical designs, APIs, workflows, and supportable implementation patterns. * Build and integrate LLM, RAG, and agentic solution components into enterprise solutions, applications and platforms. * Support project delivery through disciplined execution, estimation, documentation, status of communication, and risk identification. * Participate in design reviews, providing thoughtful trade\-off analysis and implementation of input. * Use modern AI\-assisted software engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic coding platforms as part of day\-to\-day engineering delivery to improve delivery speed, code quality and engineering efficiency. **AI and Engineering SkillsGen AI Foundational** * Experience designing, building, and maintaining production\-grade LLM applications, including end\-to\-end pipelines from data ingestion through model output delivery (e.g. Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI etc.). * Demonstrated practical experience building retrieval\-augmented systems that ground model outputs in enterprise knowledge sources, including chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, and retrieval optimization (e.g. LlamaIndex, LangChain, Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, pgvector etc.). * Working technical knowledge of embedding models, vector search, and semantic retrieval patterns used to ground LLM outputs in enterprise knowledge sources (e.g. OpenAI Embeddings, Azure AI Search, pgvector etc.). * Proficiency in prompt engineering techniques including zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, and structured output design, with the ability to systematically evaluate and iterate on prompt performance (e.g. DSPy, PromptFlow etc.). **Agentic and LLM Ops** * Experience designing and building agentic systems including multi\-agent orchestration patterns, tool use, and memory design across single and multi\-step workflows (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, NVIDIA NIM etc.). * Ability to debug, troubleshoot, and remediate production of LLM and agentic systems including failure diagnosis across retrieval, orchestration, and generation layers. **Software Engineering** * Hands\-on software engineering proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, modular, production\-quality code for LLM pipelines and agentic applications. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data sets to support LLM application development, including data curation, preparation, and quality validation for model inputs and model responses. * Working familiarity with RESTful and event\-driven API patterns including asynchronous workflows, service boundaries, and integration of enterprise data sources to expose LLM and agentic capabilities. * Practical understanding of containerization and orchestration concepts for packaging and deploying LLM applications in cloud environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS etc.). * Understanding software engineering best practices as applied to ML systems, including modular code design, testing patterns for AI pipelines, and data quality validation. * Familiarity with Data Monitoring and Data Observability in cloud environments (OpenTelemetry, Azure Application Insights, etc.). * Exposure to CI/CD and operationalization practices for AI systems, including model and workflow deployment, versioning, environment promotion, and release support in cloud or containerized environments. **Soft Skills and Additional Attributes for Success** * Clear communicator able to explain complex AI system behavior and trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including risk and compliance. * Strong ownership and accountability, taking responsibility for AI systems from design through production and issue resolution. * Able to operate effectively as requirements, regulations, and technologies evolve. * Collaborative and cross\-functional, working closely with engineering and product teams. * Bachelor's degree preferred. * 2\+ years of applied engineering experience, including meaningful experience in AI/ML engineering roles. * Partner with Development, Engineering, Product, Data, Architecture, and project leadership teams to deliver high\-value AI capabilities. * Ability to build and maintain model observability pipelines including tracing of multi\-step agentic reasoning chains, output degradation detection, and behavioral drift monitoring in production (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, Datadog, Azure Monitor, etc.). * Familiarity with LLM fine\-tuning approaches including instruction tuning and preference optimization, with an understanding of when fine\-tuning is appropriate versus prompt\-based solutions (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, NeMo Framework etc.). * Familiarity with responsible AI principles including bias and fairness evaluation, human\-in\-the\-loop design, and explainability approaches in financial services contexts. * Familiarity with data pipeline design for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, and quality validation. * Familiarity with cloud\-based platforms for building, training, and deploying scalable LLM solutions (e.g. Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI etc.). * Familiarity with AI\-assisted software engineering tools for accelerating development, implementation, and code review practices (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex etc.). * Strong grounding in traditional AI/ML and deep learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, neural network architectures, and training trade\-offs, with the ability to apply these concepts when shaping enterprise AI solutions. Pay: $50\.00 \- $52\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dallas, TX 75244

Since 2005, our team of makers, thinkers, and storytellers has partnered with leading brands like Google, Nike, Uber, ŌURA, and Eventbrite to craft digital experiences that create impact and drive results. Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t just design—we build. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Computer Vision
jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. ### **The role** Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on. We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way. ### **What you’ll do** * **Build models for the problems in front of us.** You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi\-view, multi\-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short. * **Work through the difficult footage.** You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects. * **Find out where your models fail.** You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results. * **Own the path to production.** You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back. * **Follow problems through to a fix.** You’ll reproduce customer\-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up. ### **What you’ll bring** * **Strong machine learning fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch. * **Experience training large vision models from scratch.** Your experience goes beyond running or fine\-tuning existing models. * **Depth in a computer vision specialty.** You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction. * **Experience owning models in production.** You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward. * **Comfort with the work as it is.** You can make progress with noisy real\-world data and adapt when priorities shift. ### **Nice to have** Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable: * **Hand and body tracking:** 3D hand and full\-body tracking, mesh recovery, human\-object and human\-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground. * **SLAM, VIO and calibration:** Learned ego\-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale. * **3D reconstruction and objects:** Feed\-forward or per\-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs. We may use AI\-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered. Compensation Range: CA$140K \- CA$200K

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Data Platform
jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. ### **The role** A capture is just the beginning. Before that footage becomes a dataset a robotics team can train on, it needs to be uploaded, processed, checked, labeled and packaged. You’ll build the systems that make that happen, along with the tools our operators, researchers and customers rely on every day. Our Data Platform—internally, the Data Engine—has work for software and machine learning engineers who like understanding how the pieces fit together. You’ll join as a generalist, starting in a pod that matches your strengths and company needs: capture, QA, text labels, delivery or infrastructure and platform. People move between pods as needs change, and you’ll own what you ship. ### **What you’ll do** * **Build across the stack.** You’ll take software from design through production, working across frontend, backend and data systems. * **Make the tools people need.** You’ll build clear, fast interfaces for the operators, researchers and customers using our platform every day. * **Keep the data moving.** You’ll scale the systems that ingest, process, store and serve very large volumes of video and sensor data. * **Make quality part of the pipeline.** You’ll run the systems that check, label and package data, including models working inside those pipelines, and keep bad data from reaching customers. * **Own how it runs.** You’ll take responsibility for reliability, performance and cost, replacing manual work and one\-off scripts with durable systems. ### **What you’ll bring** * **Strong software engineering fundamentals.** You bring sound system design and hands\-on experience with Python or TypeScript. * **Experience beyond a single layer.** You’ve worked across more than one layer of a production stack, or run models inside production pipelines. * **Good judgment when systems are live.** You’re comfortable monitoring, debugging and fixing production issues. * **The ability to make sense of ambiguous requirements.** You can work with researchers and non\-technical users to turn an unclear need into reliable, usable software. * **Ownership and speed.** You scope work tightly, ship a useful first version quickly and follow through on what you build. ### **Nice to have** Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable: * **Capture:** Capture applications and ingestion, device and sensor data, streaming and upload systems. * **QA:** Automated quality checks, model\-based QA, review tools and dashboards. * **Text labels:** Captioning and annotation pipelines, labeling tools and language\-model\-assisted labeling. * **Delivery:** Turning customer specifications into reproducible datasets, release gates, packaging, privacy checks and delivery tracking. * **Infrastructure and platform:** Databases such as MongoDB and ClickHouse, distributed GPU compute, storage, observability, model serving and training infrastructure. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote: United States **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- EngineeringSecurity Compliance \& ITSecurity Compliance \& IT **Compensation** ---------------- * $230K – $320K • Offers Equity *Our openings span more than one career level. The provided salary depends on many factors, such as work experience and transferable skills, business needs and impact, location, and market demands.* At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI\-native, full\-stack, multi\-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer\-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Staff Threat Intelligence Engineer to build Render’s threat intelligence program and turn what we learn about attackers into protections and products customers can use. As a hands\-on technical leader within External Security, you’ll connect research, platform telemetry, and external intelligence to detect malicious activity earlier, track campaigns, and help teams act. You’ll establish the program’s priorities and operating model, build its core systems, and help recruit and develop the engineers and researchers who grow it. Your first 90 days will focus on detecting anomalous network activity and delivering actionable leads to Trust \& Safety, who will own the resulting investigations. You’ll build the initial detection capability, provide supporting evidence and workload context, and use investigator feedback to improve signal quality. You’ll also work directly with customers and Product to turn repeatable capabilities into supported offerings. Initial opportunities include an IP threat feed, actionable threat notifications, and in container RASP, and intelligence that supports incident response. You’ll validate which opportunities solve a customer problem and can be operated sustainably. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and operate anomalous network activity detections, delivering evidence and affected workload or account context to Trust \& Safety for investigation. * Establish intelligence requirements with Security, Trust \& Safety, Engineering, and customer\-facing teams; prioritize threats to Render and its customers. * Build reliable collection, enrichment, correlation, and distribution pipelines that combine platform signals with external reporting. * Investigate attacker behavior and related accounts, infrastructure, and campaigns; document evidence, confidence, and alternative explanations. * Turn research into tested detections, investigation workflows, and response recommendations with clear ownership and measurable results. * Build partnerships with researchers, intelligence providers, and peer platforms to improve early warning and coordinated response. * Productize useful intelligence through maintained APIs, feeds, tools, or customer\-fac ate demand, adoption, willingness to pay where relevant, and delivery economics. * Publish useful research and represent Render externally in coordination with Legal and Communications. * Define the team’s skill mix and staffing plan, help hire, mentor contributors, and establish peer review and shared operational ownership. * Measure detection quality, time to action, responder effort, customer adoption, and operating cost. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * A track record of building or materially advancing a threat intelligence program and delivering operational results. * Strong software engineering skills and experience operating production data pipelines, services, or APIs. * Depth in threat research, campaign analysis, and detection engineering, including reasoning under uncertainty. * Experience converting intelligence into protections used by responders, engineering teams, or customers. * Staff\-level technical leadership: setting direction, gaining cross\-team commitment, mentoring others, and delivering complex work. * Product judgment and experience validating user needs before committing substantial engineering effort. * Clear writing, sound evidence handling, and the judgment to communicate uncertainty without overstating attribution. * Pragmatism, empathy, and ownership of long\-term system health and customer impact. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience with cloud platforms, containers, malicious workloads, phishing, C2 infrastructure, or shared IP reputation. * Experience shipping intelligence feeds, security APIs, or customer\-facing detection products. jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Stuut** =============== Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order\-to\-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank. Over 150 companies, spanning the mid\-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date. Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai. *THE ROLE* At Stuut, you’ll build and lead the data engineering team. You’ll hire and manage the data engineers, own the roadmap, and still build and review pipelines yourself. We ingest data from a lot of client systems: invoices, payments, customers and the rest of the order\-to\-cash record, much of it from ERPs. It arrives in a different shape, and with different gaps, for every customer. Your team builds and runs the pipelines that land it, clean it, model it, and get it to our product, our customers’ dashboards and our AI agents, on time and correct. Our stack is Python and Postgres, Estuary CDC into Snowflake, and dbt for transformation and testing. Sigma runs our customer dashboards, and Ask Stuut, our analytics agent, queries the same Snowflake models. We share data with customers through Snowflake data sharing, and Inngest and DBOS run our scheduled jobs. The foundation is in place. Most of what sits on top of it is still yours to build. *WHAT YOU’LL DO* * Manage, hire and grow the data engineering team, and set the bar through design and code review. * Own the data roadmap with product, engineering and leadership: what the team takes on and in what order. * Build and run the ingestion pipelines that land client data in Snowflake, including CDC from Postgres through Estuary, backfills and schema changes. * Own how we model data in Snowflake. We use dbt, and you’ll set the standards for how models are structured, tested, reviewed and deployed. * Monitor and alert on pipeline health: replication lag, failed or late runs, stale tables and unexpected changes in volume. * Track data completeness and accuracy for every customer, so we catch a problem before they do. * Keep core receivables metrics consistent everywhere they appear: in the product, in dashboards and in Ask Stuut. * Improve data latency and warehouse cost as volume and customer count grow. * Build the pipelines that serve warehouse data back to the product, including the data our AI agents and models rely on. *YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU…* * Have 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building and running production data pipelines in Python and SQL. * Have led a data team as a manager or tech lead, and have hired and grown engineers. * Have deep, hands\-on Snowflake experience in production. This one is required. You also know dbt well and have opinions on what good looks like. * Have run CDC from a production database into a warehouse and know the ways it breaks. * Have run a large data cleanup end to end: traced a gap back to its cause source by source, backfilled millions of rows without blocking live syncs, and added the checks that kept it fixed. * Have decided what to do when a source system simply doesn’t have the field you need, and written the rule down so everyone derives it the same way. * Have set data contracts with customers for files and data shares, and pushed back when what they sent wasn’t good enough. * Care about data quality and observability: testing, freshness, lineage, alerting. * Have worked on multi\-tenant data, where every customer looks a little different. * Can prioritize across many stakeholders and explain the trade\-offs plainly. *BIG PLUS* * Experience with financial data: invoices, payments, ERP exports, order\-to\-cash. * You’ve built pipelines that feed ML models or AI agents. * You’ve shipped customer\-facing analytics, like embedded dashboards or data shares. **US Compensation** * Top\-of\-market salary and equity package * Benefits (for U.S.\-based full\-time employees) * Medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you * 401(k) \& Match * Equity * Flexible PTO * Parental Leave **Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.** We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out. Compensation Range: $275K \- $315K

jobs.title: IT Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role** T1 Energy is hiring an IT Software Development Engineer at G1\_Dallas, our 5GW solar module facility in Wilmer, Texas, just south of Dallas. You own the Nintex business process management (BPM), Infor warehouse management system (WMS), and IBM integration platform as a service (iPaaS) systems that run warehouse and business operations. You work with business teams in Human Resources, Finance, and Production to improve workflows and keep systems integrated. This is an on\-site role in a manufacturing environment. **What You’ll Do** * Manage and maintain Nintex BPM, Infor WMS, and IBM iPaaS systems. * Develop and deploy cross\-system integrations using C\#, Java, and Python. * Perform database administration tasks for Oracle (WMS) and SQL Server (BPM). * Optimize SQL scripts and stored procedures for Oracle and SQL Server. * Partner with business teams to gather requirements and implement workflow and process enhancements. * Monitor system performance and troubleshoot real\-time issues. * Ensure compliance with IT security and audit requirements. * Support project acceptance and delivery of WMS implementations for new warehouse facilities. * Develop and deploy localized customizations for WMS inbound processes and order fulfillment. * Provide daily WMS support and manage user access. * Manage on\-site incidents, including scanner, printer, and workflow disruptions. * Manage the WMS codebase and server environments. * Handle basic Oracle database tasks, such as deadlock resolution and order resets. * Maintain the OpenShift container platform for enterprise integrations. * Deploy, update, and manage the integration lifecycle for ERP, WMS, and BPM systems. * Diagnose application programming interface (API) latency, transaction failures, and data inconsistencies across integrated platforms. * Implement real\-time monitoring for transaction bottlenecks and high\-latency operations. * Manage 35\+ active business processes across Human Resources, Finance, and Production, with 300\+ approval nodes. * Maintain the approval matrix, organizational structures, and user permissions. * Own requirements documentation, code implementation, and functional testing for new business processes. * Design and develop custom business reports and ad\-hoc analytics tools. **Who You Are** * Strong at problem\-solving: you diagnose and fix issues in real time. * Accountable: you thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability manufacturing environment. **Qualifications** * Strong proficiency in C\#, Java, and Python. * Hands\-on experience with SQL Server and Oracle Database, including query optimization. * Familiarity with Windows Server and Red Hat Linux environments. * Experience with enterprise workflow or business process management systems and WMS operations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Fluency in English and Mandarin. * Experience with Nintex. * Experience with IBM iPaaS or similar integration platforms. * Familiarity with Git version control and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. * Experience supporting Oracle\-based WMS systems in a production setting. **About T1 Energy** At T1 Energy (NYSE: TE), we build energy. We are an American solar manufacturer building the future of energy abundance. From our headquarters in Austin, Texas, we’re pioneering a domestic solar supply chain with one mission: to invigorate America with scalable, reliable, and low\-cost energy. We started with G1\_Dallas, one of the most advanced solar manufacturing facilities in the world. The 5GW facility is located in Wilmer, Texas. It has the capacity to produce more than 20,000 solar modules a day for solar farms that power American homes, businesses, and keep our energy grids resilient. Next is G2\_Austin: Our new solar cell fab in Rockdale, Texas. Its first 2\.1GW phase is designed to produce next\-generation TOPCon cells beginning in 2027\. As the fab grows, it’s expected to support up to 1,800 manufacturing jobs. Modules assembled at G1 can run on cells from G2\. What comes after G2? Come join us and help figure that out. And then build it. The sun has always shone on America. Now you can turn it into abundant electricity. **The T1 Way** We’re all in on the mission, and we pursue it as one team. We move fast, own our results, and treat each other with respect. Egos stay at the door: no one is too senior to roll up their sleeves, and no idea is too small to share. Be sharp, be honest, be human. If you can hold the line and keep a sense of humor, you’ll fit right in. T1 Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics.
